articles.title: Surprising new pattern of groundwater loss may signal a turning point for the Colorado River Basin
articles.author: Sascha Pare

paras.en: Western states that were thought to be resistant to prolonged drought may be more vulnerable than scientists previously believed, a new analysis of groundwater reserves in the Colorado River Basin finds.
paras.zh: 对科罗拉多河流域地下水储量的一项新分析发现，被认为能够抵抗长期干旱的西方各州可能比科学家之前认为的更脆弱。

paras.en: Researchers revealed the four states that together make up the Upper Basin — Colorado, New Mexico, Utah and Wyoming — lost almost twice as much groundwater as the Lower Basin did during an intense drought in the southwestern U.S. between 2020 and 2022. The finding was unexpected and might signal a turning point for the region, because the Upper Basin has long been seen as more resilient to dry spells than the Lower Basin, said Esther Oyedele, a doctoral student in geosciences at Virginia Tech and the study's first author.
paras.zh: 研究人员透露，在 2020 年至 2022 年美国西南部的严重干旱期间，组成上盆地的四个州——科罗拉多州、新墨西哥州、犹他州和怀俄明州——损失的地下水几乎是下盆地的两倍。地球科学博士生 Esther Oyedele 表示，这一发现出人意料，可能标志着该地区的一个转折点，因为长期以来人们认为上盆地比下盆地更能抵御干旱。弗吉尼亚理工大学的教授，也是该研究的第一作者。

paras.en: "The Upper Colorado River Basin has historically been considered more resilient because it receives more precipitation, particularly snowfall in the Rocky Mountains," Oyedele told Live Science in an email. "I think the important takeaway is that we should not assume that the Upper Basin will remain relatively resilient simply because it has historically received more precipitation and snowmelt."
paras.zh: 奥耶德勒在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“历史上，科罗拉多河流域上游被认为更具弹性，因为它接收更多的降水，尤其是落基山脉的降雪。” “我认为重要的一点是，我们不应该仅仅因为历史上经历过更多的降水和融雪就认为上盆地将保持相对的弹性。”

paras.en: The Lower Basin comprises parts of Nevada, California and Arizona. Less rain and snowfall means the Lower Basin naturally has less groundwater recharge, or less replenishment from other water sources, than the Upper Basin. On top of that, the Lower Basin generally has higher evaporation rates and substantial water demands, given that roughly 30 million of the 40 million people that depend on the Colorado River for water live in the Lower Basin, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 下盆地包括内华达州、加利福尼亚州和亚利桑那州的部分地区。降雨和降雪较少意味着下流域的地下水补给量或其他水源的补给量自然少于上流域。 Oyedele 表示，最重要的是，鉴于依赖科罗拉多河供水的 4000 万人中约有 3000 万人生活在下盆地，因此下盆地的蒸发率普遍较高，需水量也很大。

paras.en: In the new study, published Oct. 13 in the journal Water Resources Research, researchers used satellite and hydrological data to estimate groundwater depletion across the Colorado River Basin between 2004 and 2023. The data included measurements of surface water, soil moisture and snow-water storage, as well as observations from the Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment mission and its successor, called the Follow-On.
paras.zh: 在10月13日发表在《水资源研究》杂志上的这项新研究中，研究人员利用卫星和水文数据来估计2004年至2023年间科罗拉多河流域的地下水枯竭情况。这些数据包括地表水、土壤湿度和雪水储存量的测量结果，以及重力恢复和气候实验任务及其后续任务（称为后续任务）的观测结果。

paras.en: The results showed that groundwater depletion has been a persistent problem in the Colorado River Basin over the past two decades, but losses accelerated in 2019. The three-year drought that began in 2020 is the principal cause of this, because it shrank the snowpack in the Rocky Mountains, increased evaporation and boosted water demand across the basin, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 结果显示，过去二十年来，地下水枯竭一直是科罗拉多河流域的一个长期问题，但2019年损失加速。奥耶德勒说，2020年开始的三年干旱是造成这一问题的主要原因，因为它减少了落基山脉的积雪，增加了蒸发，并增加了整个流域的用水需求。

paras.en: During the drought between 2020 and 2022, the Upper Basin lost around 4.2 cubic miles (17.5 cubic kilometers) of groundwater, while the Lower Basin lost about 2.3 cubic miles (9.4 cubic km). In total, the Colorado River Basin lost 14 cubic miles (58.3 cubic km) of groundwater — equivalent to 25 million Olympic-size swimming pools' worth of water — during the study period, between 2004 and 2023.
paras.zh: 在2020年至2022年的干旱期间，上盆地损失了约4.2立方英里（17.5立方公里）的地下水，而下盆地则损失了约2.3立方英里（9.4立方公里）的地下水。在 2004 年至 2023 年的研究期间，科罗拉多河流域总共流失了 14 立方英里（58.3 立方公里）的地下水，相当于 2500 万个奥林匹克规模游泳池的水量。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: It's unclear why the deficit is so much higher in the Upper Basin than in the Lower Basin, but the Upper Basin's proximity to and dependence on the mountains for aquifer recharge probably didn't help, Oyedele said. As snow melts, some of it replenishes groundwater, so a reduction in snowfall between 2020 and 2022 would have affected the Upper Basin particularly badly, she noted.
paras.zh: 奥耶德勒说，目前还不清楚为什么上盆地的赤字比下盆地高得多，但上盆地靠近山区并依赖山区进行含水层补给可能没有帮助。她指出，随着积雪融化，其中一些会补充地下水，因此 2020 年至 2022 年降雪量减少将对上流域造成特别严重的影响。

paras.en: The Upper Basin also recorded more aquifer recharge during wet periods before the drought than the Lower Basin did, so it's possible that the pronounced decline during the drought was linked to a higher initial amount of groundwater in the Upper Basin, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 奥耶德莱说，在干旱前的湿润期，上盆地的含水层补给量也比下盆地多，因此干旱期间的明显下降可能与上盆地初始地下水量较高有关。

paras.en: Next, the researchers used advanced statistical methods to explore the relationship between groundwater and surface water in the Colorado River Basin. Due to global warming and the overallocation of the Colorado River's water in a 1922 document, the river's flow is now 35% less than it was on average in the 20th century. Water scarcity in the basin has reached alarming levels, according to the study, and Lake Mead and Lake Powell, the two largest reservoirs in the U.S., dropped to record lows in August.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员利用先进的统计方法探讨了科罗拉多河流域地下水和地表水之间的关系。由于全球变暖以及 1922 年文件中对科罗拉多河水量的过度分配，该河的流量现在比 20 世纪的平均流量减少了 35%。研究显示，该流域的水资源短缺已达到惊人水平，美国最大的两个水库米德湖和鲍威尔湖的水量在八月份跌至历史最低水平。

paras.en: The team found that in the Upper Basin, groundwater levels evolve in the same direction as surface water, but with a slight delay. This suggests groundwater losses occur due to a lack of recharge and more aquifer pumping during periods of drought, when surface water levels drop. In the Lower Basin, however, this link is weaker and more complex. The results showed that groundwater losses sometimes preceded surface water declines during the study period, suggesting that groundwater depletion is not simply tied to less surface water trickling into the ground or to humans extracting groundwater when there's less surface water available. Instead, groundwater is consistently being overused, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，在上游盆地，地下水位的演变方向与地表水相同，但略有延迟。这表明地下水流失是由于干旱期间地表水位下降时缺乏补给和更多含水层抽水造成的。然而，在下盆地，这种联系较弱且更为复杂。结果表明，在研究期间，地下水流失有时先于地表水下降，这表明地下水枯竭不仅仅与流入地下的地表水减少或在地表水减少时人类抽取地下水有关。相反，地下水一直被过度使用，奥耶代勒说。

paras.en: "This distinction is important because it suggests that groundwater depletion is not simply a direct response to surface-water shortages," she said. "Human water use, particularly sustained groundwater extraction, may also play a significant role."
paras.zh: “这种区别很重要，因为它表明地下水枯竭不仅仅是地表水短缺的直接反应，”她说。 “人类的用水，特别是持续的地下水开采，也可能发挥重要作用。”

paras.en: - Drought paradox study reveals plants around Colorado River turn to groundwater when it gets too hot and dry, reducing flow into the already strained basin
paras.zh: - 干旱悖论研究表明，科罗拉多河周围的植物在变得太热和干燥时会转向地下水，从而减少流入已经紧张的盆地的流量

paras.en: - Colorado River negotiations have stalled among 7 states and water is scarce. What happens next?
paras.zh: - 七个州之间的科罗拉多河谈判陷入僵局，水源稀缺。接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: - 'It has become very dire in a lot of places': New map reveals exactly where humans are adding and removing precious fresh water on Earth
paras.zh: -“很多地方的情况都变得非常可怕”：新地图准确揭示了人类在地球上添加和去除宝贵淡水的位置

paras.en: Looking ahead, it's hard to tell if the Upper Basin will continue to lose more groundwater than the Lower Basin and what that would mean for the region, Oyedele said. What seems clear, however, is that the Upper Basin is more vulnerable to drought than experts had thought.
paras.zh: 奥耶代勒说，展望未来，很难判断上盆地是否会继续比下盆地流失更多地下水，以及这对该地区意味着什么。然而，似乎很清楚的是，上游盆地比专家想象的更容易受到干旱的影响。

paras.en: "Continued warming, changes in snowpack, prolonged drought, and increasing water demand could place additional pressure on groundwater resources across both basins," Oyedele said. However, future groundwater responses will depend on several factors, including precipitation, snowmelt, water use and management decisions, she added.
paras.zh: 奥耶代勒说：“持续变暖、积雪变化、长期干旱和不断增加的需水量可能会给这两个盆地的地下水资源带来额外压力。”然而，她补充说，未来地下水的反应将取决于几个因素，包括降水、融雪、用水和管理决策。

paras.en: On the management side, Oyedele suggested tackling groundwater and surface water together rather than as two separate resources. Groundwater helps to sustain river flows, and rivers can recharge aquifers — so the two are interconnected. Groundwater often serves as a backup during drought, but it shouldn't be treated as an unlimited reserve, she said.
paras.zh: 在管理方面，奥耶德勒建议同时处理地下水和地表水，而不是作为两种单独的资源。地下水有助于维持河流流量，河流可以给含水层补给——因此两者是相互关联的。她说，地下水通常在干旱期间作为备用水，但不应被视为无限的储备。

paras.en: Oyedele, E. O., Werth, S., & Carlson, G. (2026). Contrasting groundwater response to surface water shortages in the Upper and Lower Colorado River Basins. Water Resources Research, 62(10). https://doi.org/10.1029/2025wr041695
paras.zh: Oyedele, E. O.、Werth, S. 和 Carlson, G. (2026)。科罗拉多河流域上游和下游地下水对地表水短缺的反应对比。水资源研究，62(10)。 https://doi.org/10.1029/2025wr041695

paras.en: Sascha is a U.K.-based staff writer at Live Science. She holds a bachelor’s degree in biology from the University of Southampton in England and a master’s degree in science communication from Imperial College London. Her work has appeared in The Guardian and the health website Zoe. Besides writing, she enjoys playing tennis, bread-making and browsing second-hand shops for hidden gems.
paras.zh: Sascha 是 Live Science 驻英国的特约撰稿人。她拥有英国南安普顿大学生物学学士学位和伦敦帝国理工学院科学传播硕士学位。她的作品曾出现在《卫报》和健康网站 Zoe 上。除了写作之外，她还喜欢打网球、制作面包和逛二手店寻找隐藏的宝石。

articles.title: Christina Applegate misdiagnosis: Why can MS be difficult to diagnose?
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Actor Christina Applegate was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis (MS) over five years ago — but this week, she announced that a recent reevaluation found that she doesn't have the condition after all. In the wake of that revelation, she's been left without a diagnosis, and she said on a podcast that she felt she was "back at square one, where I don't know what's going on with me."
paras.zh: 演员克里斯蒂娜·艾伯盖特五年多前被诊断出患有多发性硬化症 (MS)，但本周，她宣布最近的重新评估发现她根本没有患有这种疾病。此事曝光后，她一直没有得到诊断，她在播客上说，她觉得自己“回到了原点，我不知道自己出了什么事。”

paras.en: Applegate's case is not totally unique, although MS diagnosis has improved over the years. Studies offer different estimates of how frequently MS is misdiagnosed, with rates ranging from 5% to over 40%, depending on the patient population and clinical setting. There is also some degree of underdiagnosis — cases in which people with MS aren't flagged as having the disease.
paras.zh: 尽管多年来多发性硬化症的诊断有所改善，但阿普尔盖特的病例并不完全是独一无二的。研究对多发性硬化症的误诊频率提供了不同的估计，误诊率从 5% 到超过 40% 不等，具体取决于患者群体和临床环境。还存在一定程度的诊断不足的情况，即患有多发性硬化症的人没有被标记为患有这种疾病。

paras.en: So, how difficult is MS to identify, and what does that mean for patients? Live Science spoke with experts about the current state of MS diagnostics and the improvements that may be coming in the future.
paras.zh: 那么，多发性硬化症的识别有多困难，这对患者意味着什么？ Live Science 与专家讨论了多发性硬化症诊断的现状以及未来可能出现的改进。

paras.en: "It's also really important that doctors and patients be aware that it's not inappropriate to revisit a diagnosis — to make sure it's right," Dr. Ari Green, chief of the Division of Neuroimmunology and Glial Biology at the University of California, San Francisco, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 加州大学旧金山分校神经免疫学和神经胶质生物学系主任阿里·格林博士告诉《生活科学》杂志：“同样重要的是，医生和患者要意识到，重新审视诊断并不是不合适的，以确保诊断是正确的。”

paras.en: MS is an autoimmune disorder in which the immune system attacks the central nervous system, meaning the brain and spinal cord. These attacks harm neurons directly and also take aim at myelin — a fatty, insulating substance that coats neurons' outgoing wires and helps them send signals efficiently.
paras.zh: 多发性硬化症是一种自身免疫性疾病，其中免疫系统攻击中枢神经系统，即大脑和脊髓。这些攻击直接伤害神经元，并且还针对髓磷脂——一种脂肪绝缘物质，覆盖神经元的传出线并帮助它们有效地发送信号。

paras.en: This damage leads to distinctive scarring in nerve tissue and causes a range of symptoms, including vision problems, muscle weakness, tingling sensations, dizziness and bladder control issues. Patients with untreated and advanced MS can lose the ability to walk and stand or, in some cases, develop partial or complete paralysis.
paras.zh: 这种损伤会导致神经组织出现明显的疤痕，并引起一系列症状，包括视力问题、肌肉无力、刺痛感、头晕和膀胱控制问题。未经治疗的晚期多发性硬化症患者可能会失去行走和站立的能力，或者在某些情况下会出现部分或完全瘫痪。

paras.en: These severe outcomes are becoming rarer as treatments have improved significantly, Green said. Current treatments keep immune attacks at bay and thus prevent further nerve damage.
paras.zh: 格林说，随着治疗方法的显着改善，这些严重的后果变得越来越罕见。目前的治疗方法可以阻止免疫攻击，从而防止进一步的神经损伤。

paras.en: "It's moved from people ending up with severe, profound disability at 10 or 20 years of disease, and now it's at like 30 or 40 years of disease, they have modest disability," Green told Live Science. The disease most often emerges between age 20 and 40, although it can occur in any age group. Importantly, Green said, "the earlier people initiate treatment who have MS, the better they do over the long term."
paras.zh: 格林告诉《生活科学》杂志：“以前，人们在患病 10 或 20 年时就会出现严重、严重的残疾，而现在，在患病 30 或 40 年时，他们的残疾程度是中等的。”这种疾病最常出现在 20 岁至 40 岁之间，尽管它可以发生在任何年龄组。重要的是，格林说，“患有多发性硬化症的人越早开始治疗，从长远来看，他们的表现就越好。”

paras.en: For that reason, it's important to reach an MS diagnosis efficiently, so that patients can start that critical treatment, said Dr. Yohance Allette, a neuroimmunologist and researcher at Penn State Health. "You're trying to be as proactive as possible with this."
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学健康中心的神经免疫学家兼研究员 Yohance Allette 博士表示，出于这个原因，有效地诊断多发性硬化症非常重要，这样患者才能开始关键的治疗。 “你正在尝试尽可能积极主动地处理这件事。”

paras.en: However, there is no single, surefire test that can reliably show that a person has MS. "With MS, it comes down to the keyword 'criteria," Allette said.
paras.zh: 然而，没有单一的、万无一失的测试可以可靠地表明一个人患有多发性硬化症。 “对于多发性硬化症，它归结为关键词‘标准’，”阿莱特说。

paras.en: MS experts have compiled a list of criteria, which are updated periodically, that reflect how the features of MS show up in lab tests; brain, optic nerve and spinal cord scans; and patients' symptoms. (Green was among the dozens of experts involved in the latest update, which was conducted in 2024 and published in 2025.)
paras.zh: 多发性硬化症专家编制了一份标准清单，并定期更新，以反映多发性硬化症的特征在实验室测试中的表现；脑部、视神经和脊髓扫描；以及患者的症状。 （格林是参与最新更新的数十位专家之一，该更新于 2024 年进行并于 2025 年发布。）

paras.en: So, what does diagnosis look like for a patient today? The first step is to recognize symptoms that might point to MS.
paras.zh: 那么，今天的患者的诊断是什么样的呢？第一步是识别可能表明多发性硬化症的症状。

paras.en: Those early symptoms — such as issues with balance, vision or bowel control — vary significantly from person to person and may not immediately raise red flags that the patient has a neurological problem, Green said. The way those symptoms emerge can be a clue, though; typically, MS symptoms worsen over the course of a day or a few days and then dissipate, he noted.
paras.zh: 格林说，这些早期症状——例如平衡、视力或肠道控制问题——因人而异，可能不会立即发出患者患有神经系统问题的危险信号。不过，这些症状的出现方式可能是一个线索。他指出，通常情况下，多发性硬化症的症状会在一天或几天内恶化，然后消失。

paras.en: Once concerning symptoms are flagged, MRIs of the brain and spinal cord are taken. The scans may reveal evidence of myelin damage, and neurologists note the shape, size and location of those lesions. Damage often appears near blood vessels, since that's where immune cells access the brain, Green noted.
paras.zh: 一旦发现相关症状，就会对大脑和脊髓进行核磁共振检查。扫描可能会揭示髓磷脂损伤的证据，神经科医生会记录这些病变的形状、大小和位置。格林指出，损伤通常出现在血管附近，因为那是免疫细胞进入大脑的地方。

paras.en: Other conditions — like migraine, uncontrolled diabetes or vascular disease — can also come with some myelin damage, so it's key to look for specific patterns related to MS. Neurologists who specialize in MS are practiced at this task, while doctors in other neurological specialties may not know how to distinguish MS-related myelin damage from that caused by other conditions, Allette and Green both noted.
paras.zh: 其他疾病（例如偏头痛、不受控制的糖尿病或血管疾病）也可能会导致髓磷脂损伤，因此寻找与多发性硬化症相关的特定模式至关重要。阿莱特和格林都指出，专门研究多发性硬化症的神经科医生负责这项任务，而其他神经科专业的医生可能不知道如何区分多发性硬化症相关的髓鞘质损伤和其他疾病引起的髓鞘质损伤。

paras.en: MRIs of the optic nerves can also show MS-related damage, and these scans are emphasized in the latest diagnostic criteria, Allette noted. Electrophysiologic tests, which assess the function of nerves, are also "super important because they tell you something totally different than just seeing a lesion on MRI," Green said. Further signs of MS can be found via spinal taps, which sample the fluid around the brain and spinal cord that may carry proteins and inflammatory cells related to MS.
paras.zh: Allette 指出，视神经 MRI 也可以显示与多发性硬化症相关的损伤，最新的诊断标准强调了这些扫描。格林说，评估神经功能的电生理测试也“非常重要，因为它们告诉你的东西与仅仅在 MRI 上看到的病变完全不同”。多发性硬化症的进一步症状可以通过脊椎穿刺来发现，脊椎穿刺对大脑和脊髓周围的液体进行取样，这些液体可能携带与多发性硬化症相关的蛋白质和炎症细胞。

paras.en: In addition to collecting these clues, doctors must rule out diseases that look similar to MS. These include neuromyelitis optica and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD) — two other autoimmune conditions that affect the central nervous system. Both these diseases are associated with distinctive, rogue immune proteins, called autoantibodies, that latch onto various parts of the nervous system; those specific antibodies are not seen in MS.
paras.zh: 除了收集这些线索外，医生还必须排除与多发性硬化症相似的疾病。其中包括视神经脊髓炎和髓磷脂少突胶质细胞糖蛋白抗体相关疾病（MOGAD）——另外两种影响中枢神经系统的自身免疫性疾病。这两种疾病都与独特的流氓免疫蛋白（称为自身抗体）有关，这种蛋白会附着在神经系统的各个部分。这些特异性抗体在多发性硬化症中是看不到的。

paras.en: Other conditions — such as the inflammatory disease lupus and neuromuscular disease myasthenia gravis — can sometimes look like MS at first glance, as well. Some of these "MS mimics" can be ruled out with data from spinal taps or antibody tests, while others require a more laborious battery of assessments.
paras.zh: 其他疾病——例如炎症性疾病狼疮和神经肌肉疾病重症肌无力——乍一看有时也像多发性硬化症。其中一些“多发性硬化症模拟”可以通过脊髓穿刺或抗体测试的数据来排除，而另一些则需要更费力的一系列评估。

paras.en: "Ultimately, it's a diagnosis of exclusion," Allette said. "There are things that you can rule out quickly," while others take time to investigate thoroughly.
paras.zh: “最终，这是一个排除诊断，”阿莱特说。 “有些事情你可以很快排除”，而另一些事情则需要时间来彻底调查。

paras.en: Conditions like MOGAD and neurosarcoidosis, an inflammatory condition sometimes mistaken for MS, can actually be worsened by MS medications, Green noted. So if a patient's MS flare-ups worsen after they start a treatment, that could hint that something else is the culprit, he said. But because there may be long gaps between flare-ups, doctors may need to track a patient for some time before their worsening becomes apparent.
paras.zh: 格林指出，MOGAD 和神经结节病（一种有时被误认为是多发性硬化症的炎症性疾病）等疾病实际上可能会因多发性硬化症药物而恶化。因此，如果患者的多发性硬化症在开始治疗后病情恶化，这可能暗示有其他原因，他说。但由于两次发作之间可能存在很长的间隔，医生可能需要在患者病情恶化变得明显之前对患者进行一段时间的跟踪。

paras.en: Given all the tools available, a patient can be reasonably confident in their MS diagnosis, Green said.
paras.zh: 格林说，考虑到所有可用的工具，患者可以对自己的多发性硬化症诊断充满信心。

paras.en: "In general, there's a fair amount of diagnostic confidence that comes with MS diagnosis today," he said. However, that confidence is highest when the tools are in the hands of a specialist who is following the most up-to-date criteria, he noted. The test results require interpretation, and that's one place where uncertainty can creep in.
paras.zh: “总的来说，当今的多发性硬化症诊断具有相当大的诊断信心，”他说。然而，他指出，当工具掌握在遵循最新标准的专家手中时，这种信心是最高的。测试结果需要解释，而这正是不确定性可能蔓延的地方。

paras.en: Regarding Applegate's circumstances, "to speak bluntly, I think the case came as a bit of a shock because we always expect that part of society to have quick access [to high-quality medical care]," Allette said. For some patients, the road to accessing specialty MS care can be long, which can result in missteps, and even misdiagnoses, along the way. Applegate went five years with an incorrect diagnosis, but "would that have been seven or eight years for somebody who doesn't have that access?" Allette speculated.
paras.zh: 关于阿普尔盖特的情况，“坦率地说，我认为这个案件有点令人震惊，因为我们总是希望社会的一部分能够快速获得[高质量的医疗服务]，”阿莱特说。对于一些患者来说，获得多发性硬化症专业护理的道路可能很漫长，这可能会导致失误，甚至误诊。阿普尔盖特花了五年时间才得到了错误的诊断，但“对于没有这种机会的人来说，这会是七八年吗？”阿莱特猜测道。

paras.en: Without knowing the details of Applegate's case, Allette and Green said it would be difficult to speculate on what resulted in her misdiagnosis. (Applegate mentioned that her brain scans had been reassessed with a "new technology," but didn't go into specifics.)
paras.zh: 阿莱特和格林表示，在不了解阿普尔盖特病例细节的情况下，很难推测是什么导致了她的误诊。 （阿普尔盖特提到她的脑部扫描结果已经通过“新技术”重新评估，但没有透露具体细节。）

paras.en: Looking toward the future of MS diagnostics, Green and Allette think emerging proteomic tests hold a lot of promise. Such tests generate a profile of the proteins and smaller fragments, called peptides, in a patient's blood or cerebrospinal fluid. They can be designed to look for proteins involved in driving the underlying immune attacks, as well as signs of nerve damage that MS wrecks, they explained.
paras.zh: 展望多发性硬化症诊断的未来，Green 和 Allette 认为新兴的蛋白质组测试具有很大的前景。此类测试可生成患者血液或脑脊液中的蛋白质和较小片段（称为肽）的概况。他们解释说，它们可以被设计来寻找参与驱动潜在免疫攻击的蛋白质，以及多发性硬化症破坏的神经损伤的迹象。

paras.en: - 'The right diagnosis is unbelievably powerful': It can take years to diagnose rare diseases, and scientists are trying to fix that
paras.zh: - “正确的诊断具有令人难以置信的力量”：诊断罕见疾病可能需要数年时间，科学家们正在努力解决这个问题

paras.en: - Why are dengue cases surging in Florida this year? An 'unlucky' combination of factors, experts say
paras.zh: - 为什么今年佛罗里达州登革热病例激增？专家称，这是多种因素的“不幸”组合

paras.en: - 'Zombie cells' may drive aging, and scientists are devising new ways to get rid of them
paras.zh: -“僵尸细胞”可能会导致衰老，科学家正在设计消除它们的新方法

paras.en: These in-depth, protein analyses could help paint a more comprehensive picture of MS, which could ultimately help scientists "look at that whole system in concert" to reach a strong diagnosis, Allette said.
paras.zh: 阿莱特说，这些深入的蛋白质分析可以帮助描绘出更全面的多发性硬化症图景，最终可以帮助科学家“协同观察整个系统”以得出强有力的诊断。

paras.en: No proteomics-based diagnostic tests for MS have been approved yet, Green clarified. And even with those upcoming advances, Green doubts there will ever be a simple, one-time test that can determine a patient has MS. "I think that's probably unlikely, that it would ever be that straightforward," he said.
paras.zh: 格林澄清说，基于蛋白质组学的多发性硬化症诊断测试尚未获得批准。即使有了这些即将取得的进展，格林怀疑是否会有一种简单的一次性测试可以确定患者是否患有多发性硬化症。 “我认为这不太可能，事情永远不会那么简单，”他说。

paras.en: He does think that, in time, scientists could pare down the number of tests required to reach a diagnosis, but he argued that the clinical evaluation conducted by a neurologist will likely remain crucial. "I'm doubtful that there's going to be a test that will fully replace that," he said, "at least in the foreseeable future."
paras.zh: 他确实认为，随着时间的推移，科学家们可以减少诊断所需的测试数量，但他认为，神经科医生进行的临床评估可能仍然至关重要。 “我怀疑是否会有一项测试能够完全取代它，”他说，“至少在可预见的未来。”

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: Immerse Yourself in the Cosmos at Frank Lloyd Wright's Only Planetarium, Recently Restored to Its Former Glory in Florida

paras.en: Frank Lloyd Wright, one of America’s most famous and prolific architects, designed over 1,000 architectural works during his career. More than 500 were built, including countless houses, several churches, a few theaters and one planetarium.
paras.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特 (Frank Lloyd Wright) 是美国最著名、最多产的建筑师之一，在他的职业生涯中设计了 1,000 多件建筑作品。建造了 500 多座，其中包括无数房屋、几座教堂、几座剧院和一个天文馆。

paras.en: That single planetarium opened its doors in 1960 in the Polk County Science Building on the campus of Florida Southern College, a hotspot of Wright architecture. When its projector died in 2004, the planetarium fell into dormancy for over two decades. But now, after a nearly six-year renovation and technological overhaul, it is once again open to the public, per a statement from the school.
paras.zh: 这座单一的天文馆于 1960 年在佛罗里达南方学院校园的波尔克县科学大楼内开业，该学院是赖特建筑的热点。 2004 年，当投影仪失效后，天文馆陷入了长达二十多年的休眠状态。但现在，根据学校的声明，经过近六年的改造和技术检修，它再次向公众开放。

paras.en: “The college was always looking for an opportunity to restore the planetarium, knowing full well its potential to excite and inspire audiences of all ages, as they get a glimpse into the heavens and the great genius of Frank Lloyd Wright,” Jeff Baker, an architect who is leading a campus-wide renovation of Wright’s buildings, tells Dezeen’s Ellen Eberhardt.
paras.zh: “学院一直在寻找修复天文馆的机会，深知它有潜力让各个年龄段的观众兴奋和启发，因为他们可以一睹天空和弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的伟大天才，”领导赖特建筑全校园翻修的建筑师杰夫·贝克告诉 Dezeen 的艾伦·埃伯哈特。

paras.en: The private college in Lakeland, Florida, is a trove of Wright’s architecture. Wright first visited Florida Southern College in 1936, during a career high—construction was wrapping up at Fallingwater and beginning at Taliesin West. He accepted a commission to redesign the college’s campus, which he envisioned as a “Child of the Sun,” composed of sand-colored concrete and stained glass.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州莱克兰的这所私立学院是赖特建筑的宝库。赖特第一次访问佛罗里达南方学院是在 1936 年，当时正是他职业生涯的巅峰时期——流水别墅的建设工作即将结束，西塔里埃森的建设也将开始。他接受了重新设计学院校园的委托，将其设想为“太阳之子”，由沙色混凝土和彩色玻璃组成。

paras.en: Between 1938 and 1958, the architect contributed 12 buildings to the campus (a 13th was completed after his death), making it the largest single-site collection of Wright’s architecture in the world. Since 2007, Florida Southern has been restoring its run-down Wright buildings.
paras.zh: 1938 年至 1958 年间，这位建筑师为校园贡献了 12 座建筑（第 13 座建筑在他去世后竣工），使其成为世界上最大的赖特建筑单址收藏。自 2007 年以来，佛罗里达南方航空一直在修复其破旧的莱特建筑。

paras.en: “This architecture represents the laws of harmony and rhythm,” Wright said in a 1950 speech at the college. “It’s organic architecture and we have seen little of it so far. It’s like a little green shoot growing in a concrete pavement.”
paras.zh: “这座建筑代表了和谐与节奏的法则，”赖特在 1950 年在学院的一次演讲中说道。 “这是有机建筑，到目前为止我们还很少看到它。它就像混凝土路面上生长的小绿芽。”

paras.en: The Polk County Science Building was among the last of Wright’s campus designs to be realized. The planetarium—originally conceived as an observatory but scrapped on account of the Florida sun—was built between 1954 and 1958 and held its first show in 1960.
paras.zh: 波尔克县科学大楼是赖特最后实现的校园设计之一。该天文馆最初被设想为一座天文台，但由于佛罗里达州的阳光而被废弃，建于 1954 年至 1958 年间，并于 1960 年举办了首次展览。

paras.en: “Wright turned a rather prosaic program into a form of built poetry,” Baker tells Artnet’s Richard Whiddington in an email. “It was a holistic view of education. Students were taught to understand and appreciate the value of our connection to the earth while simultaneously looking for inspiration toward the stars.”
paras.zh: “赖特将一个相当平淡的程序变成了一种建筑诗歌的形式，”贝克在一封电子邮件中告诉 Artnet 的理查德·惠丁顿。 “这是一种整体的教育观。学生们被教导要理解和欣赏我们与地球的联系的价值，同时寻找星星的灵感。”

paras.en: The restoration team worked from the outside in, installing a new roof, sealing out water and replacing more than 280 custom-made tiles that decorate the building’s edges. They then took on the task of restoring the interior of the 60-seat theater.
paras.zh: 修复团队从外到内进行工作，安装了新屋顶、防水并更换了 280 多块装饰建筑物边缘的定制瓷砖。随后，他们承担了修复60个座位的剧院内部的任务。

paras.en: “Decades of interventions since Wright’s death had dramatically altered the room,” Baker tells Dezeen. The workers repainted the walls, refurbished the dark red floor and removed a computer closet once added to the room. “This removal allowed us to restore and reinstate all the seating in its original circular form, which we learned is a very rare survival in planetariums throughout the country,” Baker adds.
paras.zh: “赖特去世后数十年的干预措施极大地改变了这个房间，”贝克告诉德泽恩。工人们重新粉刷了墙壁，翻新了深红色的地板，并拆除了房间里添加的电脑柜。贝克补充道：“这次拆除使我们能够将所有座位恢复到原来的圆形形状，我们了解到，这在全国天文馆中是非常罕见的。”

paras.en: The renovation team also replaced all the planetarium’s audio-visual equipment, which formerly ran eight-track tapes, FOX 13’s Carla Bayron reports. The theatre will now regularly screen immersive public shows like “Cosmic Adventure” and “Destination Mars: The New Frontier.”
paras.zh: 据 FOX 13 的 Carla Bayron 报道，翻新团队还更换了天文馆的所有视听设备，这些设备以前运行的是八轨磁带。该剧院现在将定期放映《宇宙冒险》和《目的地火星：新前沿》等沉浸式公共节目。

paras.en: Frank Lloyd Wright’s designs appear on several other campuses, including Wichita State’s Corbin Education Center and the Grady Gammage Memorial Auditorium at Arizona State University.
paras.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的设计出现在其他几个校园，包括威奇托州立大学的科尔宾教育中心和亚利桑那州立大学的格雷迪·甘米奇纪念礼堂。

paras.en: The college planetarium wasn’t Wright’s first attempt at designing for astronomy. In the 1920s, he conceived a different planetarium for a Maryland complex that was never built. Born in 1867, the architect was fascinated by science and nature, which he incorporated into solar-conscious and futuristic designs.
paras.zh: 大学天文馆并不是赖特第一次尝试天文学设计。 20 年代，他为马里兰州的一座综合体设想了一个不同的天文馆，但从未建成。这位出生于 1867 年的建筑师对科学和自然着迷，并将其融入到太阳能意识和未来主义设计中。

paras.en: “During the course of his life, he goes from horse-and-buggy to envisioning and drawing cities that would include flying cars, and this is the only planetarium he actually got to build,” Florida Southern College president Jeremy P. Martin tells FOX 13. “But thinking about his fascination with the structure and the medium, I think we've exceeded even his wildest dreams in this restoration and new equipment.”
paras.zh: 佛罗里达南方学院院长杰里米·P·马丁 (Jeremy P. Martin) 告诉福克斯 13 频道：“在他的一生中，他从马车到想象和绘制包含飞行汽车的城市，这是他真正建造的唯一一个天文馆。但考虑到他对结构和媒介的迷恋，我认为我们在这次修复和新设备中甚至超越了他最疯狂的梦想。”

articles.title: For the First Time, Scientists Trapped an Elusive Antimatter Particle—and Contained It for Months. It Could Allow Them to Test an Enduring Physics Theory

paras.en: How do you contain a fast-moving particle that disappears as soon as it touches almost anything? You build a very special trap.
paras.zh: 如何控制快速移动的粒子，一旦接触到几乎任何物体就会消失？你建造了一个非常特殊的陷阱。

paras.en: For the first time, researchers have used electric and magnetic fields to capture and maintain an elusive kind of particle known as a positron—the antimatter cousin of an electron. In a study published October 21 in Physical Review Letters, the team describes how they have kept the particle trapped for months, where they can control and study it. The work paves the way for a test that could make or break a longstanding theory of particle physics.
paras.zh: 研究人员首次利用电场和磁场来捕获和维持一种难以捉摸的粒子，称为正电子——电子的反物质表亲。在 10 月 21 日发表在《物理评论快报》上的一项研究中，研究小组描述了他们如何将粒子捕获数月，以便控制和研究它。这项工作为一项可能成就或打破粒子物理学长期理论的测试铺平了道路。

paras.en: “Trapping an antiparticle is extremely difficult,” says Stefan Ulmer, a researcher at the Japanese scientific institute RIKEN who was not involved in the study, to New Scientist’s Karmela Padavic-Callaghan. The work is a “remarkable achievement,” Barbara Latacz, a particle physicist at CERN who did not participate in the study, tells Nature’s Elizabeth Gibney.
paras.zh: “捕获反粒子极其困难，”未参与这项研究的日本理化学研究所研究员斯特凡·乌尔默 (Stefan Ulmer) 对《新科学家》杂志的卡梅拉·帕达维奇·卡拉汉 (Karmela Padavic-Callaghan) 说道。欧洲核子研究中心的粒子物理学家芭芭拉·拉塔茨（Barbara Latacz）没有参与这项研究，她告诉《自然》杂志的伊丽莎白·吉布尼，这项工作是一项“了不起的成就”。

paras.en: Many people are familiar with electrons, protons and neutrons—three kinds of particles that make up atoms—but the universe also hosts particles known as antimatter, essentially the opposite of “regular” matter. Every kind of “regular” particle has a twin-like particle of antimatter with an equal mass but the opposite electrical charge. Positrons are the antimatter versions of electrons, antiprotons are the antimatter versions of protons and antineutrons are the antimatter versions of neutrons, for example. When antimatter meets its equivalent matter, the particles annihilate, or essentially disappear, converting their mass into energy.
paras.zh: 许多人熟悉电子、质子和中子——构成原子的三种粒子——但宇宙中也存在被称为反物质的粒子，本质上与“常规”物质相反。每种“常规”粒子都有一个类似孪生的反物质粒子，其质量相同但电荷相反。例如，正电子是电子的反物质版本，反质子是质子的反物质版本，反中子是中子的反物质版本。当反物质遇到它的等价物质时，粒子就会湮灭，或者说基本上消失，将它们的质量转化为能量。

paras.en: Annihilation presents an interesting conundrum regarding the birth of the universe. Scientists would have expected the Big Bang to produce the same amount of matter and antimatter. But this scenario would have also caused the entire universe to disappear. “All the matter and antimatter would annihilate and there’d be no universe left,” Gerald Gabrielse, a physicist at Northwestern University who led the study, tells Nature.
paras.zh: 湮灭提出了关于宇宙诞生的一个有趣的难题。科学家们预计大爆炸会产生相同数量的物质和反物质。但这种情况也会导致整个宇宙消失。领导这项研究的西北大学物理学家杰拉尔德·加布里埃尔斯告诉《自然》杂志：“所有的物质和反物质都会湮灭，宇宙将不复存在。”

paras.en: That clearly isn’t the case, and today the known universe has significantly more matter than antimatter. The standard model of particle physics—which explains the interactions between the building blocks of matter and fundamental forces in the universe—doesn’t have an explanation for why this is our reality. Even though this theory has proven to be extraordinarily accurate overall, it still has glaring issues—and it can’t predict why the universe exists. So something must be missing.
paras.zh: 事实显然并非如此，如今已知宇宙中的物质远多于反物质。粒子物理学的标准模型——它解释了宇宙中物质的组成部分和基本力之间的相互作用——并没有解释为什么这是我们的现实。尽管这一理论已被证明总体上非常准确，但它仍然存在明显的问题——并且它无法预测宇宙为何存在。所以一定是缺少了一些东西。

paras.en: Our universe has more matter than antimatter—in fact, antimatter is very hard to find. But presumably, antimatter-dominated regions of our universe could exist—or even a universe that’s made primarily of antimatter.
paras.zh: 我们的宇宙中物质多于反物质——事实上，反物质很难找到。但据推测，我们的宇宙中可能存在以反物质为主的区域，甚至可能存在一个主要由反物质构成的宇宙。

paras.en: To investigate, the team wanted to compare the magnetic properties of positrons and electrons to see whether they align with the standard model’s predictions. They had already figured out how to catch and precisely study a single electron. So they needed to do the same for a positron, which can shoot out from the radioactive decay of certain atomic nuclei.
paras.zh: 为了进行研究，该团队希望比较正电子和电子的磁性，看看它们是否与标准模型的预测相符。他们已经弄清楚如何捕获并精确研究单个电子。因此，他们需要对正电子做同样的事情，正电子可以从某些原子核的放射性衰变中射出。

paras.en: “The biggest challenge,” Gabrielse tells Science Alert’s Michelle Starr, is to persuade that high-energy positron “to slow down enough that we can capture it into our particle trap.”
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔斯告诉《科学警报》的米歇尔·斯塔尔，“最大的挑战是说服高能正电子“足够慢，以便我们能够将其捕获到粒子陷阱中。”

paras.en: He and his colleagues began with a rare, radioactive sodium isotope that emitted the positrons. Then, they slowed the positrons by passing them through a crystal of tungsten—some were annihilated, but others survived. With specialized electric and magnetic fields, they captured one of those particles and suspended it in a near-perfect vacuum at a temperature just barely above absolute zero, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 他和他的同事从一种发射正电子的稀有放射性钠同位素开始。然后，他们通过让正电子穿过钨晶体来减慢它们的速度——一些正电子被湮灭，但另一些则幸存下来。根据一份声明，他们利用专门的电场和磁场捕获了其中一个粒子，并将其悬浮在温度略高于绝对零的近乎完美的真空中。

paras.en: “If you want to hold on to antimatter, you have to hold it in a container without walls,” Gabrielse tells Clara Moskowitz for Scientific American.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔斯告诉《科学美国人》的克拉拉·莫斯科维茨：“如果你想保留反物质，你必须把它放在一个没有墙壁的容器中。”

paras.en: In this container, the team was able to observe and use microwaves to control the particle’s quantum energy states. “It’s a real kick to stand in my lab and watch a positron making transitions—‘quantum jumps’ we call them—between its lowest energy states. How much more fundamental, how much neater can it get?” Gabrielse tells New Scientist.
paras.zh: 在这个容器中，研究小组能够观察并使用微波来控制粒子的量子能态。 “站在我的实验室里，观看正电子在其最低能态之间进行跃迁（我们称之为‘量子跃迁’），真是太令人兴奋了。它还能变得多么基本、多么整洁？”加布里埃尔斯告诉新科学家。

paras.en: But the best is yet to come. Now that they’ve proven they can observe and control a positron in this manner, they can compare its precise magnetic properties to those of a normal electron. The current theory states they should be the same. But if they prove to be different, it could reveal a much-sought-after flaw in the standard model—and begin to suggest why regular matter is so much more ubiquitous.
paras.zh: 但最好的尚未到来。现在他们已经证明可以通过这种方式观察和控制正电子，他们可以将其精确的磁特性与正常电子的磁特性进行比较。当前的理论表明它们应该是相同的。但如果它们被证明是不同的，它可能会揭示标准模型中备受追捧的缺陷，并开始说明为什么常规物质如此普遍。

paras.en: “We know the standard model has to be wrong somewhere—or at least incomplete,” Gabrielse says in the statement. “We’re very precisely examining the most fundamental and simple systems to find where the theory breaks down. We hope to find an unambiguous answer.”
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔斯在声明中说：“我们知道标准模型一定在某个地方是错误的，或者至少是不完整的。” “我们正在非常精确地研究最基本、最简单的系统，以找出理论失败的地方。我们希望找到一个明确的答案。”

articles.title: A Team of Astronomers Thinks They Have Identified the Exact Night Sky That Inspired Vincent van Gogh's 'Starry Night.' Not Everyone Is Convinced

paras.en: On a clear summer night in 1889, Vincent van Gogh gazed through his asylum window at the bright pre-dawn sky above Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, France.
paras.zh: 1889 年一个晴朗的夏夜，文森特·梵高透过精神病院的窗户凝视着法国圣雷米普罗旺斯上空黎明前明亮的天空。

paras.en: Something about the scene moved the 36-year-old, who was recovering from several mental health crises. In one letter from around early June, he wrote to his brother, Theo: “This morning I saw the countryside from my window a long time before sunrise, with nothing but the morning star, which looked very big.” In mid-June, he wrote to his brother that he had completed “a new study of a starry sky.”
paras.zh: 这个场景让这位 36 岁的人感动不已，当时他正从几次心理健康危机中恢复过来。在六月初左右的一封信中，他写给弟弟西奥：“今天早上，我在日出前很久就从窗户看到了乡村，除了晨星之外什么也没有，它看起来非常大。”六月中旬，他写信给他的兄弟，说他已经完成了“对星空的新研究”。

paras.en: For years, art historians have used these letters and other documentary clues to date the painting of one van Gogh’s masterpieces, The Starry Night, to June 1889. But a team of astronomers from South Korea now claims that van Gogh created the painting during another starry night, about a month later.
paras.zh: 多年来，艺术史学家一直利用这些信件和其他文献线索将梵高的杰作《星夜》的画作追溯到 1889 年 6 月。但来自韩国的一组天文学家现在声称，梵高是在大约一个月后的另一个星夜创作了这幅画。

paras.en: In a new study published this week in the journal Scientific Reports, the researchers argue that they have pinpointed the exact night sky that inspired van Gogh: July 22, 1889.
paras.zh: 在本周《科学报告》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员认为，他们已经确定了激发梵高灵感的确切夜空：1889 年 7 月 22 日。

paras.en: “No two skies are the same. Something always changes. I believe Vincent noticed those changes and put them into the painting,” lead author Elijah Jeong-hyun Kim, the CEO of a Seoul telescope maker and an astronomy doctoral candidate at Kyung Hee University, tells Marcia Dunn of the Associated Press (AP) in an email. “I am confident that July 22 is the better date. I will bet on this date.”
paras.zh: “没有两片天空是一样的。总有一些东西在变化。我相信文森特注意到了这些变化，并将它们融入到画作中，”第一作者、首尔望远镜制造商首席执行官、庆熙大学天文学博士生 Elijah Jeong-hyun Kim 在一封电子邮件中告诉美联社 (AP) 的玛西娅·邓恩 (Marcia Dunn)。 “我相信 7 月 22 日是更好的日期。我会押注在这个日期。”

paras.en: The theory is founded on the idea that van Gogh closely based his painting on the actual sky, rather than painting stars he imagined. With this in mind, the researchers conducted a series of forensic astronomy experiments to match the celestial alignment depicted in The Starry Night with what van Gogh likely saw from Saint-Rémy during the summer of 1889.
paras.zh: 该理论的基础是梵高的绘画紧密地基于实际的天空，而不是画他想象的星星。考虑到这一点，研究人员进行了一系列法医天文学实验，将《星夜》中描绘的天体排列与梵高 1889 年夏天可能在圣雷米看到的天体排列相匹配。

paras.en: Using astronomy software, the researchers recreated every night sky during June and July 1889. The astronomers then compared the three-dimensional geometry of the painting’s most prominent celestial features—stars, the crescent moon and Venus—in relation to each other, while eliminating variables such as size and color, which the artist may have embellished.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用天文学软件重建了 1889 年 6 月和 7 月期间的每一个夜空。然后，天文学家比较了这幅画中最突出的天体特征（星星、新月和金星）的三维几何形状，并相互比较，同时消除了艺术家可能修饰的尺寸和颜色等变量。

paras.en: They found that the Hyades—a v-shaped cluster of five stars within the Taurus constellation—were the best fit for the stars appearing in van Gogh’s painting. That finding disputes conclusions reached in previous studies which had suggested that Aries was The Starry Night’s dominant constellation. At dawn, when van Gogh was known to paint, “the stars of Aries are relatively faint, hardly enough to inspire a painter,” Kim tells Scientific American’s Emma Gometz.
paras.zh: 他们发现毕宿星团（金牛座内由五颗星组成的 V 形星团）最适合梵高画作中出现的星星。这一发现与之前的研究得出的结论相矛盾，之前的研究表明白羊座是星夜的主导星座。黎明时分，梵高以绘画闻名，“白羊座的星星相对微弱，几乎不足以激发画家的灵感，”金告诉《科学美国人》的艾玛·戈麦斯。

paras.en: July 22, 1889, was the date that matched all the conditions, according to the study. The moon was a crescent shape and sat above Venus in the sky. The Hyades would have fit within the frame. The night was clear enough for van Gogh to see the stars, according to a weather analysis.
paras.zh: 研究显示，1889 年 7 月 22 日是符合所有条件的日期。月亮呈新月形，位于天空中的金星上方。毕星团可以安装在框架内。根据天气分析，夜晚的天气足够晴朗，梵高可以看到星星。

paras.en: “So, what we propose is the possibility that Vincent conceived the idea in June and completed the painting after July 22,” Kim tells Space.com’s Chelsea Gohd.
paras.zh: “因此，我们提出的可能性是，文森特在 6 月份提出了这个想法，并在 7 月 22 日之后完成了这幅画，”Kim 告诉 Space.com 的 Chelsea Gohd。

paras.en: Not everyone is sold. A spokesperson from Amsterdam’s Van Gogh Museum tells the Guardian’s Hanad Ahmed that “van Gogh was not concerned with exact likenesses. The positions of the celestial bodies depicted can therefore not form a reliable basis for dating the work.” The museum also points out that van Gogh suffered a serious breakdown around July 22 that left him unable to paint for about a month.
paras.zh: 不是每个人都被卖了。阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆的一位发言人告诉《卫报》的哈纳德·艾哈迈德，“梵高并不关心精确的相似性。因此，所描绘的天体位置不能成为确定作品年代的可靠依据。”该博物馆还指出，梵高在7月22日左右遭受了严重的精神崩溃，导致他大约一个月无法绘画。

paras.en: “Still, I would see the July date as an intriguing hypothesis rather than a settled answer,” Jose Luis Aragon, a physicist at the National Autonomous University of Mexico who was not involved in the study but who has studied van Gogh paintings, tells the AP.
paras.zh: “不过，我认为七月的日期是一个有趣的假设，而不是一个确定的答案，”墨西哥国立自治大学的物理学家何塞·路易斯·阿拉贡（Jose Luis Aragon）告诉美联社，他没有参与这项研究，但研究过梵高的画作。

paras.en: “What I find most convincing is the broader message: The painting is not pure fantasy,” he adds. “Van Gogh watched the real sky very closely.”
paras.zh: “我发现最有说服力的是更广泛的信息：这幅画不是纯粹的幻想，”他补充道。 “梵高非常仔细地观察了真实的天空。”

articles.title: Split Tunneling Is Your VPN’s Best Feature. Here’s How to Make the Most of It
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: While you may well be familiar with virtual private network apps, you might not have come across one of the best features available inside these privacy protectors: a feature called split tunneling.
paras.zh: 虽然您可能很熟悉虚拟专用网络应用程序，但您可能没有遇到过这些隐私保护器中可用的最佳功能之一：称为分割隧道的功能。

paras.en: In simple terms, split tunneling lets you choose which apps or sites use the protection of a VPN and which don't. While VPNs are worth using for extra security and privacy online—foiling trackers, spoofing your location, and stopping your internet provider from seeing your browsing—they do by their nature come with some compromises in speed.
paras.zh: 简而言之，分割隧道可让您选择哪些应用程序或站点使用 VPN 保护，哪些不使用。虽然 VPN 值得用于额外的在线安全和隐私（挫败跟踪器、欺骗您的位置以及阻止您的互联网提供商查看您的浏览内容），但它们本质上会在速度方面造成一些影响。

paras.en: If, for example, you want to get the fastest possible speeds with your online games, you might want to leave your games outside of the VPN's remit. Likewise, since VPNs typically obfuscate your actual location, if you want to make sure you can always check movie showtimes in your local area, you can use split tunneling to keep those ticketing apps outside your VPN. Putting a VPN in place can also interfere with access to other devices on your local network, like smart home gadgets and printers.
paras.zh: 例如，如果您希望在线游戏获得尽可能最快的速度，您可能希望将游戏排除在 VPN 的管辖范围之外。同样，由于 VPN 通常会混淆您的实际位置，因此如果您想确保始终可以查看本地的电影放映时间，则可以使用分割隧道将这些票务应用程序保留在 VPN 之外。设置 VPN 还会干扰对本地网络上其他设备的访问，例如智能家居设备和打印机。

paras.en: For all these reasons, you might want the extra control that split tunneling gives you, and it's available in a lot of VPN packages. Here's what you need to know about it.
paras.zh: 出于所有这些原因，您可能需要分割隧道为您提供的额外控制，并且许多 VPN 软件包中都提供了这种控制。以下是您需要了解的内容。

paras.en: VPNs work by offering an encrypted bridge for data going to and coming from the web. This bridge means your internet provider, law enforcement agencies, and people connected to the same Wi-Fi can't see what you're doing online. Split tunneling lets you route some online traffic away from that bridge, without you having to constantly turn your VPN on and off.
paras.zh: VPN 的工作原理是为进出网络的数据提供加密的桥梁。这座桥意味着您的互联网提供商、执法机构和连接到同一 Wi-Fi 的人员无法看到您在网上做什么。分割隧道可让您将一些在线流量路由到远离该网桥的地方，而无需不断地打开和关闭 VPN。

paras.en: App-based split tunneling is the most common type you'll come across, as it's the most straightforward and easiest to understand. Some of your apps use the VPN, and some don't. So maybe you want your banking app connected to a VPN for maximum protection, but you're less concerned about a weather app, and you don't want to see forecasts from whatever location the VPN is spoofing.
paras.zh: 基于应用程序的分割隧道是您遇到的最常见的类型，因为它是最直接、最容易理解的。您的某些应用程序使用 VPN，有些则不使用。因此，也许您希望将银行应用程序连接到 VPN 以获得最大程度的保护，但您不太关心天气应用程序，并且您不希望看到来自 VPN 欺骗的任何位置的天气预报。

paras.en: Depending on the VPN, you might also see URL-based split tunneling. This lets you set the rules based on domain names. It's the same idea as with apps: For websites that need fast internet access and where privacy is less important, there's no VPN. So you can keep the VPN turned on for a search engine page where you're typing information you want protected, but off for a local news site.
paras.zh: 根据 VPN 的不同，您可能还会看到基于 URL 的分割隧道。这使您可以根据域名设置规则。这与应用程序的想法相同：对于需要快速互联网访问且隐私不太重要的网站，没有 VPN。因此，您可以在输入要保护的信息的搜索引擎页面上保持 VPN 开启状态，而在本地新闻网站上则关闭 VPN。

paras.en: There are other types of VPN tunneling too, including route-based tunneling (based on specific IP addresses on the internet) and policy-based tunneling (essentially a set of overarching rules), but these are less common in consumer VPN software, and you're unlikely to come across them unless you're somehow managing other users.
paras.zh: 还有其他类型的 VPN 隧道，包括基于路由的隧道（基于互联网上的特定 IP 地址）和基于策略的隧道（本质上是一组总体规则），但这些在消费者 VPN 软件中不太常见，除非您以某种方式管理其他用户，否则您不太可能遇到它们。

paras.en: It's not a complicated technology to understand, and it can be genuinely useful—but it's also a feature that users tend not to notice or think about when they're enabling and disabling VPNs on their devices.
paras.zh: 这不是一项复杂的技术，易于理解，而且确实很有用，但用户在设备上启用和禁用 VPN 时往往不会注意到或考虑这一功能。

paras.en: The exact steps needed to enable split tunneling will vary depending on the VPN software you're using, but they shouldn't be too difficult to find. Most, but not all, VPN programs now offer some kind of split tunneling feature. If you're using a popular app, then you should find the option somewhere, especially if you're on a paid tier.
paras.zh: 启用分割隧道所需的具体步骤将根据您使用的 VPN 软件而有所不同，但它们应该不会太难找到。大多数（但不是全部）VPN 程序现在都提供某种分割隧道功能。如果您使用的是流行的应用程序，那么您应该在某处找到该选项，特别是如果您处于付费级别。

paras.en: To give you some idea how it works: In ProtonVPN for Windows, on the main console there's a split tunneling link on the right, together with other features like a kill switch and port forwarding. Click Split tunneling, and once it's enabled, you can start picking your apps. You can either select a list of apps to be included by the VPN (with everything else excluded) or a list of apps to be excluded (with everything else included).
paras.zh: 让您了解一下它是如何工作的：在 Windows 版 ProtonVPN 中，主控制台右侧有一个分割隧道链接，以及终止开关和端口转发等其他功能。单击“拆分隧道”，启用后，您就可以开始选择应用程序。您可以选择要包含在 VPN 中的应用程序列表（排除其他所有内容）或要排除的应用程序列表（包括其他所有内容）。

paras.en: For NordVPN on Windows, you can access the feature by clicking the cog icon in the bottom left of the main interface, then choosing Split tunneling and enabling the Split tunneling toggle switch. Again, you'll be able to choose which apps are included in the VPN protections and which ones aren't.
paras.zh: 对于 Windows 上的 NordVPN，您可以通过单击主界面左下角的齿轮图标，然后选择“拆分隧道”并启用“拆分隧道”切换开关来访问该功能。同样，您将能够选择哪些应用程序包含在 VPN 保护中，哪些不包含在 VPN 保护中。

paras.en: On mobile, it's a similar process: Delve into the settings for whatever VPN app you're using, wherever those settings might be. Note, though, that iPhones don't allow as much freedom for VPNs here as Android devices and desktop platforms: You'll typically be limited to selecting websites and IP addresses to exclude, rather than apps.
paras.zh: 在移动设备上，这是一个类似的过程：深入研究您正在使用的任何 VPN 应用程序的设置，无论这些设置位于何处。但请注意，iPhone 不允许像 Android 设备和桌面平台那样自由地使用 VPN：您通常只能选择要排除的网站和 IP 地址，而不是应用程序。

paras.en: Most of the time, it's going to be a set-it-and-forget-it type routine, and you're not going to need to keep diving back into the options screen to change around the apps that have VPN access—though you can if you want. It means VPN peace of mind where you need it, without the inconvenience of having a VPN applied where it's not useful.
paras.zh: 大多数时候，这将是一种一劳永逸的例行公事，你不需要不断地回到选项屏幕来更改具有 VPN 访问权限的应用程序 - 尽管如果你愿意的话也可以这样做。这意味着您可以在需要的地方放心使用 VPN，而不会在无用的地方使用 VPN 带来的不便。

articles.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 Review: The Littlest Smartphone That Could
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: If you crave a compact phone that doesn’t feel like a brick in your pocket and slips easily into a small bag, the flip style is for you. Samsung’s eighth-generation clamshell is seriously refined, and as svelte and slick as it comes. It may not offer a tablet-sized screen or the fashionable new passport shape, but it is arguably the most practical type of folding phone.
paras.zh: 如果您渴望一款紧凑型手机，既不像口袋里的一块砖头，又可以轻松放入小包中，那么翻盖式手机就适合您。三星的第八代翻盖非常精致，而且纤薄光滑。它可能不提供平板电脑大小的屏幕或时尚的新护照形状，但它可以说是最实用的折叠手机类型。

paras.en: Like almost every other phone this year, the Z Flip8 offers tiny improvements over its predecessor and costs $100 more. If you’re wondering whether it’s worth updating from last year’s Z Flip7, it’s not. The Flip8 is a teeny bit lighter and slimmer with a newer processor, and that’s about it. But if you’re looking to dip a toe in folding-phone waters or just want something small, the Z Flip8 should be in the conversation.
paras.zh: 与今年几乎所有其他手机一样，Z Flip8 比其前身有了微小的改进，但价格却高出 100 美元。如果你想知道是否值得从去年的 Z Flip7 升级，那么事实并非如此。 Flip8 配备了更新的处理器，重量更轻、更薄，仅此而已。但如果你想尝试一下折叠手机或者只是想要一些小东西，那么 Z Flip8 应该是你的选择。

paras.en: Everyone is excited about the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8’s sexy new form factor, but Samsung continues to iterate on the flip phone format for folks who prize compact devices. The Z Flip8 shaves off 0.02 inches (0.55 millimeters) and a third of an ounce (8 grams) compared to its predecessor, making it the slimmest and lightest option in this category. The improved hinge makes the crease slightly less noticeable and a little easier to open. I still found it a bit tricky to open one-handed, but you get the knack after a while. The new hinge is also supposed to be more durable.
paras.zh: 每个人都对三星 Galaxy Z Fold8 性感的新外形感到兴奋，但三星继续为喜欢紧凑型设备的人们迭代翻盖手机格式。与前代产品相比，Z Flip8 的厚度减少了 0.02 英寸（0.55 毫米）和三分之一盎司（8 克），使其成为同类产品中最薄、最轻的选择。改进的铰链使折痕稍微不那么明显并且更容易打开。我仍然发现单手打开有点棘手，但一段时间后你就会掌握窍门。新的铰链也应该更耐用。

articles.title: Revival Rugs Birthday Sale: 20 Percent Off Sitewide Through Sunday
articles.author: Boutayna Chokrane

paras.en: Revival Rugs is turning 9 this month, and evidently, the birthday girl is feeling generous. The rug retailer is taking 20 percent off everything sitewide (exclusions may apply, as always). But don’t dillydally—the party ends Sunday, October 25.
paras.zh: Revival Rugs 本月将迎来 9 岁生日，显然，这位过生日的女孩感觉很慷慨。这家地毯零售商对全场所有商品实行 20% 折扣（与往常一样，例外情况也可能适用）。但别磨磨蹭蹭——派对将于 10 月 25 日星期日结束。

paras.en: Sure, Black Friday is around the corner, and there will be deals aplenty. But will they be sitewide and stackable? Revival’s 20 percent stacks, meaning it also applies to marked-down and clearance items. Will the rug you’ve been eyeing for months still be available in November? Are you willing to risk it? I wouldn’t.
paras.zh: 当然，黑色星期五即将到来，届时会有大量优惠。但它们会在整个站点范围内并且可堆叠吗？ Revival 的叠加率为 20%，这意味着它也适用于降价和清仓商品。您关注了几个月的地毯在 11 月还会有货吗？你愿意冒这个险吗？我不会。

paras.en: Revival is a retailer we love here at WIRED, mainly because of its lovely selection of hand-knotted and handwoven wool rugs at reasonable prices. The company imports rugs from Turkey, Morocco, and India, and also works with its own supplier in Oakland, California. Revival also offers a variety of washable rugs, à la Ruggable (which, by the way, is having its own October Hosting Sale). Not every Revival rug is machine washable, but many are easy to maintain with spot cleaning and a low-suction vacuum.
paras.zh: Revival 是《连线》杂志上我们喜欢的一家零售商，主要是因为它以合理的价格提供精美的手工打结和手工编织的羊毛地毯。该公司从土耳其、摩洛哥和印度进口地毯，并与加利福尼亚州奥克兰的自己的供应商合作。 Revival 还提供各种可清洗的地毯，比如 Ruggable（顺便说一下，它正在举办自己的十月托管促销活动）。并非每块 Revival 地毯都可以机洗，但许多地毯都可以通过局部清洁和低吸力真空吸尘器轻松维护。

paras.en: WIRED reviewer Nena Farrell has the Bronto Hand-Tufted Rug in her toddler’s bedroom, and they are both fans. Farrell appreciates how soft it is and how it makes the room feel playful without looking tacky. Meanwhile, her son is mostly here for the giant dinosaur, which, honestly, is fair. WIRED operations coordinator Molly Higgins has the Garland Washable Area Rug in her living room, where its Turkish-inspired folk-art pattern adds plenty of color and disguises everyday stains. WIRED commerce director Cooper Fleishman just bought a vibrant marmalade wool rug for his new office from the Birthday Sale; sadly, it’s sold out, but this tonal design is a close cousin.
paras.zh: 《连线》评论员 Nena Farrell 在她孩子的卧室里放了 Bronto 手工簇绒地毯，她们都是 Bronto 的粉丝。法雷尔很欣赏它的柔软性，以及它如何让房间感觉有趣而不显得俗气。与此同时，她的儿子来这里主要是为了巨型恐龙，老实说，这是公平的。 《连线》运营协调员莫莉·希金斯 (Molly Higgins) 在她的客厅里放置了 Garland 可水洗地毯，其土耳其风格的民间艺术图案增添了丰富的色彩，并掩盖了日常污渍。 《连线》商务总监库珀·弗莱什曼 (Cooper Fleishman) 刚刚从生日促销活动中为他的新办公室购买了一张充满活力的果酱羊毛地毯；遗憾的是，它已经卖完了，但这种色调设计是近亲。

paras.en: As with any sale, there are a few exclusions. Swatches and gift cards aren’t included, and be sure to read the terms and conditions for more information.
paras.zh: 与任何销售一样，也有一些例外情况。不包括样本和礼品卡，请务必阅读条款和条件以获取更多信息。

articles.title: Four plead guilty in international monkey torture video conspiracy

paras.en: Oct. 23 (UPI) -- Four people have pleaded guilty to participating in an online conspiracy to produce and distribute videos depicting the torture and sexual abuse of monkeys, the Justice Department said Friday.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日（UPI）——司法部周五表示，四人已承认参与在线串谋制作和传播描绘猴子酷刑和性虐待的视频。

paras.en: Ernest Chavez, of Arizona, pleaded guilty Friday to conspiring to create and distribute so-called animal crush videos.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州的欧内斯特·查韦斯周五承认密谋制作和传播所谓的“动物粉碎”视频。

paras.en: Three other defendants previously pleaded guilty in connection with the same conspiracy.
paras.zh: 其他三名被告此前已就同一阴谋认罪。

paras.en: Mary Longoria, of North Carolina, pleaded guilty July 16. Kimberly Anglin, of Connecticut, entered her plea Aug. 12. Patrick Naylor, also of North Carolina, pleaded guilty on Aug. 14.
paras.zh: 北卡罗来纳州的玛丽·朗格利亚 (Mary Longoria) 于 7 月 16 日认罪。康涅狄格州的金伯利·安格林 (Kimberly Anglin) 于 8 月 12 日提出认罪。同样来自北卡罗来纳州的帕特里克·内勒 (Patrick Naylor) 于 8 月 14 日认罪。

paras.en: The four were among 11 people indicted in 2025 for their involvement in online groups dedicated to creating and distributing videos of monkeys being tortured.
paras.zh: 这四人是 2025 年因参与致力于制作和传播猴子遭受酷刑视频的在线团体而被起诉的 11 人之一。

paras.en: According to court documents, the defendants and their co-conspirators used the messaging application Telegram to discuss and plan videos depicting acts of animal abuse.
paras.zh: 根据法庭文件，被告及其同谋使用消息应用程序 Telegram 讨论和策划描绘虐待动物行为的视频。

paras.en: Members of the groups then sent money through online payment applications to people in Indonesia who were willing to carry out the requested acts and record them.
paras.zh: 然后，该组织的成员通过在线支付应用程序向愿意执行所要求的行为并记录这些行为的印度尼西亚人汇款。

paras.en: Nicholas Dryden, of Cincinnati, Ohio, who supplied videos to the groups, was previously sentenced to nine years in federal prison for his role in the conspiracy.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州辛辛那提市的尼古拉斯·德莱顿 (Nicholas Dryden) 向这些组织提供了视频，此前他因参与阴谋而被判处九年联邦监狱徒刑。

paras.en: Longoria and Anglin are scheduled to be sentenced Dec. 2. Naylor is scheduled for sentencing on Dec. 17.
paras.zh: 朗格利亚和安格林计划于 12 月 2 日被判刑。内勒计划于 12 月 17 日被判刑。

articles.title: Chinese national extradited to U.S. in $37M cryptocurrency scam case

paras.en: Oct. 23 (UPI) -- A Chinese national accused of helping launder millions of dollars stolen from U.S. victims in a $36.9 million cryptocurrency investment scam was extradited from the Netherlands and appeared in a California federal court Friday.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日（UPI）——一名中国公民被控帮助洗钱，从美国受害者手中窃取了 3690 万美元的加密货币投资骗局，该名中国公民于周五被从荷兰引渡，并在加州联邦法院出庭受审。

paras.en: Zheng Zhao, 44, was arraigned in the Central District of California on a charge of conspiracy to commit money laundering.
paras.zh: 44 岁的郑钊因串谋洗钱罪在加州中区受审。

paras.en: Zhao allegedly participated in an international criminal network operating through scam centers in Cambodia that targeted victims with fraudulent cryptocurrency investments, the Department of Justice said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国司法部在一份声明中表示，赵涉嫌参与通过柬埔寨诈骗中心运作的国际犯罪网络，该网络以欺诈性加密货币投资为目标。

paras.en: Federal investigators identified 174 U.S. victims connected to the scheme.
paras.zh: 联邦调查人员确认了 174 名美国受害者与该计划有关。

paras.en: According to court documents, the scammers contacted victims through social media, telephone calls, text messages and online dating services to gain their trust.
paras.zh: 根据法庭文件，诈骗者通过社交媒体、电话、短信和在线约会服务联系受害者，以获得他们的信任。

paras.en: They then directed victims to fake cryptocurrency trading websites that appeared to offer legitimate investment opportunities.
paras.zh: 然后，他们将受害者引导至似乎提供合法投资机会的虚假加密货币交易网站。

paras.en: The websites showed investments increasing in value, but prosecutors said the money had actually been stolen.
paras.zh: 这些网站显示投资价值增加，但检察官表示这些钱实际上被盗了。

paras.en: More than $36.9 million in victim funds was transferred from U.S. bank accounts controlled by members of the conspiracy to an account at Deltec Bank in the Bahamas.
paras.zh: 超过 3690 万美元的受害者资金从该阴谋成员控制的美国银行账户转移到巴哈马 Deltec 银行的账户。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Zhao and his co-conspirators arranged for the money to be converted into Tether, a cryptocurrency tied to the value of the U.S. dollar, before transferring it to digital wallets controlled in Cambodia.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，赵和他的同谋安排将这些钱转换成 Tether（一种与美元价值挂钩的加密货币），然后将其转移到柬埔寨控制的数字钱包中。

paras.en: The funds were then distributed to leaders of scam centers operating in the region.
paras.zh: 然后，这些资金被分发给在该地区运营的诈骗中心的领导人。

paras.en: "This extradition should be a lesson to all those who seek to exploit vulnerable Americans from overseas," Assistant Attorney General A. Tysen Duva said in a statement.
paras.zh: 助理司法部长 A. 泰森·杜瓦 (A. Tysen Duva) 在一份声明中表示：“这次引渡应该给那些试图从海外剥削弱势美国人的人一个教训。”

paras.en: Zhao faces up to 20 years in prison if convicted.
paras.zh: 如果罪名成立，赵将面临最高20年的监禁。

paras.en: Eight other defendants have pleaded guilty in connection with the scheme.
paras.zh: 其他八名被告已承认与该计划有关的罪行。

articles.title: Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers outmuscle Rays in 2026 World Series opener

paras.en: Oct. 23 (UPI) -- A 103.5-mph fastball slid off Jacob Misiorowski's fingertips to start the first World Series game held in Milwaukee in 44 years and the Milwaukee Brewers ace never relented in a 3-2 triumph over the Tampa Bay Rays on Friday in the 2026 title series opener.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日（合众国际社）——一颗时速 103.5 英里的快球从雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基 (Jacob Misiorowski) 的指尖滑落，拉开了 44 年来在密尔沃基举行的第一场世界大赛的序幕，这位密尔沃基酿酒人队 (Milwaukee Brewers) 王牌球员在周五 2026 年冠军系列赛揭幕战中以 3-2 战胜坦帕湾光芒队 (Tampa Bay Rays)。

paras.en: "It was amazing," Misiorowski said on the Fox broadcast. "Just to have this city behind me means the world. We couldn't ask for anything better."
paras.zh: “这太棒了，”米西奥罗夫斯基在福克斯广播中说道。 “只要我身后有这座城市，就意味着全世界。我们不能要求更好的事情了。”

paras.en: MLB's fastest-throwing starter reached triple digits on more than three dozen of his offerings. He allowed just four hits and one run over five innings to help the Brewers snatch a 1-0 series lead at American Family Field.
paras.zh: 这位美国职业棒球大联盟最快的先发球员在超过三打的投球中达到了三位数。他在五局比赛中仅失四支安打和一分，帮助酿酒人队在美国家庭球场取得了系列赛 1-0 的领先优势。

paras.en: "Not perfect, but good enough to get a win," Misiorowski said.
paras.zh: “并不完美，但足以赢得胜利，”米西奥罗夫斯基说。

paras.en: The Brewers, who earned their first World Series win in Milwaukee since Oct. 17, 1982, will host the Rays in Game 2 of the best-of-seven game series Saturday in Milwaukee.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队自 1982 年 10 月 17 日以来在密尔沃基赢得了他们的首场世界大赛胜利，周六将在密尔沃基举办七场四胜制系列赛的第二场比赛，主场迎战光芒队。

paras.en: "It feels great," said Brewers designated hitter Christian Yelich. "Anytime you win a playoff game it feels awesome, especially a World Series game. ... We've still got a ways to go, but it's nice to get that first one."
paras.zh: “感觉棒极了，”酿酒人指定击球手克里斯蒂安·耶利奇说道。 “任何时候你赢得一场季后赛都会感觉棒极了，尤其是世界职业棒球大赛……我们还有很长的路要走，但很高兴能取得第一个胜利。”

paras.en: Early offense aided Misiorowski's muscular Game 1 gem. The Brewers broke through off a Yelich RBI triple in the bottom of the first. Catcher William Contreras hit the next pitch through the infield to plate Yelich for a 2-0 lead.
paras.zh: 早期的进攻帮助米西奥罗夫斯基在第一场比赛中表现出肌肉发达的宝石。酿酒人队在第一节下半段突破了耶利奇打点三分。捕手威廉·孔特雷拉斯 (William Contreras) 在内场再次投球，为耶利奇 (Yelich) 打出一球，以 2-0 领先。

paras.en: The Rays attempted to neutralize Misiorowski's fastballs with short swings, but didn't find home until catcher Liam Hicks scored first baseman Jonathan Aranda on an RBI groundout in the fourth. They wouldn't score again until the ninth.
paras.zh: 光芒队试图用短距离挥击来抵消米西奥罗夫斯基的快球，但直到捕手利亚姆·希克斯在第四节打点滚地球上为一垒手乔纳森·阿兰达得分后才找到了主场。直到第九局他们才再次得分。

paras.en: Left fielder Jackson Chourio added Brewers insurance with an RBI single in the seventh. The Brewers bullpen -- comprised off Abner Uribe, Aaron Ashby and Trevor Megill -- surrendered just three hits and one run over the final four innings.
paras.zh: 左外野手杰克逊·乔里奥（Jackson Chourio）在第七局打出一记打点单打，为酿酒人队增添了保险。酿酒人队牛棚由阿布纳·乌里韦、亚伦·阿什比和特雷弗·梅吉尔组成，在最后四局中仅投出三支安打和一分。

paras.en: The Rays threatened with a desperate effort in the ninth, loading the bases against Megill, but only squeezed one run out of the rally. Megill secured the victory with a devastating knuckle curve for a game-ending strikeout of center fielder Jonny DeLuca.
paras.zh: 光芒队在第九局拼尽全力，对梅吉尔发起进攻，但只取得一分。梅吉尔以毁灭性的指关节曲线为中外野手乔尼·德卢卡（Jonny DeLuca）三振出局，确保了比赛的胜利。

paras.en: Contreras went 2 for 3 for the Brewers. Chourio went 2 for 4. Rays starter Nick Martinez allowed five hits and two runs over five innings. Aranda went 3 for 3 in the loss. Left fielder Chandler Simpson swatted two hits for the Rays.
paras.zh: 孔特雷拉斯为酿酒人队3投2中。乔里奥 4 投 2 中。光芒队先发球员尼克·马丁内斯 (Nick Martinez) 在五局比赛中失 5 支安打和 2 分。阿兰达在这场失利中3投3中。左外野手钱德勒·辛普森为光芒队击出两支安打。

paras.en: First pitch for Game 2 is scheduled for 8 p.m. EDT Saturday at American Family Field. Game 3 will be held at 8 p.m. Monday in St. Petersburg.
paras.zh: 第 2 场比赛的第一次投球定于晚上 8 点进行。美国东部时间周六在美国家庭球场举行。第 3 场比赛将于晚上 8 点举行。星期一在圣彼得堡。

articles.title: Hailee Steinfeld Will Have a Hold on You in ‘Magic’ Cover of The Cars for ‘Hexed’ Movie: Listen
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Hailee Steinfeld is bringing a little extra magic to her role in Disney‘s new animated feature Hexed, contributing an enchanting cover of a hit by The Cars in addition to leading the voice cast.
paras.zh: 海莉·斯坦菲尔德 (Hailee Steinfeld) 为她在迪士尼新动画长片《Hexed》中的角色带来了一点额外的魔力，除了担任配音演员外，她还为《赛车总动员》的热门歌曲翻唱了迷人的封面。

paras.en: Released Friday (Oct. 23) ahead of the movie’s theatrical premiere Nov. 25, the singer/actress’ version of “Magic” keeps all of the 1980s flair of The Cars’ original recording, while Steinfeld’s bright vocals give it a new pop sheen. “Just a little bit of magic pulls me through,” she sings. “I’ve got a hold on you.”
paras.zh: 电影于 11 月 25 日在影院首映之前于周五（10 月 23 日）发行，这位歌手兼女演员的版本“Magic”保留了 The Cars 原始录音的所有 20 世纪 80 年代风格，而斯坦菲尔德明亮的歌声则为其赋予了新的流行光泽。 “只要一点点魔法就能让我渡过难关，”她唱道。 “我已经抓住你了。”

paras.en: It pairs perfectly with the whimsical story told in Hexed, which follows a girl named Billie Doe — voiced by Steinfeld — as the discovery of her previously untapped magical abilities launches her “out of suburbia and into a spectacle-filled journey through a vast witch realm called Hexe,” according to a description. Rashida Jones, Jodie Foster, Walton Goggins, Tracey Ullman and Stephen Fry are also in the voice cast.
paras.zh: 它与《Hexed》讲述的异想天开的故事完美契合，该故事讲述了一个名叫比莉·多伊（由斯坦菲尔德配音）的女孩发现了她以前未开发的魔法能力，根据描述，她“走出郊区，进入了一个充满奇观的旅程，穿越一个名为 Hexe 的广阔女巫王国”。拉什达·琼斯、朱迪·福斯特、沃尔顿·戈金斯、特蕾西·乌尔曼和斯蒂芬·弗雷也在配音阵容中。

paras.en: “Magic” reached No. 12 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1984, but it’s far from The Cars’ only hit. The Boston rock band also scored top 10 entries with “Drive” (No. 3), “Shake It Up” (No. 4), “You Might Think” (No. 7) and “Tonight She Comes” (No. 7).
paras.zh: 《Magic》在 1984 年的 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上名列第 12 位，但这并不是汽车总动员唯一的热门单曲。这支波士顿摇滚乐队还凭借《Drive》（第 3 位）、《Shake It Up》（第 4 位）、《You Might Think》（第 7 位）和《Tonight She Comes》（第 7 位）进入前十名。

paras.en: Steinfeld has also earned her share of chart hits with five entries on the Hot 100 to date, led by 2016’s “Starving” with Grey and Zedd, which peaked at No. 12. She’s now becoming known for recording music in collaboration with the films she stars in, dropping “Dangerous” for Sinners in April of last year. “Blending music and acting like this feels like the fullest expression of who I am,” she told Billboard at the time.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，斯坦菲尔德还凭借 5 首歌曲进入热门 100 强，其中以 2016 年与 Gray 和 Zedd 合作的《Starving》领衔，最高排名第 12 位。她现在因与自己主演的电影合作录制音乐而闻名，并于去年 4 月为《Sinners》放弃了《Dangerous》。 “将音乐和这样的表演融为一体感觉就像是我是谁的最充分的表达，”她当时告诉《告示牌》。

paras.en: Listen to Steinfeld’s cover of “Magic” by The Cars below.
paras.zh: 请听下面 Steinfeld 翻唱的 The Cars 的《Magic》。

articles.title: Drake Becomes First Act to Surpass 350 Million RIAA-Certified Units, With 30 New Certifications
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: The diamonds keep on dancing on Drake. Ahead of The Boy’s 40th birthday this weekend, Drizzy earned 30 new certifications from the Recording Industry Association of America on Friday (Oct. 23).
paras.zh: 钻石继续在德雷克上跳舞。在本周末 The Boy 的 40 岁生日之前，Drizzy 于周五（10 月 23 日）获得了美国唱片工业协会颁发的 30 项新认证。

paras.en: Leading the pack are diamond certifications for VIEWS, “In My Feelings” and “Marvin’s Room,” while “God’s Plan” is now double-diamond.
paras.zh: 领先的是《VIEWS》、《In My Feelings》和《Marvin’s Room》的钻石认证，而《God’s Plan》现在是双钻石认证。

paras.en: As far as projects and albums go, Drake picked up certifications for More Life (6x), Certified Lover Boy (5x), Scorpion (9x), Care Package (1x), So Far Gone (3x) and ICEMAN is now platinum five months after its May arrival.
paras.zh: 就项目和专辑而言，Drake 获得了《More Life》(6x)、《Certified Lover Boy》(5x)、《Scorpion》(9x)、《Care Package》(1x)、《So Far Gone》(3x) 的认证，ICEMAN 在 5 月发行五个月后现已成为白金唱片。

paras.en: Singles earning certifications include: “Knife Talk” (8x), “First Person Shooter” (2x), “IDGAF” (2x), “You Broke My Heart” (1x), “Way 2 Sexy” (4x), “Girls Want Girls” (3x), “No Friends in the Industry” (3x), “Yebba’s Heartbreak” (2x), “Champagne Poetry” (2x), “Love All” (1x), “BACKOUTSIDEBOYZ” (1x), “Jumbotron Shit Poppin” (1x), “One Dance” (15x), “Fair Trade” (5x), “On BS” (2x), “Circo Loco” (1x), “Major Distribution” (1x), “Pussy and Millions” (1x), “Broke Boys” (1x) and “Privileged Rappers” (1x).
paras.zh: 获得认证的单曲包括：《Knife Talk》(8x)、《第一人称射击游戏》(2x)、《IDGAF》(2x)、《你伤了我的心》(1x)、《Way 2 sexy》(4x)、《Girls Want Girls》(3x)、《业内没有朋友》(3x)、《Yebba’s Heartbreak》(2x)、《香槟诗歌》(2x)、 “Love All”(1x)、“BACKOUTSIDEBOYZ”(1x)、“Jumbotron Shit Poppin”(1x)、“One Dance”(15x)、“Fair Trade”(5x)、“On BS”(2x)、“Circo Loco”(1x)、“Major Distribution”(1x)、“Pussy and Millions”(1x)、“Broke Boys”(1x) 和“特权说唱歌手”（1x）。

paras.en: Drake is the first artist to surpass 350 million RIAA-certified units and is the most certified artist of all time. He also extends his record with 18 diamond plaques, which is the highest amount of any artist.
paras.zh: Drake 是第一位 RIAA 认证数量超过 3.5 亿的艺术家，也是有史以来认证数量最多的艺术家。他还以 18 块钻石匾额刷新了自己的纪录，这是所有艺术家中数量最多的。

paras.en: With all the new plaques on the way, Drizzy’s going to need another trophy room. The 6 God has plenty to celebrate this weekend, as Drake will be turning 40 on Saturday (Oct. 24).
paras.zh: 随着所有新牌匾即将到来，崔兹将需要另一个奖杯室。 6 God 这个周末有很多值得庆祝的事情，因为 Drake 将于周六（10 月 24 日）迎来 40 岁生日。

paras.en: He started the festivities earlier this week with a dinner above the CN Tower and a courtside outing at the Toronto Raptors home opener. Drake made his way to NYC and was spotted moving around the Big Apple on Thursday night (Oct. 22) with a dinner stop at Mamo.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，他在加拿大国家电视塔上举行了一场晚宴，并在多伦多猛龙队主场揭幕战中在场边郊游，以此拉开了庆祝活动的序幕。周四晚上（10 月 22 日），Drake 前往纽约市，有人发现他在纽约四处走动，并在 Mamo 享用晚餐。

paras.en: Find some of Drake’s highest certifications below.
paras.zh: 下面是 Drake 的一些最高认证。

articles.title: In Canada: Summer Walker, Bebe Rexha to Accept Awards at Billboard Canada Women in Music 2026
articles.author: Chris Eggertsen

paras.en: Billboard Canada has announced some more major global names for Billboard Canada Women In Music, where Cardi B will accept the Global Woman of the Year Award.
paras.zh: 加拿大公告牌 (Billboard Canada) 宣布了加拿大公告牌音乐界女性的更多全球知名人物，卡迪·B (Cardi B) 将获得全球年度女性奖。

paras.en: Summer Walker will accept the Global Visionary Award. Walker has broken barriers to build a modern global R&B success story based on boundless creativity and radical vulnerability. This year, Walker transformed her now-complete Over It trilogy into her first arena tour, the Finally Still Over It tour, which sold out venues around the world. The tour told the tale of her three albums, kicking off in Toronto and culminating with a special finale in the U.K., with two sold-out nights at London’s O2 Arena.
paras.zh: 萨默·沃克将接受全球远见奖。沃克打破了障碍，以无限的创造力和彻底的脆弱性为基础，打造了现代全球 R&B 的成功故事。今年，沃克将她现已完成的《Over It》三部曲转变为她的首次舞台巡演《Finally Still Over It》，该巡演在世界各地的场馆门票全部售罄。这次巡演讲述了她三张专辑的故事，从多伦多开始，在英国以特别的结局结束，伦敦 O2 体育馆的两晚门票全部售罄。

paras.en: Celebrating the feat in a special moment captured by Billboard Canada and Billboard UK, Walker paid tribute to the bold and loyal team that has helped her achieve new heights as she has built her own path within the industry.
paras.zh: 沃克在加拿大公告牌和英国公告牌捕捉到的特殊时刻庆祝了这一壮举，并向勇敢而忠诚的团队致敬，他们帮助她在行业内开辟了自己的道路，达到了新的高度。

paras.en: Bebe Rexha will be honoured with the Global Hitmaker Award, which recognizes her decade-spanning career and illustrious path from songwriter to one of the most versatile charting stars on the music landscape. From pop to electronic, country and R&B, she has shown an ability to craft songs that resonate with massive audiences including multiple No. 1s in Canada and the U.S.
paras.zh: 贝比·雷克萨 (Bebe Rexha) 将荣获全球热门音乐人奖，该奖项旨在表彰她长达十年的职业生涯以及从词曲作者到音乐界最多才多艺的排行榜明星之一的辉煌道路。从流行音乐到电子音乐、乡村音乐和 R&B，她展现了创作能够引起广大听众共鸣的歌曲的能力，其中包括加拿大和美国的多位冠军。

paras.en: Now in 2026, the singer has taken greater creative control of her career, going independent and partnering with EMPIRE, a decision she describes as not just a business one, but a personal one, “embracing every part” of herself. Her 2026 album Dirty Blonde hit No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Dance Albums chart and reflects Bebe’s newly heightened creative ambition, which includes making music videos for every song on the album.
paras.zh: 现在到了 2026 年，这位歌手对自己的职业生涯有了更大的创意控制，开始独立并与 EMPIRE 合作，她称这一决定不仅是商业决定，也是个人决定，“拥抱自己的每一部分”。她的 2026 年专辑《Dirty Blonde》在 Billboard 顶级舞曲专辑排行榜上名列第一，反映了 Bebe 新近增强的创作野心，其中包括为专辑中的每首歌制作音乐视频。

paras.en: Chxrry will accept the 2026 Billboard Canada Rising Star Award.
paras.zh: Chxrrry 将接受 2026 年 Billboard 加拿大新星奖。

paras.en: It has been four years since the Scarborough-born, Los Angeles-based act (formerly Chxrry22) made history as the first female artist signed to The Weeknd’s XO record label. Chxrry has continued to build her audience, playing both intimate and stadium-sized concerts during her opening stint on The Weeknd’s record-breaking After Hours Til Dawn tour. This year, she played 16 sold-out shows across the globe, including two stops in Toronto.
paras.zh: 这位出生于斯卡伯勒、居住在洛杉矶的艺人（原名 Chxrry22）成为第一位与 The Weeknd 旗下 XO 唱片公司签约的女艺人，创造历史已有四年了。 Chxrry 继续吸引观众，在 The Weeknd 破纪录的 After Hours Til Dawn 巡演开场演出期间，她举办了亲密的和体育场大小的音乐会。今年，她在全球举办了 16 场演出，门票全部售完，其中包括多伦多的两站。

paras.en: The celebration will be hosted by Leandra Earl and Kylie Miller of The Beaches, the breakthrough Toronto band that was recognized as last year’s Women of the Year.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动将由多伦多突破性乐队 The Beaches 的 Leandra Earl 和 Kylie Miller 主持，该乐队被公认为去年的年度女性乐队。

paras.en: The band celebrated the major breakthrough that began in 2023 with “Blame Brett” and continued through their 2025 album No Hard Feelings and their graduation to an arena-level band. They have remained true to themselves and proudly worn their home country on their sleeve, all while continuing to build an impact that transcends beyond it.
paras.zh: 乐队以《Blame Brett》庆祝了 2023 年开始的重大突破，并在 2025 年专辑《No Hard Feelings》中继续前进，并毕业成为一支竞技场级别的乐队。他们始终忠于自己，并自豪地把自己的祖国挂在嘴边，同时继续创造超越祖国的影响力。

paras.en: In addition to being major honourees last year, they were undoubtedly the life of the party, celebrating with the other honourees and creating a viral moment as they shared their surprise while congratulations played from Elton John, Kid Cudi, Charlotte Cardin and more. Following the Women of the Year honour, they also became the first group to receive the Global Force Award at Billboard Women In Music in Los Angeles. They described the win, which recognizes their representation of Canada on the world stage, as a “dream come true.”
paras.zh: 除了成为去年的主要获奖者之外，他们无疑也是派对上的焦点，与其他获奖者一起庆祝，并创造了一个病毒式的时刻，他们分享了他们的惊喜，同时艾尔顿·约翰、基德·库迪、夏洛特·卡丁等人演奏了祝贺声。继获得年度女性荣誉后，她们还成为洛杉矶公告牌女性音乐界第一支获得全球力量奖的团体。他们将这场胜利描述为“梦想成真”，这承认了他们在世界舞台上代表加拿大的地位。

paras.en: Kylie and Leandra’s charm has also breathed new life into their breakthrough hit “Blame Brett” as the guitarists lead a viral stage move that has become a viral staple during the band’s live sets. From Rebecca Black and the Off Campus cast, to their own parents, the “Blame Brett hops” have become a fan-favourite moment and taken over stages of all sizes, from festivals like All Things Go to the arenas where The Beaches opened for Louis Tomlinson this spring.
paras.zh: 凯莉和莉安德拉的魅力也为他们的突破性单曲“Blame Brett”注入了新的活力，吉他手们引领了病毒式的舞台动作，成为乐队现场表演中病毒式传播的主要内容。从丽贝卡·布莱克 (Rebecca Black) 和校外演员，到他们自己的父母，“Blame Brett hop”已成为粉丝们最喜爱的时刻，并占据了各种规模的舞台，从 All Things Go 等音乐节到今年春天为路易斯·汤姆林森 (Louis Tomlinson) 举办的海滩 (The Beaches) 演出的舞台。

paras.en: Drake Finances New Album From Canadian Rapper k-os
paras.zh: Drake 资助加拿大说唱歌手 k-os 的新专辑

paras.en: The return of Canadian hip-hop veteran k-os is imminent — and it’s fuelled by one of the country’s biggest global stars.
paras.zh: 加拿大嘻哈老将 k-os 的回归迫在眉睫，而这一切的推动者是该国最知名的全球明星之一。

paras.en: BLackneck will release on Oct. 30. It’s the genre-blurring Canadian rapper’s first full album in over a decade, and it has a major credit: Drake.
paras.zh: 《BLackneck》将于 10 月 30 日发行。这是这位流派模糊的加拿大说唱歌手十多年来的首张完整专辑，主要归功于 Drake。

paras.en: The new seven-track LP finds k-os reconnecting with the influence he’s left behind — the ambition of a Canadian artist willing to think beyond the country’s borders while also representing where he came from — and it took one of its biggest benefactors to bring it to life.
paras.zh: 新的七首唱片发现 k-os 重新与他留下的影响力联系起来——一位加拿大艺术家的雄心壮志，愿意超越国家边界思考，同时也代表他的出身——它需要一位最大的捐助者才能将其变为现实。

paras.en: Drake is credited as an executive producer on the project. Though he wasn’t behind the boards, the Toronto star bankrolled the whole project while offering encouragement to k-os to make the album only he could make.
paras.zh: 德雷克被认为是该项目的执行制片人。虽然他不是董事会的幕后黑手，但这位多伦多明星为整个项目提供了资金，同时鼓励 k-os 制作只有他才能制作的专辑。

paras.en: “Drake was like, ‘please make me a k-os record, please, please, please.’ That’s all he wanted,” k-os tells Billboard Canada over the phone from Mayne Island in B.C., where he’s putting the finishing touches on the mix for the album.
paras.zh: “Drake 说，‘请帮我制作一张 k-os 唱片，拜托，拜托，拜托。’这就是他想要的。”k-os 在不列颠哥伦比亚省梅恩岛通过电话告诉加拿大公告牌，他正在那里为专辑的混音做最后的润色。

paras.en: By a ‘k-os record,’ he means an album that takes big swings and doesn’t pigeonhole itself to one genre or perspective — a vision that inspired a young Aubrey Graham as he was building his Drake persona.
paras.zh: 他所说的“k-os 唱片”是指一张摇摆不定、不会将自己归入某一流派或观点的专辑——这一愿景启发了年轻的奥布里·格雷厄姆(Aubrey Graham)，当时他正在塑造自己的德雷克(Drake)形象。

paras.en: He grew up watching k-os on Canadian music video channel MuchMusic in the 2000s, when k-os was making his name as a major name in Canadian hip-hop. They collaborated on the songs “Faith” part one and two in the early 2010s, and remained friendly ever since. They first reconnected, k-os says, in 2021 or 2022 when they saw each other at a club. They re-exchanged phone numbers and Drake asked him to send him some music.
paras.zh: 他是在 2000 年代看着加拿大音乐视频频道 MuchMusic 上的 k-os 长大的，当时 k-os 已成为加拿大嘻哈界的大腕。他们在 2010 年代初合作创作了歌曲《Faith》第一部分和第二部分，从那时起他们就一直保持着友好的关系。 k-os 说，他们第一次重新建立联系是在 2021 年或 2022 年，当时他们在俱乐部见面。他们重新交换了电话号码，德雷克请他给他发送一些音乐。

paras.en: “He was like ‘dude, clearly you’re still good at this,'” k-os remembers. “‘I want to put you into a situation where you can make some music.'”
paras.zh: “他说‘伙计，显然你还是很擅长这个，’”科斯回忆道。 “‘我想让你进入一个可以创作音乐的环境。’”

paras.en: Drake spoke to Matte Babel, the former MuchMusic VJ who now works closely with Drake as the chief brand officer of his entertainment company, DreamCrew.
paras.zh: Drake 采访了 Matte Babel，他是 MuchMusic 的前主播，现在与 Drake 密切合作，担任其娱乐公司 DreamCrew 的首席品牌官。

paras.en: Babel has been managing the project with k-os, with Drake as the “chief financier,” says k-os.
paras.zh: k-os 表示，Babel 一直在与 k-os 一起管理该项目，Drake 是“首席金融家”。

paras.en: “He’s like ‘oh, he wants to go to this big studio? He wants to get this string section?’ It’s hard for a label to spend that on an artist these days,” says k-os, who was formerly signed to major label Universal Music Canada and indie label Dine Alone. “If you’re a new artist and you just get signed off of streams, you tell them you want the Vancouver String Orchestra, they’re going to say ‘we’re not paying for it.'”
paras.zh: “他会说，‘哦，他想去这个大工作室？他想得到这个弦乐部分？’如今，唱片公司很难把钱花在艺术家身上，”曾与主要唱片公司 Universal Music Canada 和独立唱片公司 Dine Alone 签约的 k-os 说道。 “如果你是一位新艺术家，刚刚退出直播，你告诉他们你想要温哥华弦乐团，他们会说‘我们不会为此付费。’”

paras.en: But Drake is able to pay for it, bringing him back to a musical situation he was in when he was a major label artist in a pre-streaming world.
paras.zh: 但德雷克有能力为此付出代价，让他回到了他在流媒体世界中作为主要唱片公司艺术家时所处的音乐境地。

paras.en: Sophie Grégoire Trudeau Criticizes Tate McRae’s Victoria’s Secret Performance: ‘Nothing Empowering Here’
paras.zh: 索菲·格雷瓜尔·特鲁多批评泰特·麦克雷的维多利亚秘密表演：“这里没有任何力量”

paras.en: Sophie Grégoire Trudeau is criticizing Tate McRae’s debut performance of “Housewife.”
paras.zh: 索菲·格雷瓜尔·特鲁多批评泰特·麦克雷的首演《家庭主妇》。

paras.en: The Calgary-born pop sensation took the stage at the Victoria’s Secret fashion show on Sunday night (Oct. 18) to perform her new single “Housewife” live for the first time, along with her hit singles “Sports Car” and “Dear God,” wearing a sleek red lingerie ensemble that drew criticism from the author and mental health advocate formerly married to Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau.
paras.zh: 这位出生于卡尔加里的流行歌星于周日晚上（10 月 18 日）登上维多利亚的秘密时装秀的舞台，首次现场表演她的新单曲《Housewife》，以及她的热门单曲《Sports Car》和《Dear God》，她穿着时尚的红色内衣套装，招致了前加拿大总理贾斯汀·特鲁多的作家兼心理健康倡导者的批评。

paras.en: Under Billboard Canada‘s Instagram post of the performance, Grégoire Trudeau writes, “Really? This is what we need to do now to make a mark as an artist? I like her music and she’s talented but I see nothing empowering here; more like falling into the mold of people pleasing.”
paras.zh: 在加拿大告示牌的 Instagram 帖子中，格雷瓜尔·特鲁多 (Grégoire Trudeau) 写道：“真的吗？这就是我们现在需要做的，才能成为一名艺术家。我喜欢她的音乐，她很有才华，但我在这里看不到任何力量；更像是落入取悦他人的模式。”

paras.en: Ahead of its release, McRae described her song to Jimmy Fallon as an empowerment anthem, one that’s “kind of about a woman who can’t be contained.” The Canadian pop star has explained the song is about wanting to be her own provider, to be rich, successful and her own housewife. “I just wanna make a lot of money/ be my own housewife/ You could be the one I’m calling honey/ Be my sex on the side,” she sings over the song’s mellow, 2000s-inspired production.
paras.zh: 在发行前，麦克雷向吉米·法伦描述她的歌曲是一首赋权赞歌，“有点关于一个无法遏制的女人”。这位加拿大流行歌星解释说，这首歌是关于想要成为自己的养家糊口、富有、成功和自己的家庭主妇。 “我只是想赚很多钱/成为我自己的家庭主妇/你可以成为我称之为亲爱的人/成为我的性伴侣，”她在这首受 2000 年代启发的柔和歌曲中唱道。
