articles.title: NASA lays out plan for Artemis 3 moon-lander test flight —but when will it launch?
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: NASA just gave us our best look yet at its Artemis III moon-lander test flight.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局 (NASA) 刚刚向我们展示了阿耳忒弥斯三号 (Artemis III) 登月器试飞的最佳视角。

paras.en: The agency laid out a detailed concept of operations for Artemis III today (Oct. 23) during a press conference at Kennedy Space Center, stressing how important the flight is to its moon plans and how challenging it will be to make everything go right.
paras.zh: 该机构今天（10 月 23 日）在肯尼迪航天中心举行的新闻发布会上提出了阿耳忒弥斯三号的详细运行概念，强调这次飞行对其登月计划有多么重要，以及让一切顺利进行将是多么具有挑战性。

paras.en: "We're launching three of the most powerful rockets in the world, and undertaking what is likely the most complicated launch campaign ever undertaken," Jeremy Parsons, NASA’s Artemis program manager, said during today's event, which lasted more than two hours.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯项目经理杰里米·帕森斯在今天持续两个多小时的活动中表示：“我们将发射世界上最强大的三枚火箭，并开展可能是有史以来最复杂的发射活动。”

paras.en: Those three rockets are NASA's Space Launch System (SLS), SpaceX's Starship and Blue Origin's New Glenn, all of which will fly from Florida's Space Coast.
paras.zh: 这三枚火箭是美国宇航局的太空发射系统（SLS）、SpaceX的星际飞船和蓝色起源的新格伦号，它们都将从佛罗里达州的太空海岸起飞。

paras.en: If all goes according to plan, New Glenn will lift off first, carrying Blue Origin's Blue Moon lunar lander to low Earth orbit (LEO). SLS will go next, launching the Artemis III astronauts — NASA's Randy Bresnik, Andre Douglas and Frank Rubio, and the European Space Agency's Luca Parmitano — aboard NASA's Orion spacecraft.
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，新格伦号将首先升空，将蓝色起源的蓝月月球着陆器运送到近地轨道（LEO）。 SLS 接下来将搭载阿耳忒弥斯三号宇航员——美国宇航局的兰迪·布雷斯尼克、安德烈·道格拉斯和弗兰克·鲁比奥，以及欧洲航天局的卢卡·帕尔米塔诺——登上美国宇航局的猎户座飞船。

paras.en: SLS will deploy Orion into a highly elliptical orbit, one that gets as close to Earth as 18 miles (29 kilometers) and as far away as 1,122 miles (1,806 km), according to Parsons. The capsule will then maneuver itself into an orbit with an altitude of about 345 miles (555 km).
paras.zh: 帕森斯表示，SLS 将把猎户座部署到一个高椭圆轨道，该轨道距离地球最近 18 英里（29 公里），最远 1,122 英里（1,806 公里）。然后，太空舱将自行进入高度约 345 英里（555 公里）的轨道。

paras.en: "That's really about getting thermal stability," Parsons said. "Orion was built as a deep-space vehicle, and so we're going to have to really manage the thermal environments, which are higher in a low Earth orbit."
paras.zh: “这实际上是为了获得热稳定性，”帕森斯说。 “猎户座是作为深空飞行器建造的，因此我们必须真正管理低地球轨道上较高的热环境。”

paras.en: The Artemis III crew will spend two days checking out Orion and its systems in LEO before meeting up with Blue Moon, which will take place on Flight Day 3 at an altitude of 273 miles (439 km).
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯 III 号机组人员将花两天时间在近地轨道检查猎户座及其系统，然后与蓝月亮会面，这次会面将于飞行第 3 天在海拔 273 英里（439 公里）的地方进行。

paras.en: "Over the next two days, the crew will conduct operations docked with Blue Moon," Parsons said. "They're going to open up the hatch. They're going to enter the lander. They're going to evaluate the environmental controls, the life support systems. We'll confirm that the spacecraft can maintain the right atmospheric pressure, and we're also going to test emergency scenarios, dual vehicle control, and we're going to put our Mission Control teams through their paces."
paras.zh: 帕森斯说：“在接下来的两天里，船员们将进行与蓝月亮对接的操作。” “他们将打开舱门。他们将进入着陆器。他们将评估环境控制、生命支持系统。我们将确认航天器能够保持正确的大气压力，我们还将测试紧急情况、双飞行器控制，并且我们将让我们的任务控制团队完成他们的步伐。”

paras.en: After those operations are complete — likely on Flight Day 6 or thereabouts — Starship will launch, with a specially built docking adapter on its nose.
paras.zh: 这些操作完成后（可能在飞行第 6 天左右），星际飞船将发射，其机头装有一个特制的对接适配器。

paras.en: The SpaceX vehicle — the 171-foot-tall (52 meters) upper stage of its fully reusable Starship megarocket — will meet up with Orion in LEO on Flight Day 8, at an altitude of about 237 miles (381 km). But this will be a very different encounter than the rendezvous with Blue Moon.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的火箭——其完全可重复使用的星舰巨型火箭的上级，高 171 英尺（52 米）——将于飞行第 8 天与猎户座在近地轨道相遇，高度约为 237 英里（381 公里）。但这将是一次与蓝月亮会面截然不同的遭遇。

paras.en: "The demonstration with Starship is shorter, about two hours," Parsons said. "The crew will not enter the Starship during the mission, but it gives us critical data and allows us to really understand the forces of docking, how we're going to push, how we're going to work together."
paras.zh: “星舰的演示时间较短，大约两个小时，”帕森斯说。 “任务期间，船员不会进入星舰，但它为我们提供了关键数据，让我们真正了解对接的力量、我们将如何推动、我们将如何合作。”

paras.en: Artemis III will continue for another six to nine days after Orion undocks from Starship before finally heading back down to Earth for a parachute-aided ocean splashdown. (The nominal mission length is 14 days, Parsons said, but it could last as long as 17 days.)
paras.zh: 猎户座从星舰脱离后，阿耳忒弥斯三号将继续飞行六到九天，然后最终返回地球，进行降落伞辅助的海洋溅落。 （帕森斯表示，名义上的任务期限为 14 天，但实际上可能会持续长达 17 天。）

paras.en: During that time, the crew will evaluate their survival suits — something that didn't get done during the 10-day Artemis II flight around the moon this past April — and do a variety of other work as well, from detailed health assessments to scientific experiments and technology demonstrations. The main goal is to keep everything on track for Artemis IV, which will land astronauts near the moon's south pole in 2028, if all goes to plan.
paras.zh: 在此期间，机组人员将评估他们的救生衣——这是去年四月为期 10 天的阿耳忒弥斯二号绕月飞行期间未完成的工作——并进行各种其他工作，从详细的健康评估到科学实验和技术演示。主要目标是让阿耳忒弥斯四号一切顺利进行，如果一切按计划进行，阿耳忒弥斯四号将使宇航员于 2028 年登陆月球南极附近。

paras.en: "Everything we do on Artemis III is designed to reduce risk for our future lunar landing missions," Parsons said. "We're teaching these teams how to work together, how to make critical real-time mission decisions, all in an environment that is low Earth orbit, where if something goes wrong, we can come home much more quickly."
paras.zh: 帕森斯说：“我们在阿耳忒弥斯三号上所做的一切都是为了降低未来登月任务的风险。” “我们正在教这些团队如何合作，如何做出关键的实时任务决策，所有这些都在近地轨道的环境中进行，如果出现问题，我们可以更快地回家。”

paras.en: It's unclear at the moment which of these two privately developed landers — Blue Moon or Starship — will fly on Artemis IV, pulling off the first crewed lunar touchdown since Apollo 17 in 1972.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这两个私人开发的着陆器（蓝月号或星舰号）中的哪一个将搭载阿耳忒弥斯四号飞行，实现自 1972 年阿波罗 17 号以来的首次载人登月着陆。

paras.en: NASA is still preserving optionality, "to give both of our lunar landing partners the greatest opportunity for readiness in advance of astronauts landing on the moon in 2028," NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said during today's event.
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 在今天的活动中表示，NASA 仍在保留选择性，“以便为我们的登月合作伙伴提供最大的机会，在 2028 年宇航员登陆月球之前做好准备”。

paras.en: "We have no intention of surrendering a viable path to the surface before the data and schedule compels us to do so," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“在数据和时间表迫使我们这样做之前，我们无意放弃通往地面的可行路径。”

paras.en: No matter what decision NASA makes for Artemis IV, both Blue Moon and Starship should hit the gray dirt relatively soon, according to Parsons. "Regardless of who goes first, both providers are planning for lunar landing missions in 2028," he said.
paras.zh: 帕森斯表示，无论美国宇航局对阿耳忒弥斯四号做出什么决定，“蓝月亮”和“星际飞船”都应该很快就会陷入灰色泥沼。 “无论谁先行动，两家提供商都在计划 2028 年的登月任务，”他说。

paras.en: And those missions will be quite different from each other. For example, on Blue Origin touchdowns, Orion will meet up with Blue Moon in lunar orbit. On SpaceX landings, however, Starship will likely dock with the NASA capsule in Earth orbit and propel it to the moon, Parsons said — the "push" he referred to above.
paras.zh: 这些任务彼此之间会有很大不同。例如，在蓝色起源着陆时，猎户座将在月球轨道上与蓝月亮相遇。然而，帕森斯表示，在 SpaceX 着陆时，星舰可能会与地球轨道上的 NASA 太空舱对接，并将其推向月球——他在上面提到的“推动”。

paras.en: It remains unclear when exactly Artemis III will launch. NASA is targeting the summer of next year but may find it tough to meet that timeline: Last month, in an internal memo, Isaacman told agency employees that Artemis III was about 90 days behind schedule.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚 Artemis III 的具体发射时间。 NASA 的目标是明年夏天，但可能会发现很难满足这个时间表：上个月，艾萨克曼在一份内部备忘录中告诉机构员工，阿尔特弥斯 III 比计划晚了大约 90 天。

paras.en: Some of the biggest challenges have involved the supply chain for the mission's lunar landers, Parsons said during today's event. But he and Isaacman both stressed that NASA is confident in its ability to work through such issues.
paras.zh: 帕森斯在今天的活动中表示，一些最大的挑战涉及任务月球着陆器的供应链。但他和艾萨克曼都强调，美国宇航局对其解决此类问题的能力充满信心。

paras.en: "We're moving with real speed and purpose right now," Isaacman said.
paras.zh: “我们现在正在以真正的速度和目标前进，”艾萨克曼说。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: SpaceX launches Starlink satellites from California as Falcon 9 cadence slows (photos)
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: SpaceX launched its newest batch of Starlink broadband internet satellites today (Oct. 23) from the California coast.
paras.zh: SpaceX 今天（10 月 23 日）从加州海岸发射了最新一批 Starlink 宽带互联网卫星。

paras.en: The spacecraft, Starlink Group 15-15, were stacked 27 high inside the payload fairing of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, which lifted off from Pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base at 6:48 p.m. EDT (2248 GMT; 3:48 p.m. local time in California).
paras.zh: 这艘名为 Starlink Group 15-15 的航天器堆叠在 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭有效载荷整流罩内 27 层高，该火箭于下午 6 点 48 分从范登堡太空部队基地的 4E 发射台升空。美国东部时间（2248 GMT；加利福尼亚州当地时间下午 3:48）。

paras.en: The rocket's first stage booster, designated B1063, executed its main engine cutoff and stage separation about 2.5 minutes into flight, sending the second stage to continue onward to low Earth orbit (LEO). The vehicle's two-piece protective payload fairing was jettisoned just before T+3 minutes.
paras.zh: 火箭的第一级助推器（编号为 B1063）在飞行后约 2.5 分钟执行主发动机切断和级分离，将第二级继续送往近地轨道 (LEO)。车辆的两件式有效载荷保护整流罩在 T+3 分钟前被丢弃。

paras.en: The booster, meanwhile, reoriented for its descent back to Earth. As the mission clock passed 8 minutes, B1063 began its landing burn, and it touched down about 20 seconds later on SpaceX's droneship "Of Course I Still Love You." This was the 36th launch and landing for B1063, which notably launched NASA's DART asteroid-smashing mission in November 2021.
paras.zh: 与此同时，助推器重新调整方向，准备返回地球。当任务时钟过去 8 分钟时，B1063 开始着陆燃烧，约 20 秒后在 SpaceX 的无人机“当然我仍然爱你”上着陆。这是 B1063 的第 36 次发射和着陆，特别是在 2021 年 11 月执行了 NASA 的 DART 小行星粉碎任务。

paras.en: The Falcon 9's upper stage completed its first engine burn shortly after B1063 landed and will coast for about 45 minutes before initiating a second and final orbital insertion burn. Following that burn's execution, deployment of the vehicle's 27 satellites into LEO is scheduled to begin 62 minutes after launch.
paras.zh: B1063 着陆后不久，猎鹰 9 号的上级完成了第一次发动机燃烧，并将滑行约 45 分钟，然后开始第二次也是最后一次轨道插入燃烧。执行燃烧后，计划在发射后 62 分钟开始将飞行器的 27 颗卫星部署到近地轨道。

paras.en: Today's Starlink liftoff adds to SpaceX's growing constellation of more than 11,000 active spacecraft. But Starlinks aren't launching quite as often as they used to, as SpaceX shifts its focus from the Falcon 9 to its bigger and more powerful Starship rocket.
paras.zh: 今天的星链发射为 SpaceX 不断壮大的 11,000 多艘活跃航天器星座增添了新的成员。但随着 SpaceX 将其重点从猎鹰 9 号转移到更大、更强大的星舰火箭，星链发射频率不再像以前那样频繁。

paras.en: Starship is designed for full reusability and is equipped with a payload bay outfitted to accommodate SpaceX's upgraded Version 3 Starlink satellites, which are too large for the workhorse Falcon 9. Starship is still under development, but once the rocket begins operational flights (and that day is getting closer), SpaceX plans to phase out the Falcon 9 and its Falcon Heavy variant almost entirely.
paras.zh: Starship 的设计可实现完全可重复使用，并配备了一个有效载荷舱，可容纳 SpaceX 升级后的第 3 版星链卫星，这些卫星对于主力猎鹰 9 号卫星来说太大了。Starship 仍在开发中，但一旦火箭开始运行飞行（这一天越来越近），SpaceX 计划几乎完全淘汰猎鹰 9 号及其猎鹰重型变体。

paras.en: Falcon 9's 100th launch of 2026 was the Starlink 10-49 group from SpaceX's pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, which was later revealed to be the final Falcon 9 Starlink mission that would fly from Florida's Space Coast. The same might soon be true for Starlink launches from the West Coast as well.
paras.zh: 猎鹰 9 号 2026 年的第 100 次发射是从 SpaceX 卡纳维拉尔角太空部队发射场发射的星链 10-49 组，后来透露这是从佛罗里达州太空海岸起飞的最后一次猎鹰 9 星链任务。从西海岸发射的星链卫星也可能很快就会出现同样的情况。

paras.en: The reduction in missions lifting off from Florida has slowed Falcon 9's Starlink launch cadence considerably. At their peak, these missions were flying every two to three days. But the most recent one before today lifted off 11 days ago, and that launch itself was the first Starlink mission in more than three weeks.
paras.zh: 从佛罗里达州起飞的任务数量的减少大大减慢了猎鹰 9 号星链的发射节奏。在高峰时期，这些任务每两到三天飞行一次。但今天之前的最近一次发射是在 11 天前，而那次发射本身就是三周多以来的首次星链任务。

paras.en: Today's launch was the 116th Falcon 9 flight so far in 2026, with about three-quarters of those being dedicated to Starlink. The reduced cadence will likely solidify 2025 as the Falcon 9's busiest year ever, with 165 launches completed. At its current rate, the Falcon 9 is expected to fly just under 150 missions by the end of this year.
paras.zh: 今天的发射是 2026 年迄今为止猎鹰 9 号的第 116 次飞行，其中约四分之三专门用于星链。减少的节奏可能会使 2025 年成为猎鹰 9 号有史以来最繁忙的一年，完成了 165 次发射。按照目前的速度，猎鹰 9 号预计到今年年底将执行近 150 次飞行任务。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and space exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions from the Space Coast, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon and more. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和太空探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系的演变、太空海岸载人飞行任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划以及人类重返月球等内容。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: Jena-Optronik is proud to partner with MDA Space for its first ASTRO HP mission.
articles.author: Jena-Optronik

paras.en: MDA Space, a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, space exploration and infrastructure, will utilize Jena-Optronik’s ASTRO HP star sensor on a LEO mission. This milestone underscores our ability to provide cutting-edge technology that meets the demands of international space missions.
paras.zh: MDA Space 是通信卫星、地球和空间观测、太空探索和基础设施领域的全球领导者，将在低地球轨道任务中使用 Jena-Optronik 的 ASTRO HP 星传感器。这一里程碑强调了我们提供满足国际太空任务需求的尖端技术的能力。

paras.en: In a market that moves fast, the ASTRO HP optical head provides the perfect balance: high performance thanks to the radiation-hard Faintstar2 detector, the very fast optics in a compact, lightweight design optimized for small and medium-sized, high-performance satellites.
paras.zh: 在快速变化的市场中，ASTRO HP 光学头提供了完美的平衡：高性能得益于抗辐射 Faintstar2 探测器，非常快速的光学器件采用紧凑、轻量的设计，针对中小型高性能卫星进行了优化。

paras.en: The new sensor leverages the proven heritage of Jena Optronik technologies: combining the precision and agility of the ASTRO APS3 with the flight-proven electronics and software of the ASTRO CL, all unified by our easy-to-integrate ASTROlib software.
paras.zh: 新型传感器利用了 Jena Optronik 技术的成熟传统：将 ASTRO APS3 的精度和敏捷性与经过飞行验证的 ASTRO CL 电子设备和软件相结合，所有这些都通过我们易于集成的 ASTROlib 软件进行统一。

paras.en: The ASTRO HP optical head delivers next-level attitude accuracy and rate capabilities without forcing you to redesign your platform. This modular approach provides unique flexibility to tailor performance and cost directly to your mission specific needs.
paras.zh: ASTRO HP 光学头可提供更高水平的姿态精度和速率功能，而无需迫使您重新设计平台。这种模块化方法提供了独特的灵活性，可以直接根据您的任务特定需求定制性能和成本。

paras.en: Furthermore, the advanced ASTROlib enables specialized SSA capabilities. The first flight ready version will be rolled out for this particular program.
paras.zh: 此外，先进的 ASTROlib 还支持专门的 SSA 功能。第一个飞行就绪版本将针对该特定计划推出。

articles.title: Summer of Quantum: Building momentum for space-based QKD
articles.author: Craft Prospect

paras.en: Glasgow, UK | 21 October 2026 – The pace of development in quantum technologies continues to accelerate, and over the past few months, space engineering company Craft Prospect has been involved in conversations across the UK, Europe, Japan and the United States exploring the future of secure communications.
paras.zh: 英国格拉斯哥 | 2026 年 10 月 21 日 – 量子技术的发展步伐持续加快，在过去的几个月里，太空工程公司 Craft Prospect 参与了英国、欧洲、日本和美国的对话，探索安全通信的未来。

paras.en: Taking quantum technology from the lab to orbit
paras.zh: 将量子技术从实验室带入轨道

paras.en: Senior Quantum Engineer Andrew Kelly presented at two key industry events this year. At the 9th Annual ScyLight Conference in Tenerife, he joined the Quantum Mission session to discuss the quantum and optical CubeSat payloads being developed for the €20 million OPS-SAT VOLT mission. The conference brought together leaders from across Europe and provided an ideal forum to discuss how emerging quantum capabilities can be integrated into future space systems.
paras.zh: 高级量子工程师安德鲁·凯利 (Andrew Kelly) 在今年的两场重要行业活动中发表了讲话。在特内里费岛举行的第九届 ScyLight 年度会议上，他参加了量子任务会议，讨论了为 2000 万欧元的 OPS-SAT VOLT 任务开发的量子和光学 CubeSat 有效载荷。这次会议汇集了来自欧洲各地的领导人，并提供了一个理想的论坛来讨论如何将新兴的量子能力集成到未来的空间系统中。

paras.en: At Newton Q 2026, Andrew presented ‘From Optical Table to Orbit: Quantum Technology for Industry and Space’, exploring the engineering challenges involved in transforming quantum research into deployable products and space-qualified systems. Discussions throughout the event highlighted growing interest in quantum communications, cybersecurity, photonics, and the infrastructure required to support future quantum networks.
paras.zh: 在 Newton Q 2026 上，Andrew 发表了“从光学平台到轨道：工业和太空的量子技术”，探讨了将量子研究转化为可部署产品和太空合格系统所涉及的工程挑战。整个活动的讨论凸显了人们对量子通信、网络安全、光子学以及支持未来量子网络所需的基础设施日益增长的兴趣。

paras.en: As governments and industry increase investment in space and quantum technology, international collaboration is becoming increasingly important.
paras.zh: 随着政府和业界加大对空间和量子技术的投资，国际合作变得越来越重要。

paras.en: At SPACETIDE 2026, held in Tokyo in July, Craft Prospect Managing Director Steve Greenland participated in discussions around UK-Japan collaboration, space security, and the technologies required to build secure and resilient space infrastructure. Those conversations reinforced a clear trend: nations are actively exploring how quantum technologies work together to support future national capabilities.
paras.zh: 在 7 月于东京举行的 SPACETIDE 2026 上，Craft Prospect 董事总经理 Steve Greenland 参与了有关英日合作、太空安全以及构建安全和弹性太空基础设施所需技术的讨论。这些对话强化了一个明显的趋势：各国正在积极探索量子技术如何共同支持未来的国家能力。

paras.en: Similarly, at ESA’s Quantum Technology Workshop in July, Quantum Technology Lead Natalie Pearson and Sales Engineer Rory Ireland engaged with organisations from across the European space sector, discussing emerging technologies and exploring opportunities for future collaboration.
paras.zh: 同样，在 7 月份的欧空局量子技术研讨会上，量子技术主管 Natalie Pearson 和销售工程师 Rory Ireland 与欧洲航天领域的组织进行了交流，讨论新兴技术并探索未来合作的机会。

paras.en: At SmallSat 2026 in Salt Lake City in August, the conversation moved from future concepts to practical implementation.
paras.zh: 8 月在盐湖城举行的 SmallSat 2026 大会上，讨论从未来概念转向了实际实施。

paras.en: As part of Craft Prospect’s activities throughout the conference, Head of Engineering Kevin Quillien presented work on The Quantum CubeSat, while Head of Commercial Hina Khan and AI Lead Lucy Donnell showcased progress on OPS-SAT VOLT alongside partners Bright Ascension.
paras.zh: 作为 Craft Prospect 在整个会议期间活动的一部分，工程主管 Kevin Quillien 介绍了 Quantum CubeSat 的工作，而商业主管 Hina Khan 和 AI 主管 Lucy Donnell 与合作伙伴 Bright Ascension 一起展示了 OPS-SAT VOLT 的进展。

paras.en: The response highlighted significant interest in missions capable of demonstrating secure communications, optical networking, autonomy, and quantum-enabled technologies in orbit.
paras.zh: 该回应突显了人们对能够在轨道上展示安全通信、光网络、自主性和量子技术的任务的浓厚兴趣。

paras.en: View Craft Prospect’s Quantum CubeSat poster here.
paras.zh: 请在此处查看 Craft Prospect 的量子立方卫星海报。

paras.en: Rising demand for demonstration platforms
paras.zh: 对演示平台的需求不断增长

paras.en: Across every event, one message was consistent: organisations want to move beyond theory and begin testing quantum technologies in realistic operational environments.
paras.zh: 在每一次活动中，都有一个一致的信息：组织希望超越理论，开始在现实的操作环境中测试量子技术。

paras.en: That growing demand is one of the drivers behind Craft Prospect’s development of a new Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Space Network Emulator.
paras.zh: 这种不断增长的需求是 Craft Prospect 开发新型量子密钥分发 (QKD) 空间网络模拟器的驱动因素之一。

paras.en: The platform is designed to provide a practical environment for demonstrating, integrating, and testing QKD technologies before deployment, helping industry, researchers, and mission teams reduce risk and accelerate development.
paras.zh: 该平台旨在提供一个在部署前演示、集成和测试 QKD 技术的实用环境，帮助行业、研究人员和任务团队降低风险并加速开发。

paras.en: As momentum continues to build around secure communications and quantum networking, facilities that enable rapid experimentation and validation are becoming increasingly important.
paras.zh: 随着安全通信和量子网络的发展势头不断增强，能够进行快速实验和验证的设施变得越来越重要。

paras.en: A recurring theme across every event was the growing convergence of quantum technologies and space systems. As optical communications, quantum-secure networking, QKD and intelligent autonomous platforms mature, they are becoming key enablers of the next generation of Smart Secure Space.
paras.zh: 每场活动中反复出现的主题是量子技术和空间系统的日益融合。随着光通信、量子安全网络、QKD 和智能自主平台的成熟，它们正在成为下一代智能安全空间的关键推动者。

paras.en: With quantum technologies increasingly moving from research to deployment, Craft Prospect continues to develop the capabilities needed to support more secure, resilient and intelligent space systems.
paras.zh: 随着量子技术日益从研究转向部署，Craft Prospect 不断开发支持更安全、有弹性和智能的空间系统所需的功能。

articles.title: Nov. 5: Satellite Mission Management at the Edge
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Satellite operations are growing more complex. For national security missions, that means faster decisionmaking, greater resilience and the ability to adapt on orbit is needed. Today’s operators must modernize mission management, integrate new technologies and deliver capabilities without compromising security, reliability or operational control.
paras.zh: 卫星操作变得越来越复杂。对于国家安全任务来说，这意味着需要更快的决策、更强的弹性和在轨道上的适应能力。当今的运营商必须在不影响安全性、可靠性或运营控制的情况下实现任务管理现代化、集成新技术并提供功能。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and RTX on Nov. 5 for a virtual event exploring how emerging technologies and commercial capabilities are transforming satellite operations and enabling more dynamic, resilient and affordable national security space missions.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日与 SpaceNews 和 RTX 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨新兴技术和商业能力如何改变卫星运营，并实现更具活力、更有弹性和负担得起的国家安全太空任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in mission management, edge computing, automation and cloud-native architectures, as well as the challenges of integrating new capabilities with legacy systems. The conversation will examine how modular approaches can accelerate technology upgrades, strengthen mission assurance and improve affordability.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论任务管理、边缘计算、自动化和云原生架构方面的进步，以及将新功能与遗留系统集成的挑战。对话将探讨模块化方法如何加速技术升级、加强任务保证并提高可承受性。

articles.title: 'A clear red' - Should Ipswich's Diop have been sent off?

paras.en: Ipswich's Issa Diop escaped a red card for a foul on Nottingham Forest's James McAtee - but was it the right call?
paras.zh: 伊普斯维奇队的伊萨·迪奥普因对诺丁汉森林队的詹姆斯·麦卡蒂犯规而逃脱了红牌——但这是否是正确的决定呢？

paras.en: Ipswich's Issa Diop was shown a yellow card for a last-man foul on James McAtee when it was deemed he didn't deny an obvious goal-scoring opportunity by referee Thomas Bramall after a VAR intervention; Nottingham Forest boss Oliver Glasner said it was a 'clear red card' after the 1-1 draw
paras.zh: 伊普斯维奇队的伊萨·迪奥普因最后一人对詹姆斯·麦卡蒂犯规而被出示黄牌，裁判托马斯·布拉莫尔在 VAR 介入后认为他没有否认明显的进球机会；诺丁汉森林队主帅奥利弗·格拉斯纳表示，在1-1战平后，这是一张“明显的红牌”

paras.en: Issa Diop escaped what Oliver Glasner called "a clear red card" during Ipswich's 1-1 draw with Nottingham Forest - but the incident split opinion, so was it the right call or not?
paras.zh: 在伊普斯维奇 1-1 战平诺丁汉森林的比赛中，伊萨·迪奥普躲过了奥利弗·格拉斯纳所说的“明显的红牌”——但这一事件的意见分歧，所以这是正确的决定吗？

paras.en: With less than five minutes of the second half played when Diop slid in on Forest's James McAtee, a sending off could have transformed the outcome of the game.
paras.zh: 下半场还不到五分钟，迪奥普就插上了森林队的詹姆斯·麦卡蒂，如果被罚下场，比赛的结果可能会改变。

paras.en: Glasner was adamant Diop had denied a clear goal-scoring opportunity. But Diop himself told Sky Sports he was "quite confident" he would stay on the field as the officials and VAR came to their decision.
paras.zh: 格拉斯纳坚称迪奥普拒绝了明显的进球机会。但迪奥普本人告诉天空体育，当裁判和VAR做出决定时，他“非常有信心”自己会留在球场上。

paras.en: There was also split opinion among the Sky Sports pundits, too.
paras.zh: 天空体育的专家们也存在不同意见。

paras.en: On co-commentary, Lee Hendrie reckoned Diop was "really lucky" and criticised the reasoning from the referee. Post-match, Ashley Young defended the decision.
paras.zh: 在共同评论中，李亨德里认为迪奥普“真的很幸运”，并批评了裁判的推理。赛后，阿什利·杨为这一决定进行了辩护。

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract on NOW 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？立即免费观看天空体育或直播 📺

paras.en: Here we break down the key moment - and ask you to have your say.
paras.zh: 在这里，我们分解了关键时刻 - 并请您发表意见。

paras.en: Ipswich centre-back Diop slid in on McAtee, missing the ball and making contact with the Forest player as he tried to break through on goal.
paras.zh: 伊普斯维奇中后卫迪奥普冲向麦卡蒂，在麦卡蒂试图突破球门时，他错失了球并与森林队球员发生了接触。

paras.en: Ref Thomas Bramall didn't blow his whistle but was then advised by VAR to go to the pitchside monitor to review the incident "for a possible denial of an obvious goal-scoring opportunity".
paras.zh: 裁判托马斯·布拉马尔（Thomas Bramall）没有吹哨，但随后VAR建议他前往场边监视器查看这一事件，“是否有可能剥夺明显的进球机会”。

paras.en: After watching replays, ref Bramall announced it was a foul and then said: "However, because the player knocks it to the right side of the goal, the final decision is direct free-kick and a yellow card to No.6."
paras.zh: 裁判布拉马尔观看回放后宣布这是一次犯规，然后说道：“但是，由于球员将球撞到了球门右侧，因此最终判定为直接任意球，并对6号球员出示黄牌。”

paras.en: In his announcement, Bramall indicates that McAtee's touch before he is fouled by Diop means the situation cannot be deemed as an "obvious goal-scoring opportunity".
paras.zh: 布拉莫尔在声明中表示，麦卡蒂在被迪奥普犯规之前的触球意味着这种情况不能被视为“明显的进球机会”。

paras.en: McAtee touches the ball forwards. That takes the ball into the box and slightly to the right.
paras.zh: 麦卡蒂向前触球。这会将球带入禁区并稍微偏向右侧。

paras.en: Significantly to the right? "I do not think he has touched it away from goal at all," said Hendrie on Sky Sports commentary.
paras.zh: 明显偏右？亨德里在接受天空体育评论时表示：“我认为他根本没有偏离球门。”

paras.en: Glasner later argued that moving the ball to the right would have increased the possibility for McAtee to score.
paras.zh: 格拉斯纳后来辩称，将球移到右侧会增加麦卡蒂得分的可能性。

paras.en: "When you run against the keeper and you run straight, often the angle is not really good, so we are telling the players to sometimes create an angle and I think he prepared his finish by going a little bit half-right, so the keeper has to move and opens the near or far post."
paras.zh: “当你对抗守门员并且直线跑动时，角度通常不是很好，所以我们告诉球员有时要创造一个角度，我认为他通过稍微偏右来准备射门，所以守门员必须移动并打开近门柱或远门柱。”

paras.en: But it seems there were other factors on Bramall's mind, too.
paras.zh: 但布拉莫尔的脑海里似乎还有其他因素。

paras.en: Soon after the incident, the Premier League Match Centre posted an explanation on social media of what had happened, including both the on-field announcement from Bramall but also a sentence he said during the decision-making process.
paras.zh: 事件发生后不久，英超比赛中心就在社交媒体上发布了对所发生事情的解释，其中既有布拉莫尔在场上的宣布，也有他在决策过程中所说的一句话。

paras.en: "It's a heavy touch, with the defender inside and he knocks the ball away from the goal - I'm going to go direct free-kick and yellow card".
paras.zh: “这是一次重击，防守队员在内线，他将球撞离球门——我将直接任意球并获得黄牌。”

paras.en: Bramall didn't mention the "heavy touch" in his announcement at Portman Road - but was McAtee ever actually going to reach the ball after he knocked it forwards? Leif Davis was the Ipswich defender "inside" the ref is referring to.
paras.zh: 布拉莫尔在波特曼路球场的声明中并没有提到“重击”——但麦卡蒂在将球向前击出后真的能接住球吗？莱夫·戴维斯是裁判所指的“内部”伊普斯维奇后卫。

paras.en: "McAtee isn't going to get there before Davis. He's quick," said Ashley Young on Sky Sports. "Plus, the ball is going through to the goalkeeper. I think the goalkeeper is going to get there as well.
paras.zh: “麦卡蒂不会在戴维斯之前到达那里。他很快，”天空体育的阿什利·杨说。 “另外，球会传到守门员那里。我认为守门员也会到达那里。

paras.en: Diop also used Davis' presence in his defence. "I did the tackle because I saw Leif coming and covering and also he pushed the ball wide and too far."
paras.zh: 迪奥普还利用戴维斯的存在来防守。 “我之所以铲球，是因为我看到莱夫过来并进行掩护，而且他把球推得太远了。”

paras.en: "The red card will split decision," said former Forest boss Steve Cooper afterwards on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “红牌将导致决定分歧，”森林队前主帅史蒂夫·库珀事后在天空体育节目中说道。

paras.en: "Forest fans and staff and players will feel hard done by but if it had gone against Ipswich, they would definitely have felt hard done by."
paras.zh: “森林队球迷、工作人员和球员会感到很难过，但如果对阵伊普斯维奇，他们肯定会感到很难过。”

paras.en: There was even division on whether it was right for Bramall to wait for VAR to intervene, with Gibbs-White and Cooper critical of the ref for not making the decision initially, while Ipswich boss Gary O'Neil praised the process.
paras.zh: 对于布拉莫等待VAR介入是否正确的问题甚至存在分歧，吉布斯-怀特和库珀批评裁判最初没有做出决定，而伊普斯维奇主帅加里·奥尼尔则赞扬了这一过程。

paras.en: A controversial way to kick off the Premier League weekend. Have your say on the incident in our poll above!
paras.zh: 以一种有争议的方式开始英超周末。在我们上面的民意调查中对这一事件发表您的看法！

articles.title: Leclerc edges Antonelli to complete US GP practice double

paras.en: United States GP: Charles Leclerc edges Kimi Antonelli in Practice Two to complete Friday double for Ferrari
paras.zh: 美国大奖赛：查尔斯·勒克莱尔在第二场练习赛中击败基米·安东内利，为法拉利完成周五双冠王

paras.en: Charles Leclerc tops both Friday practice sessions in Austin; Ferrari driver edged out Kimi Antonelli in second practice; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔 (Charles Leclerc) 在奥斯汀举行的周五练习赛中均名列前茅；法拉利车手在第二次练习赛中击败基米·安东内利；在天空体育 F1 上观看每场美国大奖赛的直播，周六晚上 10 点排位赛，周日晚上 8 点正赛

paras.en: Ferrari's Charles Leclerc edged out Kimi Antonelli to complete a Friday practice double at the United States Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 法拉利车队的查尔斯·勒克莱尔 (Charles Leclerc) 击败基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli)，在美国大奖赛上完成周五练习赛双打。

paras.en: After narrowly topping Red Bull's Max Verstappen in the opening session, Leclerc improved by almost eight tenths of a second later in the day to finish 0.042s clear of Mercedes' Antonelli, who could become Formula 1's youngest ever world champion on Sunday.
paras.zh: 在首场比赛中以微弱优势超越红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘后，勒克莱尔在当天晚些时候提高了近十分之八秒，领先梅赛德斯车队的安东内利 0.042 秒，后者可能在周日成为 F1 有史以来最年轻的世界冠军。

paras.en: Verstappen appears to be in contention to extend his streak of two successive victories after finishing the second session in third, within a couple of tenths of Leclerc's leading time of 1:35.291s.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在第二节比赛中获得第三名，距离勒克莱尔 1 分 35.291 秒的领先时间只有十分之几，他似乎有望延续自己的两连胜纪录。

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton was unable to match his team-mate Leclerc's pace all day, and had to settle for fourth as he finished more than six tenths back from the Monegasque.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿一整天都无法追上队友勒克莱尔的步伐，最终只落后摩纳哥车手十分之六，最终只能屈居第四。

paras.en: George Russell was fifth in the other Mercedes, but will also be looking for overnight answers as he finished seven tenths back from his team-mate.
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔在另一辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第五，但他也将在夜间寻找答案，因为他落后队友十分之七。

paras.en: Antonelli could clinch his maiden title if he wins on Sunday, and Russell and Hamilton do not score sufficient points to stay in mathematical contention.
paras.zh: 如果安东内利在周日获胜，他可能会获得他的首个冠军头衔，而拉塞尔和汉密尔顿的得分不足以留在数学争夺中。

paras.en: The 20-year-old Italian had to overcome some early disruption as his seat became loose, which left him needing to pit and leave the car for the best part of 10 minutes as the issue was repaired.
paras.zh: 这位 20 岁的意大利车手必须克服一些早期的故障，因为他的座椅松动了，这使得他需要进站并离开赛车 10 分钟，因为问题得到了修复。

paras.en: McLaren suffered a disappointing day as Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri finished seventh and eighth, with both failing to deliver clean laps on their soft-tyre runs.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦度过了令人失望的一天，兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里分别获得第七和第八名，两人都未能在软胎比赛中取得干净的单圈成绩。

paras.en: Ferrari, McLaren and Red Bull have each brought upgrades to the event, while Mercedes are still trying to optimise the package they brought two rounds ago in Malaysia that has so far failed to deliver the improvement they anticipated.
paras.zh: 法拉利、迈凯轮和红牛均对赛事进行了升级，而梅赛德斯仍在努力优化他们两轮前在马来西亚带来的套件，但迄今为止未能实现他们预期的改进。

paras.en: Antonelli said: "It was a bit of a difficult start because the seat was not fixed properly, so it kind of felt a bit like being on a rollercoaster on lap one, with the seat moving in the high speed.
paras.zh: 安东内利说：“起步有点困难，因为座椅没有固定好，所以第一圈感觉有点像坐过山车，座椅高速移动。

paras.en: "We lost a little bit of time, but it was still a good recovery. I felt better in the car compared to FP1. There's still lots of work to do but it was a good step forward, and now we'll try to improve even further for tomorrow."
paras.zh: “我们损失了一点时间，但仍然是一个很好的恢复。与 FP1 相比，我在赛车中感觉更好。还有很多工作要做，但这是向前迈出的一大步，现在我们将努力为明天进一步改进。”

paras.en: Ferrari's package, which featured updates to the car's floor, sidepod and diffuser, appeared to offer hope the Italian team could end a run of eight races without victory, but Leclerc preached caution after his strong day.
paras.zh: 法拉利的套件包括对汽车地板、侧箱和扩散器的更新，似乎为意大利车队结束八场比赛未尝胜利的局面带来了希望，但勒克莱尔在强劲的一天后表示要谨慎。

paras.en: "The feeling is quite good, but we need to be careful," Leclerc said. "It's only Friday and we are seeing what we expected but, again, it's definitely not what everybody thinks in terms of upgrade and lap time gain.
paras.zh: “这种感觉相当好，但我们需要小心，”勒克莱尔说。 “这只是周五，我们看到了我们所期望的，但同样，这绝对不是每个人在升级和单圈时间增益方面的想法。

paras.en: "But it has been a good day. The balance of the car was good and straight away we started in a good window. That paid off and obviously all the hard work that has been done in order to bring this upgrade as soon as possible is also helping us a little bit.
paras.zh: “但这真是美好的一天。赛车的平衡性很好，我们很快就在一个良好的窗口开始了。这得到了回报，显然，为了尽快进行升级而付出的所有努力也对我们有所帮助。

paras.en: "But we shouldn't carry too high expectations going into tomorrow because I feel like the others have more potential to unlock for sure. Kimi and Max seem to be very, very strong, The McLaren I don't really know yet, I don't think they put everything together yet. But Kimi and Max will definitely be up there."
paras.zh: “但我们不应该对明天抱有太高的期望，因为我觉得其他人肯定有更多的潜力可以释放。Kimi 和 Max 似乎非常非常强大，迈凯伦我还不太了解，我认为他们还没有把所有东西放在一起。但 Kimi 和 Max 肯定会在那里。”

paras.en: There was early drama in the session as Russell was investigated for forcing Leclerc off track, but the stewards decided that there had been "nothing dangerous" in the manoeuvre as no further action was taken.
paras.zh: 比赛初期出现了戏剧性的场面，拉塞尔因迫使勒克莱尔偏离赛道而受到调查，但干事们认为这一动作“没有任何危险”，因此没有采取进一步的行动。

paras.en: Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar cut a frustrated figure over team radio as he could only manage ninth, with Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson taking advantage to claim an impressive sixth.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔在车队广播中表现得很沮丧，因为他只能获得第九名，而公牛队的利亚姆·劳森则利用这一优势获得了令人印象深刻的第六名。

paras.en: Williams suffered a torrid afternoon as Carlos Sainz was 20th and team-mate Alex Albon 22nd as their car struggled to meet the challenges of the high-speed circuit.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯车队经历了一个炎热的下午，卡洛斯·塞恩斯（Carlos Sainz）排名第 20，队友亚历克斯·阿尔本（Alex Albon）排名第 22，因为他们的赛车难以应对高速赛道的挑战。

articles.title: Newey responds to Horner's 'abandon ship' criticism

paras.en: Adrian Newey responds to Christian Horner's criticism of him in new book over Red Bull's struggles with Renault in 2014
paras.zh: 阿德里安·纽维 (Adrian Newey) 在新书中回应了克里斯蒂安·霍纳 (Christian Horner) 在红牛 2014 年与雷诺的斗争中对他的批评

paras.en: In his autobiography, ex-Red Bull boss Christian Horner claims Adrian Newey" wanted to abandon ship" at "first sign of adversity" at team in 2014; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
paras.zh: 前红牛老板克里斯蒂安·霍纳在自传中声称，2014 年，阿德里安·纽维在球队“遇到逆境的第一个迹象”时就“想放弃”；在天空体育 F1 上观看每场美国大奖赛的直播，周六晚上 10 点排位赛，周日晚上 8 点正赛

paras.en: Adrian Newey suspects Christian Horner did not "fully understand" his "pain and frustration" during Red Bull's fallow years with Renault engines after criticism of him in the former team principal's new book.
paras.zh: 阿德里安·纽维（Adrian Newey）怀疑克里斯蒂安·霍纳（Christian Horner）在前车队负责人的新书中批评了他之后，并没有“完全理解”他在红牛与雷诺引擎的休养年月中的“痛苦和沮丧”。

paras.en: Horner as team principal and Newey as technical chief worked together with huge success across 19 years at Red Bull, enjoying two periods of sustained title-winning form with first Sebastian Vettel in 2010-2013 and then Max Verstappen in 2021-2024.
paras.zh: 作为车队领队的霍纳和作为技术主管的纽维在红牛工作了 19 年，取得了巨大的成功，并享受了两个持续夺冠的时期，首先是 2010-2013 年的塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔，然后是 2021-2024 年的马克斯·维斯塔潘。

paras.en: But between those periods Red Bull took a back seat to Mercedes' dominance of the sport following the arrival of turbo-hybrid engines in 2014.
paras.zh: 但在此期间，随着 2014 年涡轮混合动力发动机的出现，红牛在这项运动中的统治地位让位于梅赛德斯。

paras.en: Red Bull initially continued to be powered by Renault, as in their four title-winning years under the previous rules era, but the French manufacturer struggled with the new regulations, which compromised the performance of the team's Newey-designed car.
paras.zh: 红牛最初继续由雷诺提供动力，就像他们在之前的规则时代四次夺冠一样，但这家法国制造商在新规则中遇到了困难，这损害了车队纽维设计的赛车的性能。

paras.en: Writing in his newly-released autobiography, Drive, Horner recounted a period mid-way through 2014 when he became disappointed in Newey after the legendary designer had received an offer to join Ferrari and was mulling whether to leave.
paras.zh: 霍纳在新出版的自传《Drive》中讲述了 2014 年中期的一段时期，当时他对纽维感到失望，因为这位传奇设计师收到了加入法拉利的邀请，并正在考虑是否离开。

paras.en: Horner wrote: "I stood behind him and believed that he stood behind me as well. But at the first sign of adversity, Adrian wanted to abandon ship. I felt very sad about that."
paras.zh: 霍纳写道：“我站在他身后，相信他也站在我身后。但在逆境一出现的时候，阿德里安就想弃船。我对此感到非常难过。”

paras.en: Horner added that, despite Newey's importance to the team, "I could no longer rely on him. Our partnership was not as solid as I had previously believed."
paras.zh: 霍纳补充说，尽管纽维对球队很重要，但“我不能再依赖他了。我们的合作关系并不像我之前认为的那么牢固。”

paras.en: Horner's comments were put forward to Newey in Friday's team principals' press conference at the United States Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 霍纳的评论是在周五美国大奖赛车队负责人新闻发布会上向纽维提出的。

paras.en: "You're quite right in saying that, no, I haven't read any of it [the book] yet," replied Newey.
paras.zh: “你说得很对，不，我还没有读过任何一本[这本书]，”纽维回答道。

paras.en: "I think 2014, as a chassis designer, if the PU [Power Unit] manufacturer has a bad year, that happens and you accept it.
paras.zh: “我认为 2014 年，作为一名底盘设计师，如果 PU [动力单元] 制造商经历了糟糕的一年，这种情况就会发生，你会接受它。

paras.en: "If the PU manufacturer has a bad year and doesn't appear to have any intention of trying to address the problem, that's altogether a different matter and that's quite bleak at that point. And that's the situation that unfortunately we faced in 2014.
paras.zh: “如果 PU 制造商今年表现不佳，并且似乎没有任何试图解决问题的意图，那就完全是另一回事了，那时的情况相当黯淡。不幸的是，这就是我们在 2014 年面临的情况。

paras.en: "And as it turned out, that situation didn't really change with that supplier until we changed to Honda in 2019.
paras.zh: “事实证明，直到 2019 年我们改用本田供应商之前，这种情况并没有真正改变。

paras.en: "So, you can imagine my pain and frustration at that. I don't think Christian fully understood that, perhaps. But I was in conversation."
paras.zh: “所以，你可以想象我对此的痛苦和沮丧。我认为克里斯蒂安也许没有完全理解这一点。但我正在交谈。”

paras.en: Ultimately turning down Ferrari's offer in 2014, Newey signed a new contract to stay at Red Bull but began to split his time with other projects at the company outside of F1.
paras.zh: 2014 年，纽维最终拒绝了法拉利的报价，签署了一份留在红牛的新合同，但开始将自己的时间分配给 F1 以外的公司其他项目。

paras.en: Newey stayed a further decade at Red Bull before leaving eventually in 2024 to join Aston Martin the following year, where he is team principal and managing technical partner.
paras.zh: 纽维在红牛又呆了十年，最终于 2024 年离开，并于次年加入阿斯顿·马丁，担任车队负责人和管理技术合作伙伴。

paras.en: Newey added: "The rest of it [in the book] I really can't comment, but Christian and I remain friends. As many of you know, I am godfather to his daughter Olivia, so, yeah."
paras.zh: 纽维补充道：“（书中）的其余部分我真的无法发表评论，但克里斯蒂安和我仍然是朋友。正如你们很多人所知，我是他女儿奥利维亚的教父，所以，是的。”

paras.en: In interviews publicising his book, Horner said he saw similarities between Newey's current experience of trying to turn around a struggling Aston Martin team to their early years at Red Bull following the energy drink's buyout of an underachieving Jaguar outfit in 2005.
paras.zh: 霍纳在宣传他的书的采访中表示，他认为纽维目前试图扭转陷入困境的阿斯顿·马丁车队的经历与早年在红牛2005年收购表现不佳的捷豹车队后的经历有相似之处。

paras.en: It was a comparison that Newey agreed with.
paras.zh: 纽维同意这种比较。

paras.en: "I think there are actually a lot of parallels between when I started at Red Bull and when I've started at Aston Martin," said Newey.
paras.zh: “我认为我在红牛开始的时候和在阿斯顿·马丁开始的时候实际上有很多相似之处，”纽维说。

paras.en: "Both teams that through their history had had quite a lot of turmoil with changes of owners, changes of senior managers, etcetera.
paras.zh: “两支球队在历史上都经历过相当多的动荡，比如老板的更迭、高级管理人员的更迭等等。

paras.en: "It's then really trying to, as we've spoken before, get everybody working together, try to break down silos, improve the culture. And that's been exactly the same again."
paras.zh: “正如我们之前所说，我们确实在努力让每个人一起工作，尝试打破孤岛，改善文化。这又是完全相同的。”

paras.en: Speaking to Sky Sports News earlier this week, Horner said: "Adrian is without doubt the best designer that Formula 1 has ever seen. His track record speaks for itself.
paras.zh: 霍纳本周早些时候在接受天空体育新闻采访时表示：“阿德里安无疑是一级方程式有史以来最好的设计师。他的往绩不言而喻。

paras.en: "Lawrence [Stroll] is a very successful guy. He's a very driven guy and has obviously invested heavily in that team. Honestly, I think they've got their own journey that they're on, and it'll be interesting to see how it plays out."
paras.zh: “劳伦斯（斯特罗尔）是一个非常成功的人。他是一个非常有动力的人，显然在这支球队中投入了大量资金。老实说，我认为他们已经踏上了自己的旅程，看看它如何展开将会很有趣。”

articles.title: Tasmanian football club coach charged with rape
articles.author: Chris Rowbottom

paras.en: A former northern Tasmanian football coach has been charged with three counts of rape, leading to the resignation of the football club's president.
paras.zh: 一名前塔斯马尼亚北部足球教练被指控犯有三项强奸罪，导致足球俱乐部主席辞职。

paras.en: Police confirmed a 44-year-old man from northern Tasmania had been charged with the offences that were alleged to have occurred in April last year.
paras.zh: 警方证实，一名来自塔斯马尼亚北部的 44 岁男子被指控犯有据称于去年 4 月发生的罪行。

paras.en: The man is believed to be former Bracknell football coach, Josh Adams.
paras.zh: 据信，这名男子是前布拉克内尔足球教练乔什·亚当斯。

paras.en: He is scheduled to appear in the Launceston Magistrates Court early next year.
paras.zh: 他定于明年初在朗塞斯顿地方法院出庭。

paras.en: In a statement, Northern Tasmanian Football Association (NTFA) president Peter Gutwein said the association had recently been informed that a coach had been charged with "a serious criminal offence".
paras.zh: 北塔斯马尼亚足球协会（NTFA）主席彼得·古特温（Peter Gutwein）在一份声明中表示，该协会最近获悉一名教练被指控犯有“严重刑事犯罪”。

paras.en: But he said the NTFA would not provide further comment as the matter was now before the courts.
paras.zh: 但他表示，NTFA 不会提供进一步评论，因为此事现已提交法院审理。

paras.en: News of charges being laid against Adams were first published by an independent media outlet.
paras.zh: 对亚当斯提出指控的消息首先由一家独立媒体发布。

paras.en: Its reporting detailed private messages exchanged between Bracknell Football Club president Nicole Jones and the mother of Adams's alleged victim
paras.zh: 它报道了布拉克内尔足球俱乐部主席妮可·琼斯和亚当斯所谓受害者的母亲之间交换的详细私人信息

paras.en: Yesterday, Ms Jones announced via social media that she would be "standing down as president and all official club duties with immediate effect".
paras.zh: 昨天，琼斯女士通过社交媒体宣布，她将“辞去主席职务，并立即履行所有俱乐部官方职责”。

paras.en: "I acknowledge that what I said [in the messages] was disrespectful, inappropriate and wrong, and I unreservedly apologise for these comments,"
paras.zh: “我承认我（在信息中）所说的话是不尊重的、不恰当的和错误的，我对这些评论毫无保留地道歉，”

paras.en: In his statement, Mr Gutwein said the league was "deeply concerned" by the content of the private messages.
paras.zh: 古特温在声明中表示，联盟对私人信息的内容“深感担忧”。

paras.en: "The NTFA has referred the matter to the AFL for independent consideration and acknowledges that the President has unreservedly apologised for those comments and stood aside from all official club duties with immediate effect," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“国家足协已将此事提交澳大利亚橄榄球联盟进行独立考虑，并承认主席已毫无保留地为这些言论道歉，并立即免除俱乐部的所有官方职责。”

paras.en: "The NTFA recognises that individuals who report allegations of sexual violence must be treated with dignity, compassion and respect."
paras.zh: “NTFA 认识到，举报性暴力指控的个人必须受到尊严、同情和尊重的对待。”

paras.en: Adams had not re-committed to coaching Bracknell as of last month.
paras.zh: 截至上个月，亚当斯尚未重新承诺执教布拉克内尔。

paras.en: It is understood he has since been stood down from the role, and will be replaced.
paras.zh: 据了解，他已不再担任该职务，并将被替换。

articles.title: Years of conflict splits voters in former Netanyahu stronghold
articles.author: Matthew Doran and Sami Sockol

paras.en: As lunchtime trade wanders through the door and with the smell of barbecued meat hanging in the air, kebab shop founder Amnon Oved smiles as he offers a rather blunt assessment of the state of Israel's leadership.
paras.zh: 当午餐时间的生意在门口徘徊，空气中弥漫着烤肉的味道时，烤肉店创始人阿姆农·奥维德微笑着，对以色列的领导地位做出了相当直率的评估。

paras.en: The popular businessman is a resident of Kiryat Shmona and, like many other Israelis, is preparing to vote in an election that will have a profound impact on the country after years of conflict and social upheaval.
paras.zh: 这位受欢迎的商人是什莫纳镇的居民，和许多其他以色列人一样，他正准备在一场选举中投票，这场选举将对经历多年冲突和社会动荡的国家产生深远影响。

paras.en: In his mind, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, also known as Bibi, has reached his "best before" date.
paras.zh: 在他看来，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡（也称为比比）已经达到了“最佳之前”日期。

paras.en: "Bibi needs to go to America and sit there with [US President Donald] Trump, to smoke grass together and have a good life," he quips.
paras.zh: “比比需要去美国和（美国总统唐纳德）特朗普坐在一起，一起抽草，过上美好的生活，”他打趣道。

paras.en: "Or he will sit here in prison, one of the two.
paras.zh: “或者他会坐在监狱里，两者之一。

paras.en: "That [was something] we knew before he said it!"
paras.zh: “在他说这句话之前我们就知道了！”

paras.en: The October 27 election has essentially become a referendum on Mr Netanyahu's leadership and legacy.
paras.zh: 10 月 27 日的选举本质上已成为对内塔尼亚胡先生的领导力和遗产的公投。

paras.en: That includes his management of the multiple wars Israel is involved in, through to the personal corruption charges still hanging over him.
paras.zh: 这包括他对以色列卷入的多场战争的管理，以及仍然笼罩在他身上的个人腐败指控。

paras.en: Current polling shows the longest-serving prime minister in Israel's history and his party, Likud, are facing a stiff challenge to hold on to power, with "change" candidates vying to topple him.
paras.zh: 目前的民意调查显示，以色列历史上任职时间最长的总理及其政党利库德集团正面临着保住权力的严峻挑战，“变革”候选人竞相推翻他。

paras.en: Perhaps aware of the growing challenge against his ally, Mr Trump delivered a glowing endorsement of Mr Netanyahu as a "great warrior" ahead of the election.
paras.zh: 也许是意识到他的盟友面临的挑战越来越大，特朗普在大选前对内塔尼亚胡先生表示热烈的认可，称其为“伟大的战士”。

paras.en: Most data suggests Likud will be the second largest party in the next Knesset, behind one of Mr Netanyahu's main rivals, Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar.
paras.zh: 大多数数据表明，利库德集团将成为下一届议会中的第二大党，仅次于内塔尼亚胡的主要竞争对手之一加迪·艾森科特的亚沙尔。

paras.en: But both men will still need to form coalitions post-election.
paras.zh: 但两人仍需要在选举后组建联盟。

paras.en: Mr Oved's business is one of a handful that have consistently remained open in Kiryat Shmona, in far north Israel's Galilee region.
paras.zh: 奥维德的生意是以色列远北加利利地区什莫纳镇一直保持营业的少数企业之一。

paras.en: The city has been a Likud stronghold for decades and sits at the foot of the Ramim Ridge, where the border between Israel and Lebanon runs.
paras.zh: 这座城市几十年来一直是利库德集团的据点，坐落在以色列和黎巴嫩边界的拉米姆山脊脚下。

paras.en: It was one of the Israeli cities targeted by Hezbollah's rocket and drone strikes after the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks on Israel triggered the war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击引发加沙战争后，它是真主党火箭弹和无人机袭击的以色列城市之一。

paras.en: Israeli forces fired back over the border in response until an uneasy and, as some analysts described it, flawed ceasefire was struck in late 2024.
paras.zh: 以色列军队越过边境进行还击，直到 2024 年底达成了令人不安的停火协议，正如一些分析人士所描述的，存在缺陷的停火协议。

paras.en: A fragile peace hung over the area until Hezbollah again opened fire earlier this year.
paras.zh: 脆弱的和平笼罩着该地区，直到今年早些时候真主党再次开火。

paras.en: This time, the group acted in support of its backers in Tehran, days after the US and Israel launched a war on Iran.
paras.zh: 这一次，在美国和以色列对伊朗发动战争几天后，该组织采取行动支持其在德黑兰的支持者。

paras.en: The city came under attack once more, as Israeli forces pummelled Lebanese villages just a short distance away and launched a ground invasion.
paras.zh: 以色列军队袭击了不远处的黎巴嫩村庄并发动地面入侵，这座城市再次受到攻击。

paras.en: "There have been wars since the world was created, and the wars will continue," Mr Oved said.
paras.zh: 奥维德表示：“自世界诞生以来，战争就一直存在，而且战争还将继续。”

paras.en: "It doesn't matter which leaders will be in power, good or bad. They are all crap in the end. They care about themselves."
paras.zh: “哪个领导人掌权并不重要，无论好坏。他们最终都是垃圾。他们只关心自己。”

paras.en: At the November 2022 election, just over 49 per cent of the vote in Kiryat Shmona went to the Netanyahu-led party.
paras.zh: 在 2022 年 11 月的选举中，内塔尼亚胡领导的政党获得了什莫纳镇略高于 49% 的选票。

paras.en: The joint ticket led by far-right ultranationalist politicians Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich ranked second, with just under 14 per cent of the vote.
paras.zh: 由极右翼极端民族主义政客 Itamar Ben-Gvir 和 Bezalel Smotrich 领导的联合选票排名第二，得票率略低于 14%。

paras.en: The two men would go on to become key members of the coalition government, which was later formed. They are running separately at this election.
paras.zh: 这两个人后来成为后来成立的联合政府的主要成员。他们在这次选举中分开竞选。

paras.en: Mr Ben-Gvir has been sanctioned by governments around the world, including Australia. But he and his Otzma Yehudit (Jewish Power) party is making the pitch that a strong Ben-Gvir means a strong Israel.
paras.zh: 本-格维尔先生已受到包括澳大利亚在内的世界各国政府的制裁。但他和他的犹太权力党正在宣扬强大的本格维尔意味着强大的以色列。

paras.en: That message was on clear display at a public bomb shelter on the main road of Kiryat Shmona, which was covered in posters for his party.
paras.zh: 这一信息在什莫纳市主干道上的一个公共防空洞中清晰地展示出来，那里贴满了他的政党的海报。

paras.en: In the background of the image are handcuffed Palestinian prisoners, highlighting his role as national security minister and his demands to become defence minister in a future government.
paras.zh: 图片背景是戴着手铐的巴勒斯坦囚犯，突出了他作为国家安全部长的角色以及他在未来政府中担任国防部长的要求。

paras.en: Only about half of Kiryat Shmona's 25,000 residents have returned since fighting in southern Lebanon calmed.
paras.zh: 自黎巴嫩南部战斗平息以来，什莫纳镇的 25,000 名居民中只有约一半返回。

paras.en: The city's former deputy mayor Shimon Kamari believed many locals would still vote for Likud out of blind loyalty, even though he believed it had "abandoned" the city.
paras.zh: 该市前副市长西蒙·卡马里认为，许多当地人出于盲目忠诚仍会投票支持利库德集团，尽管他认为利库德集团已经“放弃”了这座城市。

paras.en: "Those who remained in the city are traditional people, religious people, people who the support for Likud flows in their blood, and it seems to me that it's very difficult to get it out of them," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“留在这座城市的人都是传统人士、宗教人士，他们的血液中流淌着对利库德集团的支持，在我看来，要从他们身上抹去这种支持是非常困难的。”

paras.en: "It's very hard to get out of it because it comes from home, from the parents, it comes to them from grandparents, and these people are hard to move."
paras.zh: “很难摆脱它，因为它来自家里，来自父母，来自祖父母，这些人很难移动。”

paras.en: Mr Kamari was born in the city to a family of Iranian Jews, and stayed in Kiryat Shmona during the war to continue running his food distribution business.
paras.zh: 卡马里先生出生在该市的一个伊朗犹太人家庭，战争期间留在基里亚特什莫纳继续经营他的食品分销业务。

paras.en: He said his political views had shifted over the years, and he had become more right wing in recent times.
paras.zh: 他说，多年来他的政治观点发生了变化，最近变得更加右翼。

paras.en: For example, he was now of the view that things like a two state solution could not and should not happen.
paras.zh: 例如，他现在认为两国解决方案之类的事情不可能也不应该发生。

paras.en: "If the government does not change … God forbid, it is a death sentence for Kiryat Shmona," he said.
paras.zh: “如果政府不改变……上帝保佑，这对基里亚特什莫纳来说就是死刑，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Kamari said he would be backing Gadi Eisenkot at the ballot box.
paras.zh: 卡马里先生表示，他将在投票箱中支持加迪·艾森科特。

paras.en: "This culture that took root in the State of Israel, the culture of lies, we have to change it," he said.
paras.zh: “这种在以色列国扎根的文化，即谎言文化，我们必须改变它，”他说。

paras.en: "And I believe that the four parties of change, headed by Eisenkot, will be able to bring us back on track."
paras.zh: “我相信，以艾森科特为首的四个变革方将能够让我们重回正轨。”

paras.en: Simmering anger against Mr Netanyahu in the city is countered by vocal support for the prime minister, who has argued he is the only person able to keep Israel and Israelis safe from the enemies who surround it.
paras.zh: 城内对内塔尼亚胡先生的怒火被对总理的公开支持所抵消，总理声称他是唯一能够保护以色列和以色列人民免受周围敌人侵害的人。

paras.en: Herzl Ben Asher, another former deputy mayor and current editor of the Gaillee News, said some voters were misguided if they thought Mr Netanyahu's lengthy time in office was a reason to replace him.
paras.zh: 另一位前副市长、《盖利新闻》现任编辑赫兹尔·本·阿舍尔表示，如果一些选民认为内塔尼亚胡先生任职时间过长是更换他的理由，那么他们就被误导了。

paras.en: "Can you tell someone who has lived with his wife for 20 years, that 20 years is enough, and to replace her with someone else? No," he argued.
paras.zh: “你能告诉一个和妻子一起生活了20年的人，20年就够了，然后用其他人代替她吗？不，”他争辩道。

paras.en: "He needs to maintain his achievements, and that's not easy.
paras.zh: “他需要保持自己的成就，这并不容易。

paras.en: "Getting to the summit is easier than staying at the summit — everyone knows that. He needs to complete his work."
paras.zh: “登上顶峰比留在顶峰更容易——每个人都知道。他需要完成他的工作。”

paras.en: Mr Ben Asher described Mr Netanyahu's achievements as "incomprehensible" in scale and significance, and pointed to the recent war with Iran, which is still not resolved, as evidence of how influential and powerful he can be.
paras.zh: 本·阿舍尔形容内塔尼亚胡取得的成就在规模和意义上“难以理解”，并指出最近与伊朗的战争仍未解决，这证明了他的影响力和权力有多大。

paras.en: Another resident, Yoav Sabbag, lamented how empty Kiryat Shmona was but said Mr Netanyahu was the only person who could breathe life back into the city.
paras.zh: 另一位居民约夫·萨巴格 (Yoav Sabbag) 感叹什莫纳城多么空虚，但表示内塔尼亚胡先生是唯一能让这座城市重获生机的人。

paras.en: "We have to decide to take just Benjamin Netanyahu, because … maybe it is not [like he is] the 'Superman', but he [makes] me feel security in my country and in this area, five minutes from Lebanon."
paras.zh: “我们必须决定只选择本杰明·内塔尼亚胡，因为……也许他不是‘超人’，但他让我在我的国家和这个距离黎巴嫩五分钟路程的地区感到安全。”

articles.title: Two large earthquakes off coast of Vanuatu prompt tsunami warning

paras.en: Two large earthquakes off coast of Vanuatu prompt tsunami warning
paras.zh: 瓦努阿图沿海发生两次大地震，引发海啸警报

paras.en: A tsunami warning has been issued after two large earthquakes struck off the coast of Vanuatu.
paras.zh: 瓦努阿图沿海发生两次大地震后发布了海啸警报。

paras.en: A 6.9 magnitude earthquake struck 200 kilometres west of Sola on Saturday afternoon, followed by a second quake five minutes later.
paras.zh: 周六下午，索拉以西 200 公里处发生了 6.9 级地震，五分钟后又发生了第二次地震。

paras.en: A tsunami warning has been issued for coastlines within 300km of the epicentre.
paras.zh: 距震中300公里以内的海岸线已发布海啸警报。

articles.title: Carney says 'direct casualties' are result of Ukraine's restricted access to Musk's Starshield
articles.author: Peter Zimonjic

paras.en: Carney says 'direct casualties' are result of Ukraine's restricted access to Musk's Starshield
paras.zh: 卡尼称“直接伤亡”是乌克兰限制进入马斯克的星盾造成的

paras.en: PM criticizes 'whoever' decided to limit Ukraine's ability to track Russian strikes
paras.zh: 总理批评“无论是谁”决定限制乌克兰追踪俄罗斯袭击的能力

paras.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney on Friday criticized a decision to restrict Ukraine's access to Elon Musk's military-grade satellite network, saying the move is costing lives.
paras.zh: 周五，总理马克·卡尼批评了限制乌克兰使用埃隆·马斯克军事级卫星网络的决定，称此举正在造成生命损失。

paras.en: "I search for the right adjective to describe whoever took this decision, or a group of people took this decision, against a country … that is literally fighting for the lives of its citizens against naked aggression," Carney said in Istanbul.
paras.zh: 卡尼在伊斯坦布尔表示：“我寻找合适的形容词来形容做出这个决定的人，或者一群人做出这个决定，反对一个国家……这个国家实际上是在为公民的生命而战，反对赤裸裸的侵略。”

paras.en: "So are we concerned? Yes, we are concerned."
paras.zh: “那么我们担心吗？是的，我们担心。”

paras.en: Early last week, Ukrainian officials said they had lost some of their access to Starshield, the military version of Starlink, the global satellite communications system owned and operated by Musk's company SpaceX.
paras.zh: 上周早些时候，乌克兰官员表示，他们已经失去了对 Starshield 的部分访问权限，Starshield 是 Starlink 的军用版本，而 Starlink 是马斯克的公司 SpaceX 拥有和运营的全球卫星通信系统。

paras.en: Ukraine employs Starshield to both track incoming missiles and jet-powered drones, and to guide interceptor and spy drones, while using Starlink for critical internal communications.
paras.zh: 乌克兰使用“星盾”来跟踪来袭导弹和喷气式无人机，并引导拦截机和间谍无人机，同时使用“星链”进行关键的内部通信。

paras.en: Reuters reported last week that, according to two U.S. officials, the order to restrict the system came from inside the White House. The Wall Street Journal, meanwhile, reported on Wednesday that the restrictions were ordered personally by Musk.
paras.zh: 路透社上周报道称，据两名美国官员称，限制该系统的命令来自白宫内部。与此同时，《华尔街日报》周三报道称，这些限制是马斯克亲自下令的。

paras.en: Musk said that Starshield was owned and controlled by the U.S. government, and that any restrictions are decided by the U.S. military and, ultimately, by U.S. President Donald Trump. The commercial Starlink system, he said, was not designed or authorized for military use.
paras.zh: 马斯克表示，“星盾”由美国政府拥有和控制，任何限制均由美国军方决定，并最终由美国总统唐纳德·特朗普决定。他说，商业星链系统不是为军事用途而设计或授权的。

paras.en: Trump has denied ordering the restrictions. On Friday, Trump said he's unaware of who did, and wouldn't tell even if he knew.
paras.zh: 特朗普否认下令实施限制。周五，特朗普表示，他不知道是谁干的，即使知道也不会透露。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that since Starshield's capacity had been restricted, his country has been unable to track drones and missiles travelling faster than 160 kilometres per hour.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基表示，由于“星盾”的能力受到限制，乌克兰一直无法跟踪时速超过 160 公里的无人机和导弹。

paras.en: Zelenskyy says those restrictions have complicated Ukraine's efforts to repel Russian missile and jet drone attacks — resulting in the deaths of civilians, including children.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，这些限制使乌克兰击退俄罗斯导弹和喷气式无人机袭击的努力变得更加复杂，导致包括儿童在内的平民死亡。

paras.en: Carney agreed with that assessment, saying it now "does seem clear" the restrictions have "real consequences, human consequences" and that some recent deaths in Ukraine are "direct casualties as a consequence of this reduced ability."
paras.zh: 卡尼同意这一评估，并表示现在“似乎很清楚”这些限制会产生“真正的后果，人类的后果”，乌克兰最近的一些死亡是“这种能力下降造成的直接伤亡”。

paras.en: "I just refer in the last 36 hours to the attack at the centre of Kyiv," Carney said. "Kyiv, absolutely no dressing up on any sort of military or quasi-military target, just a direct attack on citizens and with immense human suffering. So this is real, this is concrete."
paras.zh: 卡尼表示：“我只是提及过去 36 小时内发生在基辅市中心的袭击事件。” “基辅，绝对没有针对任何形式的军事或准军事目标，只是对公民进行直接攻击，给人类带来巨大的痛苦。所以这是真实的，这是具体的。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Trump said that Musk has since restored Ukraine's access to the satellite network. But Zelenskyy contradicted that claim in an interview with CNN saying "it still doesn't work."
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普表示，马斯克已恢复乌克兰对卫星网络的访问。但泽伦斯基在接受美国有线电视新闻网采访时反驳了这一说法，称“这仍然行不通”。

paras.en: Ukrainian military officials also said on Friday that the restrictions on Starshield remain in place.
paras.zh: 乌克兰军方官员周五还表示，对星盾的限制仍然有效。

paras.en: In an interview with NBC's Meet The Press on Sunday, Zelenskyy was asked directly who he thought was to blame for the Starshield restrictions.
paras.zh: 在周日接受 NBC 的“与媒体见面”采访时，泽伦斯基被直接问及他认为星盾限制应该归咎于谁。

paras.en: "It’s [the] opinion of our generals, of our government and of course my also opinion … that it was the message from American government to limit this speed, and technically SpaceX did it." Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: “这是我们将军们、我们政府的意见，当然还有我的意见……这是美国政府发出的限制这一速度的信息，从技术上讲，SpaceX 做到了。”泽连斯基说道。

paras.en: The restriction of Starshield comes amid a low point in relations between Kyiv and Washington as Trump seeks to push Ukraine into accepting stronger concessions in a peace deal.
paras.zh: 对星盾的限制是在基辅和华盛顿关系陷入低谷之际进行的，特朗普试图推动乌克兰在和平协议中接受更强有力的让步。

paras.en: Trump has also been pressuring Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries, although Starshield is not used on drones conducting those attacks as it does not operate over Russian territory.
paras.zh: 特朗普还一直向乌克兰施压，要求其停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，尽管星盾并未用于进行这些袭击的无人机，因为它不在俄罗斯领土上空运行。

paras.en: Without mentioning Trump, Carney said that relying on an ally "that may change their view" puts Canadians at risk.
paras.zh: 卡尼没有提及特朗普，但表示依赖“可能会改变他们观点”的盟友会让加拿大人面临风险。

paras.en: "Once you realize that, as we have, this government has, it leads to a series of decisions and partnerships that are necessary in order to diversify and to build up sovereign capabilities within Canada or with partners," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“一旦你意识到，就像我们一样，本届政府就会做出一系列必要的决定和伙伴关系，以实现加拿大境内或与合作伙伴的多元化和建立主权能力。”

paras.en: Diversifying Canada's defence partnerships, Carney said, will take time "because we're starting from a position where we're highly, highly reliant on certain systems in certain countries."
paras.zh: 卡尼表示，加拿大防务伙伴关系的多元化需要时间，“因为我们的起点是高度、高度依赖某些国家的某些系统。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy is already working to move away from his country's reliance on the U.S. satellite network, signing a letter of intent with Finnish companies Nokia and ICEYE on Thursday to develop Ukraine's own satellite communications network.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基已经在努力摆脱乌克兰对美国卫星网络的依赖，并于周四与芬兰公司诺基亚和 ICEYE 签署了一份意向书，以开发乌克兰自己的卫星通信网络。

articles.title: Vivek Ramaswamy stands by ad featuring Amy Acton's mother despite bipartisan criticism in Ohio

paras.en: Vivek Ramaswamy stands by ad featuring Amy Acton's mother despite bipartisan criticism in Ohio
paras.zh: 尽管遭到俄亥俄州两党的批评，维韦克·拉马斯瓦米仍然支持艾米·阿克顿母亲的广告

paras.en: Every living full-term governor of Ohio has spoken out against the ad
paras.zh: 每一位在世的俄亥俄州全职州长都公开反对这则广告

paras.en: Biotech billionaire Vivek Ramaswamy embarked on a statewide bus tour across Ohio with fellow Republicans on Friday, even as his gubernatorial campaign's ad featuring the estranged mother of Democratic rival Amy Acton was sowing growing divisions within his party.
paras.zh: 周五，生物技术亿万富翁维韦克·拉马斯瓦米 (Vivek Ramaswamy) 与共和党同僚开始了横跨俄亥俄州的全州巴士之旅，尽管他的州长竞选广告以民主党竞争对手艾米·阿克顿 (Amy Acton) 关系疏远的母亲为主角，在他的党内播下了日益严重的分歧。

paras.en: With the backing of U.S. Vice-President JD Vance and at U.S. President Donald Trump's urging, Ramaswamy has continued a $4 million US campaign to air the ad on streaming platforms and TV. During stops on the tour Friday, he defended it against criticism that he characterized as concocted by Democrats and the news media.
paras.zh: 在美国副总统万斯的支持和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的敦促下，拉马斯瓦米继续耗资 400 万美元在流媒体平台和电视上播放该广告。在周五巡演期间，他针对民主党和新闻媒体炮制的批评进行了辩护。

paras.en: "The irony is they're lying about an ad that is about lying," he told a crowd in suburban Cleveland Friday morning. "They're changing the subject because they don't want to answer for their own failures."
paras.zh: “具有讽刺意味的是，他们在关于撒谎的广告上撒了谎，”他周五早上在克利夫兰郊区对人群说。 “他们正在改变话题，因为他们不想为自己的失败负责。”

paras.en: The 60-second spot features Acton's birth mother, Donna Arthur, calling her daughter "a liar" who "needs help" due to a "a serious problem" being honest about her past.
paras.zh: 这段时长 60 秒的广告中，阿克顿的生母唐娜·阿瑟 (Donna Arthur) 称她的女儿是“骗子”，她“需要帮助”，因为她在诚实地讲述自己的过去方面存在“严重问题”。

paras.en: But Arthur hasn't seen her daughter in nearly 50 years. She lost custody of her children after her husband, the children's stepfather, was indicted for raping Acton when she was 12. Acton, Ohio's former state health director, says she hasn't seen her mother since 1978.
paras.zh: 但亚瑟已经近 50 年没有见过她的女儿了。在她 12 岁时，她的丈夫（孩子们的继父）被指控强奸阿克顿后，她失去了孩子们的监护权。阿克顿是俄亥俄州前州卫生局长，她说自 1978 年以来她就没有见过她的母亲。

paras.en: By Friday, every living full-term governor of Ohio — two Democrats and three Republicans — had spoken out against the ad.
paras.zh: 到周五，俄亥俄州每一位在世的全职州长——两名民主党人和三名共和党人——都公开反对这则广告。

paras.en: Former governor Bob Taft, a Republican, told Marion, Ohio, radio show host Scott Spears that his great-grandfather, president William Howard Taft, "is probably rolling over in his grave" at the negativity of this year's elections.
paras.zh: 前州长、共和党人鲍勃·塔夫脱告诉俄亥俄州马里恩广播节目主持人斯科特·斯皮尔斯，他的曾祖父、总统威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱因今年选举的负面影响“可能正在坟墓里翻滚”。

paras.en: He urged Ramaswamy to cease airing the ad, as another fellow Republican, Gov. Mike DeWine, had done a day earlier. "It really exceeds the bounds of human decency," he said.
paras.zh: 他敦促拉马斯瓦米停止播放这则广告，就像另一位共和党同僚、州长迈克·德温一天前所做的那样。 “这确实超出了人类尊严的界限，”他说。

paras.en: U.S. Sen. Jon Husted — who, like Ramaswamy, is locked in an unexpectedly tight race in Ohio against his Democratic opponent, former senator Sherrod Brown — shared a stage with Vance on Wednesday without mentioning the controversial ad, then issued a statement shortly afterward saying he would not have run it.
paras.zh: 美国参议员乔恩·赫斯特德（Jon Husted）和拉马斯瓦米一样，在俄亥俄州与他的民主党对手、前参议员谢罗德·布朗（Sherrod Brown）展开一场出人意料的激烈竞争。周三，他与万斯同台，但没有提及这则有争议的广告，随后不久发表声明称他不会投放这则广告。

paras.en: Other statewide candidates have drawn the same careful line, without raising the issue when on the same stage with Ramaswamy.
paras.zh: 其他全州候选人也采取了同样的谨慎路线，但在与拉马斯瓦米同台时没有提出这个问题。

paras.en: Husted, whose name is emblazoned on the side of the bus along with all the other statewide candidates, did not participate in the first two stops of the tour Friday. His campaign said he had scheduling conflicts.
paras.zh: 赫斯特德的名字与所有其他全州候选人一起印在巴士侧面，他没有参加周五巡回演出的前两站。他的竞选团队表示，他的日程安排有冲突。

paras.en: At a campaign rally in Iowa on Thursday, Trump told the crowd Ramaswamy called him to ask for advice about the ad.
paras.zh: 周四在爱荷华州举行的竞选集会上，特朗普告诉人群拉马斯瓦米打电话给他，询问有关该广告的建议。

paras.en: "You've got to ride with it," Trump recalled telling Ramaswamy, a former 2024 presidential candidate. Trump expressed jealousy that he didn't have such a strong ad to run during his own campaigns.
paras.zh: 特朗普回忆说，他曾对 2024 年总统候选人拉马斯瓦米说：“你必须顺其自然。”特朗普对自己在竞选期间没有投放如此有力的广告表示嫉妒。

paras.en: Acton has made no secret of facing homelessness and abuse as a child. She has condemned Ramaswamy for the ad.
paras.zh: 阿克顿毫不掩饰童年时面临的无家可归和虐待。她谴责拉马斯瓦米的广告。

paras.en: "I won't normalize somebody who has said that my childhood is just something I'm complaining about," she told Spectrum News.
paras.zh: “我不会把那些说我的童年只是我抱怨的人正常化，”她告诉光谱新闻。

paras.en: According to police and court documents obtained by The Associated Press, Cledith Arthur was arrested and charged with the rape of his stepdaughter, then 12, in July 1978, after Acton's biological father reported him to authorities. The abuse allegedly happened from December 1976 to April 1978.
paras.zh: 据美联社获得的警方和法庭文件显示，1978 年 7 月，阿克顿的亲生父亲向当局举报克莱迪思·阿瑟 (Cledith Arthur)，之后他被捕并被指控强奸了当时 12 岁的继女。据称，虐待事件发生在 1976 年 12 月至 1978 年 4 月期间。

paras.en: Cledith Arthur pleaded not guilty. He was indicted by a grand jury that September, but failed to show at a court hearing and remained a fugitive until at least 1981. He has since died.
paras.zh: 克莱迪思·亚瑟不认罪。同年 9 月，他被大陪审团起诉，但未能出席法庭听证会，并且至少在 1981 年之前一直是逃犯。此后他去世了。

articles.title: Trump tells South Florida rally that U.S. warships could 'do a little stopover' in Cuba, after Iran

paras.en: Trump tells South Florida rally that U.S. warships could 'do a little stopover' in Cuba, after Iran
paras.zh: 特朗普在南佛罗里达州集会上表示，继伊朗之后，美国军舰可以在古巴“短暂停留”

paras.en: U.S. leader has previously threatened to take an interventionist approach in Cuba
paras.zh: 美国领导人此前曾威胁要对古巴采取干预主义做法

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday told a rally for candidates in South Florida that U.S. warships returning from the Middle East could stop over in Cuba on their way back from the Iran war, his latest suggestion of taking an interventionist approach to the nearby country.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五在南佛罗里达州举行的一场候选人集会上表示，从中东返回的美国军舰可能会在结束伊朗战争返回途中经停古巴，这是他对邻国采取干预主义做法的最新建议。

paras.en: Trump first floated this idea earlier this year, but has not mentioned it in recent months. But he revived it in response to a shouted question from the crowd about the island nation.
paras.zh: 特朗普在今年早些时候首次提出了这个想法，但最近几个月没有提及。但他为了回应人群对这个岛国的高声提问而恢复了这一说法。

paras.en: He was campaigning just days ahead of midterm elections in which voters have expressed concern about the impact the U.S. war on Iran has had on prices of goods from gas to groceries.
paras.zh: 他在中期选举前几天进行竞选活动，选民对美国对伊朗的战争对天然气和杂货等商品价格的影响表示担忧。

paras.en: "We'll do a little stopover," Trump said. "Actually, what we're going to do with Cuba is, we're going to come back from Iran. Those beautiful ships will pass Cuba. We'll have one of them stop about 50 yards off the coast. They'll raise up their hands. And then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal."
paras.zh: “我们会短暂停留，”特朗普说。 “实际上，我们要对古巴做的是，我们将从伊朗回来。那些漂亮的船只将经过古巴。我们会让其中一艘停在离海岸约 50 码的地方。他们会举起手。然后我们将派马可·卢比奥来完成这笔交易。”

paras.en: Both U.S. Secretary of State Rubio and Trump have been bullish on action in Cuba, with Trump previously suggesting the country would "be next" in terms of intervention abroad, following the winding down of the Iran war he has long forecast but which has not yet happened.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥和特朗普都看好古巴的行动，特朗普此前曾表示，在他早就预测伊朗战争结束但尚未发生之后，该国将成为对外干预的“下一个”国家。

paras.en: In May, he and Rubio raised the spectre of U.S. military intervention in Cuba, a renewed threat that took on greater weight after the administration announced criminal charges against the island's former leader, Raúl Castro.
paras.zh: 今年五月，他和卢比奥提出了美国对古巴进行军事干预的担忧，在政府宣布对古巴前领导人劳尔·卡斯特罗提出刑事指控后，这一新的威胁变得更加严重。

paras.en: Two people walk past graffiti with the colours of the Cuban flag in Havana, earlier this month. (Ricardo Arduengo/Reuters)
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，两个人走过哈瓦那的古巴国旗颜色涂鸦。 （里卡多·阿杜恩戈/路透社）

paras.en: Trump told reporters in the Oval Office that previous U.S. presidents had considered intervening in Cuba for decades but that "it looks like I'll be the one that does it."
paras.zh: 特朗普在椭圆形办公室告诉记者，前任美国总统数十年来一直考虑对古巴进行干预，但“看来我将是这样做的人”。

paras.en: Rubio told reporters separately that Cuba has been a national security threat for years because of its ties to U.S. adversaries and that Trump is intent on addressing it.
paras.zh: 卢比奥另外对记者表示，由于古巴与美国对手的关系，多年来古巴一直是国家安全威胁，特朗普有意解决这个问题。

paras.en: While saying the Trump administration wants to resolve differences with Cuba peacefully, Rubio voiced doubts that the U.S. could reach a diplomatic resolution with the island's current government.
paras.zh: 虽然卢比奥表示特朗普政府希望和平解决与古巴的分歧，但他对美国能否与古巴现任政府达成外交解决方案表示怀疑。

paras.en: Cubans seeking change can contact CIA: Rubio
paras.zh: 寻求变革的古巴人可以联系中央情报局：卢比奥

paras.en: Moments after Trump spoke at the rally, Rubio posted on social media that "now is the time" for action on Cuba, addressing his post "to those who seek to create positive change" and urging them "to seize this opportunity to create the change you desire through a discrete partnership with the CIA."
paras.zh: 特朗普在集会上发表讲话后不久，卢比奥在社交媒体上发帖称“现在是对古巴采取行动的时候了”，他向“那些寻求创造积极变革的人”发表讲话，并敦促他们“抓住这个机会，通过与中央情报局的离散合作来创造你们想要的变革”。

paras.en: Rubio has not addressed Cuba in depth in public for several weeks, with his last comments coming in a Sept. 29 interview with Fox News host Sean Hannity.
paras.zh: 卢比奥已经好几周没有在公开场合深入谈论古巴问题了，他的最后一次评论是在 9 月 29 日接受福克斯新闻主持人肖恩·汉尼提采访时发表的。

paras.en: "The truth is Cuba has already fallen. It doesn't have a functional economy and it's governed by people who continue to preach about some revolution that has been dead for 20 years that's never worked," Rubio said, without alluding to any CIA operation.
paras.zh: 卢比奥说：“事实是古巴已经沦陷了。它没有一个正常运转的经济，它的统治者继续鼓吹一场已经死了20年但从未奏效的革命。”他没有提及中央情报局的任何行动。

paras.en: "We are hopeful that Cuba will choose a different path. We are hopeful … that there will be some people in there that open their eyes to the reality of what they're facing," he said.
paras.zh: “我们希望古巴能够选择一条不同的道路。我们希望......那里会有一些人睁开眼睛看清他们所面临的现实，”他说。

paras.en: "We're never going to allow Cuba to become a base of operation against American interests or pose a threat to our national security. On that we are abundantly clear."
paras.zh: “我们永远不会允许古巴成为反对美国利益的行动基地或对我们的国家安全构成威胁。对此我们非常清楚。”

paras.en: Rubio and other top Trump aides have met with Cuban officials in recent months to explore possible improvements in relations. But the U.S. side has come away unimpressed from those talks, leading to even more sanctions imposed on the Cuban government.
paras.zh: 卢比奥和特朗普的其他高级助手近几个月会见了古巴官员，探讨改善关系的可能性。但美国方面对这些谈判不为所动，导致对古巴政府实施了更多制裁。

paras.en: During his address to the United Nations General Assembly last month, Trump said Rubio — who is the son of Cuban immigrants and has long taken a hard line against Cuba's socialist leadership — was "deep into negotiations with Cuba," saying he would "not allow a haven for foreign adversaries to threaten America on our own doorstep."
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月在联合国大会上发表讲话时表示，卢比奥——古巴移民的儿子，长期以来对古巴的社会主义领导层采取强硬路线——正在“深入与古巴进行谈判”，并表示他“不会允许外国对手在我们自己的家门口威胁美国”。

paras.en: Days later, Trump told reporters that he anticipated that the two countries "will make a deal," adding, "I don't think we'll need the military. Cuba is failing very badly."
paras.zh: 几天后，特朗普告诉记者，他预计两国“将达成协议”，并补充道，“我认为我们不需要军队。古巴失败得非常严重。”

paras.en: Earlier this week, the two countries clashed at the United Nations as the Trump administration sought once again to build opposition for an upcoming annual vote condemning Washington's decades-long economic embargo against Havana.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，两国在联合国发生冲突，特朗普政府再次寻求为即将举行的谴责华盛顿对哈瓦那长达数十年的经济禁运的年度投票建立反对派。

paras.en: Cuba has struggled since 2020 with an economic and energy crisis. Its gross domestic product has shrunk, and its 10 million residents have endured blackouts, food shortages and inflation.
paras.zh: 自2020年以来，古巴一直在经济和能源危机中挣扎。它的国内生产总值已经萎缩，1000万居民忍受着停电、食品短缺和通货膨胀。

paras.en: There have been waves of protests, and hundreds of thousands of Cubans have migrated, many to the United States.
paras.zh: 抗议活动一波又一波，数十万古巴人移民，其中许多人前往美国。

articles.title: Serbia: Hope, tension and apprehension as voters prepare to elect new parliament

paras.en: A sense of hope swept through Belgrade on Thursday evening as thousands gathered for the final rally of the Student List, the group of candidates put forward by the student movement that has been protesting against the government for almost exactly two years.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，一种希望的感觉席卷了贝尔格莱德，数千人聚集在一起参加学生名单的最后集会，这是由学生运动提出的候选人团体，该运动已经抗议政府近两年了。

paras.en: The Student List is calling for an end to the current regime in Serbia via the ballot box in Sunday's parliamentary election.
paras.zh: 学生名单呼吁在周日的议会选举中通过投票箱结束塞尔维亚现政权。

paras.en: Many of those who attended the rally had spent days walking to the Serbian capital from all four corners of the country, turning the campaign finale into a display of solidarity and peaceful determination.
paras.zh: 许多参加集会的人花了几天时间从该国的四个角落步行到塞尔维亚首都，将竞选结局变成了团结与和平决心的展示。

paras.en: "We have walked across Serbia from one end to the other, visited villages and neighborhoods, looked you in the eye and realized that we can count on you," biology student Arsa Stojanovic told the crowd.
paras.zh: “我们从塞尔维亚的一端走到另一端，参观了村庄和社区，看着你们的眼睛，意识到我们可以依靠你们，”生物学学生阿尔萨·斯托贾诺维奇告诉人群。

paras.en: "People, it smells like freedom," added Aleksandar Cupic, professor of transport and traffic engineering, and a candidate on the Student List.
paras.zh: “人们，这闻起来像自由，”运输和交通工程教授、学生名单上的候选人亚历山大·丘皮克补充道。

paras.en: After 24 months of protests sparked by the collapse of a concrete canopy at Novi Sad railway station, which killed 16 people in November 2024, Serbia is heading into an election unlike any other in the 14 years since the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) first came to power.
paras.zh: 2024 年 11 月，诺维萨德火车站混凝土顶篷倒塌引发了 24 个月的抗议活动，造成 16 人死亡，之后塞尔维亚即将迎来塞尔维亚进步党 (SNS) 上台 14 年来从未有过的一次选举。

paras.en: For the first time in years, the ruling party faces a serious political challenge, which this time comes from a student movement that has channeled widespread public discontent into an electoral campaign.
paras.zh: 执政党多年来首次面临严峻的政治挑战，这次挑战来自学生运动，该运动将公众的广泛不满情绪转化为竞选活动。

paras.en: "These are the first elections since [Aleksandar] Vucic came to power in 2012 that are competitive and whose outcome is uncertain," political scientist Dusan Spasojevic told DW. "The student movement has generated hope among citizens and substantial support. Polls suggest that they could even win more than 40% of the vote."
paras.zh: 政治学家杜桑·斯帕索耶维奇（Dusan Spasojevic）告诉德国之声：“这是自2012年武契奇上台以来举行的首次选举，竞争性的，结果也不确定。” “学生运动给公民带来了希望和大量支持。民意调查显示，他们甚至可以赢得40%以上的选票。”

paras.en: The Student List has framed the election as a chance to confront corruption and demand accountability for a disaster that became a symbol of institutional failure.
paras.zh: 学生名单将这次选举视为对抗腐败和要求对这场已成为制度失败象征的灾难负责的机会。

paras.en: In doing so, the students have sought to put aside the ideological, social and foreign-policy divisions that have long shaped Serbian politics.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，学生们试图抛开长期以来影响塞尔维亚政治的意识形态、社会和外交政策分歧。

paras.en: SNS presents itself as a guarantor of continuity
paras.zh: SNS 将自己视为连续性的保证者

paras.en: Just a few kilometers away, also in Belgrade, the ruling SNS held its own final rally.
paras.zh: 就在几公里外，执政党 SNS 也在贝尔格莱德举行了最后一次集会。

paras.en: The message here was familiar: A vote for the SNS means stability, continuity and further prosperity, while a change of government would risk plunging the country into chaos.
paras.zh: 这里传达的信息很熟悉：投票支持 SNS 意味着稳定、连续性和进一步繁荣，而政府更迭可能会让国家陷入混乱。

paras.en: The party framed the election as a battle for Serbia's future and sovereignty, accusing its opponents of serving foreign interests.
paras.zh: 该党将此次选举视为一场争夺塞尔维亚未来和主权的战争，并指责其反对者为外国利益服务。

paras.en: "They tried to destroy our country on foreign orders, and that is why this is the hardest battle," former President Aleksandar Vucic told his supporters. "They attacked us with billions of euros, and we defended ourselves with integrity, our program, love for our homeland and Serbia's achievements."
paras.zh: “他们试图根据外国命令摧毁我们的国家，这就是为什么这是最艰难的战斗，”前总统亚历山大·武契奇告诉他的支持者。 “他们用数十亿欧元攻击我们，我们用诚信、我们的计划、对祖国的热爱和塞尔维亚的成就来保卫自己。”

paras.en: The campaign has increasingly been overshadowed by violence, reflecting a society in which political opponents are often portrayed not simply as rivals, but as enemies.
paras.zh: 这场竞选活动越来越被暴力所笼罩，反映出一个社会，政治对手常常不仅被描绘成对手，而且被描绘成敌人。

paras.en: By the final week of the campaign, CRTA, an independent election-monitoring organization, had recorded 116 incidents involving physical violence or verbal threats. The incidents included physical confrontations, attacks on campaigners and attempts to seize campaign banners.
paras.zh: 截至竞选最后一周，独立选举监督组织 CRTA 记录了 116 起涉及人身暴力或口头威胁的事件。这些事件包括身体对抗、袭击活动人士以及试图夺取竞选横幅。

paras.en: CRTA also reported that opposition activists, particularly those linked to the Student List, were also subjected to surveillance and police questioning. In some cases, the organization said, police were slow to protect opposition candidates and supporters.
paras.zh: CRTA 还报告说，反对派活动人士，特别是那些与学生名单有关的活动人士，也受到监视和警方审问。该组织表示，在某些情况下，警方在保护反对派候选人和支持者方面行动缓慢。

paras.en: Allegations of links to criminal networks
paras.zh: 与犯罪网络有联系的指控

paras.en: In the final runup to the election, there have also been a series of investigative reports examining alleged links between people connected to the ruling SNS and criminal networks.
paras.zh: 在选举的最后阶段，还出现了一系列调查报告，审查与执政的社交网络服务有关的人和犯罪网络之间涉嫌的联系。

paras.en: Published by independent media in the days before the election, the reports have brought renewed attention to questions of corruption, political influence and accountability — issues at the heart of the student movement's challenge to the government.
paras.zh: 这些报告由独立媒体在选举前几天发布，让人们重新关注腐败、政治影响力和问责制问题——这些问题是学生运动向政府发起挑战的核心问题。

paras.en: But Spasojevic is skeptical that the revelations will make a significant difference to the election outcome.
paras.zh: 但斯帕索耶维奇怀疑这些爆料是否会对选举结果产生重大影响。
