paras.en: He argues that those who trust investigative media are likely to have already made up their minds, while voters who rely on pro-government outlets may never even see these reports.
paras.zh: 他认为，那些信任调查媒体的人可能已经下定决心，而依赖亲政府媒体的选民可能永远不会看到这些报道。

paras.en: There are also serious concerns about the fairness of the election process.
paras.zh: 人们还对选举过程的公平性表示严重担忧。

paras.en: CRTA told DW that the election campaign has not been either free or fair from day one, citing "a narrowing of freedoms and deepening inequality" among candidates and voters.
paras.zh: CRTA告诉德国之声，竞选活动从第一天起就不是自由或公平的，理由是候选人和选民之间“自由范围缩小，不平等加剧”。

paras.en: Its report found a pronounced imbalance in media coverage: Almost three-quarters of airtime devoted to political players on national television has featured government representatives, while more than 80% of coverage on the Student List has been negative.
paras.zh: 其报告发现媒体报道存在明显不平衡：国家电视台近四分之三的政治人物报道以政府代表为主角，而学生名单上超过 80% 的报道都是负面的。

paras.en: Ahead of the vote, the Balkan Investigative Reporting Network (BIRN) published the testimony of a former member of the SNS, who described how public-sector employees were pressured to deliver votes for the party.
paras.zh: 投票前，巴尔干调查报道网络 (BIRN) 公布了一名 SNS 前成员的证词，他描述了公共部门雇员如何被迫为该党投票。

paras.en: DW has also learned from sources who want to remain anonymous that voters have been offered between €30 and €150 to vote for the SNS, with holiday packages reportedly offered to entire families if they pledge all their votes to the ruling party.
paras.zh: 德国之声还从不愿透露姓名的消息人士处获悉，投票给 SNS 的选民将获得 30 至 150 欧元的奖励，据报道，如果他们承诺将所有选票都投给执政党，他们就会向整个家庭提供度假套餐。

paras.en: Many fear a period of turbulence, uncertainty and political crisis after the vote, with election night itself a particular source of anxiety.
paras.zh: 许多人担心投票后会出现一段动荡、不确定性和政治危机的时期，选举之夜本身就是一个特别令人焦虑的来源。

paras.en: For weeks, the authorities have warned that students, allegedly with the help of foreign intelligence services, are preparing violence in the streets. In the final days of the campaign, several people were arrested on what the prosecution has said was the suspicion of plotting disturbances on election night.
paras.zh: 几周来，当局一直警告学生据称在外国情报机构的帮助下正在准备街头暴力。在竞选活动的最后几天，有几人因涉嫌在选举之夜策划骚乱而被捕。

paras.en: The best-case scenario, says Dusan Spasojevic, would be a decisive victory for one of the two opposing camps, leaving little room for the other to challenge the result.
paras.zh: 杜桑·斯帕索耶维奇表示，最好的情况是两个对立阵营中的一个阵营取得决定性胜利，而另一个阵营几乎没有挑战结果的空间。

paras.en: "But polls suggest that the margin will be narrow, and we will probably enter some kind of post-election crisis," he said, adding that a narrow victory for the ruling party would almost certainly be contested, given longstanding concerns about the fairness of the electoral process and allegations that some votes may have been obtained illegally.
paras.zh: 他说：“但民意调查显示，差距将会缩小，我们可能会进入某种选举后危机。”他补充说，鉴于长期以来对选举过程公平性的担忧以及一些选票可能是非法获得的指控，执政党的微弱胜利几乎肯定会受到争议。

paras.en: Whatever happens, the European Union's response could be crucial.
paras.zh: 无论发生什么，欧盟的反应都可能至关重要。

paras.en: "I think the international response will be crucial in preventing major incidents and a further escalation of the crisis. It is the only thing that can persuade the authorities to accept defeat and refrain from an overly heavy-handed response to any protests or incidents," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他对德国之声表示：“我认为国际社会的反应对于防止重大事件和危机进一步升级至关重要。这是唯一能说服当局接受失败并避免对任何抗议或事件采取过度严厉反应的方法。”

paras.en: An EU Commission spokesperson acknowledged to DW that key recommendations on improving Serbia's electoral framework remain unimplemented and also stressed that democracy and the rule of law are key to the accession process. Serbia has been an EU candidate country since 2012.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会发言人向德国之声承认，改善塞尔维亚选举框架的关键建议仍未得到落实，并强调民主和法治是入盟进程的关键。塞尔维亚自2012年起一直是欧盟候选国。

paras.en: Back in Belgrade, the students ended their rally with a kolo, a traditional Serbian circle dance, projecting confidence in their chances at the ballot box.
paras.zh: 回到贝尔格莱德，学生们以塞尔维亚传统的圆圈舞“kolo”结束了集会，表达了对自己获得投票机会的信心。

paras.en: But the path to victory could prove difficult. The movement has vowed to defend every vote — setting the stage for a potentially tense election night if the results are disputed.
paras.zh: 但通往胜利的道路可能会很艰难。该运动发誓要捍卫每一张选票——如果结果存在争议，可能会导致紧张的选举之夜。

articles.title: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny

paras.en: The first confirmed Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria may have crossed paths at Uganda's Entebbe International Airport, according to African health officials, as new information from Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account of the Nigerian patient's travel history.
paras.zh: 非洲卫生官员称，肯尼亚和尼日利亚首例确诊的埃博拉患者可能曾在乌干达恩德培国际机场相遇，因为来自瑞士的新信息与乌干达对尼日利亚患者旅行史的描述相矛盾。

paras.en: Uganda, a country reporting no active Ebola infections, has become a focus of investigations into cases thousands of kilometers apart.
paras.zh: 乌干达没有报告活跃的埃博拉感染病例，已成为相距数千公里的病例调查的焦点。

paras.en: Uganda insists that it has no confirmed active cases of the deadly virus. Yet health authorities in Kenya and Nigeria are investigating Ebola infections involving people whose travel histories or contacts are connected to the East African nation.
paras.zh: 乌干达坚称没有确诊的致命病毒活跃病例。然而，肯尼亚和尼日利亚的卫生当局正在调查涉及与东非国家有旅行史或接触史的人的埃博拉感染情况。

paras.en: Both patients passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, according to Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC).
paras.zh: 非洲疾病控制和预防中心 (Africa CDC) 应急准备和响应负责人韦萨姆·曼库拉 (Wessam Mankoula) 表示，两名患者均于 10 月 3 日途经恩德培国际机场。

paras.en: Health officials say the two may have crossed paths, although it has not been established whether they encountered each other or whether any transmission occurred at the airport.
paras.zh: 卫生官员表示，两人可能有过接触，但尚不清楚他们是否相遇，也不清楚是否在机场发生了传播。

paras.en: The differing accounts have raised questions about whether Uganda was simply a transit point for infected travelers. Or could infections be going undetected along some of Africa's busiest cross-border routes?
paras.zh: 不同的说法引发了人们的疑问：乌干达是否只是受感染旅行者的中转站。或者，在非洲一些最繁忙的跨境路线上，感染是否可能未被发现？

paras.en: The latest developments come after Switzerland disputed claims that the Nigerian patient had visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where an Ebola outbreak is underway.
paras.zh: 最新事态发展是在瑞士对尼日利亚患者曾访问过正在爆发埃博拉疫情的刚果民主共和国的说法提出质疑之后发布的。

paras.en: Did the two Ebola patients cross paths in Uganda?
paras.zh: 两名埃博拉患者是否在乌干达相遇？

paras.en: Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate confirmed an Ebola case in the capital, Abuja, involving a woman who had recently traveled to East Africa, including Uganda.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚卫生部长穆罕默德·阿里·帕特证实首都阿布贾发生埃博拉病例，涉及一名最近前往东非（包括乌干达）的妇女。

paras.en: "Today we are confirming that there has been one imported case of Ebola virus disease in the Federal Capital Territory," Pate said.
paras.zh: 佩特说：“今天我们确认联邦首都地区出现一例输入性埃博拉病毒病病例。”

paras.en: The woman developed symptoms on October 7 and visited a private health facility on October 11. Further laboratory testing confirmed Ebola, and she was subsequently isolated for treatment.
paras.zh: 该女子于10月7日出现症状，并于10月11日到一家私人医疗机构就诊。进一步的实验室检测证实她感染了埃博拉病毒，随后她被隔离接受治疗。

paras.en: Pate said the patient was stable and health officials had identified 44 contacts, including health care workers, caregivers, patients and people who may have encountered her during her travels.
paras.zh: 佩特表示，该患者情况稳定，卫生官员已确定了 44 名接触者，包括医护人员、护理人员、患者以及可能在她旅行期间遇到过她的人。

paras.en: But the woman's journey has become central to the investigation.
paras.zh: 但这名女子的旅程已成为调查的核心。

paras.en: Speaking on Thursday, Mankoula said the first confirmed patients in Kenya and Nigeria were both known to have traveled through Entebbe International Airport on October 3. Investigators are examining whether the two patients were at the airport at the same time and whether their movements overlapped.
paras.zh: 曼库拉周四表示，已知肯尼亚和尼日利亚的首例确诊患者均于 10 月 3 日途经恩德培国际机场。调查人员正在检查这两名患者是否同时到达机场以及他们的活动是否重叠。

paras.en: Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account
paras.zh: 瑞士反驳乌干达的说法

paras.en: Uganda's Health Ministry says preliminary findings indicate that the Nigerian patient traveled to eastern DRCfor business before passing through Uganda without symptoms and returning to Nigeria.
paras.zh: 乌干达卫生部表示，初步调查结果表明，这名尼日利亚患者前往刚果民主共和国东部出差，然后在没有症状的情况下经过乌干达并返回尼日利亚。

paras.en: "Travel through Uganda does not establish that infection occurred here. The location of exposure remains under investigation," the ministry said in an October 20 statement.
paras.zh: 该部在 10 月 20 日的一份声明中表示：“通过乌干达旅行并不能证明这里发生了感染。暴露地点仍在调查中。”

paras.en: But, on Friday, Switzerland's Federal Department of Foreign Affairs directly disputed the account.
paras.zh: 但周五，瑞士联邦外交部直接对这一说法提出质疑。

paras.en: "She and her husband did not travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo," the department said in a statement to Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: “她和她的丈夫没有前往刚果民主共和国，”该部门在给路透社的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The woman, identified by Swiss authorities as a Swiss national of Ugandan origin, is married to a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja.
paras.zh: 瑞士当局确认该女子为乌干达裔瑞士国民，嫁给了驻阿布贾的一名瑞士外交官。

paras.en: On Thursday, the Swiss government told Reuters that she was believed to have contracted Ebola while traveling with her husband in Uganda, although that assessment has not been independently confirmed.
paras.zh: 周四，瑞士政府告诉路透社，据信她与丈夫在乌干达旅行时感染了埃博拉病毒，尽管这一评估尚未得到独立证实。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa CDC also said Thursday that they had not received confirmed information establishing that the woman had traveled to the DRC.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）和非洲疾病预防控制中心周四也表示，他们尚未收到证实该妇女曾前往刚果民主共和国的信息。

paras.en: The conflicting accounts raise fresh questions about where the woman was exposed to the virus and how accurately her movements were initially reconstructed. They do not, however, establish that she contracted Ebola in Uganda.
paras.zh: 这些相互矛盾的说法引发了新的问题：这名妇女在哪里接触了病毒，以及最初重建她的动作的准确性如何。然而，他们并没有证实她在乌干达感染了埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: Uganda maintains that it has no confirmed active Ebola cases and says it is awaiting more detailed information from Nigeria about the woman's movements.
paras.zh: 乌干达坚称没有确诊的埃博拉活跃病例，并表示正在等待尼日利亚提供有关该妇​​女活动的更多详细信息。

paras.en: Kenya's missing contact complicates investigation
paras.zh: 肯尼亚失踪联系人使调查变得复杂

paras.en: In Kenya, Uganda has emerged in a separate investigation involving the country's first confirmed Ebola patient, who died in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, on October 5. The patient had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda before reaching Kenya.
paras.zh: 在肯尼亚，乌干达出现在另一项调查中，涉及该国首例确诊的埃博拉患者，该患者于 10 月 5 日在肯尼亚首都内罗毕死亡。该患者从刚果民主共和国经乌干达抵达肯尼亚。

paras.en: Health officials have now established that the patient passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, the same day as the woman subsequently diagnosed in Nigeria. Kenyan authorities have since reported additional infections linked to the initial case.
paras.zh: 卫生官员现已确定，该患者于 10 月 3 日通过恩德培国际机场，与随后在尼日利亚确诊的该妇女同一天。此后，肯尼亚当局报告了与最初病例有关的更多感染病例。

paras.en: But one aspect of the investigation remains unresolved.
paras.zh: 但调查的一个方面仍未解决。

paras.en: According to Kenya's Daily Nation, health officials are searching for a Ugandan national identified as a contact of the deceased patient.
paras.zh: 据肯尼亚《国家日报》报道，卫生官员正在寻找一名与死者有过接触的乌干达国民。

paras.en: "We know him (the Ugandan) by name and passport number and from his phone but we are not able to reach him," Kenya's director-general for health, Patrick Amoth, told the newspaper.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯告诉该报：“我们通过姓名、护照号码以及电话号码认识了他（乌干达人），但我们无法联系到他。”

paras.en: The Daily Nation reported that the man was using a South Sudanese telephone number, complicating efforts to establish his whereabouts.
paras.zh: 据《国家日报》报道，该男子使用的是南苏丹的电话号码，这使得确定他的下落变得更加困难。

paras.en: Being an untraced contact does not mean that he is infected. However, locating potentially exposed individuals is essential to preventing further transmission.
paras.zh: 未被追踪的接触者并不意味着他被感染了。然而，找到可能暴露的个人对于防止进一步传播至关重要。

paras.en: Uganda shares a lengthy border with the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola outbreaks have repeatedly challenged health authorities.
paras.zh: 乌干达与刚果民主共和国有着漫长的边界，那里的埃博拉疫情多次给卫生当局带来挑战。

paras.en: Cross-border trade, population movements and international travel make it difficult to establish where someone was exposed to the virus.
paras.zh: 跨境贸易、人口流动和国际旅行使得确定某人接触该病毒的地点变得困难。

paras.en: Ebola symptoms typically develop two to 21 days after infection. According to the WHO, people infected with Ebola are not considered infectious until symptoms appear.
paras.zh: 埃博拉症状通常在感染后 2 至 21 天出现。根据世界卫生组织的说法，埃博拉病毒感染者在出现症状之前并不被认为具有传染性。

paras.en: Even well-functioning border surveillance systems cannot identify every infected traveler.
paras.zh: 即使运作良好的边境监控系统也无法识别每一位受感染的旅行者。

paras.en: The discovery that both patients traveled through the same international airport on the same day illustrates the complexity of tracing potential exposures across multiple countries. It also highlights the importance of reconstructing travel histories and identifying close contacts.
paras.zh: 两名患者在同一天经过同一国际机场的发现说明了追踪多个国家潜在暴露的复杂性。它还强调了重建旅行历史和识别密切接触者的重要性。

paras.en: Uganda says it is strengthening screening and public health controls at points of entry. Nigeria has intensified contact tracing and infection prevention measures.
paras.zh: 乌干达表示正在加强入境口岸的筛查和公共卫生控制。尼日利亚加强了接触者追踪和感染预防措施。

paras.en: The challenge is ensuring that authorities across different countries can exchange accurate information quickly enough to identify potential exposures.
paras.zh: 挑战在于确保不同国家的当局能够足够快地交换准确的信息，以识别潜在的风险。

paras.en: In Abuja, the confirmed infection has revived memories of previous Ebola outbreaks. Resident Peace Kolawole expressed concern about the consequences of another outbreak. "So here is my hand sanitizer, so I'm actually very concerned about it," she told DW.
paras.zh: 在阿布贾，确诊的感染事件让人们重新回忆起之前爆发的埃博拉疫情。居民 Peace Kolawole 对再次爆发的后果表示担忧。 “这是我的洗手液，所以我实际上非常担心它，”她告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Others fear that Nigeria's health care system may struggle to respond while many citizens face economic hardship. "Because now people are not even worried about sickness anymore, people are worried about surviving," Abuja resident Jonathan Steven told DW.
paras.zh: 其他人担心尼日利亚的医疗保健系统可能难以应对，而许多公民面临经济困难。阿布贾居民乔纳森·史蒂文告诉德国之声：“因为现在人们不再担心疾病，而是担心生存。”

paras.en: Nigeria's health authorities say the patient is receiving medical care and contact tracing is continuing.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚卫生当局表示，该患者正在接受医疗护理，并且正在继续追踪接触者。

paras.en: Uganda's position between the DRC and other regional destinations offers one explanation for its appearance in both investigations.
paras.zh: 乌干达介于刚果民主共和国和其他地区目的地之间的立场为其出现在两项调查中提供了一种解释。

paras.en: But the latest findings have added two significant questions: Did the patients from Kenya and Nigeria come into contact at Entebbe International Airport on October 3? And where did the Nigerian woman contract the virus if, as Switzerland insists, she never traveled to DR Congo?
paras.zh: 但最新发现又增加了两个重要问题：来自肯尼亚和尼日利亚的患者是否于10月3日在恩德培国际机场有过接触？如果正如瑞士坚称的那样，这名尼日利亚妇女从未去过刚果民主共和国，那么她是在哪里感染病毒的呢？

paras.en: The conflicting accounts from Uganda and Switzerland have made establishing the Nigerian patient's travel history an urgent part of the investigation. The WHO and Africa CDC have yet to confirm the disputed DR Congo travel history.
paras.zh: 乌干达和瑞士的说法相互矛盾，使得确定尼日利亚患者的旅行史成为调查的紧迫部分。世界卫生组织和非洲疾病预防控制中心尚未确认有争议的刚果民主共和国旅行史。

paras.en: Uganda's declaration of zero confirmed active cases does not establish that all infections have been ruled out. Equally, the travel histories do not prove an undetected outbreak.
paras.zh: 乌干达宣布零确诊活跃病例并不能证明所有感染都已被排除。同样，旅行历史并不能证明疫情未被发现。

paras.en: For Kenya and Nigeria, the immediate priority is containing confirmed infections. For Uganda, the challenge is demonstrating that its surveillance systems are effective and reassuring both its citizens and neighboring countries.
paras.zh: 对于肯尼亚和尼日利亚来说，当务之急是控制确诊感染。对于乌干达来说，面临的挑战是证明其监控系统有效并让其公民和邻国放心。

paras.en: The Africa CDC will convene an "extraordinary virtual meeting" of national health officials on October 28 as the continent's latest Ebola outbreak continues to spread.
paras.zh: 随着非洲大陆最新的埃博拉疫情继续蔓延，非洲疾病预防控制中心将于 10 月 28 日召开一次由国家卫生官员组成的“特别虚拟会议”。

articles.title: Russia's attacks on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, are intensifying. DW asked people on the ground what life is like

paras.en: Until a few months ago, life was relatively peaceful in Kyiv when compared with the situation near the war's front lines elsewhere in Ukraine. Now, as Russia expands its attacks on the capital, Kyiv has increasingly become a front-line city.
paras.zh: 直到几个月前，与乌克兰其他地区战争前线附近的局势相比，基辅的生活还相对平静。现在，随着俄罗斯扩大对首都的攻击，基辅日益成为前线城市。

paras.en: With too few shelters for the 4 million residents of Kyiv, subway stations double as makeshift dormitories. Starting at about 10 every night, people create sleeping areas with mattresses and small tents. Children snuggle up to adults; pets seek comfort from their owners or find a spot among strangers between the cold walls.
paras.zh: 由于基辅 400 万居民的住所太少，地铁站兼作临时宿舍。每天晚上 10 点左右开始，人们会用床垫和小帐篷搭建睡眠区。孩子们依偎着大人；宠物从主人那里寻求安慰，或者在冰冷的墙壁之间的陌生人中寻找一席之地。

paras.en: "We're alive," Halyna told DW, holding her 5-year-old son, Roman, close. "We've been lucky once again." Most evenings — even when no air-raid siren has sounded — she takes the boy to the nearest subway station. Her apartment is located in the Lukyanivka district, which Russia has systematically targeted over the war's four years and eight months.
paras.zh: “我们还活着，”哈莉娜抱着她 5 岁的儿子罗曼 (Roman) 告诉德国之声。 “我们再次幸运了。”大多数晚上，即使空袭警报没有响起，她也会带男孩去最近的地铁站。她的公寓位于卢基亚尼夫卡区，俄罗斯在四年零八个月的战争中系统地瞄准了该地区。

paras.en: 'These sick monsters don't care who they kill'
paras.zh: “这些病态的怪物不在乎他们杀了谁”

paras.en: In September, 14-year-old Daniel Umanskyj was doing homework in his room when a Russian drone struck the apartment building in the central district of Pechersk. A neighbor named Vlad happened to be in the hallway with his daughter at the time of the strike. "We were late that day — and this saved our lives," Vlad said. "Daniel's death is a tragedy." He added: "These sick monsters don't care who they kill." Flowers have been planted in front of the damaged apartment building in memory of Daniel.
paras.zh: 9月，14岁的丹尼尔·乌曼斯基(Daniel Umanskyj)正在房间里做作业，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了佩乔尔斯克(Pechersk)中心区的公寓楼。罢工发生时，一位名叫弗拉德的邻居正和他的女儿在走廊里。 “那天我们迟到了——这救了我们的命，”弗拉德说。 “丹尼尔的死是一场悲剧。”他补充道：“这些病态的怪物不在乎他们杀了谁。”为了纪念丹尼尔，受损的公寓楼前种植了鲜花。

paras.en: Russia also targets places where children gather. In early October, a drone struck a school building in southwestern Kyiv. Fortunately, pupils and teachers were already in shelters at the time.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯还针对儿童聚集的地方。十月初，一架无人机袭击了基辅西南部的一所学校建筑。幸运的是，当时学生和老师已经在避难所里。

paras.en: "We've been teaching all the pupils in person because we have a large shelter that can accommodate more than 500 students," Valentyna Chorna, the school's principal, told DW. As there is enough space in the shelter for everyone, students in the first through ninth grades are able to go to school, she said.
paras.zh: 该校校长瓦伦蒂娜·乔纳 (Valentyna Chorna) 告诉德国之声：“我们一直亲自对所有学生进行教学，因为我们有一个可以容纳 500 多名学生的大型避难所。”她说，由于避难所里有足够的空间容纳每个人，一年级到九年级的学生都可以去上学。

paras.en: Whether classes take place depends not only on the decision of the parents and the school administration: It also depends on whether shelters are available and how long the air-raid siren continues to sound. If an alarm sounds in the morning while children are still at home, they may not be able to go to school that day.
paras.zh: 是否上课不仅取决于家长和学校管理部门的决定：还取决于是否有避难所以及防空警报持续鸣响多久。如果早上闹钟响了，而孩子们还在家里，他们当天可能无法去上学。

paras.en: "This is an enormous burden for parents," said a colleague from the DW bureau in Kyiv, whose daughter attends school. "You have to go to work — and the child stays home alone."
paras.zh: “这对家长来说是一个巨大的负担，”德国之声驻基辅分社的一位同事说，他的女儿正在上学。 “你必须去上班——而孩子一个人呆在家里。”

paras.en: "Even the walk to school is dangerous because an air-raid alarm can go off at any time," she said. Her daughter attends a school not far from the Antonov aircraft factory. "One day she texted me: ‘You can't imagine what a huge explosion that was!'" she said. "I don't know if something was shot down or if there was a strike somewhere." She added: "Things like that really scare children." And staying home brings its own risks.
paras.zh: “即使步行去学校也很危险，因为空袭警报随时可能响起，”她说。她的女儿在距离安东诺夫飞机制造厂不远的一所学校上学。 “有一天，她给我发短信：‘你无法想象那是一场多么巨大的爆炸！’”她说。 “我不知道是否有东西被击落，或者某个地方是否发生过罢工。”她补充道：“这样的事情真的会让孩子们感到害怕。”呆在家里也会带来风险。

paras.en: In September, a Russian drone struck their building. The apartment itself wasn't damaged, and her daughter was at school that morning, but it was another reminder of just how much survival has become a matter of luck. When an air-raid siren sounds, no one knows who will be spared, she said.
paras.zh: 九月，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了他们的大楼。公寓本身没有受损，而且她的女儿那天早上也在上学，但这再次提醒人们，生存在很大程度上取决于运气。她说，当空袭警报响起时，没有人知道谁会幸免。

paras.en: Russia's attacks have become deadlier in 2026. According to the military administration in Kyiv, 140 people were killed in the capital during the first eight months of the year, compared with 172 for all of 2025. If this trend continues, 2026 could become Kyiv's deadliest year since the start of the Russian invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯的袭击在 2026 年变得更加致命。根据基辅军事管理部门的数据，今年前 8 个月，首都有 140 人死亡，而 2025 年全年有 172 人死亡。如果这种趋势持续下去，2026 年可能成为基辅自 2022 年俄罗斯入侵开始以来死亡人数最多的一年。

paras.en: Attacks on warehouses have led to shortages in supermarkets on a scale not seen since the early months of the war. At the end of September, emergency power outages resumed in Kyiv. The subway was paralyzed by a Russian attack. Given the strikes on the energy infrastructure, it is unclear how the capital can reliably supply residents with heat, electricity and water during the upcoming winter.
paras.zh: 对仓库的袭击导致超市出现自战争初期以来从未见过的短缺。 9月底，基辅恢复紧急停电。地铁因俄罗斯袭击而瘫痪。鉴于能源基础设施遭受袭击，目前尚不清楚首都如何在即将到来的冬季可靠地为居民提供热、电和水。

paras.en: Despite Russia's attempts to render Kyiv uninhabitable, 72% of the city's residents said in September that they are prepared to endure the war for as long as necessary, the Kyiv International Institute of Sociology reported in early October. The authorities are striving to maintain normal life in the city, where the curfew has been shortened and now runs from 1 a.m. to 5 a.m.
paras.zh: 基辅国际社会学研究所 10 月初报告称，尽管俄罗斯试图让基辅变得无法居住，但该市 72% 的居民在 9 月份表示，只要有必要，他们就准备好忍受战争。当局正在努力维持该市的正常生活，宵禁已缩短为凌晨 1 点至凌晨 5 点。

paras.en: Some facilities have even been allowed to continue operating during "yellow" alerts. During "red" alerts, however, people must immediately seek shelter: This could mean ballistic missiles, cruise missiles or massive combined attacks.
paras.zh: 一些设施甚至被允许在“黄色”警报期间继续运营。然而，在“红色”警报期间，人们必须立即寻求庇护：这可能意味着弹道导弹、巡航导弹或大规模联合攻击。

paras.en: This article was originally written in Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用乌克兰语写的。

articles.title: Argentinian judge drops fraud investigation into Milei over crypto scandal

paras.en: An Argentinian federal judge has dropped a criminal investigation into President Javier Milei and his sister Karina Milei over the collapse of a cryptocurrency he promoted online.
paras.zh: 阿根廷联邦法官撤销了对总统哈维尔·米莱 (Javier Milei) 和他的妹妹卡琳娜·米莱 (Karina Milei) 的刑事调查，原因是他在网上推广的加密货币崩溃了。

paras.en: Judge Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi issued the decision on Friday, according to court records, ending an inquiry into Milei’s role in the launch of the $Libra token, which crashed after a brief rally.
paras.zh: 根据法庭记录，法官马塞洛·马丁内斯·德乔治 (Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi) 于周五发布了这一决定，结束了对 Milei 在 $Libra 代币发行中所扮演角色的调查，该代币在短暂上涨后崩盘。

paras.en: “The reported events do not constitute a criminal offence,” the judge said in a ruling. He also wrote that investor losses and the rise and fall in the currency’s price were insufficient to establish fraud.
paras.zh: “所报道的事件不构成刑事犯罪，”法官在裁决中表示。他还写道，投资者的损失和货币价格的涨跌不足以构成欺诈。

paras.en: In his ruling, Martinez de Giorgi said that Milei’s institutional standing could have given the launch “greater impact” when he posted about it, but that does not translate into a fraudulent scheme.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯·德乔治 (Martinez de Giorgi) 在裁决中表示，当他发布相关消息时，米莱的机构地位可能会给此次发布带来“更大的影响”，但这并不意味着欺诈计划。

paras.en: Javier Milei recommended the little-known meme coin in a post on X in February 2025. He later deleted the post and denied any link to the cryptocurrency, whose value soon plunged.
paras.zh: 2025 年 2 月，哈维尔·米雷 (Javier Milei) 在 X 上的一篇帖子中推荐了这款鲜为人知的模因币。他后来删除了该帖子，并否认与这种加密货币有任何联系，而这种加密货币的价值很快就暴跌了。

paras.en: The judge also dismissed an investigation into US businessman Hayden Davis, who described himself as a “launch adviser” for the token. Davis has acknowledged that he held close to $100m after the crash and denies any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 法官还驳回了对美国商人海登戴维斯的调查，他称自己是该代币的“启动顾问”。戴维斯承认，事故发生后他持有近 1 亿美元，并否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: “For the first time in history, a President of the Nation was investigated with complete freedom, resulting in absolute proof of his innocence,” read a post shared on X by the official presidential office.
paras.zh: 青瓦台官方在 X 上分享的一篇帖子中写道：“历史上第一次，国家总统受到完全自由的调查，绝对证明了他的清白。”

paras.en: “The question that remains is this: Who will take responsibility for having wasted Argentine taxpayers’ money and the President of the Nation’s time in a failed attempt at an institutional coup?”
paras.zh: “剩下的问题是：谁将为在一场失败的制度政变中浪费阿根廷纳税人的钱和国家总统的时间承担责任？”

paras.en: Milei is one of US President Donald Trump’s closest allies. Trump firmly backed him a year ago and has called him his “favourite president”.
paras.zh: 米莱是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普最亲密的盟友之一。特朗普一年前坚定支持他，并称他为“最喜欢的总统”。

paras.en: Trump made clear the support hinged on a victory for Milei’s party.
paras.zh: 特朗普明确表示，支持率取决于米莱所在政党的胜利。

paras.en: “I’m with this man because his philosophy is correct,” he said ahead of a White House lunch with the Argentinian leader last year. “If he wins, we’re staying with him. And if he doesn’t win, we’re gone.”
paras.zh: “我支持这个人，因为他的哲学是正确的，”去年他在白宫与阿根廷领导人共进午餐之前说道。 “如果他赢了，我们就会和他在一起。如果他没有赢，我们就会离开。”

paras.en: Earlier this month, Milei urged Trump to emerge stronger from the US midterm elections, saying the vote mattered for the West as a whole.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，米莱敦促特朗普在美国中期选举中变得更加强大，称这次投票对整个西方都很重要。

paras.en: Since taking office in 2023, Milei has laid off thousands of state employees, shut ministries, cut subsidies and reduced government-funded programmes. The measures were meant to fight high inflation, which has fallen to about 2 percent a month.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年上任以来，米雷已解雇了数千名国家雇员，关闭了各部委，削减了补贴并减少了政府资助的项目。这些措施旨在对抗高通胀，目前通胀率已降至每月 2% 左右。

paras.en: Milei says his plan is working, claiming that Argentina has grown for 27 consecutive months and is expanding at four times its historical rate.
paras.zh: 米雷表示，他的计划正在发挥作用，并声称阿根廷已经连续 27 个月实现增长，并且扩张速度是历史增长率的四倍。

paras.en: When the coin crashed, Milei said he had acted “in good faith” and accused his political rivals of trying to exploit the situation.
paras.zh: 当硬币崩盘时，米莱表示他的行为是“善意的”，并指责他的政治对手试图利用这一情况。

articles.title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes a national security threat

paras.en: The United States Department of Defense has designated Confucius Institutes, Chinese-funded cultural centres on university campuses, as a threat to US national security.
paras.zh: 美国国防部已将孔子学院、中国资助的大学校园文化中心认定为对美国国家安全的威胁。

paras.en: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced the move on Friday in a video posted on social media, saying the Pentagon added the organisations to its list of institutions that threaten national security.
paras.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯周五在社交媒体上发布的视频中宣布了这一举措，称五角大楼将这些组织添加到威胁国家安全的机构名单中。

paras.en: Washington has long accused the centres of serving as Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them.
paras.zh: 华盛顿长期以来一直指责这些中心充当中国的宣传工具，并已采取措施对其进行打击。

paras.en: Hegseth said Confucius Institutes had operated in disguise after being restricted by Congress, calling them “sleeper organisations”.
paras.zh: 赫格斯表示，孔子学院在受到国会限制后变相运作，称其为“潜伏组织”。

paras.en: “It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students,” he said.
paras.zh: “事实证明，30 所大学中出现了 80 个新的宣传单位，它们使用不同的名称和不同的章程，但有着相同的使命：窃取知识产权并渗透美国学生的思想，”他说。

paras.en: In the video, Hegseth said that Chinese government-backed cultural programmes had infiltrated universities and reappeared in new guises despite congressional restrictions.
paras.zh: 赫格斯在视频中表示，中国政府支持的文化项目已经渗透到大学，并以新的面貌重新出现，尽管国会有限制。

paras.en: Over the past two months, the Pentagon has “systematically dismantled every single one of these organisations”, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，在过去的两个月里，五角大楼“系统性地解散了这些组织中的每一个”。

paras.en: The Chinese embassy in Washington did not respond to Reuters’ request for comment.
paras.zh: 中国驻华盛顿大使馆没有回应路透社的置评请求。

articles.title: Israel raids towns, detains dozens of Palestinians in occupied West Bank

paras.en: Israeli forces have raided towns, detaining dozens of Palestinians, hours after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced ordering a full lockdown of the occupied West Bank following an attack in the city of Hebron that killed two Israeli soldiers.
paras.zh: 在希伯伦市发生袭击导致两名以色列士兵死亡后，以色列总理内塔尼亚胡宣布下令全面封锁被占领的约旦河西岸，数小时后，以色列军队袭击了城镇，拘留了数十名巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: Israeli forces raided at least 15 towns in the northern West Bank, detaining dozens of Palestinians, Al Jazeera correspondents reported on Saturday.
paras.zh: 据半岛电视台记者周六报道，以色列军队袭击了西岸北部至少 15 个城镇，拘留了数十名巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: The military raids targeted several northern cities and towns, including Nablus, Jenin, Tubas and Qalqilya.
paras.zh: 军事袭击针对几个北部城镇，包括纳布卢斯、杰宁、图巴斯和盖勒吉利耶。

paras.en: In Nablus, Israeli forces carried out arrests and raided Palestinian homes in the villages of Jalud and Qaryut. Arrests were also reported in Arrabeh and Burqin, near Jenin, while Israeli forces entered Tubas and the nearby town of Aqqaba.
paras.zh: 在纳布卢斯，以色列军队逮捕并袭击了贾鲁德和卡留特村的巴勒斯坦人房屋。据报道，杰宁附近的阿拉贝和布尔津也发生了逮捕事件，而以色列军队则进入了图巴斯和附近的阿卡巴镇。

paras.en: In the southern occupied West Bank, Israeli bulldozers demolished a three-storey building in Hebron, with families given five minutes to collect their belongings. Israeli forces also ordered hundreds of Palestinian families to forcibly evacuate their homes in the Ein Deir Bahha area of Hebron and its surroundings.
paras.zh: 在被占领的约旦河西岸南部，以色列推土机拆除了希伯伦的一栋三层楼房，并给了家庭五分钟的时间来收集他们的财物。以色列军队还下令数百名巴勒斯坦家庭强行撤离希伯伦艾因代尔巴哈地区及其周边地区的家园。

paras.en: Israeli troops also surrounded the home of one of the suspects in the shooting attack that killed two Israeli soldiers in Hebron, while carrying out raids in the city’s al-Jalda neighbourhood.
paras.zh: 以色列军队在希伯伦的阿尔贾尔达街区进行突袭时，还包围了希伯伦枪击事件中一名嫌疑人的家，该枪击事件造成两名以色列士兵死亡。

paras.en: The Israeli army said late on Friday that its forces began an operation in Hebron that would last “for several days”, in addition to operations by other forces in “dozens” of areas across the West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列军队周五晚间表示，除了其他部队在西岸“数十个”地区开展的行动外，其部队还开始在希伯伦开展为期“数天”的行动。

paras.en: Further east, Israeli forces entered Jericho and the nearby Aqabat Jabr refugee camp.
paras.zh: 再往东，以色列军队进入杰里科和附近的阿喀巴特贾布尔难民营。

paras.en: With the lockdown, nearly 1,000 checkpoints and gates across the West Bank will be closed, affecting millions of Palestinians.
paras.zh: 随着封锁，西岸近 1000 个检查站和大门将被关闭，影响数百万巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: Netanyahu gave the order on Friday, shortly after the Israeli military said it had killed two Palestinian gunmen who attacked a reserve battalion near the Israeli settlement of Telem, killing two soldiers.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周五下达了这一命令，此前不久，以色列军方表示，两名巴勒斯坦枪手袭击了以色列泰莱姆定居点附近的一个预备营，造成两名士兵死亡。

paras.en: Israel’s ambulance service reported that at least three Israeli soldiers were injured in addition to the two who died.
paras.zh: 以色列救护车服务部门报告称，除了两人死亡外，至少还有三名以色列士兵受伤。

paras.en: All Israeli settlements, including Telem, are illegal under international law.
paras.zh: 根据国际法，包括 Telem 在内的所有以色列定居点都是非法的。

paras.en: The attack and clampdown came amid heightened tensions across the Palestinian territory as Israeli settlers and soldiers engage in violent pogroms. Attacks on olive harvesters have been rife as aggression has been on the rise before the coming Israeli elections on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 这次袭击和镇压发生在巴勒斯坦领土紧张局势加剧之际，以色列定居者和士兵进行暴力屠杀。在周二即将举行的以色列选举之前，由于侵略行为不断增加，针对橄榄收割机的袭击十分猖獗。

paras.en: Far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir responded to the killing of the Israeli soldiers by calling for Israel to take full control of the West Bank, in which the Israeli government is encouraging the construction of numerous settlements.
paras.zh: 极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本格维尔对以色列士兵被杀事件做出回应，呼吁以色列完全控制约旦河西岸，以色列政府正在鼓励在那里建造众多定居点。

paras.en: Mustafa Barghouti, secretary-general of the Palestinian National Initiative political party, said incitement from far-right Israeli ministers is making the situation worse.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦民族倡议政党秘书长穆斯塔法·巴尔古提表示，以色列极右部长的煽动使局势变得更糟。

paras.en: The closure turns every city and village into “a small prison”, with checkpoints and gates blocking healthcare, the economy and education, he told Al Jazeera. He warned that collective punishment “will lead to explosions”.
paras.zh: 他告诉半岛电视台，封锁将每个城市和村庄变成了“一座小监狱”，检查站和大门封锁了医疗保健、经济和教育。他警告说，集体惩罚“将导致爆炸”。

articles.title: After nearly 6 years, ex-Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi's son hears her voice
articles.author: Lorcan Lovett

paras.en: After nearly 6 years, ex-Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi's son hears her voice
paras.zh: 近六年后，缅甸前领导人昂山素季的儿子听到了她的声音

paras.en: CHIANG MAI, Thailand — After nearly six years in detention, Aung San Suu Kyi's first words to her son were a question about his health.
paras.zh: 泰国清迈——被拘留近六年后，昂山素季对儿子说的第一句话就是询问他的健康状况。

paras.en: "And then I said all the family was sending their love and asked after her health," said Kim Aris, who spoke by phone with his 81-year-old mother on Thursday, their first direct conversation since the 2021 military coup toppled the democratically elected Myanmar government she led.
paras.zh: 金·阿里斯 (Kim Aris) 周四与 81 岁的母亲通了电话，这是自 2021 年军事政变推翻了她领导的民选缅甸政府以来，他们第一次直接交谈。

paras.en: The 20-minute call, which Aris believes the military monitored, offered a rare glimpse of how the 1991 Nobel Peace Prize laureate is being held. She was first sentenced in 2021, with consecutive trials through 2022 bringing her total sentence to 33 years on corruption and electoral fraud charges, widely condemned by the U.S., Western countries, and human rights groups as fabricated. The sentence was later reduced, leaving her with 18 years still to serve.
paras.zh: 阿里斯相信这段 20 分钟的通话受到了军方的监控，这让人们难得一睹这位 1991 年诺贝尔和平奖获得者的被关押情况。她于 2021 年首次被判刑，经过到 2022 年的连续审判，她因腐败和选举舞弊指控而被判刑 33 年，美国、西方国家和人权组织普遍谴责这些指控是捏造的。后来刑期被减刑，她还有 18 年的刑期。

paras.en: Little has been known about her condition since the coup, which triggered a civil war that has killed about 100,000 people, according to Armed Conflict Location and Event data, a conflict monitoring organization. The U.N. says the conflict has displaced millions.
paras.zh: 冲突监测组织武装冲突地点和事件数据显示，政变引发内战，造成约 10 万人死亡，自政变以来，人们对她的状况知之甚少。联合国表示，冲突已导致数百万人流离失所。

paras.en: "My mother is actually alive and well," said Aris, a 49-year-old carpenter, who has campaigned for her release and sought to raise awareness of the crisis engulfing the Southeast Asian nation. He described the call to NPR in phone interview from London, where he lives. "Hearing her voice has reassured me."
paras.zh: 49 岁的木匠阿里斯 (Aris) 说：“我的母亲实际上还活着，而且状况良好。”他一直致力于争取母亲获释，并试图提高人们对席卷这个东南亚国家的危机的认识。他在居住地伦敦接受美国国家公共广播电台电话采访时描述了这次通话。 “听到她的声音让我安心了。”

paras.en: Khaing Khaing Soe, a spokesperson for Myanmar's military-backed president, said on social media that Aris spoke with Suu Kyi by telephone through Myanmar's Embassy in London, and shared separate photographs of the two.
paras.zh: 缅甸军方支持的总统发言人凯凯索(Khaing Khaing Soe)在社交媒体上表示，阿里斯通过缅甸驻伦敦大使馆与昂山素季通电话，并分享了两人的单独照片。

paras.en: Until now, Aris said he had received almost no word from her — just a single censored letter three years ago and occasional second-hand scraps of information. From the call, he said he learned she is being held at "a residence" somewhere in the surroundings of Myanmar's capital, Naypyidaw. He also said he believes police and military personnel surround the building, which is "fenced off, with a scrubby, nondescript garden which I believe she is allowed to go out into."
paras.zh: 阿里斯说，到目前为止，他几乎没有收到她的任何消息——只有一封三年前经过审查的信件，偶尔还会收到一些二手信息。他说，他从电话中得知她被关押在缅甸首都内比都周边某处的“一处住所”。他还表示，他相信警察和军事人员包围了这座建筑，该建筑“被围起来，有一个灌木丛生、不起眼的花园，我相信她可以进入其中”。

paras.en: "From what I can ascertain, she's basically being held in solitary confinement even if she's not in a prison cell," Aris said.
paras.zh: 阿里斯说：“据我所知，即使她不在牢房里，她基本上也被单独监禁。”

paras.en: She was permitted to read books, he said, adding, "I don't think she gets any news. So no radio, no television, no newspapers."
paras.zh: 他说，她被允许读书，并补充说，“我认为她没有得到任何新闻。所以没有广播，没有电视，没有报纸。”

paras.en: Her health has long been a worry for the family. While she "sounded strong," Aris said, "she is still in a lot of pain because her hand is playing up." She told him she has tendonitis. "She said it is very painful, and at points she can't even use her hand." She also said she gets a health checkup every six months.
paras.zh: 她的健康状况一直是家人的担忧。阿里斯说，虽然她“听起来很坚强”，但“她仍然很痛苦，因为她的手在打球。”她告诉他她患有肌腱炎。 “她说这非常痛苦，有时她甚至无法使用她的手。”她还说她每六个月进行一次健康检查。

paras.en: He believes food is cooked at the residence and sometimes delivered by her lawyers, though not directly to the premises. Aris said he hopes to send her care packages, and she had a request.
paras.zh: 他认为食物是在住所烹饪的，有时由她的律师送来，尽管不是直接送到住所。阿里斯说他希望给她寄送爱心包裹，她也提出了要求。

paras.en: She would like "some healthy foods and some nice foods — something of a treat," he said. "She'd like it half and half so it wasn't too much of either."
paras.zh: 她想要“一些健康的食物和一些美味的食物——一些款待，”他说。 “她想要一半一半，所以两者都不会太多。”

paras.en: "And some chocolate wouldn't go amiss," he added.
paras.zh: “而且一些巧克力也不会出错，”他补充道。

paras.en: Because the conversation was likely monitored by Myanmar's security forces, he said, "there's nothing we could talk about that's too sensitive," including Myanmar's civil war.
paras.zh: 他说，因为谈话可能受到缅甸安全部队的监控，“我们没有什么可以谈论的太敏感的”，包括缅甸内战。

paras.en: "We've had to deal with this for so many years on and off that we're pretty well-versed in how it works," he said, recalling her years of house arrest in her Yangon family home between 1989 and 2010. The regime back then would photograph parcels sent to her and "use that as propaganda," he said.
paras.zh: 他回忆起 1989 年至 2010 年间她在仰光家中被软禁的岁月，他说：“我们已经断断续续地处理这个问题很多年了，所以我们非常熟悉它是如何运作的。”他说，当时的政权会拍摄寄给她的包裹，并“将其用作宣传”。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the military-backed government did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 军方支持的政府发言人没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: Kim Aris believes Myanmar's generals are feeling international pressure as coup leader Min Aung Hlaing, who was installed as president after a military-engineered election in January, travels abroad seeking legitimacy.
paras.zh: 金·阿里斯认为，随着政变领导人敏昂莱 (Min Aung Hlaing) 出国寻求合法性，缅甸将军们正感受到国际压力。敏昂莱在一月份军事策划的选举后就任总统。

paras.en: "It's an indication that the military are wanting to present a better image of themselves, while actually giving very little," he said. "I hope that governments around the world won't be taken in. After all, they've used these same tactics for decades, and it's been proven time and time again that nothing comes of it."
paras.zh: “这表明军方希望展示自己更好的形象，但实际上付出的却很少，”他说。 “我希望世界各国政府不要上当。毕竟，他们几十年来一直在使用同样的策略，而且一次又一次地被证明没有任何结果。”

paras.en: As far as he knows, the call might be a one-off. He said his mother's situation "shines a light on what's going on in Burma, and reminds people this is happening to many others — and much worse."
paras.zh: 据他所知，这个电话可能是一次性的。他说，他母亲的处境“让人们了解了缅甸正在发生的事情，并提醒人们这种情况也发生在许多其他国家身上，而且情况更糟。”

paras.en: "She believes she gives the people of Burma strength by being there with them, going through what they're going through," Aris said.
paras.zh: “她相信，通过与缅甸人民在一起，经历他们正在经历的事情，她给了他们力量，”阿里斯说。

paras.en: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing remains under U.S. sanctions for human rights abuses, including the 2016-2017 mass killings and expulsions of hundreds of thousands of Rohingya Muslims that Washington has declared a genocide.
paras.zh: 缅甸总统敏昂莱仍因侵犯人权行为而受到美国制裁，其中包括 2016 年至 2017 年大规模屠杀和驱逐数十万罗辛亚穆斯林，华盛顿已宣布这些行为为种族灭绝。

paras.en: Based on interviews and social media posts, Suu Kyi remains a beloved figure for many inside Myanmar, though her international standing took a blow in 2019, when she appeared before the International Court of Justice to defend the country against those genocide allegations.
paras.zh: 根据采访和社交媒体帖子，昂山素季仍然是缅甸境内许多人喜爱的人物，尽管她的国际地位在 2019 年受到打击，当时她在国际法院出庭，针对种族灭绝指控为国家辩护。

paras.en: Since Min Aung Hlaing became president, the military has sharply escalated attacks on civilians, according to ACLED, even as regional governments step up diplomatic engagement.
paras.zh: 据 ACLED 称，自敏昂莱就任总统以来，尽管地方政府加强了外交接触，但军方对平民的袭击却急剧升级。

paras.en: An opposition figure, Nay Phone Latt, spokesperson for the exiled National Unity Government, told NPR in a recent interview he believes the regime "dare not release" Suu Kyi.
paras.zh: 反对派人士、流亡民族团结政府发言人奈·电话·拉特 (Nay Phone Latt) 在最近的一次采访中告诉 NPR，他认为该政权“不敢释放”昂山素季。

paras.en: "If she's released, her strength will combine with the revolution — that's what Min Aung Hlaing fears," he added.
paras.zh: “如果她被释放，她的力量将与革命结合起来——这就是敏昂莱所担心的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Richard Horsey, senior Asia adviser at the non-profit International Crisis Group, said Suu Kyi's status is "potentially the most valuable card Min Aung Hlaing holds, but he is very reluctant to play it."
paras.zh: 非营利组织国际危机组织的亚洲高级顾问理查德·霍西表示，昂山素季的地位“可能是敏昂莱手中最有价值的一张牌，但他非常不愿意打这张牌”。

paras.en: "The risk is that Aung San Suu Kyi becomes a bargaining chip, traded for concessions while airstrikes on civilian targets continue," Horsey said. "Her release is very unlikely. And while it would matter enormously to her family and to many people in Myanmar, it would not on its own end the war."
paras.zh: 霍西说：“风险在于，昂山素季成为讨价还价的筹码，在对平民目标的空袭继续进行的同时，被用来换取让步。” “她获释的可能性很小。虽然这对她的家人和缅甸的许多人来说非常重要，但它本身并不会结束战争。”

paras.en: The State Department said the U.S. remains concerned about everyone it considers unjustly detained and continues to call for their release. It also urged the military to engage in "genuine dialogue with all opposition groups" to end the conflict.
paras.zh: 美国国务院表示，美国仍然对所有被不公正拘留的人感到担忧，并继续呼吁释放他们。它还敦促军方“与所有反对派团体进行真正的对话”以结束冲突。

paras.en: In August, the department's Bureau of East Asian and Pacific Affairs said in an online statement that it continued to call for Suu Kyi's "immediate and unconditional release."
paras.zh: 8月，该部门东亚和太平洋事务局在一份网上声明中表示，继续呼吁“立即无条件释放”昂山素季。

articles.title: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70% of websites
articles.author: Kate Bartlett

paras.en: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70% of websites
paras.zh: 影响 70% 网站的程序中发现缺陷后，黑客攻击企图增加

paras.en: A few months ago AI caused global alarm after autonomous agents were found to have cheated on evaluations and then tried to cover it up, in what became known as the "Hugging Face hack."
paras.zh: 几个月前，人工智能引起了全球恐慌，因为自主代理被发现在评估中作弊，然后试图掩盖这一行为，这就是所谓的“拥抱脸黑客”。

paras.en: This week, AI and hacking are back in the spotlight with AI technology credited to have helped prevent a global cybersecurity crisis.
paras.zh: 本周，人工智能和黑客行为再次成为人们关注的焦点，人工智能技术被认为有助于防止全球网络安全危机。

paras.en: Cybersecurity firm Wiz Research, using OpenAI technology, announced on Wednesday it had discovered security flaws in a computer programming language that helps run some 70% of the world's websites.
paras.zh: 使用 OpenAI 技术的网络安全公司 Wiz Research 周三宣布，它发现了一种计算机编程语言中的安全漏洞，该语言帮助运行全球约 70% 的网站。

paras.en: OpenAI called the bug "one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory." Wiz Research warned that its "successful exploitation could allow attackers to take control of affected servers, steal sensitive data, and deface the websites running on them."
paras.zh: OpenAI 称该漏洞是“近年来最具影响力的漏洞之一”。 Wiz Research 警告称，“成功利用该漏洞可能会让攻击者控制受影响的服务器、窃取敏感数据并破坏其上运行的网站。”

paras.en: Corporations and governments from the U.K. to Japan are now rushing to prevent hackers from capitalizing on the flaws.
paras.zh: 从英国到日本的企业和政府现在都在加紧阻止黑客利用这些漏洞。

paras.en: The flaws were discovered in a major programming language called PHP, short for Hypertext Preprocessor. Wiz Research calls PHP "the backbone of the web," saying the technology has underpinned much of the internet since the 1990s.
paras.zh: 这些缺陷是在一种名为 PHP（超文本预处理器的缩写）的主要编程语言中发现的。 Wiz Research 将 PHP 称为“网络的支柱”，并称该技术自 20 世纪 90 年代以来一直支撑着大部分互联网。

paras.en: "These findings rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history," the firm said, adding that before publicly disclosing the flaw, teams had worked on building a solution that's now available to websites to protect themselves.
paras.zh: 该公司表示：“这些发现属于 PHP 中发现的最严重的漏洞之一，可以说是软件历史上发现的最严重的漏洞之一。”并补充说，在公开披露该缺陷之前，团队已经致力于构建一个解决方案，现在可供网站使用以保护自己。

paras.en: As countries scrambled to prevent cyberattacks, numerous websites and pages were taken offline in the past few days. The U.S. National Security Agency warned organizations using PHP to "maintain heightened awareness" over the coming weeks. The U.K.'s National Cyber Security Center called on organizations to "take immediate action" to update their websites to the latest fixed or patched version.
paras.zh: 随着各国争先恐后地防止网络攻击，过去几天许多网站和页面被下线。美国国家安全局警告使用 PHP 的组织在未来几周内“保持高度警惕”。英国国家网络安全中心呼吁各组织“立即采取行动”，将其网站更新到最新的修复或修补版本。

paras.en: Dozens of British and Finnish government services were taken offline this week. In France, many local government sites were also briefly taken down. China's Industry Ministry urged entities to review security gaps.
paras.zh: 本周，英国和芬兰的数十个政府服务被关闭。在法国，许多地方政府网站也被短暂关闭。中国工业部敦促各实体审查安全漏洞。

paras.en: In Japan, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi put out "an urgent request for everyone to take action," adding, "If it is difficult to apply the fix patch promptly, temporarily suspending websites and similar measures can be considered an effective way to reduce risk."
paras.zh: 在日本，首相高市早苗“紧急要求所有人采取行动”，并补充道，“如果难以及时应用修复补丁，暂时关闭网站等类似措施不失为降低风险的有效方法。”

paras.en: Matthew Prince, the head of the cybersecurity firm Cloudflare, said his organization saw tens of thousands of attempts to exploit the flaw in the first 45 minutes of its discovery. That's now in the millions, Prince said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 Cloudflare 的负责人马修·普林斯 (Matthew Prince) 表示，在发现该漏洞的前 45 分钟内，他的组织就发现了数以万计的利用该漏洞的尝试。普林斯周四表示，目前这一数字已达数百万。

paras.en: Wiz Research said the flaws in PHP had been present for decades.
paras.zh: Wiz Research 表示 PHP 的缺陷已经存在了数十年。

paras.en: "But demonstrating their exploitability required an exceptionally complex chain of steps, at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve," the organization said. The AI models have "substantially reduced that barrier, turning a longstanding flaw into an exploit. "
paras.zh: 该组织表示：“但是证明它们的可利用性需要一系列极其复杂的步骤，这处于人类研究人员实际上可以实现的边缘。”人工智能模型“大大减少了这一障碍，将长期存在的缺陷变成了漏洞。”

articles.title: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
paras.zh: 以色列士兵在涉嫌袭击事件中杀死两名男子后下令关闭约旦河西岸

paras.en: HEBRON, West Bank — Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.
paras.zh: 约旦河西岸希伯伦——以色列士兵开枪打死了两名男子，军方称这两名男子周五上午在被占领的约旦河西岸希伯伦市附近发动了袭击。至少有五人受伤，其中一些人伤势严重。

paras.en: The army said it prevented a "terror attack against Israeli civilians" and that the gunmen carried an M16 rifle and a handgun. It did not elaborate on the target of the alleged attack. There was also no word on the identities of the two dead and those injured.
paras.zh: 军方表示，他们阻止了“针对以色列平民的恐怖袭击”，枪手携带了 M16 步枪和手枪。它没有详细说明所谓袭击的目标。也没有透露两名死者和伤者的身份。

paras.en: A few hours later, Israel ordered the army to prepare for a full closure of the West Bank. The office of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said it instructed security forces to immediately cordon off the city of Hebron and prepare to fully close all of the West Bank, starting Friday.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，以色列下令军队准备全面关闭约旦河西岸。总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡办公室表示，已指示安全部队立即封锁希伯伦市，并准备从周五开始全面关闭整个西岸。

paras.en: The deadly shooting comes as Israeli voters will decide next Tuesday whether to grant Netanyahu yet another term as prime minister — or usher in a new era of Israeli politics. The election comes three years after the Hamas-led attacks on Israel that triggered the war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 这起致命枪击事件发生之际，以色列选民将于下周二决定是让内塔尼亚胡连任总理，还是开启以色列政治的新时代。这次选举是在哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击引发加沙战争三年后举行的。

paras.en: Israel's government has warned of potential attacks by the country's "enemies" in the lead-up to the election.
paras.zh: 以色列政府警告称，该国的“敌人”可能会在选举前发动袭击。

paras.en: Following the shooting, Netanyahu held an emergency meeting of his Security Cabinet and officials from top military and security agencies. He blamed Hamas, saying the militant group was "planning a major attack aimed at murdering innocent civilians."
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生后，内塔尼亚胡召开了安全内阁以及高级军事和安全机构官员的紧急会议。他指责哈马斯，称该激进组织正在“计划发动一次旨在谋杀无辜平民的重大袭击”。

paras.en: "Our brave soldiers thwarted this attack with courage and determination," he said, without elaborating on what the planned attack entailed.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们勇敢的士兵以勇气和决心挫败了这次袭击。”但他没有详细说明计划中的袭击具体内容。

paras.en: "I commend them for their actions and wish our wounded a speedy recovery," he added but did not say if the wounded were soldiers or civilians.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“我赞扬他们的行动，并祝愿我们的伤员早日康复。”但他没有透露伤者是士兵还是平民。

paras.en: Earlier Friday Israel's far-right national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, known for extremist views, said that the attack shows that Israel needs to restrict the Palestinians' freedom of movement in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，以极端主义观点闻名的以色列极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本格维尔表示，这次袭击表明以色列需要限制巴勒斯坦人在约旦河西岸的行动自由。

paras.en: "The lives of the residents of Judea and Samaria, of the settlers, the lives of the soldiers, the lives of the police officers, the lives of our fighters are a million times more important than freedom of movement," he said, using an Israeli reference to the West Bank.
paras.zh: 他说：“朱迪亚和撒马利亚居民、定居者、士兵、警察、我们战士的生命比行动自由重要一百万倍。”

paras.en: Ahead of the anniversary of the Oct. 7, 2023 Hamas-led attack that triggered the war, Netanyahu said the Palestinian militant group could attack Israel in a bid to influence the outcome of the elections. He did not provide evidence to back up the claim.
paras.zh: 在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的引发战争的袭击周年纪念日之前，内塔尼亚胡表示，巴勒斯坦激进组织可能会袭击以色列，以影响选举结果。他没有提供证据来支持这一说法。

paras.en: The injured are evacuated to a hospital, medics say
paras.zh: 医护人员称伤者已被送往医院

paras.en: Emergency responders said five people were injured, some critically, and were being evacuated to hospitals in Israel. A statement from the responders said gunfire was still ongoing as they arrived at the scene of the attack near the Yehuda Junction in the morning.
paras.zh: 紧急救援人员表示，有五人受伤，其中一些人伤势严重，正在被疏散到以色列的医院。救援人员发表声明称，当他们早上到达耶胡达枢纽附近的袭击现场时，枪声仍在持续。

paras.en: Two men in their 20s had gunshot wounds to their lower limbs, one was unconscious and seriously injured, the responders said.
paras.zh: 急救人员称，两名 20 多岁的男子下肢受枪伤，其中一人伤势严重，失去知觉。

paras.en: "We arrived at a difficult scene while shooting was still taking place in the area," said Tzuriel Edri with the response team.
paras.zh: 响应小组的特祖里尔·埃德里 (Tzuriel Edri) 表示：“我们到达了一个困难的现场，当时该地区仍在拍摄。”

paras.en: An investigation was underway, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局表示，调查正在进行中。

paras.en: Also Friday, the army said soldiers and Israeli security and intelligence agencies conducted dozens of operations in the West Bank and apprehended dozens of people, including those affiliated with Hamas and Islamic Jihad militant groups. It also said it had located weapons, including M16 rifles and submachine guns.
paras.zh: 同样在周五，军方表示，士兵和以色列安全和情报机构在约旦河西岸开展了数十次行动，逮捕了数十人，其中包括与哈马斯和伊斯兰圣战激进组织有关联的人。它还表示已找到武器，包括 M16 步枪和冲锋枪。

paras.en: Closures of the West Bank, such as the one ordered Friday, are growing more common in the territory. It's the fourth time in the past month that Israel has imposed restrictions across the area, shutting gates and checkpoints connecting Palestinian villages to major roads.
paras.zh: 西岸的关闭（例如周五下令的关闭）在该地区越来越普遍。这是以色列在过去一个月内第四次对该地区实施限制，关闭了连接巴勒斯坦村庄与主要道路的大门和检查站。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Israeli roads in the territory remain open to Israeli drivers, including settlers, who can still travel through the area but may face delays.
paras.zh: 与此同时，该领土上的以色列道路仍然向包括定居者在内的以色列司机开放，他们仍然可以穿过该地区，但可能会面临延误。

articles.title: Michigan Senate rivals clash over Muslim Brotherhood allegations as Rogers doubles down on El-Sayed

paras.en: Michigan Democrat Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed accused Republican rival Mike Rogers of questioning his loyalty to the United States during a heated Fox News interview Friday, while Rogers doubled down on allegations that his opponent has embraced the ideology of the Muslim Brotherhood.
paras.zh: 密歇根州民主党参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德在周五接受福克斯新闻的激烈采访时指责共和党竞争对手迈克·罗杰斯质疑他对美国的忠诚度，而罗杰斯则加倍指责他的对手接受了穆斯林兄弟会的意识形态。

paras.en: The candidates both spoke separately with Fox News chief political anchor Bret Baier on "Special Report" in Detroit, 11 days before the Nov. 3 election.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日大选还有 11 天，两位候选人分别在底特律接受了福克斯新闻首席政治主播布雷特·拜尔 (Bret Baier) 的“特别报道”采访。

paras.en: Baier pressed El-Sayed about a 2012 statement involving former Egyptian President Mohamed Morsi, who was affiliated with the Muslim Brotherhood.
paras.zh: 拜尔就 2012 年一份涉及埃及前总统穆罕默德·穆尔西 (Mohamed Morsi) 的声明向埃尔·赛义德施压，穆尔西隶属于穆斯林兄弟会。

paras.en: "No, no, no, let me just stop there," El-Sayed interrupted. "You are asking this question to raise a question about whether or not I have dual loyalties."
paras.zh: “不，不，不，让我就此打住，”埃尔赛义德打断道。 “你问这个问题是想问我是否有双重忠诚。”

paras.en: Baier explained he was asking about allegations raised by Rogers' campaign.
paras.zh: 拜尔解释说，他是在询问罗杰斯竞选团队提出的指控。

paras.en: "I will be loyal to the Constitution of the United States," El-Sayed said.
paras.zh: “我将忠于美国宪法，”赛义德说。

paras.en: "Don't be Rogers' campaign," he continued.
paras.zh: “不要成为罗杰斯的竞选团队，”他继续说道。

paras.en: El-Sayed accused Rogers of making his Muslim faith a campaign issue, calling the suggestion "sad" and "beneath him."
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德指责罗杰斯将他的穆斯林信仰作为竞选议题，称这一建议“令人悲伤”且“令他失望”。

paras.en: The controversy centers partly on a 2012 letter that The Washington Free Beacon reported El-Sayed signed supporting decisions by then-Egyptian President Mohamed Morsi, including calls to purge Egypt's police and media.
paras.zh: 争议部分集中在2012年的一封信上，据《华盛顿自由灯塔》报道，埃尔-赛义德签署了支持时任埃及总统穆罕默德·穆尔西的决定，其中包括呼吁清洗埃及警察和媒体。

paras.en: El-Sayed has also faced scrutiny over social media posts from his half-sister describing their mother's alleged involvement in Muslim Brotherhood activism in the 1970s. He has denied personal or family ties to the organization and said he was raised by his father and stepmother.
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德还因其同父异母的妹妹在社交媒体上发布的帖子而受到审查，这些帖子描述了他们的母亲涉嫌参与 20 世纪 70 年代穆斯林兄弟会的活动。他否认与该组织有个人或家庭关系，并表示他是由父亲和继母抚养长大的。

paras.en: In an Oct. 17 Fox News interview, El-Sayed acknowledged that his sister-in-law was a plaintiff in a lawsuit challenging her alleged placement on a terrorist watchlist but insisted she had done nothing wrong. The FBI declined to confirm or deny her watchlist status. The lawsuit does not establish wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 17 日接受福克斯新闻采访时，埃尔-赛义德承认，他的嫂子是一起诉讼的原告，该诉讼质疑她被列入恐怖分子观察名单的指控，但坚称她没有做错任何事。联邦调查局拒绝确认或否认她的观察名单状态。该诉讼并未证实存在不当行为。

paras.en: Rogers rejected El-Sayed's characterization in his own interview.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在他自己的采访中拒绝了埃尔赛义德的描述。

paras.en: "I wore the uniform of the United States. Many in my family, including our son, wore the uniform of the United States so he can pray any way he wants," Rogers said. "It is not how he prays, it's how he thinks."
paras.zh: “我穿着美国的制服。我家里的许多人，包括我们的儿子，都穿着美国的制服，这样他就可以以任何他想要的方式祈祷，”罗杰斯说。 “这不是他如何祈祷，而是他如何思考。”

paras.en: Rogers accused El-Sayed of embracing the organization's ideology and portraying himself as a victim.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯指责埃尔赛义德接受该组织的意识形态并将自己描绘成受害者。

paras.en: "He has adopted the ideology of the Muslim Brotherhood," Rogers alleged.
paras.zh: “他接受了穆斯林兄弟会的意识形态，”罗杰斯声称。

paras.en: Baier noted that El-Sayed had denied ever belonging to the organization and pledged allegiance to the Constitution.
paras.zh: 拜尔指出，埃尔赛义德否认曾属于该组织，并宣誓效忠宪法。

paras.en: "Does he disavow? Does he really say it?" Rogers responded.
paras.zh: “他否认吗？他真的这么说吗？”罗杰斯回应道。

paras.en: El-Sayed had explicitly disavowed the organization at an Oct. 17 town hall, answering, "Sure. Yeah, absolutely" when asked.
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德在 10 月 17 日的市政厅上明确否认该组织，当被问及时回答说：“当然。是的，绝对”。

paras.en: The candidates also differed over the war with Iran, which El-Sayed blamed for rising gasoline and grocery prices.
paras.zh: 两位候选人在与伊朗的战争问题上也存在分歧，埃尔-赛义德将汽油和杂货价格上涨归咎于伊朗战争。

paras.en: "We need a war powers resolution to end the capacity for this president to wage an illegal, unjustifiable war," El-Sayed said.
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德说：“我们需要一项战争权力决议，以终止这位总统发动非法、不合理战争的能力。”

paras.en: Rogers defended the original rationale for military action but said he has urged President Donald Trump to end the conflict.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯为军事行动的最初理由进行了辩护，但表示他已敦促唐纳德·特朗普总统结束冲突。

paras.en: "I've called for him to wrap it up. That's the right thing to do," Rogers said.
paras.zh: “我已经要求他结束这件事。这是正确的做法，”罗杰斯说。

paras.en: Turning to Michigan's economy, Rogers said the state has lost 27,000 manufacturing jobs and faces some of the nation's highest auto insurance costs. He also raised concerns about education, claiming roughly two-thirds of fourth graders cannot read at grade level.
paras.zh: 谈到密歇根州的经济，罗杰斯表示，该州已经失去了 27,000 个制造业工作岗位，并且面临着全美最高的汽车保险成本。他还提出了对教育的担忧，声称大约三分之二的四年级学生无法达到年级水平的阅读能力。

paras.en: Rogers defended Trump's influence in Michigan, pointing to his support among voters and crediting his trade policies with encouraging General Motors to bring Silverado pickup truck production back to the state.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯为特朗普在密歇根州的影响力辩护，指出他在选民中的支持，并称赞他的贸易政策鼓励通用汽车将索罗德皮卡生产带回该州。

paras.en: But the Republican acknowledged a disagreement with Trump over trade with Canada.
paras.zh: 但这位共和党人承认在与加拿大的贸易问题上与特朗普存在分歧。

paras.en: "I've come out and said we shouldn't be doing the Canadian tariffs the way we are doing them," Rogers said.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯说：“我站出来表示，我们不应该以现在的方式对加拿大征收关税。”

paras.en: Baier also pressed El-Sayed over Medicare-for-all, and whether middle-class taxes would rise.
paras.zh: 拜尔还就全民医疗保险以及中产阶级税收是否会增加等问题向埃尔赛义德施压。

paras.en: "I'm fine with people keeping their private insurance if that's what they want, but I want guaranteed public insurance for everybody," El-Sayed said.
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德说：“如果人们愿意的话，我可以保留他们的私人保险，但我希望每个人都有有保障的公共保险。”

paras.en: Rogers disputed El-Sayed's position, arguing that Medicare-for-all would eliminate private insurance and raise costs for Michigan families.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯对埃尔-赛义德的立场提出异议，认为全民医疗保险将取消私人保险并增加密歇根州家庭的费用。

paras.en: El-Sayed touted upcoming campaign appearances with former President Barack Obama and Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., while questioning whether Trump would help Rogers in Michigan.
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德宣传即将与前总统巴拉克·奥巴马和佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯一起参加竞选活动，同时质疑特朗普是否会在密歇根州帮助罗杰斯。

paras.en: With both Trump and Obama expected to campaign in Michigan over the weekend, the candidates are turning to their parties' most recognizable figures as they make their final pitches to voters ahead of Election Day.
paras.zh: 由于特朗普和奥巴马预计周末将在密歇根州竞选，候选人将转向各自政党最知名的人物，在选举日之前向选民进行最后的宣传。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Leo Briceno contributed to this reporting.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字版的利奥·布里塞诺 (Leo Briceno) 对本报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Mavericks star Cooper Flagg exits game after hard foul sparks shoving match vs Pacers

paras.en: Dallas Mavericks star Cooper Flagg exited Friday night's game against the Indiana Pacers with an apparent shoulder injury after taking a hard foul while attempting a layup.
paras.zh: 达拉斯小牛队球星库珀·弗拉格在周五晚上对阵印第安纳步行者队的比赛中因在尝试上篮时严重犯规而明显肩部受伤退出。

paras.en: In the final minute of the second quarter, Flagg made a great defensive play to intercept a pass and broke down the court for what was looking like a very easy layup for the second-year pro out of Duke.
paras.zh: 在第二节的最后一分钟，弗拉格在防守中表现出色，拦截了传球，并突破了球场，为这位来自杜克大学的二年级职业球员完成了一个看起来非常轻松的上篮。

paras.en: What he may not have anticipated was Pacer Aaron Nesmith hustling behind him and fouling him as he approached the basket.
paras.zh: 他可能没有预料到的是，步行者亚伦·内史密斯在他身后冲刺，并在他接近篮筐时对他犯规。

paras.en: Flagg went down hard under the basket and stayed down on the floor for some time.
paras.zh: 弗拉格重重地倒在篮下，在地板上呆了一会儿。

paras.en: The Mavericks weren't big on that one for obvious reasons. You've always got to stick up for your stars.
paras.zh: 出于显而易见的原因，小牛队在这一点上并不大。你必须始终坚持你的明星。

paras.en: Nesmith was dealt a flagrant foul, but not before some pushing and shoving broke out.
paras.zh: 内史密斯被判恶意犯规，但在此之前爆发了一些推搡。

paras.en: And shout-out to Pacers assistant coach Jenny Boucek, who dove straight into the fray to retrieve Nesmith.
paras.zh: 并向步行者队助理教练珍妮·布切克大声喊叫，她直接冲入战斗救下了内史密斯。

paras.en: As for Flagg, he unfortunately left the game and did not return.
paras.zh: 至于弗拉格，他不幸离开了比赛，并且没有回来。

paras.en: That was a turning point in the game, considering Dallas was up by 33 points at the time of Nesmith's foul on Flagg. However, this one ended up being way closer than you'd think, given the margin at the half.
paras.zh: 这是比赛的转折点，考虑到在内史密斯对弗拉格犯规时达拉斯领先 33 分。然而，考虑到半场的差距，这场比赛最终比你想象的更接近。

paras.en: The Mavericks held on to win by a score of 121-108, and while they undoubtedly will be fired up about the win, it might be overshadowed by concern for Flagg.
paras.zh: 小牛队以 121-108 的比分继续获胜，尽管他们无疑会对这场胜利感到兴奋，但可能会被对弗拉格的担忧所掩盖。

articles.title: Brewers rally past chaotic late-game replay, premature celebrations to win first World Series game in 44 years

paras.en: For the first time since 1982, the Milwaukee Brewers have won a World Series game.
paras.zh: 自 1982 年以来，密尔沃基酿酒人队首次赢得了世界大赛的胜利。

paras.en: The Brew Crew took Game 1 of the Fall Classic over the Tampa Bay Rays in a sweaty 3-2 ballgame.
paras.zh: Brew Crew 队在秋季经典赛第一场比赛中以 3-2 的比分战胜了坦帕湾光芒队。

paras.en: Down two, the Rays loaded the bases with one out in the ninth, but Liam Hicks grounded into what initially was ruled a game-ending double play. However, replay showed shortstop Cooper Pratt came off second base, instead making it a 3-2 game with runners on second and third and two outs.
paras.zh: 在落后两分的情况下，光线队在第九局以一垒安打的方式上垒，但利亚姆·希克斯（Liam Hicks）击倒了最初被判定为双杀的比赛。然而，重播显示游击手库珀·普拉特(Cooper Pratt)从二垒出发，将比分变成了3-2，二垒手、三垒手和两个出局者都在。

paras.en: The Brewers had already ignited their fireworks, creating a chaotic, fog-filled scene, before Johnny DeLuca came to the plate and struck out to end the game.
paras.zh: 在约翰尼·德卢卡上垒并三振结束比赛之前，酿酒人队已经点燃了烟花，营造出一片混乱、充满雾气的场面。

paras.en: The city of Milwaukee waited 46 years to see its team in the Fall Classic, and this year's Brewers wanted to stop wasting time. An RBI triple by Christian Yelich, followed by a William Contreras single, put the Brewers up 2-0 in the first inning. However, that was all they'd get for a while, as Nick Martinez settled down to get through five innings of work.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基市等待了 46 年才看到自己的球队参加秋季经典赛，今年的酿酒人队希望不再浪费时间。克里斯蒂安·耶利奇 (Christian Yelich) 打出三分打点，随后威廉·孔特雷拉斯 (William Contreras) 打出一垒安打，酿酒人队在第一局以 2-0 领先。然而，这就是他们一段时间内所能得到的一切，因为尼克·马丁内斯安定下来，完成了五局的比赛。

paras.en: The Milwaukee pitching, though, was just as good. Soon-to-be Cy Young Award winner Jacob Misiorowski held the Rays to just one run in his five innings, but certainly not without the help of some Rays baserunning blunders.
paras.zh: 不过，密尔沃基的投球也同样出色。即将获得赛扬奖的雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基 (Jacob Misiorowski) 在他的五局比赛中只让光芒队只得一分，但当然也离不开一些光芒队跑垒失误的帮助。

paras.en: Tampa Bay had runners on first and second with one out in the first, but Junior Caminero lined out, and Jonathan Aranda was doubled off at second to end the threat. In the fifth, Victor Mesa Jr. was caught stealing at third for the final out of the inning, a big baseball no-no.
paras.zh: 坦帕湾队在第一名和第二名都有参赛者，第一名中有一人出局，但朱尼尔·卡米内罗（Junior Caminero）出局，乔纳森·阿兰达（Jonathan Aranda）在第二名双打以结束威胁。在第五局中，小维克多·梅萨在最后一局的第三局中被抓到偷球，这是棒球界的一大禁忌。

paras.en: The Brewers matched that mistake with one of their own almost immediately, as nine-hitter David Hamilton made the first out at third in the bottom half of the frame trying to stretch a double into a triple.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队几乎立即将这个错误与他们自己的错误相匹配，九击球手大卫·汉密尔顿在下半区的第三名中首次出局，试图将二垒打变成三垒打。

paras.en: But they got a huge insurance run after some more typical Brewers small ball. In the seventh, Hamilton got a productive second out to get a runner into scoring position, and Jackson Chourio drove him in with an opposite-field, ground-ball single to make it 3-1. No team in the league went oppo and hit grounders at a higher rate than the Brewers in the regular season.
paras.zh: 但在一些更典型的酿酒人小球之后，他们得到了巨大的保险。第七局，汉密尔顿第二次出局，帮助跑垒者进入得分位置，杰克逊·乔里奥（Jackson Chourio）在对方外野打出一记滚地球单垒打，将比分改写为 3-1。常规赛中，联盟中没有哪支球队的反扑和滚地球击球率比酿酒人队更高。

paras.en: Milwaukee will have Logan Henderson on the bump on Saturday night, while Drew Rasmussen will toe the slab for Tampa Bay.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，密尔沃基将让洛根·亨德森上场，而德鲁·拉斯穆森将前往坦帕湾。

articles.title: Embattled Greens senator Jordon Steele-John confirms leave from parliament after allegations against him made public
articles.author: Sarah Basford Canales

paras.en: Jordon Steele-John has confirmed he will not attend parliament next week as the embattled Greens senator releases a letter detailing the allegations against him.
paras.zh: 乔登·斯蒂尔·约翰确认，他下周不会出席议会，这位四面楚歌的绿党参议员发表了一封详细说明对他的指控的信。

paras.en: After days of confusion following historical complaints about alleged misconduct were publicly aired in the media, Steele-John posted a statement to social media late Friday night.
paras.zh: 媒体公开报道了有关涉嫌不当行为的历史投诉，引发了数日的混乱之后，斯蒂尔-约翰于周五深夜向社交媒体发布了一份声明。

paras.en: In the statement, the Western Australian senator said he considered attending Senate estimates virtually but was told it would be “unacceptable”. He will instead focus on seeing through an independent investigation to its conclusion, he said.
paras.zh: 这位西澳大利亚州参议员在声明中表示，他考虑以虚拟方式参加参议院的评估，但被告知这是“不可接受的”。他说，他将专注于通过独立调查得出结论。

paras.en: “Over the past few days there has been a growing chorus calling on me not to attend parliament next week. I have explored attending digitally but have been informed that would also be unacceptable,” Steele-John said.
paras.zh: “过去几天，越来越多的人呼吁我不要参加下周的议会。我曾尝试过以数字方式参加，但被告知这也是不可接受的，”斯蒂尔-约翰说。

paras.en: Steele-John said a precedent of keeping parliamentarians out of parliament after “allegations of allegations” are made had now been set.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰表示，在提出“指控”后将议员排除在议会之外的先例现已形成。

paras.en: “Had an allegation or complaint been made against me, I would have taken these actions immediately,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果有人对我提出指控或投诉，我会立即采取这些行动，”他说。

paras.en: The 32-year-old senator’s attendance in parliament for the remainder of the year had been uncertain after a public stoush with the party’s leader, David Shoebridge, over whether he was on leave while an investigation was undertaken into allegations he had acted inappropriately towards women between 2017 and 2025.
paras.zh: 这位 32 岁的参议员在今年剩余时间里出席议会的情况一直不确定，此前与该党领袖戴维·舒布里奇 (David Shoebridge) 就他在 2017 年至 2025 年间对女性做出不当行为的指控进行调查期间是否休假进行了公开争论。

paras.en: The complaints are now subject to an independent investigation commissioned by the WA Greens and have been referred to the Independent Parliamentary Standards Commission.
paras.zh: 这些投诉现已接受西澳绿党委托进行的独立调查，并已提交给独立议会标准委员会。

paras.en: Shoebridge claimed Steele-John had requested leave and he accepted it last week after seven party members penned a letter to the leader urging an investigation into the claims.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇声称斯蒂尔-约翰已请求休假，上周七名党员写信给斯蒂尔-约翰，敦促对这一说法进行调查，他接受了这一请求。

paras.en: The three-page letter sent on 13 October, and first published by the Nine newspapers, said the authors had been “made aware of multiple allegations of serious misconduct” against Steele-John about his “behaviour in the presence of women”.
paras.zh: 这封三页的信于 10 月 13 日发出，最初由九号报纸发表，信中称，作者已获悉针对斯蒂尔-约翰“在女性面前的行为”的“多项严重不当行为指控”。

paras.en: The letter referred to an allegation of sexual harassment at a Greens campaign event in 2024 that the alleged victim had not reported out of fear and backlash. The letter provided no further detail.
paras.zh: 这封信提到了 2024 年绿党竞选活动中发生的性骚扰指控，但据称受害者出于恐惧和强烈反对而没有举报。这封信没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: In another, the authors referred to an allegation of “serious sexual misconduct” in 2025.
paras.zh: 在另一篇文章中，作者提到了 2025 年的一项“严重性行为不端”指控。

paras.en: Also contained in the letter was a reference to a disparaging nickname for Steele-John – “feels on wheels” – which the authors said implied he had a reputation for acting inappropriately.
paras.zh: 信中还提到了斯蒂尔-约翰的一个贬义绰号——“感觉就像在轮子上”——作者说，这暗示着他因行为不当而闻名。

paras.en: “To be clear, all signatories to this letter know that an allegation does not equate to a fact and/or guilt. We simply believe that it is in the party’s best interests to ensure that every allegation is investigated thoroughly, in alignment with community and member expectations,” the letter’s authors wrote.
paras.zh: “需要明确的是，这封信的所有签署人都知道，指控并不等于事实和/或有罪。我们只是相信，确保每项指控都得到彻底调查，符合社区和成员的期望，符合该党的最大利益，”该信的作者写道。

paras.en: Steele-John was defiant in a lengthy statement last Sunday, rejecting the allegations against him, denying he agreed to take leave from parliament and accusing an internal faction within the Greens of playing “nasty political games” in their decision to release the letter to the media.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰上周日在一份冗长的声明中挑衅性地拒绝了对他的指控，否认他同意离开议会，并指责绿党内部派系在决定向媒体发布这封信时玩“肮脏的政治游戏”。

paras.en: Steele-John said any claims of his alleged behaviour should be investigated “fairly and thoroughly” but accused an “unofficial faction” within the WA branch had released the complaint letter to the media in a bid to oust him from the Senate.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰表示，任何有关他被指控行为的指控都应该“公平、彻底”地进行调查，但他指责西澳分部内的一个“非官方派别”向媒体发布了这封投诉信，目的是将他逐出参议院。

paras.en: Guardian Australia has confirmed the WA police told Steele-John the investigation was closed in May with no charges.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报证实，西澳警方告诉斯蒂尔-约翰，调查已于五月结束，没有提出任何指控。

articles.title: Seven killed and 40 injured after gunmen open fire at church funeral in Jordan
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan on Friday, killing seven people and wounding 40 others, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，周五，枪手在约旦一座教堂举行的葬礼上开枪，造成 7 人死亡、40 人受伤。

paras.en: The shooting took place at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, about 180km (110 miles) south of the capital, Amman.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在卡拉克的一座希腊东正教教堂，位于首都安曼以南约 180 公里（110 英里）处。

paras.en: Footage broadcast on Jordanian state television showed two gunmen who appear to be holding pistols approaching the church and firing shots. A third man who appears to be holding a semiautomatic rifle then approaches and opens fire, and all three then run toward the church.
paras.zh: 约旦国家电视台播放的画面显示，两名枪手似乎手持手枪接近教堂并开枪。第三名男子似乎拿着一把半自动步枪，然后接近并开枪，然后三人都跑向教堂。

paras.en: Video footage taken by witnesses shows broken glass and pools of blood on the floor of the church.
paras.zh: 目击者拍摄的视频显示，教堂地板上有碎玻璃和血泊。

paras.en: Dorgham Halasa, who was among the mourners inside the church, said intense gunfire erupted 15 minutes after the funeral had started, and then people started running. “It was a weird situation, and heavy gunfire,” Halasa said.
paras.zh: 教堂内的哀悼者之一多尔格姆·哈拉萨 (Dorgham Halasa) 表示，葬礼开始 15 分钟后爆发了激烈的枪声，然后人们开始逃跑。 “情况很奇怪，枪声很大，”哈拉萨说。

paras.en: He did not see the gunmen, but said other people reported seeing four of them. The Associated Press could not independently verify the number of assailants, and Jordan’s security services did not immediately release details.
paras.zh: 他没有看到枪手，但说其他人报告看到其中四人。美联社无法独立核实袭击者的人数，约旦安全部门也没有立即公布细节。

paras.en: A government statement said that the attack was “carried out by unknown assailants,” but didn’t say whether any gunmen were captured or killed. It said that “investigations are under way at full speed”.
paras.zh: 一份政府声明称，这次袭击是“由身份不明的袭击者实施的”，但没有说明是否有枪手被抓获或被杀。声明称“调查正在全速进行”。

paras.en: Jordan declared three days of national mourning, according to the kingdom’s Petra news agency.
paras.zh: 据该国佩特拉通讯社报道，约旦宣布全国哀悼三天。

paras.en: Karak is home to a minority Christian population.
paras.zh: 卡拉克是少数基督徒的家园。

paras.en: In 2016, gunmen ambushed police in a series of attacks in Karak, including at a Crusader castle popular with tourists, killing 10 people, including seven officers, and wounding dozens. Jordanian security forces killed those gunmen after a long standoff.
paras.zh: 2016年，枪手在卡拉克发生了一系列袭击事件，其中包括在一座深受游客欢迎的十字军城堡袭击警察，造成包括七名警察在内的10人死亡，数十人受伤。经过长时间对峙后，约旦安全部队击毙了这些枪手。

paras.en: Jordan’s health minister Ibrahim al-Budour said two of those wounded are in critical condition.
paras.zh: 约旦卫生部长易卜拉欣·布杜尔表示，其中两名伤者情况危急。

paras.en: King Abdullah II said on X that Jordan “will confront the terrorist act that targeted Karak with the harshest penalties” and offered his “deepest condolences to the families of the martyrs, and our wishes for recovery to the wounded”.
paras.zh: 国王阿卜杜拉二世于十日表示，约旦“将对针对卡拉克的恐怖行为给予最严厉的惩罚”，并“向烈士家属表示最深切的哀悼，并祝愿伤者康复”。

paras.en: Jordan’s prime minister Jafar Hassan said during a security meeting in Karak on Friday evening that the attack was a result of terrorist ideology and blind extremism. He said the assailants will be punished and legal measures taken against those who seek to introduce extremism.
paras.zh: 约旦总理贾法尔·哈桑周五晚上在卡拉克举行的安全会议上表示，这次袭击是恐怖主义意识形态和盲目极端主义的结果​​。他表示，袭击者将受到惩罚，并对那些试图引入极端主义的人采取法律措施。

paras.en: Condemnation of the slayings came from around the region, including from Lebanon, Syria, Egypt and Oman.
paras.zh: 该地区各地，包括黎巴嫩、叙利亚、埃及和阿曼，都谴责了这些屠杀事件。

paras.en: Ahmed al-Tayeb in Cairo, the grand imam of Al-Azhar, the Sunni Muslim world’s foremost religious institution, offered his condolences to the families of victims in Friday’s shooting, calling it a “heinous terrorist attack.”
paras.zh: 逊尼派穆斯林世界最重要的宗教机构爱资哈尔大伊玛目开罗的艾哈迈德·塔耶布向周五枪击事件的受害者家属表示哀悼，称这是一次“令人发指的恐怖袭击”。

paras.en: Iraqi foreign minister Fuad Hussein called his Jordanian counterpart and “affirmed Iraq’s solidarity with Jordan in the face of terrorism”, Hussein’s office said in a statement.
paras.zh: 侯赛因办公室在一份声明中表示，伊拉克外交部长福阿德·侯赛因致电约旦外长，“重申伊拉克在恐怖主义面前与约旦团结一致”。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres condemned the attack during a funeral as “especially heinous,” spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said. “The secretary-general also calls for all those responsible to be found and to be held to account.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克表示，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯谴责葬礼期间发生的袭击“特别令人发指”。 “秘书长还呼吁找到所有责任人并追究其责任。”

articles.title: Typhoon Champi kills one and injures more than 500 in Taiwan as it heads to China
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: Typhoon Champi swept past Taiwan on Saturday killing one person, injuring more than 500, and uprooting trees and severing power as it weakened and headed north toward the Chinese coast.
paras.zh: 周六，台风“占比”横扫台湾，造成 1 人死亡、500 多人受伤，并在强度减弱并向北移动至中国海岸时将树木连根拔起并切断电源。

paras.en: Earlier classified as a super typhoon and one of the strongest storms in the Pacific this year, Champi was still packing gusts of about 126km per hour (78 miles per hour) near its centre, according to Taiwan’s Central Weather Administration (CWA).
paras.zh: 据台湾中央气象局（CWA）称，此前被归类为超强台风和今年太平洋最强风暴之一的“占比”仍在其中心附近带来约每小时 126 公里（每小时 78 英里）的阵风。

paras.en: The storm was about 150km (93 miles) east of Taiwan, the CWA said, having glanced off the island’s northeast coast in the early hours of Saturday.
paras.zh: CWA 表示，这场风暴位于台湾以东约 150 公里（93 英里）处，周六凌晨掠过台湾东北海岸。

paras.en: Champi’s forecast track shows it turning north toward the Chinese coast before eventually moving into southern Japan.
paras.zh: 占比的预测轨迹显示，它将向北转向中国海岸，然后最终进入日本南部。

paras.en: Taiwan’s fire department said one man had been killed, swept by waves from the island of Liuqiu. Another 527 people were injured during heavy wind and torrential rain.
paras.zh: 台湾消防部门表示，一名男子被琉球岛的海浪卷走而死亡。另有527人因大风和暴雨受伤。

paras.en: Taipower said more than 167,000 homes had lost electricity, but most had now been reconnected.
paras.zh: 台电表示，超过 167,000 户家庭断电，但大多数现已重新接通。

paras.en: Large parts of northern and central Taiwan, including Taipei, declared a second day of office and school closures on Saturday, and some flights were still being cancelled.
paras.zh: 包括台北在内的台湾北部和中部大部分地区周六宣布办公室和学校关闭第二天，部分航班仍被取消。

paras.en: Taiwan is generally well prepared for typhoons, which keeps casualties low. Although more common in summer, the storms can strike also in autumn.
paras.zh: 台湾总体上对台风做好了充分的准备，因此伤亡人数较低。虽然风暴在夏季更为常见，但秋季也可能发生。

articles.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack

paras.en: The condition of Helen Haines, the Australian MP hit by a car five days ago in north-east Victoria, has improved from critical to serious but stable.
paras.zh: 五天前在维多利亚州东北部遭遇车祸的澳大利亚议员海伦·海恩斯（Helen Haines）的病情已从危急转为严重但稳定。

paras.en: The independent MP, 65, had both her legs amputated after what authorities say was a deliberate attack outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, north-east of Melbourne, on Monday.
paras.zh: 周一，这位 65 岁的独立议员在墨尔本东北部旺加拉塔的选举办公室外遭到了蓄意袭击，随后双腿被截肢。

paras.en: In the latest update on Saturday morning, the Alfred Hospital in Melbourne said Haines was in a serious but stable condition, the first improvement since she was airlifted there.
paras.zh: 在周六早上的最新消息中，墨尔本阿尔弗雷德医院表示，海恩斯的情况严重但稳定，这是她被空运到那里以来的首次好转。

paras.en: Her alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, was arrested shortly after the incident and has since appeared in court on three charges.
paras.zh: 袭击她的人是 43 岁的布伦丹·纽金特 (Brendan Nugent)，他在事件发生后不久被捕，此后因三项指控出庭。

paras.en: The politician's husband, Phil Haines, said on Wednesday that the "horrendous incident" had caused his wife significant injuries but "her heart and her mind" were "in good shape".
paras.zh: 这位政治家的丈夫菲尔·海恩斯周三表示，这起“可怕的事件”给他的妻子造成了严重伤害，但“她的心脏和思想”“状况良好”。

paras.en: Nugent, who was arrested moments after he allegedly drove his Toyota LandCruiser into the MP, appeared in court to face three charges: dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally causing serious injury, and causing harm to a Commonwealth public official.
paras.zh: 纽金特据称驾驶丰田陆地巡洋舰撞向议员后不久被捕，他出庭面临三项指控：危险驾驶造成严重伤害、故意造成严重伤害以及对联邦公职人员造成伤害。

paras.en: Police said more charges might be laid, including attempted murder.
paras.zh: 警方表示可能会提出更多指控，包括谋杀未遂。

paras.en: His lawyer said his client had "mental health concerns" but did not give any further detail.
paras.zh: 他的律师表示，他的当事人有“心理健康问题”，但没有提供任何进一步的细节。

paras.en: Victoria Police has said its investigation, with support from the Australian Federal Police, remains ongoing and a motive is yet to be established.
paras.zh: 维多利亚警方表示，在澳大利亚联邦警察的支持下，调查仍在进行中，动机尚未确定。

paras.en: Investigators are looking into whether drug use or medication played a part in the incident.
paras.zh: 调查人员正在调查这起事件是否与吸毒或药物治疗有关。

paras.en: Nugent's family has said they were long-time friends with Haines.
paras.zh: 纽金特的家人表示，他们与海恩斯是多年的朋友。

paras.en: Shortly after the alleged attack, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese told ABC television that there had been a "rise in temperature" and "too much shouting, not enough discourse" in Australia.
paras.zh: 据称的袭击事件发生后不久，澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞向美国广播公司电视台表示，澳大利亚出现了“气温升高”和“喊叫太多，讨论不够”的情况。

paras.en: Haines, known for stances such as supporting stronger climate action, entered parliament in 2019 after working as a nurse and midwife.
paras.zh: 海恩斯以支持更强有力的气候行动等立场而闻名，在担任护士和助产士后，于 2019 年进入议会。

articles.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's Eagle's Nest retreat

paras.en: Police in the south German state of Bavaria have detained a suspect during a fire at Adolf Hitler's Alpine mountain retreat, the Kehlsteinhaus, also known as the Eagle's Nest.
paras.zh: 德国南部巴伐利亚州警方在阿道夫·希特勒的阿尔卑斯山区度假胜地凯尔斯坦豪斯（又名“鹰巢”）发生火灾时拘留了一名嫌疑人。

paras.en: Dispatchers in Traunstein received a fire alarm from the building at 21:15 (19:15 GMT) on Friday, and firefighters found it engulfed in flames.
paras.zh: 周五 21 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 19 点 15 分），特劳恩施泰因的调度员收到了大楼的火警警报，消防队员发现大楼已被火焰吞没。

paras.en: Difficult terrain was hindering efforts to extinguish the blaze and it was still burning early on Saturday, police said, with some 200 emergency personnel deployed. There were no reports of injuries.
paras.zh: 警方表示，复杂的地形阻碍了灭火工作，周六早些时候火势仍在燃烧，并部署了约 200 名急救人员。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。
