paras.zh: - 闪电回合：Paolone 分享了一些个人见解。 (14:07)

articles.title: Audi Matrix LED Headlights
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: LED headlights are changing the role of forward illumination. Before LEDs, forward lighting was just a bulb that cast its light in a pattern defined by the housing. Most of the innovation came with incandescent, halogen and Xenon bulbs. But light-emitting diodes (LEDs) are really a game changer for designers, engineers and technicians.
paras.zh: LED 车头灯正在改变前方照明的作用。在 LED 出现之前，前向照明只是一个灯泡，它按照外壳定义的模式投射光线。大多数创新来自白炽灯、卤素灯和氙气灯泡。但发光二极管 (LED) 确实改变了设计师、工程师和技术人员的游戏规则。

paras.en: LED lights offer increased functionality by being able to control the brightness and pattern almost instantaneously. This is the case with Audi’s Matrix LED headlights found on the A8 and some E-Tron models. With these headlights, just the high-beam unit itself is made up of 25 individual segments. The small light-emitting diodes, which work in conjunction with lenses and reflectors connected in series, are activated and deactivated or dimmed individually according to the situation. This enables the system to react precisely to other cars, which it recognizes using a camera, and always illuminates the road brightly. Additional features of the new headlights are the intelligent cornering light, new-look daytime running lights and dynamic turn signals. The Audi Matrix LED headlights get the information they need from a camera, the navigation system and other sensors.
paras.zh: LED 灯几乎可以即时控制亮度和图案，从而提供了更多功能。 A8 和一些 E-Tron 车型上的奥迪矩阵 LED 车头灯就是这种情况。对于这些车头灯，仅远光灯单元本身就由 25 个单独的部分组成。小型发光二极管与串联的透镜和反射器一起工作，根据情况单独激活、关闭或变暗。这使得系统能够对使用摄像头识别的其他车辆做出精确反应，并始终明亮地照亮道路。新型车头灯的附加功能包括智能转弯灯、新外观日间行车灯和动态转向灯。奥迪矩阵 LED 车头灯从摄像头、导航系统和其他传感器获取所需的信息。

paras.en: Composed of 1.3 million micromirrors per headlight, the units operate like movie projectors, emitting tiny unique particles or adaptable light. This is done with electrostatically controlled micromirrors that can adjust light beam pixels up to 5,000 times per second.
paras.zh: 每个车头灯由 130 万个微镜组成，这些装置的运行方式类似于电影放映机，发射微小的独特粒子或适应性强的光。这是通过静电控制的微镜完成的，该微镜每秒可以调整光束像素高达 5,000 次。

paras.en: This lighting technology offers a selection of five different welcome/leaving animations when the vehicle is parked, each with unique motion graphics and text selected through the vehicle’s touchscreen display.
paras.zh: 当车辆停放时，该照明技术提供五种不同的欢迎/离开动画选择，每种动画都具有通过车辆触摸屏显示屏选择的独特动态图形和文本。

paras.en: Audi’s lighting technology provides drivers with a 50-meter “light carpet” that is designed to keep light within the driver’s lane and extends the carpet left or right when changing lanes, and helps to avoid a “blinding” effect for oncoming traffic. Low-beam curved lighting bends below oncoming traffic, helping to illuminate people or objects on the side of the road that are otherwise difficult to detect. And on-ground light arrows help place the vehicle’s tires within its lane.
paras.zh: 奥迪的照明技术为驾驶员提供了50米长的“光地毯”，旨在将光线保持在驾驶员车道内，并在变道时向左或向右延伸光地毯，有助于避免对迎面驶来的车辆产生“致盲”效果。近光弧形照明在迎面驶来的车辆下方弯曲，有助于照亮路边难以察觉的人或物体。地面光箭头有助于将车辆的轮胎放置在车道内。

paras.en: Early versions from 2020 in the U.S. lacked functions of the light carpet due to antiquated headlight laws that forbid adaptive lighting. Previously, the system could only show logos during startup and shutdown. On recent models, most of the European functionality has been enabled due to changes in headlight laws and adaptive lighting.
paras.zh: 由于过时的前灯法律禁止自适应照明，美国 2020 年的早期版本缺乏灯毯功能。此前，系统只能在启动和关闭时显示徽标。在最近的车型上，由于前灯法规和自适应照明的变化，大部分欧洲功能已启用。

paras.en: The good news is that the LED segments and lighting elements are expected to last the lifetime of the vehicle. But the units are sealed, and individual components inside can’t be serviced. The complete headlight assembly may cost in excess of $6,000 to replace.
paras.zh: 好消息是 LED 段和照明元件预计可持续车辆的使用寿命。但这些装置是密封的，内部的单个组件无法维修。更换整个车头灯组件的成本可能超过 6,000 美元。

paras.en: The units are deeply integrated with the ADAS systems of the vehicle, including the Pre-Sense systems for automatic emergency braking. Having a scan tool that can talk to the ADAS system’s modules is critical. The ability to program replacement is also vital. Audi has issued several updates over the air and in new calibrations from the service information website.
paras.zh: 这些单元与车辆的 ADAS 系统深度集成，包括用于自动紧急制动的 Pre-Sense 系统。拥有一个可以与 ADAS 系统模块对话的扫描工具至关重要。编程替换的能力也至关重要。奥迪通过无线方式发布了多项更新，并通过服务信息网站进行了新的校准。

paras.en: The headlights are aimed and calibrated using a dynamic self-learning procedure that uses the forward-facing camera. If the camera is out of calibration, the headlights might not be aimed properly.
paras.zh: 前灯通过使用前置摄像头的动态自学习程序进行瞄准和校准。如果摄像头未校准，前灯可能无法正确瞄准。

articles.title: Timing BMW VANOS N53 And N54
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The BMW N53 (naturally aspirated) and N54 (turbocharged) engines were among the first BMW engines to come with variable valve timing on the intake and exhaust camshafts. The N53 and N54 straight-six have unfairly earned a bad reputation for reliability with technicians due to timing chain and variable valve timing problems. The reputation comes from owners not keeping up with oil changes and it is difficult to check engine timing.
paras.zh: BMW N53（自然吸气）和 N54（涡轮增压）发动机是首批在进气和排气凸轮轴上配备可变气门正时的 BMW 发动机。由于正时链条和可变气门正时问题，N53 和 N54 直列六缸发动机在可靠性方面赢得了技术人员的坏名声。这种声誉来自于车主不及时更换机油，并且很难检查发动机正时。

paras.en: The latest versions continuously adjust the position of the intake and exhaust camshafts for better power, efficiency and idle performance. The keyword to remember for a late-model VANOS system is that it works “continuously,” and not just under specific RPM ranges.
paras.zh: 最新版本不断调整进气和排气凸轮轴的位置，以获得更好的动力、效率和怠速性能。对于最新型号的 VANOS 系统，要记住的关键词是它“连续”工作，而不仅仅是在特定的转速范围内工作。

paras.en: To service them, you will need the appropriate toolset to lock the crank and camshaft. You will also need a scan tool and scope to observe the crankshaft and camshaft signals to accomplish more advanced diagnostics.
paras.zh: 要维修它们，您将需要适当的工具组来锁定曲柄和凸轮轴。您还需要扫描工具和示波器来观察曲轴和凸轮轴信号，以完成更高级的诊断。

paras.en: Some newer systems can change the camshaft timing by as much as ±72 degrees. Dual-VANOS systems operate at all engine speeds. At lower engine speeds, the VANOS system opens the valves later during the intake stroke, increasing the vacuum and scavenging effect generated by the piston traveling downward in the cylinder. This improves idle quality and smooth power tip-in from a stop. As the engine rpm increases, the valves are opened earlier, enhancing torque as rpm increases. At higher engine speeds, the valves open later for full power delivery so the scavenging effect of the exhaust leaving the cylinder can pull more air into the cylinder. Hot rodders call this “valve overlap.”
paras.zh: 一些较新的系统可以将凸轮轴正时改变多达 ±72 度。双 VANOS 系统可在所有发动机转速下运行。在发动机转速较低时，VANOS 系统会在进气冲程期间稍后打开气门，从而增加活塞在气缸中向下运动所产生的真空和扫气效果。这提高了怠速质量并在停车时平稳地提供动力。随着发动机转速的增加，阀门会提前打开，从而随着转速的增加而增强扭矩。在发动机转速较高时，气门稍后打开以提供全部动力，因此离开气缸的废气的扫气作用可以将更多空气吸入气缸。热棒爱好者称之为“气门重叠”。

paras.en: The system can augment and even eliminate the EGR valve by allowing some of the exhaust gas to remain in the combustion chamber to control combustion temperatures and NOX emissions.
paras.zh: 该系统可以通过允许部分废气保留在燃烧室中来控制燃烧温度和氮氧化物排放，从而增强甚至消除 EGR 阀。

paras.en: Also, the camshaft position is changed to reduce engine warm-up times by allowing some unburned fuel to reach the catalytic converters. When the VANOS system on the N53 and N54 is not working, the most common symptoms are poor idle quality, reduced power and poor fuel economy. These symptoms are common to any other variable valve timing system, as well.
paras.zh: 此外，凸轮轴位置发生变化，通过允许一些未燃烧的燃料到达催化转化器来减少发动机预热时间。当N53和N54上的VANOS系统不工作时，最常见的症状是怠速质量差、动力下降和燃油经济性差。这些症状对于任何其他可变气门正时系统也很常见。

paras.en: Like many variable valve timing systems, VANOS uses oil pressure-powered actuators to move the camshafts. The actuators need a consistent supply of oil for the correct viscosity, pressure and volume.
paras.zh: 与许多可变气门正时系统一样，VANOS 使用油压驱动的执行器来移动凸轮轴。执行器需要持续供应油，以获得正确的粘度、压力和体积。

paras.en: The N53 and N54 use a conventional cam phaser with internal chambers that hold pressurized oil that changes the position of the camshaft.
paras.zh: N53 和 N54 使用传统的凸轮相位器，其内腔可容纳可改变凸轮轴位置的加压油。

paras.en: BMW N53 and N54 use an oil control valve like a lot of other variable valve timing engines. The solenoid is actuated by a pulse-width modulated signal.
paras.zh: 与许多其他可变气门正时发动机一样，BMW N53 和 N54 使用油控制阀。螺线管由脉宽调制信号驱动。

paras.en: If the oil is contaminated or is the wrong viscosity, the system can become sluggish. If the oil pressure can’t move the camshafts to the target positions in a specified time, the camshaft position sensors will sense it and set a code.
paras.zh: 如果油被污染或粘度错误，系统可能会变得缓慢。如果油压无法在指定时间内将凸轮轴移动到目标位置，凸轮轴位置传感器将感应到并设置一个代码。

paras.en: When oil pressure is not present, the camshafts go to a fully retarded position and are locked in place by a pin. A code will be set if the actuator and camshaft do not return to the correct position, because they are hydraulically jammed due to oil pressure leaking past a seal.
paras.zh: 当不存在油压时，凸轮轴进入完全延迟位置并通过销锁定到位。如果执行器和凸轮轴由于油压通过密封件泄漏而被液压卡住，因此无法返回到正确位置，则会设置一个代码。

paras.en: Disconnect the oil control valve if you are trying to scope a crankshaft and camshaft waveform. If this is not done, the waveform might look like the timing is out of sync because the engine will be adjusting the camshafts.
paras.zh: 如果您尝试观察曲轴和凸轮轴波形，请断开油控制阀。如果不这样做，波形可能看起来像是正时不同步，因为发动机将调整凸轮轴。

paras.en: What Goes Wrong With N53 And N54 VANOS Systems?
paras.zh: N53 和 N54 VANOS 系统出了什么问题？

paras.en: The two most common failures for a VANOS system are related to the quality of the oil. The most common failure is when the O-ring seal on the piston wears out and allows oil pressure to move between the two chambers. This causes the actuator to be stuck or hydraulically jammed in either the full advance or retard positions.
paras.zh: VANOS 系统最常见的两个故障与油的质量有关。最常见的故障是活塞上的 O 形密封圈磨损并导致油压在两个腔室之间移动。这会导致执行器卡在或液压卡在完全提前或延迟位置。

paras.en: When this happens, the actuator can’t fight the pressure exerted on the camshaft by the valve springs. This can cause a rattling noise at startup and idle.
paras.zh: 发生这种情况时，执行器无法抵抗气门弹簧施加在凸轮轴上的压力。这可能会导致启动和闲置时发出嘎嘎声。

paras.en: If the oil is the wrong viscosity, it can cause the corrections to either retard or advance – in other words, to lag or happen too quickly. These changes take place in milliseconds. Depending on your scan tool and whether you can pull BMW DME or OBDII codes, the description may include the words jammed, stiff or lagging.
paras.zh: 如果油的粘度不正确，可能会导致修正延迟或提前——换句话说，滞后或发生得太快。这些变化发生在几毫秒内。根据您的扫描工具以及是否可以提取 BMW DME 或 OBDII 代码，描述可能包括“卡住”、“僵硬”或“滞后”等字样。

paras.en: The engine will factor in the oil and coolant temperature into the time allowed for the actuation. If you have any codes related to these sensors, you might want to resolve these issues before troubleshooting the VANOS system.
paras.zh: 发动机会将机油和冷却液温度考虑到允许的致动时间中。如果您有与这些传感器相关的任何代码，您可能需要在对 VANOS 系统进行故障排除之前解决这些问题。

paras.en: Remind your customers that the quality of the oil in both engines matters to the life of their timing chains. BMW recommends a high-quality 5W-30 or 5W-40 that is fully synthetic and meets the BMW Longlife-01 FE specifications. These oils are formulated around the extended oil change interval. When a low-quality oil is used, it can break down before the oil change interval and accelerate wear on the links and pins of the timing chain.
paras.zh: 提醒您的客户，两台发动机中的机油质量对其正时链条的使用寿命至关重要。 BMW 推荐使用高品质的全合成 5W-30 或 5W-40，且符合 BMW Longlife-01 FE 规格。这些油是围绕延长换油间隔而配制的。当使用劣质机油时，它可能会在换油间隔之前发生故障，并加速正时链条的链节和销的磨损。

articles.title: XL Parts, The Parts House Expands VIP Event Series
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: XL Parts and The Parts House recently concluded its 2026 VIP Event Series with expanded programming across Houston, Dallas and Orlando.
paras.zh: XL Parts 和 The Parts House 最近结束了 2026 年 VIP 活动系列，并在休斯顿、达拉斯和奥兰多扩大了活动范围。

paras.en: “This year’s VIP Event Series represents a significant step forward in how we engage with our team, our vendor partners, and our customers,” said President and CEO Vikrant Aggarwal. “We have had the opportunity to create meaningful opportunities to align on strategic growth, strengthen industry relationships, and express our deep appreciation for the partners who drive our business forward.”
paras.zh: 总裁兼首席执行官维克兰特·阿加瓦尔 (Vikrant Aggarwal) 表示：“今年的 VIP 活动系列代表着我们在与团队、供应商合作伙伴和客户互动方面向前迈出了重要一步。” “我们有机会创造有意义的机会，以协调战略增长，加强行业关系，并向推动我们业务发展的合作伙伴表示深深的谢意。”

paras.en: This year’s events introduced an upgraded two-day experience in both Houston and Orlando. The new structure provided dedicated time for internal strategy sessions, vendor showcases, formal awards ceremonies for employee-of-the-year honorees and supplier partners and customer-focused trade shows and appreciation dinners.
paras.zh: 今年的活动在休斯顿和奥兰多推出了升级的两天体验。新的结构为内部战略会议、供应商展示、年度最佳员工获奖者和供应商合作伙伴的正式颁奖典礼以及以客户为中心的贸易展览和答谢晚宴提供了专门的时间。

paras.en: The series debuted Sept. 17-18 at The Woodlands Resort in Houston, TX, where XL Parts team members, vendor partners, and customers gathered for comprehensive product training, business development and vendor recognition.
paras.zh: 该系列于 9 月 17 日至 18 日在德克萨斯州休斯顿的 Woodlands Resort 首次亮相，XL Parts 团队成员、供应商合作伙伴和客户齐聚一堂，进行全面的产品培训、业务开发和供应商认可。

paras.en: It continued at The Shop Club in Dallas, TX, on September 24, where XL Parts says local shop owners and industry partners connected with suppliers over interactive exhibition booths, live entertainment, and multiple prizes.
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日，活动在德克萨斯州达拉斯市的 The Shop Club 继续进行，XL Parts 表示，当地店主和行业合作伙伴通过互动展位、现场娱乐表演和多种奖品与供应商建立了联系。

paras.en: The VIP event line-up concluded Oct. 1–2 at the Gaylord Palms Resort in Orlando, FL, where The Parts House (TPH) honored VIP customers and supplier partners through targeted product training, networking, and evening celebrations.
paras.zh: VIP 活动系列于 10 月 1 日至 2 日在佛罗里达州奥兰多盖洛德棕榈度假村结束，The Parts House (TPH) 通过有针对性的产品培训、社交和晚间庆祝活动向 VIP 客户和供应商合作伙伴致敬。

articles.title: Recalling The Brake Rotor Wars of the Early 2000s
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Last year, Chinese and Turkish brake drum manufacturers were hit with antidumping duties for selling some trailer brake drums in the United States at less than fair market value. The news gave me flashbacks to the light-vehicle rotor market 25 years ago, when I first started working on Brake & Front End magazine.
paras.zh: 去年，中国和土耳其制动鼓制造商因以低于公平市场价格的价格在美国销售部分拖车制动鼓而受到反倾销税打击。这个消息让我回想起 25 年前的轻型车辆转子市场，当时我第一次开始为《Brake & Front End》杂志工作。

paras.en: In the early 2000s, shops faced brake pedal pulsation comebacks for several reasons. Some people might call it a perfect storm.
paras.zh: 2000 年代初，由于多种原因，商店面临制动踏板脉动卷土重来的问题。有些人可能称之为完美风暴。

paras.en: Facing new fuel-efficiency standards, OEMs began removing mass from brake rotors. Vehicles such as the Jeep Cherokee and Chevrolet Malibu used “composite” rotor designs with stamped-steel hats cast into iron friction rings. These rotors would develop lateral runout if the lug nuts were tightened even slightly unevenly.
paras.zh: 面对新的燃油效率标准，原始设备制造商开始减轻制动盘的重量。吉普切诺基和雪佛兰马里布等车辆采用“复合”转子设计，将冲压钢帽铸入铁摩擦环中。如果凸耳螺母拧紧得稍微不均匀，这些转子就会产生横向跳动。

paras.en: Some rotor manufacturers introduced one-piece replacements for these composite applications, but wheel-stud length was always a concern. Because the cast hats were thicker, the studs sometimes did not extend far enough beyond the rotor flange to properly secure the wheel. Some aftermarket brake companies even offered longer wheel-stud kits.
paras.zh: 一些转子制造商为这些复合材料应用推出了一体式替代品，但轮螺柱长度始终是一个问题。由于铸帽较厚，螺柱有时无法延伸到转子法兰之外足够远以正确固定车轮。一些售后制动公司甚至提供更长的车轮螺柱套件。

paras.en: This period also marked the infancy of ceramic brake pad formulations. Most OE friction materials at the start of the transition process were semi-metallic or aggressive non-asbestos organic (NAO) compounds that could contribute to disc thickness variation when even a small amounts of runout were present. Ceramic formulations were being rolled out that on new OE platforms and as aftermarket alternatives. They can be credited, at least in part, with extending rotor life and reducing incidents of brake pedal pulsation.
paras.zh: 这一时期也标志着陶瓷刹车片配方的起步阶段。大多数原厂摩擦材料在过渡过程开始时都是半金属或侵蚀性非石棉有机 (NAO) 化合物，即使存在少量跳动，也会导致摩擦盘厚度变化。陶瓷配方正在新的原厂平台上推出，并作为售后市场的替代品。它们至少可以部分归功于延长转子寿命和减少制动踏板脉动事件。

paras.en: What I remember most was the debate surrounding replacement brake rotors. In the late 1990s, “offshore manufacturers” were selling brake rotors at prices well below fair market value. By 2006, the federal government had begun investigating the situation and imposed antidumping duties on certain imports.
paras.zh: 我印象最深刻的是围绕更换制动盘的争论。 20 世纪 90 年代末，“离岸制造商”以远低于公平市场价值的价格销售制动盘。 2006年，联邦政府开始调查这一情况并对某些进口产品征收反倾销税。

paras.en: Within the aftermarket, some brake brands alleged that these inexpensive rotors were unsafe. Their main argument was that manufacturers were reducing rotor weight by making the friction plates thinner and failing to match the original fin design. I remember several press events that highlighted these design differences. I also remember phone calls from other rotor manufacturers arguing that the practice was acceptable because OE rotors were designed with an “eight-times” safety margin.
paras.zh: 在售后市场，一些刹车品牌声称这些廉价的转子不安全。他们的主要论点是，制造商通过使摩擦片更薄来减轻转子重量，并且未能匹配原始的翅片设计。我记得有几次新闻发布会强调了这些设计差异。我还记得其他转子制造商打来的电话，他们认为这种做法是可以接受的，因为原厂转子的设计具有“八倍”的安全裕度。

paras.en: The lasting effect of these events were on technicians and repair shops. Replacement brake rotors became so inexpensive that installing new ones often cost less than the labor required to machine the originals. The economics allowed shops to recommend new rotors with increasing frequency, based on the rationale that replacement produced a more reliable, comeback-free brake job.
paras.zh: 这些事件对技术人员和维修店产生了持久影响。更换制动盘变得如此便宜，以至于安装新制动盘的成本通常低于加工原始制动盘所需的劳动力。从经济角度考虑，商店可以越来越频繁地推荐新的转子，其理由是更换可以带来更可靠、无复发的制动效果。

paras.en: This replacement mindset even prompted California’s Bureau of Automotive Repair to conduct a sting investigation in 2010 targeting shops that recommended new rotors without first measuring the thickness of the existing ones.
paras.zh: 这种更换心态甚至促使加州汽车维修局在 2010 年针对那些在没有先测量现有转子厚度的情况下推荐新转子的商店进行了一项诱捕调查。

paras.en: Like it or not, we have been spoiled by inexpensive brake rotors over the past 20 years. Their availability permanently changed how some technicians and shops service brake systems. Today, it is not uncommon for technicians to recommend new rotors regardless of whether the existing rotors remain within specification, based on the economics.
paras.zh: 不管你喜欢与否，在过去的 20 年里，我们已经被廉价的制动盘宠坏了。它们的可用性永久地改变了一些技术人员和商店维修制动系统的方式。如今，技术人员根据经济性推荐新转子，无论现有转子是否符合规格，这种情况并不罕见。

paras.en: The market, however, is always changing. Vehicle brake systems have improved, and modern friction formulations have extended rotor life through better ceramic transfer-layer developments. OEMs have also increased the size and mass of many brake rotors to improve braking performance, manage heat and control noise.
paras.zh: 然而，市场总是在变化。车辆制动系统得到了改进，现代摩擦配方通过更好的陶瓷转移层开发延长了转子寿命。原始设备制造商还增加了许多制动盘的尺寸和质量，以提高制动性能、管理热量和控制噪音。

paras.en: On the parts side, replacement rotor prices have increased because of higher transportation costs, inflation, tariffs and other market pressures. Rotors have also become more sophisticated, incorporating improved hat and heat-dam designs. Coatings and treatments such as ferritic nitrocarburizing have further increased the price of replacement rotors.
paras.zh: 在零部件方面，由于运输成本上升、通货膨胀、关税和其他市场压力，更换转子的价格有所上涨。转子也变得更加复杂，采用了改进的帽子和热坝设计。铁素体氮碳共渗等涂层和处理进一步提高了更换转子的价格。

paras.en: In my opinion, we are approaching another perfect storm. As replacement rotor prices rise and original brake rotors become more durable, the economics of replacement versus machining are beginning to converge on some brake jobs—especially when shops compare labor and parts costs while accounting for the rotor’s discard dimension.
paras.zh: 在我看来，我们正在接近另一场完美风暴。随着更换转子价格的上涨和原装制动转子变得更加耐用，更换与加工的经济性开始集中在一些制动作业上，特别是当商店在考虑转子报废尺寸的同时比较劳动力和零件成本时。

paras.en: As an industry veteran who survived the rotor wars, I see this as a win-win for repair shops. On the labor side, machining rotors can be a profitable again. On the parts side, selling a higher-value replacement rotor can generate more gross-profit dollars.
paras.zh: 作为一名在转子战争中幸存下来的行业资深人士，我认为这对于维修店来说是双赢的。在劳动力方面，加工转子可以再次盈利。在零件方面，销售更高价值的替换转子可以产生更多的毛利润。

paras.en: It may be time to dust off your micrometers and tune up your brake lathes.
paras.zh: 也许是时候掸去千分尺上的灰尘并调整刹车车床了。

articles.title: Alignment Specs: 2021–Current Ford Mustang Mach-E
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E uses Ford’s Global Electrified 1 (GE1) platform, a heavily reworked version of the automaker’s C2 architecture. The C2 platform also underpins the fourth-generation Ford Focus and third-generation Kuga, as well as the fourth-generation Escape. While the Mach-E shares its platform lineage with these vehicles, GE1 was adapted for an all-electric SUV. That platform connection provides useful context for technicians approaching its suspension and alignment service, while vehicle-specific procedures and specifications remain essential across model years and configurations.
paras.zh: Mustang Mach-E 使用福特的 Global Electrified 1 (GE1) 平台，这是该汽车制造商 C2 架构的经过大量修改的版本。 C2平台还支持第四代福特福克斯和第三代Kuga以及第四代Escape。虽然 Mach-E 与这些车辆共享其平台血统，但 GE1 适合于全电动 SUV。该平台连接为技术人员提供悬架和定位服务提供了有用的背景，而车辆特定的程序和规范在不同型号年份和配置中仍然至关重要。

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E has adjustable camber and toe at both ends, but an alignment service with this car also calls for attention to the vehicle loading, ride height and driver-assistance systems. The procedures provided in this article are for a 2023 AWD Mach-E, so confirm the specifications and service procedure for the vehicle’s exact model year and configuration before making adjustments. The supplied information does not include numerical alignment specifications or acceptable ride-height ranges.
paras.zh: 野马 Mach-E 两端的外倾角和前束均可调节，但该车的对准服务还需要注意车辆负载、行驶高度和驾驶员辅助系统。本文提供的程序适用于 2023 年 AWD Mach-E，因此在进行调整之前请确认车辆的确切型号年份和配置的规格和维修程序。提供的信息不包括数字对准规范或可接受的行驶高度范围。

paras.en: Before measuring toe, Ford’s procedure calls for a level surface, correct tire pressure, and an inspection for tire wear, damage and suspension wear or damage. The steering wheel must be held straight ahead with a suitable holding device during the toe checks.
paras.zh: 在测量前束之前，福特的程序要求地面平整、轮胎压力正确，并检查轮胎磨损、损坏和悬架磨损或损坏。在检查前束时，必须使用合适的固定装置将方向盘保持在正前方。

paras.en: Ride-height measurement has additional preparation requirements. Position the vehicle on a flat, level surface with tires inflated to the correct pressure. The procedure specifies a full tank of fuel, proper fluid levels and no cargo in the cabin or bed. Inspect for aftermarket equipment and changes to steering, suspension, wheels or tires, then jounce the front and rear suspension vigorously to let the vehicle settle.
paras.zh: 行驶高度测量有额外的准备要求。将车辆放置在平坦的水平表面上，轮胎充气至正确的压力。该程序规定燃油箱已满、液位适当且客舱或床上不得有货物。检查售后设备以及转向、悬架、车轮或轮胎的变化，然后用力摇晃前后悬架，让车辆稳定下来。

paras.en: Remember: Alignment readings are only useful when the vehicle is in the specified condition. If ride height is incorrect, look for changes or problems in the suspension and review the vehicle’s service information before treating alignment adjustments as the solution.
paras.zh: 请记住：对准读数仅在车辆处于指定条件时才有用。如果行驶高度不正确，请查找悬架的变化或问题，并查看车辆的维修信息，然后再将定位调整作为解决方案。

paras.en: If you find that you can’t get the vehicle to roll to carry out the rolling compensation measurements, this is because it has Rollaway Protection Mode that activates when the car is turned off and the driver exits. To enable the car to roll, you will have to leave it on and in neutral during the alignment. In some cases, you might want to attach the driver seatbelt and roll the door latch to prevent it from going into park.
paras.zh: 如果您发现无法让车辆滚动以进行滚动补偿测量，这是因为它具有滚动保护模式，该模式会在汽车关闭且驾驶员退出时激活。为了使汽车能够滚动，您必须在对准过程中将其保持在空档位置。在某些情况下，您可能需要系上驾驶员安全带并滚动门锁以防止其进入停车位。

paras.en: Front camber is adjusted at the strut-to-knuckle connection. First, measure camber with alignment equipment, then remove the wheels and tires. The brake flexible hose is unbolted and moved aside, and the wheel knuckle is supported with mechanic’s wire.
paras.zh: 前外倾角在支柱到转向节的连接处进行调整。首先，用定位设备测量外倾角，然后拆下车轮和轮胎。松开制动软管并移到一边，车轮转向节用机械钢丝支撑。

paras.en: The original strut-to-knuckle bolts and nuts are removed and discarded. Ford specifies new service bolts and nuts for reassembly. The service fasteners are smooth and smaller in diameter than the splined original equipment bolts. With the new fasteners installed and snug, move the knuckle inboard or outboard to bring camber into specification. The procedure states that moving from the maximum inboard to maximum outboard position provides 0.5 degree of adjustment.
paras.zh: 原来的支柱到转向节的螺栓和螺母被拆除并丢弃。福特指定了用于重新组装的新维修螺栓和螺母。维修紧固件光滑且直径小于带花键的原始设备螺栓。安装新紧固件并使其紧贴后，将转向节向内或向外移动，使外倾角符合规格。该程序规定，从最大内侧位置移动到最大外侧位置可提供 0.5 度的调整。

paras.en: Do not fully tighten the strut-to-knuckle fasteners until camber is corrected. After adjustment, torque the bolts and nuts to 173 lb.-ft. (235 Nm). Reinstall the brake hose and torque its bolt to 97 lb.-in. (11 Nm). Reinstall the wheels and tires, recheck alignment and adjust front toe if needed. Because changing camber can affect toe, finish by verifying the toe readings.
paras.zh: 在外倾角得到纠正之前，请勿完全拧紧支柱至转向节的紧固件。调整后，将螺栓和螺母拧紧至 173 磅英尺。 （235 牛米）。重新安装制动软管并将其螺栓拧紧至 97 磅英寸。 （11 纳米）。重新安装车轮和轮胎，重新检查对准情况并根据需要调整前束。由于改变外倾角会影响前束，因此最后要验证前束读数。

paras.en: Front toe is adjusted at the inner tie rods. With the steering wheel held straight, check toe on both sides. Hold each outer tie-rod end stationary while loosening its jam nut; Ford cautions that allowing the tie-rod end to turn can damage the boot. Move the steering gear boot clamp aside, then rotate the inner tie rod to adjust toe. Do not let the steering gear bellows twist as the inner tie rod turns. Recheck toe after adjustment and road test the vehicle.
paras.zh: 前束通过内横拉杆进行调节。保持方向盘伸直，检查两侧前束。松开锁紧螺母时，保持每个外横拉杆端部固定；福特警告说，让横拉杆末端转动可能会损坏行李箱。将舵机靴夹移到一边，然后旋转内横拉杆调整前束。请勿让转向器波纹管随着内拉杆的转动而扭转。调整后重新检查前束并对车辆进行路试。

paras.en: Rear camber is adjusted by moving the upper control arm at its inboard mounting point. Measure camber, loosen the inboard nut approximately two turns, then slide the control arm inboard or outboard to change the reading. Recheck the alignment to verify the change and adjust rear toe if needed. The supplied procedure lists a torque of 76 lb.-ft. (103 Nm) for the upper control arm inboard nut.
paras.zh: 通过移动内侧安装点的上控制臂来调整后外倾角。测量外倾角，松开内侧螺母大约两圈，然后向内或向外滑动控制臂以更改读数。重新检查对齐情况以验证更改并根据需要调整后束。提供的程序列出了 76 磅-英尺的扭矩。 (103 Nm) 用于上控制臂内侧螺母。

paras.en: Rear toe is adjusted at the toe link. With the steering wheel held straight ahead, measure toe on both sides. Before turning the toe-link bolt, clean the area around the joint using mild liquids. Ford notes that the cam nut and cam bolt area must be free of foreign material for proper clamping. Loosen the toe-link nut approximately one turn, rotate the toe-link bolt to obtain the specified reading, and tighten without disturbing the setting. The procedure lists 66 lb.-ft. (90 Nm) for the toe-link nut.
paras.zh: 后束角在束角处进行调节。将方向盘保持笔直向前，测量两侧的前束角。转动趾连杆螺栓之前，请使用温和的液体清洁接头周围的区域。福特指出，凸轮螺母和凸轮螺栓区域必须没有异物才能正确夹紧。松开趾连杆螺母大约一圈，旋转趾连杆螺栓以获得指定读数，然后在不干扰设置的情况下拧紧。该程序列出了 66 磅英尺。 (90 Nm) 用于趾连杆螺母。

paras.en: If the Mach-E is equipped with Lane Departure Warning, Ford requires an IPMA camera alignment after rear toe adjustment. Connect a scan tool and follow its directions for the camera alignment procedure. Road test after the adjustment and required camera service.
paras.zh: 如果 Mach-E 配备车道偏离警告，福特需要在后束调整后进行 IPMA 摄像头对准。连接扫描工具并按照其说明进行相机对准过程。调整后的路试和所需的相机服务。

paras.en: The supplied ride-height procedure uses a surface gauge to measure from a flat, level surface to suspension reference points. At the front, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm forward bolt and to the center of the ball-joint pinch bolt. Subtract the lower-arm forward-bolt measurement from the ball-joint pinch-bolt measurement to calculate front ride height.
paras.zh: 提供的行驶高度程序使用表面测量仪来测量从平坦的水平表面到悬架参考点的距离。在前面，从表面到下臂前部螺栓的中心以及球形接头压紧螺栓的中心进行测量。从球窝接头压紧螺栓测量值中减去下臂前向螺栓测量值，即可计算前部行驶高度。

paras.en: At the rear, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm-to-subframe bolt and to the center of the lower arm-to-wheel-knuckle bolt. For the rear, subtract the wheel-knuckle-bolt measurement from the subframe-bolt measurement.
paras.zh: 在后部，从表面到下臂到副车架螺栓的中心以及下臂到车轮转向节螺栓的中心进行测量。对于后部，从副车架螺栓测量值中减去车轮转向节螺栓测量值。

paras.en: The service information provided describes how to take these measurements but does not give target ride-height values. Use the correct model-year service information for the vehicle to determine whether the recorded measurements are within specification. Avoid substituting a visual estimate or a generic ride-height value.
paras.zh: 提供的服务信息描述了如何进行这些测量，但没有给出目标行驶高度值。使用车辆的正确型号年份服务信息来确定记录的测量值是否符合规格。避免用视觉估计或通用行驶高度值代替。

paras.en: The vehicle’s service information shows a headlamp level sensor at both the front and rear suspension. The front sensor is mounted at the left front suspension, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. The rear sensor is also mounted at the left side, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. Each has an electrical connector.
paras.zh: 车辆的维修信息显示前悬架和后悬架上都有前照灯水平传感器。前传感器安装在左前悬架上，其臂支架连接到下臂。后传感器也安装在左侧，其臂支架连接到下臂。每个都有一个电连接器。

paras.en: During a suspension or alignment inspection, check that the sensors, brackets, arms and wiring are present and undamaged. The supplied procedure covers sensor removal and installation, but it does not specify an adjustment or calibration following a wheel alignment. If a sensor or its linkage has been disturbed or damaged, consult the correct service information for the required repair steps.
paras.zh: 在悬挂或对准检查期间，检查传感器、支架、臂和接线是否存在且未损坏。提供的程序涵盖了传感器的拆卸和安装，但没有指定车轮定位后的调整或校准。如果传感器或其连杆受到干扰或损坏，请查阅正确的服务信息以了解所需的维修步骤。

articles.title: Vehicle Electrification Market to Reach $87.8B by 2033
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: According to a new report from MarketsandMarkets, the vehicle electrification market will grow from $54.9 billion in 2026 to $87.8 billion by 2033. The market will expand at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 6.9% during the forecast period. Regulatory frameworks, including strict carbon dioxide emissions standards, zero-emission mandates and fleet decarbonization targets, have become primary demand drivers. These requirements have shifted beyond compliance costs, making policy timelines leading indicators for new automotive platform launches.
paras.zh: 根据 MarketsandMarkets 的最新报告，汽车电气化市场将从 2026 年的 549 亿美元增长到 2033 年的 878 亿美元。在预测期内，该市场将以 6.9% 的复合年增长率 (CAGR) 扩大。监管框架，包括严格的二氧化碳排放标准、零排放指令和车队脱碳目标，已成为主要的需求驱动因素。这些要求已经超越了合规成本，使政策时间表成为新汽车平台发布的领先指标。

paras.en: Meanwhile, high-utilization commercial fleets are reaching total cost of ownership (TCO) parity first. This trend makes electrification an investment decision driven by return on investment (ROI). Rapid paybacks on electrified auxiliaries, start-stop systems and integrated starter generators support these investments.
paras.zh: 与此同时，高利用率商业车队首先达到总拥有成本 (TCO) 平价。这一趋势使电气化成为由投资回报 (ROI) 驱动的投资决策。电气化辅助设备、启停系统和集成启动发电机的快速回报为这些投资提供了支持。

paras.en: Additionally, the transition toward 800-volt architectures and battery-electric vehicle (BEV) platforms increases component value per vehicle. These platforms incorporate higher-margin components, including electric power steering, positive temperature coefficient (PTC) heaters and electric compressors. This allows suppliers to increase revenue per vehicle faster than overall vehicle production volumes.
paras.zh: 此外，向 800 伏架构和电池电动汽车 (BEV) 平台的过渡增加了每辆车的组件价值。这些平台采用了利润率较高的组件，包括电动助力转向系统、正温度系数 (PTC) 加热器和电动压缩机。这使得供应商能够比车辆总产量更快地增加每辆车的收入。

paras.en: Infrastructure Challenges Affect Vehicle Electrification Market Growth
paras.zh: 基础设施挑战影响汽车电气化市场增长

paras.en: However, energy infrastructure availability and economics now represent the industry’s primary growth constraints, rather than vehicle technology or baseline demand.
paras.zh: 然而，能源基础设施的可用性和经济性现在代表了该行业的主要增长限制，而不是车辆技术或基准需求。

paras.en: Grid capacity limitations, megawatt charging speeds and high deployment costs continue to restrict mass-market expansion. These challenges concentrate early adoption among commercial fleets and fixed-route applications.
paras.zh: 电网容量限制、兆瓦级充电速度和高昂的部署成本继续限制大众市场的扩张。这些挑战集中在商业车队和固定路线应用程序的早期采用上。

paras.en: This infrastructure gap creates an imbalance between demand and supply that component manufacturers must navigate.
paras.zh: 这种基础设施差距造成了组件制造商必须解决的供需失衡。

paras.en: Near-term revenue growth will remain concentrated in privately funded fleet operations. Meanwhile, broader market expansion depends on utility upgrades, public policy and capital investment cycles outside the automotive industry’s direct control.
paras.zh: 近期收入增长将继续集中在私人资助的车队运营上。与此同时，更广泛的市场扩张取决于汽车行业直接控制之外的公用事业升级、公共政策和资本投资周期。

paras.en: Passenger Cars Expected to Hold Largest Market Share
paras.zh: 乘用车预计将占据最大的市场份额

paras.en: The passenger car segment will likely account for the largest share of the vehicle electrification market. Passenger cars dominate because electrification extends beyond propulsion into steering, braking, thermal management, HVAC and power distribution.
paras.zh: 乘用车领域可能会占据汽车电气化市场的最大份额。乘用车占据主导地位是因为电气化超越了推进领域，延伸到了转向、制动、热管理、暖通空调和配电领域。

paras.en: Consequently, individual vehicles incorporate numerous electrified components, including electric power steering, electric compressors, electric pumps, PTC heaters and integrated starter generators. Advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), infotainment technology and increasingly complex thermal requirements further accelerate this trend.
paras.zh: 因此，每辆车都配备了大量电气化组件，包括电动助力转向系统、电动压缩机、电动泵、PTC 加热器和集成启动发电机。先进的驾驶辅助系统 (ADAS)、信息娱乐技术和日益复杂的散热要求进一步加速了这一趋势。

paras.en: As Bosch highlights, the convergence of electrification, automation, and connectivity is driving the transition to centralized zonal architectures and elevated powernet demands to support these next-generation x-by-wire capabilities.
paras.zh: 正如博世所强调的那样，电气化、自动化和连接性的融合正在推动向集中式区域架构的过渡，并提高电力网络需求，以支持这些下一代线控功能。

paras.en: Passenger cars offer opportunities to increase electrification content per vehicle, beyond their large share of vehicle production. Passenger car platforms include 12-volt, 48-volt mild-hybrid, hybrid-electric, plug-in hybrid and 400- to 800-volt BEV architectures. This diversity allows suppliers to offer multiple electrification technologies across a broad customer base.
paras.zh: 乘用车提供了增加每辆车电气化含量的机会，超出了其在汽车产量中所占的很大份额。乘用车平台包括 12 伏、48 伏轻度混合动力、混合动力电动、插电式混合动力和 400 至 800 伏 BEV 架构。这种多样性使供应商能够为广泛的客户群提供多种电气化技术。

paras.en: For example, Valeo offers low- and high-voltage electrification, 48-volt hybrid systems, electric motors and thermal management technologies. Its portfolio supports various passenger car architectures. Meanwhile, Bosch integrates powertrain, thermal and battery management functions into its vehicle-control architecture.
paras.zh: 例如，法雷奥提供低压和高压电气化、48 伏混合动力系统、电动机和热管理技术。其产品组合支持各种乘用车架构。与此同时，博世将动力总成、热量和电池管理功能集成到其车辆控制架构中。

paras.en: These developments create multiple revenue opportunities as passenger cars transition toward electrically actuated, software-controlled platforms. Electrification continues expanding beyond powertrains into steering, thermal management, braking and auxiliary functions.
paras.zh: 随着乘用车向电动、软件控制平台的过渡，这些发展创造了多种收入机会。电气化继续从动力总成扩展到转向、热管理、制动和辅助功能。

paras.en: Liquid PTC Heaters Expected to Lead EV Product Growth
paras.zh: 液体 PTC 加热器有望引领电动汽车产品增长

paras.en: Liquid PTC heaters will likely become the fastest-growing electrification product in the electric vehicle (EV) segment during the forecast period. These heaters address a fundamental BEV design challenge: the absence of engine waste heat.
paras.zh: 在预测期内，液体 PTC 加热器可能会成为电动汽车 (EV) 领域增长最快的电气化产品。这些加热器解决了纯电动汽车设计的一个基本挑战：消除发动机废热。

paras.en: Unlike internal combustion engine vehicles, BEVs cannot rely on engine-heated coolant for cabin heating or battery conditioning. Instead, high-voltage liquid PTC heaters directly heat coolant circulating through battery, cabin heating and other thermal systems.
paras.zh: 与内燃机汽车不同，纯电动汽车不能依靠发动机加热的冷却液来加热驾驶室或调节电池。相反，高压液体 PTC 加热器直接加热通过电池、驾驶室加热和其他热系统循环的冷却剂。

paras.en: Their importance increases with larger batteries, fast charging, cold-weather operation and stricter battery temperature requirements. These heaters rapidly precondition batteries before charging or driving and maintain operating temperatures. They directly influence charging performance, power availability and battery durability.
paras.zh: 它们的重要性随着更大的电池、快速充电、寒冷天气操作和更严格的电池温度要求而增加。这些加热器在充电或行驶之前快速预处理电池并保持工作温度。它们直接影响充电性能、电力可用性和电池耐用性。

paras.en: For example, BorgWarner offers high-voltage coolant heaters operating between 250 and 800 volts, with outputs ranging from 3 to 10 kilowatts. The company has secured programs across BEV and plug-in hybrid platforms, including 400- and 800-volt applications.
paras.zh: 例如，博格华纳提供工作电压为 250 至 800 伏、输出范围为 3 至 10 千瓦的高压冷却液加热器。该公司已获得跨 BEV 和插电式混合动力平台的项目，包括 400 伏和 800 伏应用。

paras.en: Thermal Management Technologies Expand Applications
paras.zh: 热管理技术扩展应用

paras.en: Liquid PTC heaters are evolving beyond cabin heating into essential components of vehicle thermal management systems. Modern systems increasingly combine these heaters with heat pumps, coolant pumps, valves and waste-heat recovery technologies.
paras.zh: 液体 PTC 加热器正在从驾驶室加热发展成为车辆热管理系统的重要组成部分。现代系统越来越多地将这些加热器与热泵、冷却剂泵、阀门和废热回收技术结合起来。

paras.en: These combinations direct heat toward functions that deliver the greatest vehicle-level benefits. Applications include battery preconditioning before fast charging, cabin heating with reduced range loss and battery temperature management under extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 这些组合将热量引导至可提供最大车辆级优势的功能。应用包括快速充电前的电池预处理、减少续航里程损失的驾驶室加热以及极端条件下的电池温度管理。

paras.en: Webasto’s latest architecture integrates high-voltage heaters with coolant and refrigerant circuits. Its Heated Chiller combines previously separate functions, reducing component counts and system complexity.
paras.zh: 伟巴斯特的最新架构将高压加热器与冷却剂和制冷剂回路集成在一起。其加热冷却器结合了以前独立的功能，减少了组件数量和系统复杂性。

paras.en: The expansion of high-voltage coolant heater programs into 800-volt platforms and plug-in hybrids also broadens the technology’s potential market.
paras.zh: 将高压冷却液加热器项目扩展到 800 伏平台和插电式混合动力车也拓宽了该技术的潜在市场。

articles.title: BendPak Opens Third Distribution Center
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: BendPak Inc. has opened its third distribution center, enabling the company to deliver within two days to 92% of the U.S. population. The new facility in Milford, Connecticut, serves New England, the Mid-Atlantic states and parts of the Great Lakes region.
paras.zh: BendPak Inc. 开设了第三个配送中心，使该公司能够在两天内向 92% 的美国人口送货。位于康涅狄格州米尔福德的新设施为新英格兰、大西洋中部各州和五大湖地区的部分地区提供服务。

paras.en: BendPak’s other regional hubs operate in Santa Paula, California, and Theodore, Alabama. The Santa Paula facility serves the western half of the country, while the Theodore hub covers most of the Midwest and South. The distribution network provides next-day or two-day shipping to 40 states and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: BendPak 的其他区域中心位于加利福尼亚州圣保拉和阿拉巴马州西奥多。圣保拉中心服务于该国的西半部，而西奥多中心则覆盖了中西部和南部的大部分地区。该配送网络提供前往 40 个州和华盛顿特区的次日或两日送达服务。

paras.en: BendPak has further decentralized inventory storage and integrated predictive stocking algorithms across all three hubs. These changes reduce order fulfillment times and shipping transit times, curb shipping-related emissions and minimize regional supply chain delays.
paras.zh: BendPak 进一步分散了库存存储，并在所有三个中心集成了预测库存算法。这些变化减少了订单履行时间和运输运输时间，抑制了与运输相关的排放，并最大限度地减少了区域供应链延误。

paras.en: “This Northeast distribution center marks a milestone in our commitment to customer-centric growth,” says Derek Burns, BendPak director of distribution center operations for the East. “In addition to scaling our footprint, we’re redefining what reliability looks like for our dealers and end-user customers. Reaching 92% of Americans in two days or less means our customers get what they need, when they need it, with unprecedented speed.”
paras.zh: BendPak 东部配送中心运营总监 Derek Burns 表示：“这个东北配送中心标志着我们致力于以客户为中心的增长的一个里程碑。” “除了扩大我们的足迹之外，我们还重新定义了经销商和最终用户客户的可靠性。在两天或更短的时间内覆盖 92% 的美国人，这意味着我们的客户可以在需要时以前所未有的速度获得他们需要的东西。”

paras.en: Rising Demand Fuels Nationwide Expansion
paras.zh: 不断增长的需求推动了全国范围内的扩张

paras.en: Over the last nine years, BendPak has expanded its product portfolio and geographic footprint. The company has introduced brands including Autostacker, JackPak, Ergochair and APEX. New products include OctaFlex and AP Series two-post lifts, Mobi-EVS Series electric vehicle battery lifts and Coolee portable air coolers.
paras.zh: 在过去的九年里，BendPak 扩大了其产品组合和地理覆盖范围。公司推出了Autostacker、JackPak、Ergochair、APEX等品牌。新产品包括 OctaFlex 和 AP 系列两柱升降机、Mobi-EVS 系列电动汽车电池升降机和 Coolee 便携式空气冷却器。

paras.en: During that time, the privately held company expanded its Santa Paula manufacturing and distribution center twice. Those expansions increased the facility’s size to more than 400,000 square feet. The company also established a new global headquarters in Agoura Hills, California.
paras.zh: 在此期间，这家私营公司两次扩建了圣保拉制造和分销中心。这些扩建使该设施的面积增加到超过 400,000 平方英尺。该公司还在加利福尼亚州阿古拉山设立了新的全球总部。

paras.en: Additionally, BendPak expanded its Alabama operations from a single distribution center in Theodore into a campus with multiple buildings. Earlier this year, BendPak completed the first phase of its Donald R. Henthorn Industrial Complex in Mobile County, Alabama.
paras.zh: 此外，BendPak 将其阿拉巴马州业务从西奥多的单一配送中心扩展到拥有多栋建筑的园区。今年早些时候，BendPak 完成了位于阿拉巴马州莫比尔县的 Donald R. Henthorn 工业园区一期工程。

paras.en: Expansion Supports Long-Term Logistics Strategy
paras.zh: 扩张支持长期物流战略

paras.en: “In today’s marketplace, business moves faster than ever, and BendPak is positioned to outpace it,” says Jeff Kritzer, president and CEO. “Our Northeast expansion is just the latest step in our long-term plan to continuously refine our logistics network to optimize delivery times and best serve our customers.”
paras.zh: “在当今的市场中，业务发展速度比以往任何时候都快，而 BendPak 有望超越它，”总裁兼首席执行官 Jeff Kritzer 说道。 “我们的东北扩张只是我们长期计划的最新一步，我们的长期计划是不断完善我们的物流网络，以优化交货时间并最好地服务我们的客户。”

articles.title: Used Class 8 Retail Sales Fall, Total Volume Rises
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: September used Class 8 sales were mixed across channels, with same-dealer retail volume falling 7% month over month (M/M) while total preliminary sales increased 6%, according to ACT Research.
paras.zh: ACT Research 的数据显示，9 月份二手 8 级车各渠道销量参差不齐，同一经销商零售量环比下降 7%，而初步总销量增长 6%。

paras.en: Auction sales jumped 28% M/M, offsetting the retail decline and a 6% drop in wholesale transactions. Retail sales fell for the second consecutive month.
paras.zh: 拍卖销售额环比增长 28%，抵消了零售额下降和批发交易下降 6% 的影响。零售额连续第二个月下降。

paras.en: ACT said the sequential increase in total sales suggests underlying demand for used trucks remains resilient despite tighter inventory, higher interest rates, driver availability challenges, and fuel costs.
paras.zh: ACT 表示，总销量的环比增长表明，尽管库存紧张、利率上升、司机可用性面临挑战以及燃料成本增加，但二手卡车的潜在需求仍然强劲。

paras.en: The preliminary average retail price for same-dealer used Class 8 sales declined 1.5% M/M to $61,000. ACT said the decrease was greater than normally expected on a seasonal basis.
paras.zh: 同一经销商二手 8 类产品的初步平均零售价环比下降 1.5%，至 61,000 美元。 ACT 表示，按季节计算，降幅大于正常预期。

paras.en: Pricing also declined in the auction and wholesale channels. The combined preliminary average sale price across all units fell 7.1% M/M.
paras.zh: 拍卖和批发渠道的定价也有所下降。所有单位的综合初步平均售价环比下降 7.1%。

paras.en: “While tighter inventories have been a persistent theme, it’s clear that higher interest rates and ongoing challenges in the driver pool and fuel costs are also influencing the used truck market,” said Steve Tam, vice president at ACT Research.
paras.zh: ACT Research 副总裁 Steve Tam 表示：“虽然库存紧张一直是一个持续的主题，但很明显，利率上升以及司机群体和燃油成本方面持续存在的挑战也正在影响二手卡车市场。”

paras.en: “Despite these headwinds, the sequential uptick in total sales and continued strength in freight activity suggest that underlying demand for used equipment remains resilient.”
paras.zh: “尽管存在这些不利因素，但总销售额的连续上升和货运活动的持续强劲表明，对二手设备的潜在需求仍然具有弹性。”

paras.en: The September used Class 8 sales figures come from ACT Research’s latest State of the Industry: U.S. Classes 3-8 Used Trucks Flash report.
paras.zh: 9 月份二手 8 类卡车销售数据来自 ACT Research 最新的行业状况：美国 3-8 类二手卡车快讯报告。

articles.title: PRT Introduces 18 New Products for North America
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: PRT, a brand of the ADD Group, announces the arrival of new applications for light vehicles. The launches include strategic models across North America, such as the Tesla Model S, Chevrolet Spark, Honda Passport, Mitsubishi Outlander and Cadillac STS, in addition to brand-new applications including the 2024 Audi Q7, as well as the 2024 Nissan Kicks, among others.
paras.zh: ADD集团旗下品牌PRT宣布推出轻型车辆新应用。此次发布的产品包括北美地区的战略车型，如特斯拉 Model S、雪佛兰 Spark、本田 Passport、三菱欧蓝德和凯迪拉克 STS，此外还有全新应用，包括 2024 款奥迪 Q7 和 2024 款日产 Kicks 等。

paras.en: PRT said its products are produced under the strictest OE quality processes required by the main automakers. “These 18 new product introductions reflect our continued focus on expanding vehicle coverage while delivering the OE-quality, high performance, and reliability our customers expect from PRT. Our goal is to provide the right solutions for the North American aftermarket,” explains PRT’s Bruno Bello.
paras.zh: PRT表示，其产品是按照主要汽车制造商要求的最严格的原厂质量流程生产的。 “这 18 款新产品的推出反映了我们持续关注扩大车辆覆盖范围，同时提供客户期望 PRT 的原厂质量、高性能和可靠性。我们的目标是为北美售后市场提供正确的解决方案，”PRT 的 Bruno Bello 解释道。

paras.en: For more information, call 1-770-238-1611 visit www.prtautoparts.com, or follow @prtautoparts.
paras.zh: 如需了解更多信息，请致电 1-770-238-1611，访问 www.prtautoparts.com，或关注 @prtautoparts。

articles.title: Bumper Removal & ADAS Recalibration
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Removing a front bumper cover for repairs or modifications can affect advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Cameras, radar and other sensors require precise alignment to function properly.
paras.zh: 拆卸前保险杠盖进行维修或改装可能会影响高级驾驶员辅助系统(ADAS)。摄像头、雷达和其他传感器需要精确对准才能正常工作。

paras.en: Remind customers that bumper removal or replacement may require ADAS recalibration, even during routine radiator, condenser or headlight repairs. Always consult manufacturer procedures to ensure proper operation and safety.
paras.zh: 提醒客户，即使在常规散热器、冷凝器或前灯维修期间，拆卸或更换保险杠也可能需要 ADAS 重新校准。请务必查阅制造商程序以确保正确操作和安全。

articles.title: Simple Steps for Successful Wiper Blade Installation
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Installing wiper blades is a valuable customer service, but proper installation requires care. Never place blades on a vehicle’s paint or leave an exposed wiper arm upright, where it could damage the windshield.
paras.zh: 安装雨刷片是一项有价值的客户服务，但正确安装需要小心。切勿将刀片放在车辆的油漆上或将暴露的雨刷臂直立放置，否则可能会损坏挡风玻璃。

paras.en: Use a pocket screwdriver to help remove stubborn blades, select the correct adapter and ensure it snaps securely into place before lowering the arm.
paras.zh: 使用袖珍螺丝刀帮助移除顽固的刀片，选择正确的适配器并确保其在放下臂之前牢固地卡入到位。

articles.title: Climate change is literally altering the shape of our planet
articles.author: Stephanie Pappas

paras.en: Climate change is making Earth progressively rounder, new research finds.
paras.zh: 新的研究发现，气候变化正在使地球变得越来越圆。

paras.en: The findings are a signal of human-caused climate change, however, and tracking the shape of the Earth can help reveal just how much impact people are having on its ice caps.
paras.zh: 然而，这些发现是人为气候变化的一个信号，追踪地球的形状可以帮助揭示人类对其冰盖的影响有多大。

paras.en: Our planet is not a perfect sphere. Because of its rotation, it is a bit flatter at the poles and bulges in the middle. But the new study reveals that Earth is getting rounder at an accelerated rate, largely due to shifts caused by the melting polar ice caps.
paras.zh: 我们的星球不是一个完美的球体。由于它的旋转，它的两极有点平坦，中间凸起。但新的研究表明，地球正在加速变圆，这主要是由于极地冰盖融化引起的变化。

paras.en: This finding applies only to the solid parts of the planet; the ocean continues to bulge outward at the equator.
paras.zh: 这一发现仅适用于行星的固体部分；赤道处的海洋继续向外隆起。

paras.en: The study, published Sept. 9 in the journal JGR Solid Earth, used direct measurements from the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) to track the planet's shape-shifting over time. This system provides direct measurements, but there are limits in how it can be used. For example, there are few GNSS stations near the North and South poles and few in remote oceans because they must be deployed on buoys.
paras.zh: 这项研究于 9 月 9 日发表在《JGR Solid Earth》杂志上，利用全球导航卫星系统 (GNSS) 的直接测量来跟踪地球随时间的形状变化。该系统提供直接测量，但其使用方式存在限制。例如，靠近北极和南极的 GNSS 站很少，而在偏远海洋则很少，因为它们必须部署在浮标上。

paras.en: Christoforos Kotsakis, a professor of geodesy at the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki in Greece, developed a new method for analyzing GNSS data to better capture the changes in the planet's surface. He found that the poles are rising and the equator's bulge has been shrinking, each by about 0.04 inch (1 millimeter) per year between 2011 to 2015. That's a small number, considering Earth's diameter at the equator is about 7,926 miles (12,756 kilometers). But that change is bigger than between 1997-2000, when Earth was becoming about 0.02 inch (0.5 mm) rounder per year. This means Earth's shape is rounding at 0.016 inch (0.4 mm) more per year with each decade that passes.
paras.zh: 希腊塞萨洛尼基亚里士多德大学大地测量学教授 Christoforos Kotsakis 开发了一种分析 GNSS 数据的新方法，以更好地捕捉地球表面的变化。他发现，极地正在上升，赤道的隆起一直在缩小，2011年至2015年间，每年缩小约0.04英寸（1毫米）。考虑到地球赤道处的直径约为7,926英里（12,756公里），这个数字很小。但这一变化比 1997 年至 2000 年期间更大，当时地球每年圆约 0.02 英寸（0.5 毫米）。这意味着每十年过去，地球的形状每年都会以 0.016 英寸（0.4 毫米）的速度增加。

paras.en: The shift is being driven by polar ice melt, which takes pressure off the Earth's crust and allows it to rise slowly, similar to how rising bread dough springs back after you press a finger into it, Kotsakis reported. Meanwhile, increased mass toward the equator puts pressure on the crust there, reducing its bulge. However, there's a catch: When considering the solid Earth and the ocean together, the planet is getting flatter by about 0.03 inches (0.8 mm) a year because the ocean is getting bulgier at the equator as water shifts away from the poles. This 'water weight' overwhelms the rounding happening in the rock below.
paras.zh: 科察基斯报道说，这种转变是由极地冰融化推动的，它消除了地壳的压力，使其缓慢上升，类似于将手指按入面团后，上升的面团会弹回来。与此同时，朝向赤道的质量增加会对那里的地壳施加压力，从而减少其隆起。然而，有一个问题：当把固体地球和海洋放在一起考虑时，地球每年变得平坦约 0.03 英寸（0.8 毫米），因为随着水从两极转移，赤道处的海洋变得更加膨胀。这种“水的重量”压倒了下面岩石中发生的倒圆角。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: These shifts are also slowing Earth's rotation, other research has shown.
paras.zh: 其他研究表明，这些变化也减缓了地球的自转。

paras.en: Researchers also track Earth's changing shape using measurements of its gravity field, which varies depending on the mass of particular regions. GNSS changes and gravity field measurements don't match up perfectly, Kotsakis found, which indicates that the planet's shape and gravity field aren't in perfect lockstep. However, the two methods can be used together to track the major effects of climate change, especially the melting of Greenland and Antarctica and the varying movements of ocean water.
paras.zh: 研究人员还通过测量重力场来跟踪地球形状的变化，重力场的变化取决于特定区域的质量。科察基斯发现，全球导航卫星系统的变化和重力场测量结果并不完美匹配，这表明行星的形状和重力场并不完美同步。然而，这两种方法可以一起使用来追踪气候变化的主要影响，特别是格陵兰岛和南极洲的融化以及海水的变化运动。

paras.en: Stephanie Pappas is a contributing writer for Live Science, covering topics ranging from geoscience to archaeology to the human brain and behavior. She was previously a senior writer for Live Science but is now a freelancer based in Denver, Colorado, and regularly contributes to Scientific American and The Monitor, the monthly magazine of the American Psychological Association. Stephanie received a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of South Carolina and a graduate certificate in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·帕帕斯 (Stephanie Pappas) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，涵盖的主题从地球科学到考古学，再到人脑和行为。她曾是《Live Science》的高级撰稿人，但现在是科罗拉多州丹佛市的自由职业者，并定期为《科学美国人》和美国心理学协会的月刊《监视器》撰稿。斯蒂芬妮获得了南卡罗来纳大学的心理学学士学位和加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书。

articles.title: Scientists can now 'watermark' AI-generated proteins to deter bioweapon creation. But will it really work?
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: With artificial intelligence (AI), scientists have a powerful new tool for creating never-before-seen proteins, which can be used to make either groundbreaking new medicines or devastating bioweapons.
paras.zh: 借助人工智能 (AI)，科学家们拥有了一种强大的新工具来创造前所未见的蛋白质，这些蛋白质可用于制造突破性的新药物或毁灭性的生物武器。

paras.en: To help guard against nefarious uses of these proteins, scientists have recently figured out a way to "watermark" them without compromising their function. A team from Google DeepMind developed this technique to better track the provenance of AI-designed proteins.
paras.zh: 为了帮助防止这些蛋白质的恶意使用，科学家们最近找到了一种在不损害其功能的情况下给它们“加水印”的方法。谷歌 DeepMind 的团队开发了这项技术，以更好地追踪人工智能设计的蛋白质的来源。

paras.en: "This has the potential to reduce biosecurity threats, such as unauthorized toxin creation, and may help with database curation, preventing artificial designs from cluttering the standard databases," said Roy Sleator, a biology professor at Munster Technological University in Ireland, who was not involved in the research.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰蒙斯特理工大学的生物学教授罗伊·斯利特（Roy Sleator）没有参与这项研究，他说：“这有可能减少生物安全威胁，例如未经授权的毒素产生，并可能有助于数据库管理，防止人工设计扰乱标准数据库。”

paras.en: "In practice, it could help trace a design's origin, flag engineered proteins for extra biosecurity checks, and reduce misleading claims about how a protein was made," Sleator told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “实际上，它可以帮助追踪设计的起源，标记工程蛋白质以进行额外的生物安全检查，并减少有关蛋白质如何制造的误导性说法，”斯利特在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: However, in its current form, the same AI technologies that add watermarks can also strip them away, other experts warned.
paras.zh: 然而，其他专家警告说，就目前的形式而言，添加水印的相同人工智能技术也可以将其去除。

paras.en: The unveiling of the AI program AlphaFold in 2020 was a milestone in protein engineering. The tool, which won Demis Hassabis, John Jumper and David Baker the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2024, can reveal the 3D structure of a protein from the sequence of its building blocks, called amino acids. Proteins fold like origami, adopting 3D shapes that dictate their function.
paras.zh: 2020 年人工智能程序 AlphaFold 的推出是蛋白质工程领域的一个里程碑。该工具为 Demis Hassabis、John Jumper 和 David Baker 赢得了 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖，它可以根据蛋白质的组成部分（称为氨基酸）的序列揭示蛋白质的 3D 结构。蛋白质像折纸一样折叠，采用决定其功能的 3D 形状。

paras.en: However, AlphaFold's technology also opened the door to generating brand-new proteins that could be used to create biothreats, including viral proteins that can evade our immune systems and existing vaccines.
paras.zh: 然而，AlphaFold 的技术也为生成可用于制造生物威胁的全新蛋白质打开了大门，包括可以逃避我们的免疫系统和现有疫苗的病毒蛋白质。

paras.en: "Anything that can be used for good can be used for bad," said George Rose, professor emeritus of biophysics at Johns Hopkins University.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学生物物理学名誉教授乔治·罗斯说：“任何可以用来做好事的东西都可以用来做坏事。”

paras.en: Current screening tools identify novel dangerous or restricted molecules by seeing how similar their amino acid sequences are to those of recognized threats. But the problem is that AI could come up with proteins that don't look like anything we've ever seen. That's what the new watermarking technique aims to solve.
paras.zh: 目前的筛选工具通过观察其氨基酸序列与已识别威胁的氨基酸序列的相似程度来识别新的危险或限制分子。但问题是人工智能可能会产生与我们见过的任何东西都不一样的蛋白质。这就是新的水印技术旨在解决的问题。

paras.en: The DeepMind team has framed the watermarking effort as a "family" of related techniques they call SynthIDBio. The first member of this family is SynthIDBio-sequence, which encodes watermarks into the amino acid sequences of proteins created by a program called ProteinMPNN.
paras.zh: DeepMind 团队将水印工作定义为相关技术的“家族”，他们称之为 SynthIDBio。该家族的第一个成员是 SynthIDBio-sequence，它将水印编码到由 ProteinMPNN 程序创建的蛋白质氨基酸序列中。

paras.en: When users tell ProteinMPNN the desired 3D shape for their protein, it chooses amino acid options that ultimately fold into that shape. SynthIDBio-sequence subtly influences how the program chooses each amino acid according to a secret watermarking "key." Once the sequence is generated, anyone who knows the hidden code can assess how likely the sequence is to have been created under the key's bias. In their recent study, the DeepMind team showed that proteins built with this watermark could still bind to their targets as well as non-watermarked proteins.
paras.zh: 当用户告诉 ProteinMPNN 其蛋白质所需的 3D 形状时，它会选择最终折叠成该形状的氨基酸选项。 SynthIDBio 序列巧妙地影响程序如何根据秘密水印“密钥”选择每个氨基酸。一旦生成序列，任何知道隐藏代码的人都可以评估该序列在密钥偏差下创建的可能性有多大。在他们最近的研究中，DeepMind 团队表明，带有此水印的蛋白质仍然可以与其目标以及无水印的蛋白质结合。

paras.en: A sister technique, called SynthIDBio-structure, instead embeds a watermark directly into the protein's structure. It does this by altering the function of AlphaFold 3, DeepMind's flagship protein prediction algorithm.
paras.zh: 另一种名为 SynthIDBio-struct 的姊妹技术将水印直接嵌入到蛋白质结构中。它通过改变 DeepMind 的旗舰蛋白质预测算法 AlphaFold 3 的功能来实现这一点。

paras.en: When AlphaFold predicts a structure, SynthIDBio-structure gives it a side mission: The AI must make minuscule tweaks to how the atoms in the protein are arranged. These tweaks can be picked up by a detector later, and they're small enough that they don't look like obvious distortion.
paras.zh: 当 AlphaFold 预测结构时，SynthIDBio-struct 赋予它一个附带任务：人工智能必须对蛋白质中原子的排列方式进行微小的调整。这些调整稍后可以被探测器检测到，而且它们足够小，看起来不会像明显的失真。

paras.en: In a test, these two systems created hidden watermarks that could be detected with incredible accuracy, flagging more than 99% of watermarked proteins and correctly ignoring 99.9% of non-watermarked proteins.
paras.zh: 在测试中，这两个系统创建了隐藏的水印，可以以令人难以置信的精度检测到，标记超过 99% 的带水印的蛋白质，并正确忽略 99.9% 的非水印蛋白质。

paras.en: Live Science spoke to several experts who agreed that SynthIDBio was an impressive technical feat. However, they said it wasn't ready for widespread implementation yet.
paras.zh: Live Science 采访了几位专家，他们一致认为 SynthIDBio 是一项令人印象深刻的技术壮举。然而，他们表示尚未准备好广泛实施。

paras.en: The two techniques are "effective but brittle," Bruce Wittmann, a principal applied scientist at Microsoft, told Live Science in an email. That's because, as the DeepMind team also notes in their paper, the watermarks can be easily removed.
paras.zh: 微软首席应用科学家 Bruce Wittmann 在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》，这两种技术“有效但脆弱”。这是因为，正如 DeepMind 团队在论文中指出的那样，水印可以轻松删除。

paras.en: "For sequences, watermarks can be removed by 'resequencing' — effectively, altering the protein amino acid sequence such that the watermark is no longer detectable," Wittmann said. "For structures, watermarks can be removed by adding noise to or otherwise modifying the spatial coordinates of the structure." Screening tools wouldn't be able to detect if a watermark had been removed from a protein.
paras.zh: “对于序列，可以通过‘重新测序’来去除水印——有效地改变蛋白质氨基酸序列，使水印不再可检测到，”威特曼说。 “对于结构，可以通过添加噪声或以其他方式修改结构的空间坐标来去除水印。”筛选工具无法检测蛋白质中的水印是否已被去除。

paras.en: Experts are also skeptical that watermarking would provide a long-term solution for biosecurity.
paras.zh: 专家们还对水印能否为生物安全提供长期解决方案表示怀疑。

paras.en: An indelible watermark could identify who originally made a nefarious protein, or identify when a user was accessing a protein generation software without permission. This might deter some criminals, but terrorists looking to create a novel protein for a biological weapon would be less likely to care about being identified after a successful attack, said Max Brackmann, a chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear arms expert at the Spiez Laboratory in Switzerland.
paras.zh: 不可磨灭的水印可以识别谁最初制造了邪恶的蛋白质，或者识别用户何时未经许可访问蛋白质生成软件。瑞士施皮茨实验室的化学、生物、放射性和核武器专家马克斯·布拉克曼 (Max Brackmann) 表示，这可能会阻止一些犯罪分子，但寻求为生物武器制造新型蛋白质的恐怖分子不太可​​能在意在成功袭击后被识别。

paras.en: Additionally, the vast majority of software for protein prediction and generation is open-source, meaning much of the code is freely available to use and modify. That makes it far harder to bake watermarking into these programs. Wittmann warned that the field would have to shift toward closed-source models before watermarks could become an industry standard.
paras.zh: 此外，绝大多数用于蛋白质预测和生成的软件都是开源的，这意味着大部分代码可以免费使用和修改。这使得在这些程序中添加水印变得更加困难。威特曼警告说，在水印成为行业标准之前，该领域必须转向闭源模型。

paras.en: He added that watermarking could act as one layer of a biosecurity defense shield, rather than offering standalone protection. Top-down regulation would be challenging to enforce. "I imagine it would be very difficult to ensure the regulations were being followed," he said.
paras.zh: 他补充说，水印可以充当生物安全防御盾牌的一层，而不是提供独立的保护。自上而下的监管很难执行。 “我想确保这些规定得到遵守是非常困难的，”他说。

paras.en: Rose was even blunter about regulating the use of generative proteins.
paras.zh: 罗斯对于规范生成蛋白的使用甚至更加直言不讳。

paras.en: "I'm convinced it won't work," he said. "Once there's a sweet technology that does something, government regulation to keep it under wraps has never been really successful."
paras.zh: “我确信这行不通，”他说。 “一旦出现了一项有用的技术，政府对其进行保密的监管就从来没有真正成功过。”

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: RJ Mackenzie is an award-nominated science and health journalist. He has degrees in neuroscience from the University of Edinburgh and the University of Cambridge. He became a writer after deciding that the best way of contributing to science would be from behind a keyboard rather than a lab bench. He has reported on everything from brain-interface technology to shape-shifting materials science, and from the rise of predatory conferencing to the importance of newborn-screening programs. He is a former staff writer of Technology Networks.
paras.zh: RJ Mackenzie 是一位荣获奖项提名的科学与健康记者。他拥有爱丁堡大学和剑桥大学的神经科学学位。在决定为科学做出贡献的最佳方式是在键盘后面而不是在实验室工作台后面后，他成为了一名作家。他报道了从大脑接口技术到变形材料科学，从掠夺性会议的兴起到新生儿筛查计划的重要性等各个方面。他是《科技网络》的前特约撰稿人。

articles.title: 'Most people can't handle driving in 2 dimensions let alone 3': Readers respond to our poll about flying cars
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Last week, Tesla unveiled a new "flying" edition of its Roadster electric vehicle. While some experts remain skeptical that the new "Rocket" EV is feasible in the real world, the demonstration reignited a long-standing debate about whether flying cars could soon become a reality.
paras.zh: 上周，特斯拉推出了新款“飞行”版 Roadster 电动汽车。尽管一些专家仍然怀疑新型“火箭”电动汽车在现实世界中的可行性，但这次演示重新引发了关于飞行汽车是否很快成为现实的长期争论。

paras.en: In response to this demonstration, Live Science polled its readers on whether they think flying cars will be available to consumers in the next five years.
paras.zh: 为了回应这次演示，《Live Science》对读者进行了民意调查，询问他们是否认为飞行汽车将在未来五年内向消费者提供。

paras.en: Over 280 readers responded, with the largest voting group, 34% of readers, picking "No, we need more than five years for flying cars to take off." The next-highest voting bloc was even more skeptical with 23% of readers choosing "No, flying cars will never happen."
paras.zh: 超过 280 名读者做出了回应，其中最大的投票群体为 34%，他们选择“不，我们需要五年以上的时间才能让飞行汽车起飞。”投票第二高的群体更加持怀疑态度，23% 的读者选择“不，飞行汽车永远不会发生”。

paras.en: Several comments reflected this pessimistic view, with one commenter leaving this response: "No flying cars. In my almost 60 years of driving experience I find that most people can't handle driving in 2 dimensions let alone 3. Besides that we have face [sic] so many other problems: hunger, poverty, inadequate healthcare, the careless disregard for our planet. What are we leaving my grandchildren and great grandchildren??"
paras.zh: 一些评论反映了这种悲观的观点，其中一位评论者留下了这样的回应：“没有飞行汽车。在我近 60 年的驾驶经验中，我发现大多数人都无法在 2 维中驾驶，更不用说 3 维了。除此之外，我们还面临[原文如此]许多其他问题：饥饿、贫困、医疗保健不足、对我们星球的粗心漠视。我们会给我的孙子和曾孙留下什么？”

paras.en: Other commenters echoed this sentiment. "It will never happen as some cheap alternative to electric or petrol driven vehicles," one person responded. "Gravity is master on this planet so to rise above that and be floating or propelled around on some sort of air current, Nah! I cannot imagine the damage that will take place in any livable area, towns, suburbs, cities, parks, etc, etc., that list is endless. And imagine the protests should a general public be allowed to dive and fly above any or all livable areas."
paras.zh: 其他评论者也表达了同样的观点。一位人士回应道：“作为电动或汽油驱动车辆的廉价替代品，这种情况永远不会发生。” “重力是这个星球上的主宰，因此要超越重力并在某种气流的作用下漂浮或推动，不！我无法想象在任何宜居区、城镇、郊区、城市、公园等会发生的损害，这个清单是无穷无尽的。想象一下，如果允许普通公众在任何或所有宜居区上空潜水和飞行，将会引发抗议。”

paras.en: Not everyone was as adverse, with another commenter remarking on how far Tesla's technological development has come. "The flying roadster is a statement of what Mr. Musk can do with technology more than anything else. In the same way he can make the Roadster fly, be sure that the technology designed into the Tesla Y, the Cybercab or the Starship are at the very frontier of science. Mr Musk has singlehanded revolutionized the car industry and space travel in less than 20 years (the first Tesla car was sold in 2008). No small feat."
paras.zh: 并非所有人都持反对态度，另一位评论者评论了特斯拉的技术发展已经取得了多大进展。 “飞行跑车是马斯克先生最能利用技术做的事情的证明。就像他可以让 Roadster 飞起来一样，确保 Tesla Y、Cyber​​cab 或 Starship 中设计的技术处于科学的最前沿。马斯克先生在不到 20 年的时间里单枪匹马地彻底改变了汽车工业和太空旅行（第一辆特斯拉汽车于 2008 年售出）。这是一个不小的壮举。”

paras.en: Do you agree or disagree with our readers? Tell us your thoughts in the comments.
paras.zh: 您同意还是不同意我们的读者的观点？在评论中告诉我们您的想法。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: In a Hoard of 5,500 Viking Age Coins, Archaeologists in Norway Found One So Rare That They Already Consider It a 'National Treasure'

paras.en: In April, metal detectorists stumbled upon a massive cache of 1,000-year-old silver coins in eastern Norway. At the time, archaeologists were impressed by the sheer size of the find, known as the Mørstad hoard, which totals thousands of coins and counting. They hailed it as the largest Viking Age coin stash ever found in Norway.
paras.zh: 4 月，金属探测器在挪威东部偶然发现了大量拥有 1000 年历史的银币。当时，考古学家对这一被称为莫斯塔德宝藏的巨大发现印象深刻，其中总共有数千枚硬币，而且还在不断增加。他们称赞这是挪威迄今为止发现的最大的维京时代硬币储藏室。

paras.en: Now, researchers are even more excited about the cache. While cataloging the hoard, they found an exceedingly rare silver coin minted during the reign of Olaf II Haraldsson, a Norwegian king who later became the patron saint of Norway.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员对缓存更加兴奋。在对宝藏进行编目时，他们发现了一枚极其罕见的银币，该银币是在挪威国王奥拉夫二世·哈拉尔松（Olaf II Haraldsson）统治时期铸造的，他后来成为挪威的守护神。

paras.en: Anne Skogsfjord, an archaeologist with the University of Oslo’s Museum of Cultural History, was the one who discovered the coin. She didn’t realize its significance at first, until she took a closer look at the inscription: “ONLAF R+ NORMANORV,” which means “Olaf, King of the Norwegians,” according to a statement.
paras.zh: 奥斯陆大学文化历史博物馆的考古学家安妮·斯科格斯菲尤尔 (Anne Skogsfjord) 是发现这枚硬币的人。一份声明称，她一开始并没有意识到它的重要性，直到她仔细观察了铭文：“ONLAF R+ NORMANORV”，意思是“奥拉夫，挪威人的国王”。

paras.en: She was shocked, as only four coins of that type had ever been found before, just one of which was discovered in Norway, during the restoration of church ruins in 1924. Fewer than 20 coins minted under Olaf have ever been found, and most have been discovered outside of Norway.
paras.zh: 她很震惊，因为以前只发现了四枚这种类型的硬币，其中只有一枚是在挪威 1924 年修复教堂遗址时发现的。奥拉夫时期铸造的硬币不到 20 枚，而且大多数是在挪威境外发现的。

paras.en: “I realized that we had found a national treasure,” she says in the statement.
paras.zh: “我意识到我们发现了一件国宝，”她在声明中说。

paras.en: Jon Anders Risvaag, a numismatist at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, agrees with that characterization, adding that finding an Olaf coin is like “finding a needle in a haystack,” he tells Science Norway’s Ida Irene Bergstrøm. “There are so few of them.”
paras.zh: 挪威科技大学的钱币学家乔恩·安德斯·里斯瓦格（Jon Anders Risvaag）同意这一描述，并补充说，找到奥拉夫硬币就像“大海捞针”，他告诉《科学挪威》的艾达·艾琳·伯格斯特罗姆（Ida Irene Bergstrøm）。 “他们的数量太少了。”

paras.en: The obverse side of the coin features Olaf’s left-facing bust wearing a conical battle helmet, as well as a so-called Golgotha cross on three steps, inspired by Byzantine coinage. The other side depicts a double cross and an inscription that means “My leader, my lord.”
paras.zh: 硬币的正面是奥拉夫戴着圆锥形战斗头盔的左半身像，以及受拜占庭硬币启发的所谓各各他三级十字架。另一面描绘了一个双十字架和一个铭文，意思是“我的领袖，我的主”。

paras.en: The design, researchers say, is emblematic of Olaf’s bid to establish Christianity in Norway.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这一设计象征着奥拉夫在挪威建立基督教的努力。

paras.en: “It is a Christianization coin on a grand scale,” Svein Gullbekk, a numismatist at the University of Oslo, says in the statement. “We can see how Olaf used coinage to legitimize the new faith and to establish himself as a Christian king of European standing. This is branding.”
paras.zh: 奥斯陆大学钱币学家斯文·古尔贝克 (Svein Gullbekk) 在声明中表示：“这是一枚规模宏大的基督教化硬币。” “我们可以看到奥拉夫如何利用铸币来使新信仰合法化，并确立自己作为欧洲基督教国王的地位。这就是品牌。”

paras.en: Only three types of coins were issued under Olaf’s reign, so the king and his inner circle were probably intimately involved in the design and production process. “We can almost imagine Olaf himself holding this coin in his hand,” adds Gullbekk.
paras.zh: 奥拉夫统治时期只发行了三种硬币，因此国王和他的核心圈子可能密切参与了设计和生产过程。 “我们几乎可以想象奥拉夫本人手里拿着这枚硬币，”古尔贝克补充道。

paras.en: Coin production in Norway didn’t really take off until Harald Hardrada came to power in 1045 C.E. For Olaf, minting coins was likely more of a political power move than anything else.
paras.zh: 直到公元 1045 年哈拉尔德·哈德拉达 (Harald Hardrada) 掌权后，挪威的硬币生产才真正开始腾飞。对于奥拉夫来说，铸造硬币可能更多的是一种政治权力举动。

paras.en: “It’s someone pulling out all the stops and showing that he can do what people do abroad,” Risvaag tells Science Norway. “It’s a demonstration of kingship.”
paras.zh: 里斯瓦格告诉《挪威科学》杂志：“这是一个人使出浑身解数，证明他可以做国外人能做的事情。” “这是王权的体现。”

paras.en: However, this particular coin may also have been used as currency. It bears numerous small cuts that appear to have been made by a knife, which was a method of testing the silver content during transactions.
paras.zh: 然而，这种特殊的硬币也可能被用作货币。它有许多似乎是用刀划出的小切口，这是在交易过程中测试银含量的一种方法。

paras.en: Researchers think the coin was probably produced around 1024 to 1028, near the end of the Viking Age, then buried with the rest of the Mørstad hoard in the late 1040s. During those intervening years, the cut marks suggest it changed hands several times.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这枚硬币可能是在 1024 年至 1028 年左右生产的，接近维京时代末期，然后在 1040 年代末与莫斯塔德宝藏的其余部分一起埋葬。在此期间，切割痕迹表明它曾数次转手。

paras.en: Olaf, born around 995, first discovered Christianity as a young man, when he joined Viking raids against England and France. He was baptized in Rouen, France, around 1013. He became king not long after and ruled from 1015 to 1028.
paras.zh: 奥拉夫出生于 995 年左右，他在年轻时第一次发现了基督教，当时他参加了维京人对英格兰和法国的袭击。他于 1013 年左右在法国鲁昂受洗。不久后他成为国王，并于 1015 年至 1028 年统治。

paras.en: During his reign, he pushed for the acceptance of Christianity, and his 1024 religious code is considered the founding of the Church of Norway. His aggressive efforts to Christianize Norway sparked resistance, particularly in Trøndelag and the inland districts of eastern Norway, according to the museum.
paras.zh: 在他的统治期间，他推动接受基督教，他的1024年宗教法典被认为是挪威教会的创立。据博物馆称，他对挪威基督教化的积极努力引发了抵制，特别是在特伦德拉格和挪威东部的内陆地区。

paras.en: Olaf was killed in 1030 and canonized in 1031. His popularity skyrocketed after his death, with churches and shrines built in his honor across the world.
paras.zh: 奥拉夫于1030年被杀，并于1031年被册封。他的知名度在他去世后飙升，在世界各地为他建造了教堂和神社。

paras.en: - When Danish King Cnut conquered Norway in 1028, Olaf took refuge with his brother-in-law, Yaroslav the Wise, the Grand Prince of Kyivan Rus.
paras.zh: -当丹麦国王克努特（ Cnut ）于1028年征服挪威时，奥拉夫（ Olaf ）与他的姐夫，基辅罗斯（ Kyivan Rus ）大王子智者雅罗斯拉夫（ Yaroslav the Wise ）一起避难。

paras.en: - Olaf’s comeback attempt in 1030 failed, resulting in his death at the Battle of Stiklestad.
paras.zh: - 奥拉夫在1030年的复出尝试失败，导致他在斯蒂克莱斯塔德战役中阵亡。

paras.en: Historical accounts of Olaf are relatively scarce, so the newfound coin offers a rare and valuable glimpse into his life and royal power. The museum plans to feature it in an upcoming exhibition on the Mørstad hoard, marking the first time any part of the cache will go on public display.
paras.zh: 关于奥拉夫的历史记载相对较少，因此新发现的硬币为人们提供了了解他的生活和王权的罕见而宝贵的机会。博物馆计划在即将举行的莫斯塔德宝库展览中展示它，这标志着该藏品的任何部分将首次公开展示。

paras.en: In the meantime, researchers are continuing to catalog the hoard—a process that’s not likely to wrap up any time soon. The cache now contains an estimated 5,500 coins, according to the latest count.
paras.zh: 与此同时，研究人员正在继续对这些宝藏进行编目——这一过程不太可能很快结束。根据最新统计，该缓存目前估计包含 5,500 个硬币。

paras.en: “I am beginning to think that the hoard may soon exceed 6,000 coins,” Florent Audy, who is overseeing the Mørstad hoard cataloging process, says in the statement.
paras.zh: “我开始认为这些宝藏可能很快就会超过 6,000 枚硬币，”负责监督莫斯塔德宝藏编目过程的弗洛伦特·奥迪 (Florent Audy) 在声明中表示。

articles.title: These Big, Fierce Birds Found Love in Australia—and Laid the First Southern Cassowary Eggs at the Adelaide Zoo in 34 Years

paras.en: Finding love isn’t always easy—especially if you’re a southern cassowary, a massive, solitary bird with an aggressive reputation. But conservationists in Australia seem to have cracked the matchmaking code: A female cassowary recently laid two eggs after being paired with a potential mate.
paras.zh: 寻找真爱并不总是那么容易——尤其是如果你是一只南方食火鸡，一种体型巨大、独居且具有攻击性的鸟类。但澳大利亚的自然资源保护主义者似乎已经破解了配对密码：一只雌性食火鸡在与潜在配偶配对后最近产下了两个蛋。

paras.en: The large, bright green orbs are the first southern cassowary eggs laid at Adelaide Zoo in South Australia in more than three decades—and their arrival is an encouraging bright spot for a species facing an uncertain future.
paras.zh: 这些大而亮绿色的球体是三十多年来在南澳大利亚阿德莱德动物园产下的第一批南方食火鸡蛋，它们的到来对于一个面临不确定未来的物种来说是一个令人鼓舞的亮点。

paras.en: “This is really exciting news for us because it has been 34 years since we’ve had successful cassowary chicks here at Adelaide Zoo, so the team and myself included are very excited,” says Erin Kasteliz, team supervisor for birds at the zoo, in a statement.
paras.zh: “这对我们来说确实是令人兴奋的消息，因为我们已经 34 年没有在阿德莱德动物园成功饲养食火鸡雏鸟了，所以包括我在内的团队都非常兴奋，”动物园鸟类团队主管艾琳·卡斯特里兹 (Erin Kasteliz) 在一份声明中说道。

paras.en: Native to Australia, southern cassowaries are huge flightless birds found primarily in Queensland’s Wet Tropics and Cape York Peninsula; they also live in New Guinea and eastern Indonesia. Weighing up to 175 pounds and standing more than five feet tall, they’re the third-largest birds in the world, trailing behind emus and ostriches.
paras.zh: 南方食火鸡原产于澳大利亚，是一种巨大的不会飞的鸟类，主要分布在昆士兰州的湿热带地区和约克角半岛。他们还生活在新几内亚和印度尼西亚东部。它们重达 175 磅，站立高度超过 5 英尺，是世界第三大鸟类，仅次于鸸鹋和鸵鸟。

paras.en: Beyond their imposing size, southern cassowaries are known for their striking appearance. Inky-black feathers cover most of their bodies, contrasting with vibrant blue necks, two dangling red wattles and a Mohawk-like casque—a raised, bony structure—atop their heads.
paras.zh: 除了巨大的体型之外，南方食火鸡还以其引人注目的外观而闻名。墨黑色的羽毛覆盖了它们的大部分身体，与充满活力的蓝色脖子、两个悬垂的红色肉垂和头顶上的莫霍克式头盔（一种凸起的骨质结构）形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: Scientists don't know why cassowaries have casques atop their heads. But they recently discovered that this helmet-like head ornament fluoresces under ultraviolet (UV) light, a discovery that only deepens the mystery.
paras.zh: 科学家们不知道为什么食火鸡的头上有头盔。但他们最近发现，这种类似头盔的头饰在紫外线（UV）光下会发出荧光，这一发现只会加深谜团。

paras.en: Southern cassowaries have been recorded eating more than 200 different kinds of plants, and they play an important role in maintaining rainforest diversity by dispersing seeds via their droppings. They’re mostly solitary creatures, but they aren’t afraid to use their powerful legs and sharp claws to defend their turf when necessary.
paras.zh: 据记录，南方食火鸡吃 200 多种不同的植物，它们通过粪便传播种子，在维持雨林多样性方面发挥着重要作用。它们大多是独居动物，但在必要时它们并不害怕使用强大的腿和锋利的爪子来保卫自己的地盘。

paras.en: The International Union for Conservation of Nature considers southern cassowaries a species of least concern, but Australia lists them as endangered, with an estimated 4,400 individuals remaining on the continent. Their survival has been threatened primarily by habitat loss and fragmentation resulting from forest clearing for agriculture and infrastructure, but the species is also vulnerable to vehicle strikes, poaching, dog attacks and competition with feral pigs.
paras.zh: 国际自然保护联盟认为南方食火鸡是最不受关注的物种，但澳大利亚将其列为濒危物种，估计澳大利亚大陆上仅存有 4,400 只食火鸡。它们的生存主要受到农业和基础设施砍伐造成的栖息地丧失和破碎化的威胁，但该物种也容易受到车辆撞击、偷猎、狗攻击和与野猪的竞争。

paras.en: Some Australian zoos have captive populations, which are part of a breeding program managed by the Zoo Aquarium Association Australasia (ZAA). The organization maintains a studbook to help determine which birds should breed, with an overarching goal of maintaining genetic diversity.
paras.zh: 一些澳大利亚动物园有圈养种群，这是澳大利亚动物园水族馆协会 (ZAA) 管理的繁殖计划的一部分。该组织维护着一份血统簿，以帮助确定哪些鸟类应该繁殖，其总体目标是保持遗传多样性。

paras.en: Earlier this year, staff at the Adelaide Zoo got the go-ahead to try breeding their resident southern cassowaries: 10-year-old Martina and 13-year-old Jeffrey. Though the two birds seemed like a good match on paper, there was no guarantee sparks would fly when they met in person.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，阿德莱德动物园的工作人员获准尝试繁殖当地的南方食火鸡：10 岁的玛蒂娜和 13 岁的杰弗里。尽管这两只鸟在纸面上看起来很般配，但并不能保证它们见面时会擦出火花。

paras.en: Chad Crittle, the zoo’s director, compared the team’s matchmaking efforts to online dating, where it “might look like everything lines up really well. We like the same things and you might like the same food, but when you actually meet, it doesn’t always work,” he tells the New York Times’ Jennifer Sinco Kelleher. “And the same can be for animals in a zoo setting as part of these programs.”
paras.zh: 动物园园长查德·克里特尔 (Chad Crittle) 将团队的牵线搭桥工作与网上约会进行了比较，“可能看起来一切都很顺利。我们喜欢同样的东西，你可能喜欢同样的食物，但当你们真正见面时，它并不总是有效，”他告诉《纽约时报》的詹妮弗·辛科·凯莱赫 (Jennifer Sinco Kelleher)。 “作为这些计划的一部分，同样的情况也适用于动物园里的动物。”

paras.en: Fortunately, Martina and Jeffrey seemed to hit it off right away. When they were officially introduced in August, Jeffrey started preening Martina—and, later that same day, they copulated. After that, staff members saw them mating on "multiple occasions," Kasteliz says in the statement.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，玛蒂娜和杰弗里似乎一拍即合。当他们八月份正式见面时，杰弗里开始为玛蒂娜打扮——当天晚些时候，他们就交配了。卡斯特里兹在声明中说，此后，工作人员“多次”看到它们交配。

paras.en: This month, caretakers were overjoyed when they spotted two, fluorescent green eggs in the birds’ enclosure. And, they say, more could be on the way, as cassowary clutches typically contain three to five eggs. Whenever Martina is done laying eggs, it will be Jeffrey’s job to incubate them.
paras.zh: 本月，当饲养员在鸟舍内发现两个荧光绿色的蛋时，他们欣喜若狂。而且，他们说，可能还会有更多的蛋，因为一窝食火鸡通常含有三到五个蛋。每当玛蒂娜产完蛋后，杰弗里的工作就是孵化它们。

paras.en: According to Kasteliz, the eggs’ neon-green color helps them blend in with their surroundings.
paras.zh: 据卡斯特里兹介绍，鸡蛋的霓虹绿色有助于它们与周围环境融为一体。

paras.en: “That color comes from pigment in the shell and helps camouflage the egg," she says in the statement. "In the wild, cassowaries live in dense rainforest and will find a safe area amongst the leaves to lay, so that green helps keep the eggs hidden from predators.”
paras.zh: “这种颜色来自蛋壳中的色素，有助于伪装鸡蛋，”她在声明中说。 “在野外，食火鸡生活在茂密的雨林中，会在树叶中找到安全的区域产卵，因此绿色有助于防止捕食者发现它们的卵。”

paras.en: Zoo staffers don’t know whether the eggs are viable and will ultimately hatch into chicks. However, the sheer fact that Martina laid the eggs is a major win, since breeding southern cassowaries in captivity is so tricky. If the eggs do end up being viable, the zoo expects to have chicks in about 50 days—and Jeffrey would be responsible for rearing them.
paras.zh: 动物园工作人员不知道这些蛋是否能存活并最终能否孵化成小鸡。然而，玛蒂娜下蛋这一事实本身就是一个重大胜利，因为人工饲养南方食火鸡非常棘手。如果鸡蛋最终确实能存活，动物园预计大约 50 天后就会生出小鸡，而杰弗里将负责饲养它们。

paras.en: For now, the team is cautiously optimistic. They’re keeping an eye on Jeffrey and Martina, while also trying to give them their space. They plan to be largely hands-off to let Jeffrey “have his first go at doing this so he can learn,” Crittle tells the Times.
paras.zh: 目前，团队持谨慎乐观态度。他们密切关注杰弗里和玛蒂娜，同时也试图给他们空间。克里特尔告诉《泰晤士报》，他们计划在很大程度上不干涉，让杰弗里“第一次尝试这样做，这样他就可以学习”。

articles.title: Astronomers Detect the Oldest Known Fast Radio Burst, Spewed From an Ancient Galaxy Just Three Billion Years After the Big Bang
