articles.title: Brain scans reveal 'number line' that's used to mentally compare values
articles.author: Jenna Congdon

paras.en: Picture a number line, with the values running from the smallest to the largest. New research shows that the human brain uses a similar system when comparing numbers; in the study, scientists uncovered a "mental map" in which numbers have unique coordinates in the brain, which may help us place them in order of magnitude.
paras.zh: 想象一条数字线，数值从最小到最大。新的研究表明，人脑在比较数字时使用了类似的系统；在这项研究中，科学家们发现了一个“心理地图” ，其中数字在大脑中具有独特的坐标，这可能有助于我们将它们按数量级放置。

paras.en: "Numbers are abstract concepts, but our brains have ways of organizing them that allow us to compare and reason about their values," said study co-authors Daniela Valério, a postdoctoral researcher in the INSERM-CEA Cognitive Neuroimaging Unit (UNICOG) in France, and Stanislas Dehaene, the director of UNICOG.
paras.zh: “数字是抽象的概念，但我们的大脑有办法组织它们，使我们能够比较和推理它们的价值观，”该研究的共同作者，法国INSERM-CEA认知神经成像单元（ UNICOG ）的博士后研究员Daniela Valério和UNICOG主任Stanislas Dehaene说。

paras.en: "What is fascinating is that the brain can bring together numbers that look very different, such as integers [whole numbers] and fractions, within a common system," they told Live Science in a joint statement.
paras.zh: “令人着迷的是，大脑可以在一个共同的系统中将看起来非常不同的数字汇集在一起，例如整数[整数]和分数，”他们在一份联合声明中告诉Live Science。

paras.en: That system is a map for both sets of numerical values within the brain, they reported Thursday (Oct. 22) in the journal PLOS Biology.
paras.zh: 该系统是大脑内两组数值的地图，他们周四（ 10月22日）在PLOS Biology杂志上报道。

paras.en: To investigate how the brain represents different types of numbers, Valério, Dehaene and their colleagues used a high-resolution functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) scanner, which tracks blood flow through the brain as an indirect measure of activity. They measured brain activity in 20 adults while they worked through a simple task of comparing numbers — a mix of fractions and whole numbers — and determining whether each number was bigger or smaller than the previous one shown.
paras.zh: 为了研究大脑如何代表不同类型的数字， Valério、Dehaene和他们的同事使用了高分辨率功能性磁共振成像（ fMRI ）扫描仪，该扫描仪跟踪通过大脑的血流量作为活动的间接测量。他们测量了20名成年人的大脑活动，同时他们完成了一项简单的任务，即比较数字—分数和整数的混合—并确定每个数字是大于还是小于所示的前一个数字。

paras.en: The brain scans revealed distinct activity patterns in the anterior inferior parietal cortex — part of the brain that's known to be key for processing numbers. As participants compared numerical values, the brain region lit up in an organized pattern resembling a number line. The whole numbers and fractions were represented along this shared line according to their size, rather than being mapped in separate systems.
paras.zh: 大脑扫描显示了前壁下皮层（已知是处理数字的关键部分）的不同活动模式。当参与者比较数值时，大脑区域以类似于数字线的组织模式亮起。整数和分数根据它们的大小沿着这条共享线表示，而不是在单独的系统中映射。

paras.en: The brain's shared map brings different number formats into a common system based on the quantities they represent, the researchers concluded.
paras.zh: 研究人员总结道，大脑的共享地图根据它们所代表的数量，将不同的数字格式带入一个共同的系统中。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "For me, it is how the brain gets from a symbol to its meaning," said Abiot Derbie, a cognitive neuroscientist and founder of the company LifeByLogic, which makes psychology assessments.
paras.zh: 认知神经科学家、进行心理评估的LifeByLogic公司创始人Abiot Derbie说： “对我来说，这是大脑从符号到意义的方式。”

paras.en: The fraction "¼" contains the digit "4," but the fraction's value is much closer to zero, he noted. "The activity patterns reflected that numerical relationship, going beyond the digits themselves," Derbie, who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 他指出，分数“¼”包含数字“4” ，但该分数的值更接近于零。“活动模式反映了这种数值关系，超出了数字本身，”没有参与这项研究的德比在一封电子邮件中告诉Live Science。

paras.en: The idea that the brain represents numerical magnitude in the parietal lobe is not novel. However, scientists mostly understood how the brain dealt with whole numbers, while its strategy for fractions was not well understood. The new work builds on that existing research by exploring how both numerical magnitude and number type are processed together.
paras.zh: 大脑代表顶叶的数值大小的想法并不新颖。然而，科学家们大多理解大脑如何处理整数，而其分数策略却没有得到很好的理解。这项新工作建立在现有研究的基础上，探索了数字大小和数字类型是如何一起处理的。

paras.en: "To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate the geometry of neural representations in a task involving both integers and fractions," the researchers wrote in their report. "In the future, it might be interesting to expand the present work to decimal numbers."
paras.zh: “据我们所知，这是第一项在涉及整数和分数的任务中研究神经表示几何的研究，”研究人员在报告中写道。“将来，将目前的工作扩展到十进制数字可能会很有趣。”

paras.en: From previous work, "scientists already knew that fractions and whole numbers engage overlapping parts of the brain's number-processing network," Derbie said. "This study gives us a clearer picture of how their values are organized."
paras.zh: 从以前的工作中， “科学家们已经知道分数和整数与大脑数字处理网络的重叠部分有关，”德比说。“这项研究让我们更清楚地了解他们的价值观是如何组织的。”

paras.en: In the future, the team could examine how this neural representation varies across people of different ages, educational levels and mathematical backgrounds, Derbie suggested. The study also included only native French speakers, so may not reflect differences across language or culture.
paras.zh: Derbie建议，在未来，该团队可以研究这种神经表征在不同年龄、教育水平和数学背景的人之间的差异。该研究还仅包括母语为法语的人，因此可能无法反映语言或文化之间的差异。

paras.en: "I would want to see how this organization develops as people learn," Derbie said. For instance, the team could follow children before and after they learn about fractions, to see whether changes in brain activity accompany better understanding.
paras.zh: “我想看看这个组织如何随着人们的学习而发展，”德比说。例如，团队可以在儿童学习分数之前和之后跟踪他们，看看大脑活动的变化是否伴随着更好的理解。

paras.en: In the current study, the participants found it more difficult to compare fractions than to compare whole numbers, the researchers noted; they were slower and made more errors while working with fractions, which was expected. But the study's results don't offer hints as to why.
paras.zh: 在目前的研究中，研究人员指出，参与者发现比较分数比比较整数更困难；他们在使用分数时速度更慢，犯了更多的错误，这是预期的。但该研究的结果并没有提供有关原因的暗示。

paras.en: "Our study was not designed to explain why fractions are harder to learn or understand," Valério and Dehaene told Live Science. "What is new in our study is that we show that these different types of numbers are organized within a shared map in the brain."
paras.zh: “我们的研究不是为了解释为什么分数更难学习或理解，” Valério和Dehaene告诉Live Science。“我们研究中的新发现是，我们发现这些不同类型的数字在大脑中的共享地图中组织起来。”

paras.en: Valério, D., Debray, S., Karami, A., Cauté, M., Gravel, N., & Dehaene, S. (2026). A cortical semantic map integrates fractions and integers in the human brain. PLOS Biology, 24(10), e3003820. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003820
paras.zh: Valério, D., Debray, S., Karami, A., Cauté, M., Gravel, N., & Dehaene, S. (2026).皮层语义映射集成了人脑中的分数和整数。PLOS Biology ， 24 (10) ， e3003820。https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003820

articles.title: Crows may make lightning-fast decisions, sometimes twice as fast as humans, study hints
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Crows are intelligent animals that can use tools, hold grudges and even host funerals. Now, new research suggests these birds can make certain decisions faster than humans and monkeys — another potential sign of their smarts, the researchers argue.
paras.zh: 乌鸦是聪明的动物，可以使用工具，怀恨在心，甚至举办葬礼。现在，新的研究表明，这些鸟类可以比人类和猴子更快地做出某些决定--研究人员认为，这是它们聪明的另一个潜在标志。

paras.en: In a study published Thursday (Oct. 22) in the journal Science, researchers found that two carrion crows (Corvus corone) could distinguish the direction of moving dots on a screen in an average of 235 milliseconds, or less than a quarter of a second. By contrast, historical studies of humans suggest they make decisions in similar tasks six seconds as fast.
paras.zh: 在周四（ 10月22日）发表在《科学》杂志上的一项研究中，研究人员发现，两只腐肉乌鸦（ Corvus corone ）平均可以在235毫秒或不到四分之一秒的时间内分辨出屏幕上移动点的方向。相比之下，对人类的历史研究表明，他们在类似任务中做出决定的速度要快6秒。

paras.en: The birds were highly accurate, and recordings of their brain activity suggested that their decision-making process resembled that seen in primates and humans.
paras.zh: 这些鸟类非常准确，它们的大脑活动记录表明，它们的决策过程类似于灵长类动物和人类。

paras.en: Given birds and mammals have evolved along separate paths for more than 310 million years, "this suggests that evolution may have independently developed similar solutions to the same computational problem," study co-author Andreas Nieder, a professor of animal physiology and director of the Institute of Neurobiology at the University of Tübingen in Germany, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 鉴于鸟类和哺乳动物已经沿着不同的路径进化了超过3.1亿年， “这表明进化可能已经独立地为相同的计算问题开发了类似的解决方案，”该研究的共同作者，德国图宾根大学动物生理学教授兼神经生物学研究所所长Andreas Nieder在一封电子邮件中告诉Live Science。

paras.en: To understand how crows make decisions using cues in their environments, the researchers trained two carrion crows to complete a visual task on a touchscreen. The birds watched a cloud of white dots moving against a black background. Some dots moved to the left or right while others moved randomly. The crows had to determine the predominant direction of the dots' movement and peck the corresponding target on the screen to earn a mealworm reward.
paras.zh: 为了了解乌鸦如何利用环境中的线索做出决策，研究人员训练了两只腐肉乌鸦在触摸屏上完成视觉任务。鸟儿们看着一团白点在黑色背景上移动。一些点向左或向右移动，而另一些点则随机移动。乌鸦必须确定圆点运动的主要方向，并在屏幕上啄食相应的目标，才能获得粉虫奖励。

paras.en: By changing the proportion of dots moving together, the researchers could make the decision easier or harder for the crow. When most dots moved in the same direction, the answer was fairly obvious for the birds. But when only a small percentage moved together, the birds had weaker visual evidence to base their decisions on.
paras.zh: 通过改变点在一起移动的比例，研究人员可以使乌鸦的决定更容易或更难。当大多数点朝同一个方向移动时，对于鸟类来说，答案是显而易见的。但是，当只有一小部分鸟类一起移动时，它们的视觉证据就更弱了。

paras.en: The crows reached nearly 100% accuracy when many dots were involved and the motion was clear. But even when just 3% of the dots moved in concert, both birds performed significantly better than just guessing, getting the answer right 50% of the time.
paras.zh: 当涉及到许多点并且运动清晰时，乌鸦达到了近100 ％的准确度。但即使只有3%的圆点一致移动，两只鸟的表现也比仅仅猜测要好得多， 50%的时间都得到了正确的答案。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The birds maintained high accuracy in different rounds of the experiment, suggesting they were not sacrificing judgement for quickness.
paras.zh: 这些鸟在实验的不同回合中保持了很高的准确性，这表明它们并没有为了快速而牺牲判断力。

paras.en: The study did not directly compare crows to humans and monkeys performing the exact same task. However, previous studies suggest that humans and monkeys take roughly twice as long on comparable, self-paced visual motion tasks.
paras.zh: 这项研究没有直接将乌鸦与执行完全相同任务的人类和猴子进行比较。然而，之前的研究表明，人类和猴子在类似的自定进度的视觉运动任务上花费了大约两倍的时间。

paras.en: To understand how the birds reached their decisions so quickly, the researchers recorded activity from 248 neurons in the nidopallium caudolaterale (NCL) — a region of the bird brain that's considered functionally comparable to the prefrontal cortex in humans and primates. Birds lack the layered cerebral cortex found in mammalian brains, but the NCL performs similarly advanced functions.
paras.zh: 为了理解鸟类是如何如此迅速地做出决定的，研究人员记录了尾侧尼氏钯（ NCL ）中248个神经元的活动，该区域被认为在功能上可与人类和灵长类动物的前额叶皮层相媲美。鸟类缺乏哺乳动物大脑中发现的分层大脑皮层，但NCL具有类似的高级功能。

paras.en: In primates, neurons accumulate sensory information and their activity increases until it hits a critical threshold and the brain reaches a decision. The new findings suggest that crows use a comparable process, the researchers concluded.
paras.zh: 在灵长类动物中，神经元积累感官信息，其活动增加，直到达到临界阈值，大脑做出决定。研究人员得出结论，新发现表明乌鸦使用类似的过程。

paras.en: "The bigger implication is that a brain does not need a mammalian neocortex to perform sophisticated computations," Nieder said.
paras.zh: “更大的含义是，大脑不需要哺乳动物的大脑皮层来执行复杂的计算，” Nieder说。

paras.en: The team could use neural activity to predict the crows' eventual choice "as early as 70 milliseconds after" the dots appeared, Nieder said. That was roughly 170 milliseconds before the crows' behavioral responses, meaning their pecks at the screen.
paras.zh: Nieder说，该团队可以使用神经活动来预测乌鸦的最终选择， “最早可以在70毫秒后”出现。那是在乌鸦的行为反应之前大约170毫秒，这意味着它们在屏幕上啄食。

paras.en: The speediness of the crows' decision-making may reflect the demands of the birds' daily lives.
paras.zh: 乌鸦决策的速度可能反映了鸟类日常生活的需求。

paras.en: "Flight places enormous demands on visual processing and sensorimotor [sensation and movement] coordination," Nieder said. "Birds must navigate three-dimensional environments, avoid obstacles, and react quickly to moving objects. Finding food and capturing prey can also require rapid, precise decisions. These pressures may have favoured fast information processing."
paras.zh: “飞行对视觉处理和感觉运动协调提出了巨大要求，” Nieder说。“鸟类必须在三维环境中导航，避开障碍物，并对移动的物体做出快速反应。寻找食物和捕获猎物也需要快速、准确的决定。这些压力可能有利于快速的信息处理。”

paras.en: But for now, scientists don't know why crows seem to outpace primates in this particular type of decision-making. The study included only two birds and no direct comparisons to primates, so more work could be done to confirm the results and explore that question further.
paras.zh: 但就目前而言，科学家们不知道为什么乌鸦在这种特定类型的决策中似乎超过了灵长类动物。这项研究只包括两只鸟，没有与灵长类动物进行直接比较，因此可以做更多的工作来证实结果并进一步探索这个问题。

paras.en: For Nieder, observing the faster decision-making process in crows raises a broader question about how scientists define intelligence.
paras.zh: 对于Nieder来说，观察乌鸦更快的决策过程提出了一个更广泛的问题，即科学家如何定义智力。

paras.en: "Rather than assuming that the mammalian brain is the blueprint for intelligent behaviour," he said, "we can study different species to discover which computational principles are shared across animals and which reflect adaptations to their particular environments."
paras.zh: “与其假设哺乳动物的大脑是智能行为的蓝图，”他说， “我们可以研究不同的物种，以发现哪些计算原理在动物之间共享，哪些反映了对特定环境的适应。”

paras.en: Are you a bird nerd? Find out with our bird quiz!
paras.zh: 你是一个鸟类书呆子吗？通过我们的鸟类测验找出答案！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry是Live Science的内容经理。之前，她是Space.com的内容经理，之前是物理研究所JILA的科学传播者。肯娜也是一位书籍作者，她即将出版的书《章鱼X》计划于2027年春季发行。她的节拍包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、corvids和头足类动物。

articles.title: 'We're never going to come home': Artemis II commander recalls the most terrifying moment of his 10-day trip around the moon
articles.author: Dan Green

paras.en: TENERIFE, Spain — The commander of NASA's Artemis II mission briefly feared that he and his crew would never return home from their trip around the moon after overshooting their turn-back point.
paras.zh: 西班牙特内里费岛--美国宇航局阿尔忒弥斯II号任务的指挥官曾短暂地担心，他和他的船员在超过回头点后，再也不会从月球旅行中返回家园。

paras.en: Commander Reid Wiseman and his three crewmates were supposed to reach 219,667 nautical miles (252,788 standard miles, or 406,823 kilometers) — farther than any humans have ever traveled from their home planet — before turning back toward Earth on the sixth day of their 10-day mission to the moon.
paras.zh: 指挥官里德·怀斯曼（ Reid Wiseman ）和他的三名船员应该达到219,667海里（ 252,788标准英里，即406,823公里） —比任何人类从家乡星球旅行过的距离都要远—然后在他们为期10天的月球任务的第六天返回地球。

paras.en: But the odometer on the Integrity spacecraft continued to tick upward as they shot past their intended point of return, leading the astronaut to fear that something had gone terribly wrong, he told an audience here at the Starmus VIII festival earlier this week. (This semi-annual event is held to celebrate achievements in science, exploration, and creativity.)
paras.zh: 但他本周早些时候在Starmus VIII音乐节上告诉观众，当他们超过预期的回程点时， Integrity航天器上的里程表继续向上移动，导致宇航员担心出现了严重的问题。（这个半年度活动旨在庆祝科学、探索和创造力方面的成就。）

paras.en: "Mission control in Houston had told us our maximum distance would be 219,667 nautical miles and that was the furthest we were supposed to be from Earth," Wiseman said. "I was watching this number, and I saw it hit 219,667, and I thought, 'Great, this is the farthest we will be from Earth, and the next number I will see will be 219,666 — we'll be going home.' But about three minutes later, I didn't see 219,666; I saw 219,668. It went up. I was like. 'Huh? That's weird.'
paras.zh: 怀斯曼说： “休斯顿的任务控制中心告诉我们，我们的最大距离为219,667海里，这是我们应该离地球最远的距离。” “我看着这个数字，我看到它达到了219,667 ，我想， '太好了，这是我们离地球最远的地方，下一个我会看到的数字将是219,666 —我们将回家。“但大约三分钟后，我没有看到219,666 ；我看到了219,668。它上升了。我就像。“哼，怪怪的。”

paras.en: "And then about three minutes later, it goes to 219,669, and that was the moment that I felt real fear because I thought we had just gone too far — we're never going to come home — and so I was very scared," he added.
paras.zh: “然后大约三分钟后，它达到了219,669 ，那一刻我感到真正的恐惧，因为我认为我们走得太远了—我们永远不会回家—所以我很害怕，”他补充说。

paras.en: Then, at last, he saw the counter start to drop. Meanwhile, NASA astronauts Victor Glover and Christina Koch were at the window, doing science observations of the moon, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen was sending reports back to mission control — so Wiseman's moment of terror went unnoticed.
paras.zh: 然后，他终于看到柜台开始下降。与此同时，美国宇航局宇航员维克多·格洛弗（ Victor Glover ）和克里斯蒂娜·科赫（ Christina Koch ）在窗前对月球进行科学观测，加拿大航天局宇航员杰里米·汉森（ Jeremy Hansen ）正在向任务控制中心发送报告—所以怀斯曼的恐怖时刻没有被注意到。

paras.en: When Wiseman saw the odometer click back to 219,668 nautical miles, he said, "We're going home," and the crew let out a cheer. "I knew there was a good chance we might make it," he added.
paras.zh: 当怀斯曼看到里程表点击回到219,668海里时，他说： “我们要回家了。”船员们欢呼起来。“我知道我们很有可能成功，”他补充道。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: In an interview with Live Science's sister publication The Week Junior Science+Nature, Wiseman paid tribute to NASA's Earth-based teams for the ultimate success of the mission.
paras.zh: 在接受Live Science的姊妹出版物The Week Junior Science + Nature的采访时， Wiseman向NASA的地球团队致敬，感谢他们最终成功完成了这项任务。

paras.en: "Getting home safely is a testament to the engineering rigor and the flight control teams back here on planet Earth, who put this rocket together and then who controlled it as we went out to the moon and came back. Those are the true heroes of this mission. They have real courage."
paras.zh: “安全回家证明了地球上的工程严谨性和飞行控制团队，他们将这枚火箭组装在一起，然后在我们登上月球并返回时控制它。他们是这次任务的真正英雄。他们有真正的勇气。”

paras.en: The Artemis II mission launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida on April 1. It was the first crewed flight of the Orion space capsule and the first crewed mission to travel to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972, taking nearly 10 days to fly around the lunar far side and return to Earth.
paras.zh: Artemis II任务于4月1日从美国宇航局位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心发射。这是猎户座太空舱的首次载人飞行，也是自1972年阿波罗17号以来首次载人登月任务，花了近10天的时间绕月飞行并返回地球。

paras.en: Nearly every moment of the crew's activities in the Orion capsule was livestreamed to the world, garnering massive public interest in the mission. The Artemis II crewmembers were awarded the Stephen Hawking Medal for Science Communication at the Starmus VIII festival.
paras.zh: 船员在猎户座太空舱中活动的几乎每一刻都被直播到世界各地，引起了公众对这项任务的浓厚兴趣。阿尔忒弥斯II号船员在Starmus VIII音乐节上获得了斯蒂芬霍金科学传播奖章。

paras.en: Are you a NASA nerd? See how well you score on our Artemis quiz to find out!
paras.zh: 你是NASA的书呆子吗？看看您在阿耳忒弥斯测验中的得分情况，找出答案！

articles.title: The Canadian Artist Jean Paul Riopelle Was 'Completely Absorbed by the Act of Painting.' His Abstract Works Finally Have Their Own Home in a Quebec Museum

paras.en: Nearly 25 years after the death of one of Canada’s most celebrated modern artists, a brand-new pavilion at Quebec’s Musée National des Beaux-Arts is opening this week in his honor.
paras.zh: 加拿大最著名的现代艺术家之一去世近 25 年后，魁北克国家美术博物馆的一座全新展馆将于本周开放，以纪念他。

paras.en: The Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain Pavilion is named for the acclaimed Quebecois painter and sculptor Jean Paul Riopelle and Michael Audain, a philanthropist and co-founder of the Jean Paul Riopelle Foundation.
paras.zh: Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain 馆以著名的魁北克画家和雕塑家 Jean Paul Riopelle 和慈善家兼 Jean Paul Riopelle 基金会联合创始人 Michael Audain 的名字命名。

paras.en: Born in Montreal in 1923, Riopelle earned international recognition in the 20th century as an influential abstract expressionist. Riopelle’s unique “mosaic” style works, which he made by squeezing oil paint straight from the tube, then spreading it using a palette knife, gained particular renown.
paras.zh: 里奥佩尔 1923 年出生于蒙特利尔，作为 20 世纪颇具影响力的抽象表现主义画家而获得国际认可。里奥佩尔独特的“马赛克”风格的作品，他通过直接从管子中挤出油画颜料，然后用调色刀将其涂抹而制成，获得了特别的声誉。

paras.en: Riopelle was a key member of the Automatistes, a radical artistic movement founded in Quebec in the 1940s that was influenced by French surrealists and automatism, a philosophy of creating art without conscious thought. In 1948, the group published a controversial manifesto called Le Refus Global, or Total Refusal, which sought to shatter apart stodgy Quebecois culture with exhortations like: “Make way for magic! Make way for objective enigmas! Make way for love! Make way for what is needed!”
paras.zh: Riopelle 是 Automatistes 的重要成员，Automatistes 是 20 世纪 40 年代在魁北克创立的激进艺术运动，受到法国超现实主义者和自动主义的影响，自动主义是一种在没有意识思考的情况下创造艺术的哲学。 1948年，该组织发表了一份颇具争议的宣言，名为“Le Refus Global”或“全面拒绝”，旨在粉碎古板的魁北克文化，其劝告包括：“为魔法让路！为客观的谜题让路！为爱让路！为需要的东西让路！”

paras.en: Riopelle’s style was devoted to radical abstraction and spur-of-the-moment, unconscious creation—an ethos immortalized in his diverse array of art works, spanning his more than 50-year career.
paras.zh: Riopelle 的风格致力于激进的抽象和即兴、无意识的创作——这种精神在他 50 多年的职业生涯中的各种艺术作品中永垂不朽。

paras.en: “I paint all in one go, without stopping, whether it’s one canvas or ten, without wondering when it began or when it’ll end, completely absorbed by the act of painting,” Riopelle said, per a statement from the museum. “I have no idea if an hour has gone by, or a whole night!”
paras.zh: 根据博物馆的一份声明，里奥佩尔说：“我一口气画完，不停歇，无论是一张画布还是十张画布，都不知道它何时开始或何时结束，完全沉浸在绘画行为中。” “我不知道是一个小时过去了，还是一整晚过去了！”

paras.en: Riopelle’s vast body of work and artistic legacy now have a permanent home at the museum in Quebec City. The $61-million gallery, built with architectural nods to the artist’s home studio, comprises three stories and nearly 54,000 square-feet. It overlooks both the Plains of Abraham and the St. Lawrence River. With more than 130 of his works on display, the museum is officially home to the largest public Riopelle collection in the world.
paras.zh: 里奥佩勒的大量作品和艺术遗产现在在魁北克市的博物馆拥有永久的家园。这座耗资6100万$的画廊由三层楼和近54,000平方英尺的建筑组成，向艺术家的家庭工作室致敬。它俯瞰着亚伯拉罕平原和圣劳伦斯河。博物馆展出了130多件他的作品，是世界上最大的公共Riopelle收藏品的官方所在地。

paras.en: “Riopelle finally has a space entirely dedicated to him,” Jean-Luc Murray, the museum’s director, tells the Art Newspaper’s Hadani Ditmars. “The [museum] has long wanted to showcase his work while making it more accessible, and the Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain Pavilion does so brilliantly.”
paras.zh: “里奥佩尔终于拥有了一个完全属于他的空间，”博物馆馆长让-吕克·穆雷 (Jean-Luc Murray) 告诉《艺术报》的哈达尼·迪特马斯 (Hadani Ditmars)。 “[博物馆]长期以来一直希望展示他的作品，同时让其更容易接近，而 Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain 展馆做得非常出色。”

paras.en: The pavilion opens with four inaugural exhibitions that engage with Riopelle’s art and life in different ways. The primary show, “Riopelle: The Expression of Gesture,” is a permanent retrospective of Riopelle’s career, divided into seven themes on his constant artistic evolution. These include early works from his Automatiste era, 1950s mosaic works, depictions of bestiaries, prints of Quebec’s natural landscape and murals he created later in his life.
paras.zh: 展馆以四个开幕展览开幕，以不同的方式展示里奥佩尔的艺术和生活。主要展览“里奥佩尔：姿态的表达”是对里奥佩尔职业生涯的永久回顾，分为七个主题，展示他不断的艺术演变。其中包括他 Automatiste 时代的早期作品、20 世纪 50 年代的马赛克作品、动物寓言的描绘、魁北克自然景观的版画以及他晚年创作的壁画。

paras.en: “[Riopelle is] arguably Canada’s most internationally known artist,” Audain tells the Art Newspaper. “He broke new ground by painting the landscape in a way that no one had ever painted it before … I think the most important and innovative aspect of Riopelle’s work was disaggregating the landscape and reducing it to strokes of a palette knife.”
paras.zh: “[里奥佩尔]可以说是加拿大最国际知名的艺术家，”奥丹告诉《艺术新闻》。 “他以一种前所未有的方式描绘风景，开辟了新天地……我认为里奥佩尔作品中最重要和最具创新性的方面是分解风景并将其简化为调色刀的笔触。”

paras.en: The other three exhibitions shed light on Riopelle’s relationships, affiliations and perceptions. “Challenging: Modern Art in Quebec” features works by some 50 Quebecois modern artists, including other members of the Automatistes. In “Art and Emotions” visitors will be able to share the feelings evoked by Riopelle’s works in real-time in an effort to help the museum “design new artificial intelligence-based tools to personalize exhibition pathways,” according to the exhibition’s online description.
paras.zh: 其他三个展览揭示了里奥佩尔的人际关系、从属关系和看法。 “挑战：魁北克现代艺术”展出了约 50 名魁北克现代艺术家的作品，其中包括 Automatistes 的其他成员。根据展览的在线描述，在“艺术与情感”中，参观者将能够实时分享里奥佩尔作品所唤起的感受，以帮助博物馆“设计新的基于人工智能的工具来个性化展览路径”。

paras.en: Finally, the gallery will have a specially designed space for Riopelle’s largest work, a 130-foot-long work composed of 30 paintings. Entitled Tribute to Rosa Luxemburg, he created the wall-spanning masterpiece over a period of three months in 1992 following the death of Joan Mitchell, Riopelle’s partner of roughly 20 years.
paras.zh: 最后，画廊将为Riopelle最大的作品专门设计一个空间，这是一件由30幅画组成的130英尺长的作品。 1992 年，里奥佩尔大约 20 年的伴侣琼·米切尔去世后，他花了三个月的时间创作了这部名为《向罗莎·卢森堡致敬》的杰作。

paras.en: “After he experimented with sculpture, his paintings changed because he explored form in a different way,” André Gilbert, the new pavilion’s curator, tells La Presse’s Jean Siag. “Riopelle took lots of risks. He painted his Rosa fresco using stencils and spray paint, the tools of graffiti artists. It feels as if we’re dealing with five or six artists at once.”
paras.zh: “在他尝试雕塑之后，他的画作发生了变化，因为他以不同的方式探索形式，”新馆馆长安德烈·吉尔伯特告诉《新闻报》的让·西格。 “里奥佩尔冒了很多风险。他使用模板和喷漆（涂鸦艺术家的工具）绘制了《罗莎》壁画。感觉就像我们同时与五六位艺术家打交道。”

articles.title: One in Four Cases of Depression Could Be Caused by a Dysregulated Body Clock, Study Says

paras.en: One in four people with depression could have a newly identified subtype called “circadian depression” caused by a dysregulated body clock, suggests a new study.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，四分之一的抑郁症患者可能患有一种新发现的亚型，称为“昼夜节律抑郁症”，这是由生物钟失调引起的。

paras.en: The work, published in the British Journal of Psychiatry on October 21, deepens our understanding of depression and could lead to more effective intervention and treatment for people affected by this subtype.
paras.zh: 这项研究于 10 月 21 日发表在《英国精神病学杂志》上，加深了我们对抑郁症的理解，并可能为受这种亚型影响的人带来更有效的干预和治疗。

paras.en: “Depression is not a uniform illness, and understanding the characteristics of different subtypes means that we can give people earlier access to treatments that will be most effective for them,” says study co-author Emiliana Tonini to Lauren Roberts at the Australian Broadcasting Corporation.
paras.zh: “抑郁症并不是一种统一的疾病，了解不同亚型的特征意味着我们可以让人们更早地获得对他们最有效的治疗，”研究合著者埃米利亚娜·托尼尼对澳大利亚广播公司的劳伦·罗伯茨说。

paras.en: However, the study also had several limitations, and outside experts say that more research is needed before circadian depression can be classified as a subtype.
paras.zh: 然而，这项研究也有一些局限性，外部专家表示，在将昼夜节律抑郁症归类为亚型之前，还需要进行更多研究。

paras.en: To conduct the study, Tonini and her colleagues surveyed more than 11,000 Australians of European descent with severe depression and asked them about their sleep patterns, tiredness and other characteristics. The participants also provided saliva samples.
paras.zh: 为了进行这项研究，托尼尼和她的同事调查了超过 11,000 名患有严重抑郁症的欧洲裔澳大利亚人，并询问他们的睡眠模式、疲劳程度和其他特征。参与者还提供了唾液样本。

paras.en: The researchers found that 2,604 people met at least three of the researchers’ criteria for circadian depression: morning sleepiness, delayed sleep timing, social jet lag, excessive sleeping during depressive episodes and seasonality.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，2,604 人至少符合研究人员的昼夜节律抑郁标准中的三个：早晨嗜睡、睡眠时间延迟、社交时差、抑郁发作期间睡眠过多以及季节性。

paras.en: “It’s not only about the quantity or the amount of sleep, it’s really about the rhythm and the regularity of sleep,” Tonini explains to Alice Klein at New Scientist.
paras.zh: “这不仅与睡眠的数量或时间长短有关，还与睡眠的节奏和规律有关，”托尼尼向《新科学家》杂志的爱丽丝·克莱因解释道。

paras.en: Did you know? Sleep plays a role in longevity
paras.zh: 你可知道？睡眠在长寿中发挥着重要作用

paras.en: - A study published in December 2025 found a strong correlation between sleep and life span. The researchers discovered that sleep—more than diet, exercise and social connections—could predict life expectancy.
paras.zh: - 2025 年 12 月发表的一项研究发现，睡眠与寿命之间存在很强的相关性。研究人员发现，睡眠比饮食、锻炼和社交关系更能预测预期寿命。

paras.en: The team also found that those with the subtype had higher genetic risk factors for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and mood disorders, as well as “a series of metabolic and inflammatory markers,” says Tonini to Donna Lu at the Guardian. That suggests that with circadian depression, “there is an underlying biology that is quite distinct from other forms of depression.”
paras.zh: 托尼尼对《卫报》的唐娜·卢说，研究小组还发现，患有这种亚型的人有更高的注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）和情绪障碍的遗传风险因素，以及“一系列代谢和炎症标志物”。这表明，昼夜节律抑郁症“存在一种与其他形式的抑郁症截然不同的潜在生物学原理。”

paras.en: Those with circadian depression tended to have more severe mental health symptoms that began at a younger age compared to those with non-circadian depression. They were also less likely to respond to standard antidepressants like selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), which include drugs such as Prozac.
paras.zh: 与非昼夜节律抑郁症患者相比，昼夜节律抑郁症患者往往会出现更严重的心理健康症状，而且这些症状在较年轻的时候就开始出现。他们也不太可能对标准抗抑郁药产生反应，例如选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂（SSRI），其中包括百忧解等药物。

paras.en: “One of the things I hate most in the depression world is the name ‘treatment-resistant depression’—as if, if you failed two SSRIs or an SNRI, somehow your depression won’t respond. When really, you’ve been on the wrong track since the start,” says study co-author Ian Hickie, a psychiatrist at the University of Sydney, to Euan Black at the Financial Review. For people with this subtype of depression, drugs that target the circadian system are more likely to be effective, he suggests.
paras.zh: “在抑郁症领域，我最讨厌的事情之一就是‘难治性抑郁症’这个名字——就好像，如果你两次 SSRIs 或一次 SNRI 治疗失败，你的抑郁症就会以某种方式不起作用。事实上，你从一开始就走在了错误的道路上，”该研究的合著者、悉尼大学精神病学家伊恩·希基 (Ian Hickie) 在《金融评论》上对尤安·布莱克 (Euan Black) 说道。他建议，对于患有这种抑郁症亚型的人来说，针对昼夜节律系统的药物可能更有效。

paras.en: The findings are “really useful because they advance the field in terms of understanding the whole circadian rhythm aspect of depression and how it might be related to biological measures like genetics and inflammatory markers,” says Colleen Loo, a clinical psychiatrist at the University of New South Wales who wasn’t involved in the work, to New Scientist.
paras.zh: 未参与这项工作的新南威尔士大学临床精神病学家 Colleen Loo 对《新科学家》杂志表示，这些发现“非常有用，因为它们在理解抑郁症的整个昼夜节律方面以及它如何与遗传学和炎症标记物等生物学指标相关方面推动了该领域的发展”。

paras.en: However, they also have several limitations. For one, the study is based on self-reported data about symptoms, Loo tells Rachel Fieldhouse at Nature, so more work is needed to establish the connection between circadian rhythm and depression.
paras.zh: 然而，它们也有一些局限性。 For one, the study is based on self-reported data about symptoms, Loo tells Rachel Fieldhouse at Nature, so more work is needed to establish the connection between circadian rhythm and depression.

paras.en: The study’s sample size was also limited to people with European ancestry; future work needs to look at people from other populations. Andrew Coogan, a behavioral neuroscientist at Maynooth University in Ireland who wasn’t involved in the work, tells the Guardian that the proposed subtype has a “lack of detail as to how the cluster of features of, and the criteria for, the proposed circadian subtype of depression was arrived at.”
paras.zh: 该研究的样本量也仅限于有欧洲血统的人。未来的工作需要关注其他人群。爱尔兰梅努斯大学的行为神经科学家安德鲁·库根（Andrew Coogan）没有参与这项工作，他告诉《卫报》，拟议的亚型“缺乏关于如何得出拟议的抑郁症昼夜节律亚型的特征集和标准的细节”。

paras.en: “The results of this exploratory study are best interpreted as initial if interesting findings that warrant further examination,” he adds.
paras.zh: “这项探索性研究的结果最好被解释为初步的、有趣的发现，值得进一步检查，”他补充道。

articles.title: This Mysterious Medieval Manuscript Has Stumped Scholars for Well Over a Century. Could Its Pages Have Been Bound Out of Order This Whole Time?

paras.en: The Voynich Manuscript has been baffling researchers for over a century. Housed at Yale University’s Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, it is, on its surface, a handwritten and illustrated manuscript likely from 16th-century Europe. But no one (including artificial intelligence) has successfully deciphered its script, a language or code so unique that it has been dubbed “Voynichese.”
paras.zh: 伏尼契手稿一个多世纪以来一直困扰着研究人员。该书收藏于耶鲁大学拜内克善本和手稿图书馆，从表面上看，它是一份可能来自 16 世纪欧洲的手写和插图手稿。但没有人（包括人工智能）成功破译了它的文字，这种语言或代码如此独特，以至于被称为“伏尼契语”。

paras.en: As it turns out, there might be another reason why experts are unable to make sense of the Voynich Manuscript. According to a study recently published in the journal Digital Medievalist, there is “strong evidence” that the manuscript’s pages are incorrectly bound.
paras.zh: 事实证明，专家们无法理解伏尼契手稿的原因可能还有另一个。根据《数字中世纪主义者》杂志最近发表的一项研究，有“强有力的证据”表明手稿的页面装订不正确。

paras.en: While the manuscript is currently bound as a quire—several pages folded and sewn together to form a booklet—the study suggests it was originally designed as “a collection of individual bifolia,” or sheets folded in half to form two pages and stacked up and “meant to be read in sequence.”
paras.zh: 虽然手稿目前被装订成一本小册子——几页折叠并缝在一起形成一本小册子——但研究表明，它最初被设计为“一本单独的双叶书集”，即对折形成两页并堆叠起来的纸张，“旨在按顺序阅读”。

paras.en: “This means that any research that relies on the current sequence of pages needs to be revisited, since the manuscript is out of order,” study co-author Lisa Fagin Davis, the executive director of the Medieval Academy of America, tells Gizmodo’s Gayoung Lee.
paras.zh: “这意味着任何依赖于当前页面顺序的研究都需要重新审视，因为手稿的顺序是混乱的，”研究合著者、美国中世纪学院执行主任丽莎·费金·戴维斯 (Lisa Fagin Davis) 告诉 Gizmodo 的 Gayoung Lee。

paras.en: The Voynich Manuscript is named for Polish-American bookseller Wilfrid Voynich, who purchased the text from a Jesuit college in Italy in 1912. It was bequeathed and sold a few times before ending up at Yale in 1969.
paras.zh: 《伏尼契手稿》以波兰裔美国书商威尔弗里德·伏尼契 (Wilfrid Voynich) 的名字命名，他于 1912 年从意大利的一所耶稣会学院购买了该手稿。该手稿被遗赠并出售了几次，最终于 1969 年在耶鲁大学出售。

paras.en: The book’s pages are made of vellum, or calf skin, which has been carbon dated to the early 1400s; its earliest recorded owner lived in Germany in the late 1500s. The manuscript’s 240 pages are filled with colorful illustrations and lines of carefully inked, repetitive letters with a passing resemblance to modern Western alphabets.
paras.zh: 这本书的书页由牛皮纸或小牛皮制成，经碳测年可追溯到 1400 年代初期；有记载的最早主人生活在 1500 年代末的德国。这份 240 页的手稿充满了色彩缤纷的插图和精心涂墨的重复字母，与现代西方字母有些相似。

paras.en: “It could be a code, a lost language, nonsense or something else entirely,” Davis tells Gizmodo. “The illustrations are equally bizarre, with fantastical plants, astronomical and zodiacal diagrams, bathing women and other illustrations that are not interpretable yet.”
paras.zh: “它可能是一种代码、一种失落的语言、胡言乱语或完全是其他东西，”戴维斯告诉 Gizmodo。 “这些插图同样奇异，有奇幻的植物、天文和黄道图、沐浴的女人以及其他尚无法解释的插图。”

paras.en: Davis has studied the Voynich Manuscript before. In 2020, she concluded that five different scribes created the text. The differences between these scribes’ writing styles was key to the recent study, co-authored by Colin Layfield, an information scientist at the University of Malta.
paras.zh: 戴维斯之前研究过伏尼契手稿。 2020 年，她得出结论，该文本是由五位不同的抄写员创作的。这些抄写员的写作风格之间的差异是马耳他大学信息科学家科林·雷菲尔德 (Colin Layfield) 最近研究的关键。

paras.en: Building on a paper from May, Davis and Layfield applied latent semantic analysis, a technique that can compare "any two pieces of text and derive a similarity score based on the words that are present and how related they are to one another and how they are used in general,” per the study.
paras.zh: 根据这项研究，戴维斯和雷菲尔德在 5 月份的一篇论文的基础上应用了潜在语义分析，这种技术可以比较“任何两段文本，并根据出现的单词、它们彼此之间的相关程度以及它们的一般使用方式得出相似度分数”。

paras.en: Looks for patterns and similarities among the text’s symbols, they found that the pages of the manuscript alternate illogically in penmanship. One page will be written by one scribe, the next page by another, and so on. It doesn’t match the normal medieval manuscript creation process.
paras.zh: 在寻找文本符号之间的模式和相似性时，他们发现手稿的页面在书写上不合逻辑地交替。一页将由一名抄写员书写，下一页将由另一位抄写员书写，依此类推。它与正常的中世纪手稿创作过程不符。

paras.en: “Typically a single scribe writes in a quire ‘booklet,’ but the current binding has different scribes in the same quire, which, to be blunt, is simply not [how it is] done,” Layfield tells Gizmodo.
paras.zh: “通常由一个抄写员在一本奎尔‘小册子’中书写，但当前的装订在同一个奎尔中有不同的抄写员，坦率地说，这根本就不是[如何]完成的，”雷菲尔德告诉Gizmodo。

paras.en: There were other oddities, too, such as a large water stain on the top of the book that doesn’t appear symmetrically on concurrent pages, Davis tells Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove.
paras.zh: 戴维斯告诉《生活科学》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫，还有其他奇怪的地方，比如书的顶部有一个大水渍，但在并发页面上却没有对称地出现。

paras.en: Also, she adds, “there are several examples where the image goes off the page in the middle and comes out on the other side, even though there are a bunch of pages in between.”
paras.zh: 此外，她补充道，“有几个例子，图像从中间脱离页面并出现在另一侧，即使中间有很多页面。”

paras.en: It all suggests that the Voynich Manuscript was supposed to be “a collection of individual bifolia meant to be read in sequence,” per the study. At some point, those bifolia were incorrectly nested together.
paras.zh: 根据这项研究，这一切都表明伏尼契手稿应该是“一本旨在按顺序阅读的个体双叶书的集合”。在某些时候，这些双叶植物被错误地嵌套在一起。

paras.en: “Once you treat them as loose pages stacked together, all these artistic anomalies suddenly join up,” Layfield tells the Guardian’s Philip Oltermann.
paras.zh: “一旦你将它们视为堆叠在一起的松散页面，所有这些艺术异常就会突然结合在一起，”雷菲尔德告诉卫报的菲利普·奥尔特曼。

paras.en: There are still a lot of unknowns surrounding the Voynich Manuscript. The letters, or symbols, remain undeciphered. Experts have theorized that scribes purposefully encoded the text to keep it secret, or that they were attempting to put a written script to a mysterious language that was only ever spoken. Others believe the whole book is a hoax, written in gibberish by a medieval con man to dupe collectors.
paras.zh: 伏尼契手稿仍有很多未知之处。这些字母或符号仍然无法破译。专家推测，抄写员故意对文本进行编码以保密，或者他们试图将书面文字写入一种仅被使用过的神秘语言。其他人则认为整本书是一个骗局，是一个中世纪骗子用胡言乱语写的，目的是欺骗收藏家。

paras.en: “I think it’s likely we are looking … at an object that was made by a community that wanted to pass its knowledge forward,” Davis tells the Guardian. She says that some of the manuscript’s illustrations suggest its content relates to female sexuality and reproduction, as previous studies have suggested.
paras.zh: 戴维斯告诉《卫报》：“我认为我们可能正在寻找......一个由想要传播其知识的社区制造的物体。”她说，正如之前的研究表明的那样，手稿的一些插图表明其内容与女性性行为和生殖有关。

paras.en: The new research may give experts a new edge in their efforts to decipher the vexing manuscript, whose very existence may be owed to the person who incorrectly compiled it.
paras.zh: 这项新研究可能会给专家们破译这份令人烦恼的手稿的努力带来新的优势，这份手稿的存在可能要归功于错误编译它的人。

paras.en: “So few manuscripts have survived from the Middle Ages, because they weren’t bound,” Davis tells the Guardian. “The irony is that whoever misbound this manuscript still did us a huge favor by ensuring its survival.”
paras.zh: “中世纪幸存下来的手稿很少，因为它们没有装订，”戴维斯告诉卫报。 “具有讽刺意味的是，无论谁装订错误，这份手稿仍然帮了我们一个大忙，确保了它的保存。”

articles.title: The Google Home Speaker Has Been Secretly Eating My Wi-Fi Data
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: If you had to estimate how much data your smart speaker was using over the course of a couple of weeks, would you guess 3 terabytes? That's what one Google Home Speaker user discovered when he checked his home Wi-Fi's usage, according to Reddit posts reported on by 9to5Google. The Google Gemini–powered smart speakers have apparently been downloading huge amounts of data to the device over the past two weeks, which could put a serious damper on your Wi-Fi network.
paras.zh: 如果您必须估算您的智能音箱在几周内使用了多少数据量，您会猜是 3 TB 吗？据 9to5Google 报道的 Reddit 帖子称，一位 Google Home音箱用户在检查家里 Wi-Fi 使用情况时发现了这一点。过去两周，谷歌 Gemini 驱动的智能音箱显然已经向设备下载了大量数据，这可能会对你的 Wi-Fi 网络造成严重阻碍。

paras.en: While it isn't happening to everyone, after checking my own home internet usage, I found out that I have been experiencing the same issue. My Google Home Speaker has used 487 GB of data in the past 10 days, using almost as much as the entire rest of my home between August and September.
paras.zh: 虽然并不是每个人都会遇到这种情况，但在检查了我自己的家庭互联网使用情况后，我发现我也遇到了同样的问题。我的 Google Home 音箱在过去 10 天里使用了 487 GB 的数据流量，几乎相当于 8 月到 9 月期间我家里所有其他地方的数据流量。

paras.en: Google confirmed this bug has only affected some devices and that it has rolled out a solution. A spokesperson from Google told WIRED: “A server misconfiguration caused some Google Home Speakers to repeatedly download a software update. This issue has now been resolved.”
paras.zh: 谷歌确认此错误仅影响部分设备，并已推出解决方案。谷歌发言人告诉《连线》杂志：“服务器配置错误导致一些谷歌家庭音箱反复下载软件更新。这个问题现已解决。”

paras.en: Looking into this issue made me go beyond just Google's usage, though. My husband and I started reviewing the data usage for all of the individual devices that our router could identify and found some surprising numbers. The weirdest highlight was that Amazon was listed as using 22 GB in the past week with only the Ring smoke detector set up in my house, which was similar to the use of one of the smartphones in my house. There's also a mysterious device just labeled “WATCH” that used about 21 GB in the past week, but no one in my home has a smart watch that's been on in the last year. A mystery for me to solve another day.
paras.zh: 不过，对这个问题的研究让我超越了谷歌的使用范围。我和我的丈夫开始检查我们的路由器可以识别的所有单个设备的数据使用情况，并发现了一些令人惊讶的数字。最奇怪的亮点是亚马逊在过去一周被列为使用 22 GB，而我家中只安装了环形烟雾探测器，这与我家中一部智能手机的使用类似。还有一个神秘的设备，刚刚标记为“WATCH”，在过去一周使用了约 21 GB 的内存，但我家里没有人拥有去年一直在使用的智能手表。这是我改天要解开的谜团。

paras.en: If you've noticed your home Wi-Fi bandwidth isn't what it used to be, it could be because one of your smart home devices (or possibly something else entirely). Here's how to check your router or Wi-Fi provider for which device could be at fault.
paras.zh: 如果您发现您的家庭 Wi-Fi 带宽与以前不同，可能是因为您的智能家居设备之一（或者可能完全是其他设备）。以下介绍了如何检查您的路由器或 Wi-Fi 提供商，以确定哪些设备可能出现故障。

paras.en: You have a couple of options for checking how much data a smart home device has been using. Some routers provide detailed information about where all your data is going, for starters. I have an Eero mesh system for my house, but we don't pay for its subscription fee to access detailed information—so it's fairly limited. The free version of the app lists all the connected devices in my home, but it doesn't tell me how much data each uses.
paras.zh: 您有几个选项可以检查智能家居设备已使用的数据量。对于初学者来说，一些路由器提供有关所有数据去往何处的详细信息。我的房子有一个 Eero 网格系统，但我们不需要支付订阅费来访问详细信息，因此它相当有限。该应用程序的免费版本列出了我家中所有连接的设备，但它没有告诉我每个设备使用了多少数据。

paras.en: There are a lot of routers that have subscription fees and paywalls that can hide this information and other features you might want. But our favorite subscription-free mesh Wi-Fi system comes from Asus, which also makes our favorite regular Wi-Fi router, and you can track and analyze traffic for free with an Asus router. Here's how:
paras.zh: 有很多路由器都有订阅费和付费专区，可以隐藏这些信息和您可能想要的其他功能。但我们最喜欢的免订阅网状 Wi-Fi 系统来自华硕，它也是我们最喜欢的常规 Wi-Fi 路由器，您可以使用华硕路由器免费跟踪和分析流量。方法如下：

paras.en: - Open the web interface (go to http://www.asusrouter.com/ in your browser) and log in.
paras.zh: - 打开 Web 界面（在浏览器中访问 http://www.asusrouter.com/）并登录。

paras.en: - Click on the Traffic Analyzer tab and make sure it's turned on (data is refreshed every hour).
paras.zh: - 单击流量分析器选项卡并确保其已打开（数据每小时刷新一次）。

paras.en: - You can see the top five clients using data listed on the Statistic tab.
paras.zh: - 您可以查看使用“统计”选项卡上列出的数据的前五个客户端。

paras.en: - You can also see live traffic in the Asus Router app on your phone.
paras.zh: - 您还可以在手机上的华硕路由器应用程序中查看实时流量。

paras.en: Folks with a TP-Link router or mesh can also review traffic. Here's how:
paras.zh: 拥有 TP-Link 路由器或网状网络的人也可以查看流量​​。方法如下：

paras.en: - Tap on the Network tab and select Traffic Usage.
paras.zh: - 点击网络选项卡并选择流量使用情况。

paras.en: - What you see will depend on the model you have, but with some routers you can toggle on In-depth Statistics for more detailed information.
paras.zh: - 您看到的内容取决于您拥有的型号，但对于某些路由器，您可以打开“深入统计”以获取更详细的信息。

paras.en: Netgear only tracks overall traffic under Traffic Meter, you can't break it down by device. For other manufacturers it's worth poking around in the web interface. (It usually gives you access to more data than the mobile app.) If you're looking to get more information without hitting a paywall, explore both our router and mesh Wi-Fi guides for recommendations.
paras.zh: Netgear 仅在流量计下跟踪总体流量，您无法按设备对其进行细分。对于其他制造商来说，值得在网络界面中探索一下。 （它通常可以让您访问比移动应用程序更多的数据。）如果您希望在不付费的情况下获取更多信息，请浏览我们的路由器和网状 Wi-Fi 指南以获取建议。

paras.en: But even that limited information revealed which devices were gobbling up the most data in the recent days and weeks, which is how we discovered the issue with both the Google Home Speaker and the Ring smoke detector.
paras.zh: 但即使这些有限的信息也揭示了最近几天和几周内哪些设备消耗了最多的数据，这就是我们发现 Google Home Sound 和 Ring 烟雾探测器问题的方式。

paras.en: It's not a huge issue for me that my Google Home Speaker has been guzzling my data. I have a large Wi-Fi plan (a must as a smart home tester), and it was patched quickly. On the other hand, I have unplugged it for the time being to make sure I don't hit the 2 terabyte cap we have per billing period. But if you're on a plan where massive downloads like this can cost you, or your signal is getting clogged up by mysterious devices, it might be time to check your data usage to find out which device is at fault. You never know when you'll find a 3-terabyte bug slowing your whole network.
paras.zh: 我的 Google Home 音箱一直在消耗我的数据，这对我来说并不是一个大问题。我有一个大型 Wi-Fi 计划（作为智能家居测试人员必须的），并且很快就得到了修补。另一方面，我暂时拔掉了它的电源，以确保不会达到每个计费周期 2 TB 的上限。但是，如果您的计划中这样的大量下载可能会让您付出代价，或者您的信号被神秘设备堵塞，那么可能是时候检查您的数据使用情况以找出哪个设备出了问题。您永远不知道什么时候会发现 3 TB 的错误导致整个网络变慢。

articles.title: What to Know About Shamonda Virus Following the First Reported Human Infection
articles.author: Fernanda González

paras.en: France confirmed the death of the first person infected with the Shamonda virus, which is known to affect cattle, sheep, and goats and was previously considered non-transmissible to humans. The French government asserts that, based on current knowledge of this pathogen, there is no risk to the general public. It emphasized, however, that health authorities are continuing to investigate.
paras.zh: 法国确认第一例沙蒙达病毒感染者死亡，该病毒已知会感染牛、绵羊和山羊，此前被认为不会传染给人类。法国政府声称，根据目前对这种病原体的了解，对公众没有风险。但它强调，卫生当局正在继续调查。

paras.en: The report specifies that the case occurred in Lyon. The patient, who died earlier this month, suffered from severe immunosuppression, making this likely an exceptional case. “The neurological complications observed in the immunocompromised patient prior to his death were most likely related to infection with the Shamonda virus,” the official statement notes.
paras.zh: 报道指出，案件发生在里昂。该患者于本月早些时候去世，患有严重的免疫抑制，这可能是一个特殊病例。官方声明指出：“在免疫功能低下的患者去世前观察到的神经系统并发症很可能与沙蒙达病毒感染有关。”

paras.en: According to preliminary evidence, the patient contracted Shamonda virus from an insect bite. A tiny gnat known as the biting midge is known to be the primary route of transfer between animals. Since the virus was first identified in Nigeria in the mid-1960s, sporadic infections have been reported in livestock across Africa as well as in Japan. Cattle are considered the primary host because they develop visible symptoms. (Although sheep and goats can become infected, no obvious clinical signs have been documented in these animals.)
paras.zh: 根据初步证据，患者因昆虫叮咬而感染沙蒙达病毒。众所周知，一种被称为“叮蠓”的小昆虫是动物之间传播的主要途径。自 20 世纪 60 年代中期在尼日利亚首次发现该病毒以来，非洲和日本的牲畜中都有零星感染的报道。牛被认为是主要宿主，因为它们会出现明显的症状。 （虽然绵羊和山羊可能被感染，但这些动物没有明显的临床症状。）

paras.en: After animal is bitten by a midge carrying Shamonda virus, the infection has an incubation period of two to three days. Symptoms observed in animals include fever, diarrhea, and a decrease in milk production. When pregnant cows have become infected, the virus can cause miscarriages or severe deformations in the calf.
paras.zh: 动物被携带沙蒙达病毒的蠓叮咬后，感染的潜伏期为两到三天。在动物中观察到的症状包括发烧、腹泻和产奶量减少。当怀孕的奶牛被感染时，病毒会导致流产或小牛严重变形。

paras.en: To date, there is no vaccine, so prevention and control measures rely on the use of insecticides and repellents. That doesn’t mean you should panic. Public health authorities are considering the case to be “exceptional,” because the deceased patient was severely immunocompromised.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，还没有疫苗，因此预防和控制措施依赖于使用杀虫剂和驱避剂。这并不意味着您应该惊慌。公共卫生当局认为此案“特殊”，因为死者的免疫功能严重受损。

paras.en: Still, several European countries are on alert, because until a few months ago, this region was considered free of the virus. However, this summer, a new variant known as Shamonda-Europe was detected in livestock in Switzerland. Other cases were subsequently identified in Germany, France, Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands, Liechtenstein, Italy, and Spain.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，一些欧洲国家仍保持警惕，因为直到几个月前，该地区还被认为没有感染该病毒。然而，今年夏天，在瑞士的牲畜中发现了一种名为 Shamonda-Europe 的新变种。随后在德国、法国、奥地利、比利时、荷兰、列支敦士登、意大利和西班牙发现了其他病例。

paras.en: Spain’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Food states that two genetically distinct forms of the virus, known as Shamonda Type 1 and Shamonda Type 2, have been identified circulating in Europe. It adds that, in early September, infections of both types were confirmed on livestock farms in 37 provinces across France.
paras.zh: 西班牙农业、渔业和食品部表示，已发现两种基因不同的病毒形式在欧洲传播，即沙蒙达 1 型和沙蒙达 2 型。报告补充说，9月初，法国37个省的畜牧场都确认了这两种类型的感染。

paras.en: The case documented in France constitutes the first known infection in a person.
paras.zh: 法国记录的病例构成首例已知的人感染病例。

paras.en: “This is an important scientific finding. However, it is important to put this into perspective. The patient had a serious underlying illness that left them particularly vulnerable to infections, and we do not yet know whether Shamonda virus contributed to their death,” Ben Brennan, professor of virology at the University of Glasgow, said in a statement.
paras.zh: “这是一项重要的科学发现。然而，重要的是要正确看待这一点。该患者患有严重的基础疾病，这使他们特别容易受到感染，我们还不知道沙蒙达病毒是否导致了他们的死亡，”格拉斯哥大学病毒学教授本·布伦南(Ben Brennan)在一份声明中说。

paras.en: It’s premature to draw conclusions about the virus and it’s potential to infect humans, agreed David Roiz, a scientist Institute for Game and Wildlife Research in Spain. Many viruses “circulate naturally amongst mammals in tropical regions and cause sporadic cases in humans,” he said. “In a globalized world, where animals and goods are on the move and the climate is changing, it is not unusual for cases of human transmission to occur, and we should not be concerned; we simply need to monitor the situation, remain vigilant, and be proactive in addressing potential health risks.”
paras.zh: 西班牙游戏和野生动物研究所科学家戴维·罗伊兹（David Roiz）表示，现在就该病毒及其感染人类的​​可能性下结论还为时过早。他说，许多病毒“在热带地区的哺乳动物中自然传播，并在人类中引起散发病例”。 “在全球化的世界中，动物和货物不断流动，气候不断变化，人际传播病例的发生并不罕见，我们不应该担心；我们只需要监测情况，保持警惕，并积极应对潜在的健康风险。”

paras.en: This story originally appeared on WIRED en Español and has been translated from Spanish.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在《连线》西班牙语版上，并由西班牙语翻译而来。

articles.title: Palmer Luckey Made a Genetically Modified Military Dog Startup
articles.author: Kate Knibbs

paras.en: A new startup launched today with the definitely not terrifying mission of creating genetically enhanced dogs for the United States military, law enforcement, and emergency first responders.
paras.zh: 今天成立了一家新的初创公司，其使命绝对不可怕，那就是为美国军队、执法部门和紧急急救人员创造基因增强的狗。

paras.en: Warhound is the brainchild of Anduril’s Palmer Luckey and Colossal Biosciences cofounder Ben Lamm. The startup has raised $200 million to “rebuild America’s domestic supply of elite working dogs” and reduce dependency on European dog breeders for military canines.
paras.zh: Warhound 是 Anduril 的 Palmer Luckey 和 Colossal Biosciences 联合创始人 Ben Lamm 的创意。该初创公司已筹集 2 亿美元，用于“重建美国国内精英工作犬的供应”，并减少对欧洲军犬饲养员的依赖。

paras.en: Lamm tells WIRED that Warhound is in the process of gene-editing its first batch of dogs. The startup has already collected blood samples from specific "top-performing” military, police, and first responder dogs in the United States, and its goal is to clone them. Breeds will be “mostly Belgian Malinois, some labs, and some shepherds,” he says. The company anticipates the first round of puppies to be born in early 2027.
paras.zh: 拉姆告诉《连线》杂志，Warhound 正在对其第一批狗进行基因编辑。该初创公司已经从美国特定的“表现最好”的军犬、警犬和急救犬身上采集了血液样本，其目标是克隆它们。他说，品种将“主要是比利时玛利诺犬，一些拉布拉多犬，还有一些牧羊犬”。该公司预计第一轮小狗将于 2027 年初出生。

paras.en: The initial rounds of gene-editing will focus on eliminating common health conditions that impact these breeds, like hip dysplasia. Further down the line, Lamm envisions expanding to “really interesting things,” such as incorporating olfactory receptor genes from wolves to “enhance” the military dogs. (Colossal Biosciences is perhaps best known for its work on gene-edited wolves for its so-called Dire Wolf De-Extinction Project.)
paras.zh: 最初几轮的基因编辑将侧重于消除影响这些品种的常见健康状况，例如髋关节发育不良。进一步，拉姆设想扩展到“真正有趣的事情”，例如整合狼的嗅觉受体基因来“增强”军犬。 （Colossal Biosciences 最出名的或许是其在基因编辑狼方面的工作，即所谓的“恐狼去灭绝项目”。）

paras.en: Warhound, based in Texas, will also equip its canines with “Anduril’s advanced cybernetic Augments, software, and battlefield situational awareness,” according to a press release. Asked if this means the dogs will be some kind of cyborgs, Lamm clarifies that the plan right now is to supply them with tools like “advanced body armor” rather than, say, embedding some sort of computer in their dog bodies.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，总部位于德克萨斯州的 Warhound 还将为其警犬配备“Anduril 先进的控制论增强功能、软件和战场态势感知能力”。当被问及这是否意味着这些狗将成为某种机器人时，拉姆澄清说，目前的计划是为它们提供“先进防弹衣”等工具，而不是在它们的狗身上嵌入某种计算机。

paras.en: “So no dogs with lasers?” WIRED asked Lamm.
paras.zh: “那么没有带激光的狗吗？” 《连线》杂志问拉姆。

paras.en: “I can’t comment on what Anduril plans,” he says. “Dog safety and performance, and then helping continue helping to improve the human handler and dog bond, and working as a team—that is what the mission is.”
paras.zh: “我无法评论安杜里尔的计划，”他说。 “狗的安全和表现，然后继续帮助改善人类处理者和狗的关系，并作为一个团队工作——这就是我们的使命。”

paras.en: Neither Luckey nor Lamm will be involved in Warhound’s day-to-day, although Lamm is on the company’s board, he says. David Spirk, a former Department of Defense chief data officer who most recently worked at Palantir, is serving as chief executive, and investors include In-Q-Tel, Sequoia Capital, and ARK Invest. Luckey is not an owner and does not have equity in the company, nor does Anduril; Colossal Biosciences does have an ownership stake.
paras.zh: 他表示，尽管 Lamm 是公司董事会成员，但 Luckey 和 Lamm 都不会参与 Warhound 的日常事务。最近在 Palantir 工作的前国防部首席数据官 David Spirk 担任首席执行官，投资者包括 In-Q-Tel、红杉资本和 ARK Invest。 Luckey 不是该公司的所有者，也没有该公司的股权，Anduril 也没有； Colossal Biosciences 确实拥有所有权股份。

paras.en: Luckey and Lamm have been working on the project for over a year, Lamm says, and just recently decided to take the company out of stealth. “Someone said, ‘So it's like the Captain America dog program with the Ironman tech program on top of it,’” Lamm tells WIRED.
paras.zh: 拉姆说，拉基和拉姆已经在这个项目上工作了一年多，最近才决定让该公司不再隐秘。 “有人说，‘所以这就像美国队长的狗计划，加上钢铁侠技术计划，’”拉姆告诉《连线》杂志。

paras.en: Everyone can agree that this is normal, and good, and that when the precision-designed beasts arrive on Earth, they will recognize that we are not the enemy.
paras.zh: 每个人都同意这是正常的，也是好的，当精心设计的野兽到达地球时，他们会认识到我们不是敌人。

paras.en: The company plans to operate under the guidance of the American Humane Society.
paras.zh: 该公司计划在美国人道协会的指导下运营。

articles.title: U.S. Supreme Court says New Hampshire can limit student IDs for voting

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- The U.S. Supreme Court ruled Thursday student IDs in New Hampshire cannot be used for next month's midterm election.
paras.zh: 10 月 22 日（UPI）——美国最高法院周四裁定新罕布什尔州的学生证不能用于下个月的中期选举。

paras.en: In a brief court order, the justices granted an emergency request by the state, which was backed by the Republican National Committee.
paras.zh: 在一份简短的法院命令中，法官批准了州政府的紧急请求，并得到了共和党全国委员会的支持。

paras.en: The unsigned order said a federal judge should not have ordered voting rule changes so close to the Nov. 3 election, citing precedent.
paras.zh: 这份未签署的命令称，联邦法官不应在临近 11 月 3 日大选之际下令改变投票规则，并援引先例。

paras.en: "Here, the District Court did not point to anything that would justify deviating from that principle," the order said.
paras.zh: 该命令称：“在这里，地方法院没有指出任何可以证明偏离这一原则的理由。”

paras.en: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson was the sole dissenter. "I would not disturb a clearly justifiable federal court order issued to ensure that the public receives accurate information about a State's electoral processes," she wrote.
paras.zh: 法官科坦吉·布朗·杰克逊是唯一的反对者。她写道：“我不会干扰联邦法院发布的明确合理的命令，以确保公众收到有关州选举程序的准确信息。”

paras.en: A state law was already on the books that restricted the use of student IDs as a primary form of identification. The ruling means voters cannot use them as backups to establish their identities.
paras.zh: 州法律已经明文规定限制使用学生证作为主要身份证明形式。该裁决意味着选民不能使用它们作为备份来确定自己的身份。

paras.en: The dispute arose from a state law enacted in the spring that removed student IDs from a list of forms of identification which election officials would accept when a ballot is requested.
paras.zh: 这场争议源于今年春季颁布的一项州法律，该法律将学生证从选举官员在要求投票时接受的身份证明形式列表中删除。

paras.en: The law was challenged by nonprofit voting rights group Coalition for Open Democracy, which argued it unlawfully burdened the right to vote and discriminated against young voters
paras.zh: 该法律受到非营利投票权组织开放民主联盟的质疑，该组织认为该法律非法加重了投票权的负担并歧视年轻选民

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Joseph Laplante declined to block the law, but he earlier this month reconsidered the case and put guidance from Republican New Hampshire Secretary of State David Scanlan on hold.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官约瑟夫·拉普兰特拒绝阻止这项法律，但他本月早些时候重新考虑了此案，并搁置了共和党新罕布什尔州国务卿戴维·斯坎兰的指导。

paras.en: The guidance from Scanlan said student IDs could be used when people seek ballots, which Laplante ruled went further than the law, which barred them as a primary source of identification.
paras.zh: 斯坎兰的指导意见称，当人们寻求选票时可以使用学生证，拉普兰特认为这超出了法律的范围，法律禁止学生证作为身份证明的主要来源。

paras.en: A separate provision of New Hampshire law allows people to establish identities using other unofficial forms of ID. It says people can use "any other evidence that reasonably establishes that it is more likely than not that the person is who they claim to be."
paras.zh: 新罕布什尔州法律的另一项规定允许人们使用其他非官方形式的身份证件来建立身份。它说，人们可以使用“任何其他证据来合理证明该人更有可能是他们所声称的人”。

paras.en: Under the ruling by Laplante, election officials could still consider student ID in trying to determine if someone is a valid voter.
paras.zh: 根据拉普兰特的裁决，选举官员在确定某人是否是有效选民时仍然可以考虑学生证。

paras.en: The 1st U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals in Boston declined to stay Laplante's ruling, prompting the state to ask the Supreme Court to intervene.
paras.zh: 位于波士顿的美国第一巡回上诉法院拒绝维持拉普兰特的裁决，促使该州要求最高法院进行干预。

articles.title: France detects first human case of insect-borne Shamonda virus

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- French health officials on Thursday reported the first documented human case of Shamonda, an Africa-origin, insect-borne virus that was first detected in European cattle this summer.
paras.zh: 10 月 22 日（UPI）——法国卫生官员周四报告了首例有记录的人间沙蒙达病例，沙蒙达是一种原产于非洲的虫媒病毒，今年夏天首次在欧洲牛身上发现。

paras.en: France's Ministry of Health said in a statement that the patient infected with the Shamonda virus was severely immunocompromised and died early this month. The person had received treatment at the Hospices Civils de Lyon, it said.
paras.zh: 法国卫生部在一份声明中表示，感染沙蒙达病毒的患者免疫功能严重受损，于本月初死亡。据称，该人已在里昂民事临终关怀医院接受治疗。

paras.en: "Based on available knowledge about this virus, no health risk to the general population has been identified to date," the ministry said.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示：“根据有关该病毒的现有知识，迄今为止尚未发现该病毒对普通人群构成健康风险。”

paras.en: Health officials believe that the patient became infected through a vector, specifically the bite of a midge in eastern France, where the virus has been circulating among livestock since the spring.
paras.zh: 卫生官员认为，该患者是通过媒介感染的，特别是法国东部的蠓叮咬，该病毒自春季以来一直在该地区的牲畜中传播。

paras.en: "Until now, the Shamonda virus was considered incapable of being transmitted to humans," the French Ministry of Health said.
paras.zh: 法国卫生部表示：“到目前为止，沙蒙达病毒被认为无法传播给人类。”

paras.en: "The infection of this patient with Shamonda virus therefore constitutes the first documented and reported detection of the virus in a human."
paras.zh: “因此，这名沙蒙达病毒患者的感染构成了人类首次有记录和报道的该病毒的检测。”

paras.en: The European Center for Disease Prevention and Control said investigations were underway to understand whether the virus caused the patient's death or contributed to it as well as how the infection was acquired.
paras.zh: 欧洲疾病预防和控制中心表示，正在进行调查，以了解该病毒是否导致或促成了患者死亡，以及感染是如何获得的。

paras.en: Transmitted by midge bites, the Shamonda virus was first detected in Nigeria in the mid-1960s and has since been sporadically reported in cattle in West, East and Southern Africa, as well as Japan.
paras.zh: 沙蒙达病毒通过蠓叮咬传播，于 20 世纪 60 年代中期首次在尼日利亚被发现，此后在西非、东非、南部非洲以及日本的牛群中出现零星报道。

paras.en: The human infection follows the first-ever detection of Shamonda in European cattle this summer, according to the ECDC.
paras.zh: 据欧洲疾病预防控制中心称，今年夏天，欧洲牛群中首次检测到沙蒙达病毒，随后发生了人类感染。

paras.en: A U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention report states that dairy cattle in southern Germany and Switzerland have been affected by this virus since mid-June, while the ECDC states it has also been detected in farm animals in Austria, Belgium, Ireland, Italy, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain, as well as Jersey, a British Crown Dependency. French health officials said the virus was also sporadically identified in France.
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心的一份报告指出，自 6 月中旬以来，德国南部和瑞士的奶牛已受到这种病毒的影响，而欧洲疾病预防控制中心表示，在奥地利、比利时、爱尔兰、意大利、列支敦士登、卢森堡、荷兰、葡萄牙和西班牙以及英国皇家属地泽西岛的农场动物中也发现了这种病毒。法国卫生官员表示，法国也零星发现了这种病毒。

paras.en: The disease has caused symptoms including reduced milk yield, diarrhea, fever and lethargy.
paras.zh: 这种疾病引起的症状包括产奶量减少、腹泻、发烧和嗜睡。

paras.en: The ECDC and the World Health Organization have been notified, the French health officials said.
paras.zh: 法国卫生官员表示，欧洲疾控中心和世界卫生组织已收到通知。

paras.en: The ECDC and the WHO each said they were in contact with French authorities and were monitoring the situation.
paras.zh: 欧洲疾病预防控制中心和世界卫生组织均表示，他们正在与法国当局联系并正在监测局势。

paras.en: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said that because the patient was immunocompromised, it made them more vulnerable to infection and severe disease.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示，由于患者免疫功能低下，这使得他们更容易受到感染和患上严重疾病。

paras.en: "My heartfelt condolences to their loved ones," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“我向他们的亲人表示衷心的哀悼。”

paras.en: He said French authorities were collecting information to better understand the source of the infection, and possible routes of transmission and potential public health risks.
paras.zh: 他说，法国当局正在收集信息，以更好地了解感染源、可能的传播途径和潜在的公共卫生风险。

paras.en: Òscar Ordeig, agriculture minister for Agriculture for Catalonia in northeastern Spain, urged the public to remain calm, stating that "the detection of the virus does not imply, by itself, a high risk to the population."
paras.zh: 西班牙东北部加泰罗尼亚农业部长奥斯卡·奥尔代格（Òscar Ordeig）敦促公众保持冷静，并表示“检测到该病毒本身并不意味着人们面临高风险。”

paras.en: "The risk to humans in Catalonia is considered very low," he said online.
paras.zh: 他在网上说：“加泰罗尼亚对人类的风险被认为非常低。”

paras.en: "The work of veterinary teams, early notification and control of the vector insects are the main prevention tools. We act with rigor, coordination and transparency."
paras.zh: “兽医团队的工作、及早通知和控制媒介昆虫是主要的预防工具。我们的行动严谨、协调和透明。”

articles.title: U.S. imposes visa restrictions on nearly two dozen people in Colombia

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- The United States imposed visa restrictions on nearly two dozen people in Colombia on Thursday, expanding enforcement of a new policy to prohibit entry to those in Latin American whom the Trump administration accuses of corruption or narcotrafficking.
paras.zh: 10月22日（UPI）——美国周四对哥伦比亚近二十人实施签证限制，扩大了一项新政策的执行范围，禁止特朗普政府指控腐败或贩毒的拉丁美洲人入境。

paras.en: The State Department named seven former and current Colombian officials targeted by the visa restrictions, adding that the restrictions also apply to their families.
paras.zh: 美国国务院点名了七名前任和现任哥伦比亚官员的签证限制目标，并补充说这些限制也适用于他们的家人。

paras.en: Of those named, six have been linked to corruption or criminal investigations in Colombia, while the seventh, José Ignacio Mesa Betancur, a former congressman and mayor of Envigado, was convicted and sentenced to 76 months in prison in May 2025, with his conviction upheld in late August for his involvement in a criminal organization that financed his political campaigns and helped secure him votes going back to at least 1995, in exchange for influence over government decisions.
paras.zh: 在被点名的人中，有六人与哥伦比亚的腐败或刑事调查有关，而第七人是前国会议员兼恩维加多市市长何塞·伊格纳西奥·梅萨·贝坦库尔 (José Ignacio Mesa Betancur)，他于 2025 年 5 月被定罪并被判处 76 个月监禁，8 月底维持原判，因为他参与了一个犯罪组织，该组织为他的政治竞选活动提供资金，并帮助他确保选票至少可以追溯到 1995 年，以换取对政府决策的影响力。

paras.en: The others targeted include Ricardo Roa Barragán, the former president of state-run energy company Ecopetrol; Yahir Fernando Acuña Cardales, mayor of Sincelejo; Wadith Alberto Manzur Imbett, senator-elect and former member of the House of Representatives; Julio Elías Chagüí Flórez, former senator, and Liliana Esther Bitar Castilla, former senator.
paras.zh: 其他目标包括国营能源公司 Ecopetrol 前总裁里卡多·罗亚·巴拉甘 (Ricardo Roa Barragán)；辛塞莱霍市市长亚希尔·费尔南多·阿库尼亚·卡达莱斯 (Yahir Fernando Acuña Cardales)； Wadith Alberto Manzur Imbett，当选参议员、前众议院议员；前参议员胡里奥·埃利亚斯·查古伊·弗洛雷斯和前参议员莉莉安娜·埃丝特·比塔尔·卡斯蒂利亚。

paras.en: The punitive measures come as the Trump administration seeks to expand U.S. influence in the Western Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 这些惩罚措施是在特朗普政府寻求扩大美国在西半球的影响力之际出台的。

paras.en: In March, President Donald Trump announced the Shield of the Americas initiative to combat transnational criminal organizations alongside Latin American nations led by either right-leaning governments or those aligned with the U.S. president. Colombia and Peru joined the initiative following right-wing electoral victories.
paras.zh: 今年三月，唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布了“美洲之盾”倡议，旨在与右倾政府或与美国总统结盟的拉丁美洲国家一起打击跨国犯罪组织。哥伦比亚和秘鲁在右翼选举胜利后加入了该倡议。

paras.en: Then last month, at the second leaders' meeting in New York City, the 15 governments moved toward coordinated action, including issuing a declaration stating their intention to impose sanctions and visa restrictions on members, associates and supporters of 24 identified criminal organizations.
paras.zh: 上个月，在纽约市举行的第二次领导人会议上，15 个国家政府采取了协调行动，包括发表声明，表示打算对 24 个已查明的犯罪组织的成员、同伙和支持者实施制裁和签证限制。

paras.en: About a week later, the U.S. State Department unveiled a new policy to restrict visas to those whose actions through corruption or narcotrafficking undermine democratically elected governments in the Western Hemispher.
paras.zh: 大约一周后，美国国务院公布了一项新政策，限制向那些通过腐败或毒品贩运行为破坏西半球民选政府的人发放签证。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Thursday said that new policy targets foreign nationals "regardless of their political affiliation."
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周四表示，新政策针对的是外国人，“无论其政治派别如何”。

paras.en: "The Trump administration stands with the government of Colombia as it works to remove criminal influence, including from their courts police forces and legislature," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“特朗普政府与哥伦比亚政府站在一起，努力消除犯罪影响，包括法院、警察部队和立法机构的影响。”

articles.title: Cristian Castro Accepts the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award ‘In the Name of Romantic Love’
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: Cristian Castro became emotional on Thursday evening (Oct. 22) as he accepted the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award at the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards, delivering a poetic speech inspired by love.
paras.zh: 周四晚（10 月 22 日），克里斯蒂安·卡斯特罗 (Cristian Castro) 在接受 2026 年公告牌拉丁音乐奖颁发的公告牌终身成就奖时情绪激动，发表了充满爱的诗意演讲。

paras.en: “Romantic love and poetry are the only real things — the truest aspects of our human existence, the firmest thought, the clearest expression that emerges from our spirit and our hearts from the time we are children,” the pop icon remarked upon receiving the award from Mexican actress Jacqueline Bracamontes. “It is like when we first behold the soul — the serene calm of morning dew, the Moon, the majesty of a sunset — and that face, that presence, which fills your entire soul and which you cannot cast out from your being.”
paras.zh: 这位流行偶像在接受墨西哥女演员杰奎琳·布拉卡蒙特斯颁发的奖项时表示：“浪漫的爱情和诗歌是唯一真实的东西——我们人类存在的最真实的方面、最坚定的思想、从我们孩提时代起就从我们的精神和心灵中出现的最清晰的表达。” “就像当我们第一次看到灵魂时——晨露的宁静、月亮、日落的威严——还有那张脸、那个存在，它充满了你的整个灵魂，你无法将其从你的存在中驱逐出去。”

paras.en: “Throughout my life, romantic love has been my focal point and my true ambition — my firmament and my greatest longing,” continued the singer behind No. 1 hits such as “Amor” and “Azul.” “I accept this award in the name of romantic love and in the name of poetry; they are the most beautiful things I have ever possessed — gifts placed within me by God, alongside my voice.”
paras.zh: “在我的一生中，浪漫的爱情一直是我的焦点和我真正的抱负——我的天空和我最大的渴望，”这位创作了《Amor》和《Azul》等热门歌曲的歌手继续说道。 “我以浪漫爱情和诗歌的名义接受这个奖项；它们是我所拥有的最美丽的东西——上帝与我的声音一起赋予我的礼物。”

paras.en: Castro, who received the honor in recognition of a glittering career spanning more than three decades and his enduring influence on Latin music, also took to the stage for a special performance during the ceremony, broadcast live on Telemundo and Peacock from the James L. Knight Center in Miami. Together with the Mexican-American duo Ha*Ash, he performed their new collaboration “Antes Que Te Cases” live for the first time.
paras.zh: 卡斯特罗获得这一荣誉是为了表彰他三十多年的辉煌职业生涯以及他对拉丁音乐的持久影响，他还在颁奖典礼上登台进行了一场特别表演，并在迈阿密詹姆斯·L·奈特中心的 Telemundo 和 Peacock 频道进行了现场直播。他与墨西哥裔美国组合 Ha*Ash 一起首次现场表演了他们的新合作歌曲“Antes Que Te Cases”。

paras.en: The Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award honors an artist for an exceptional professional career — someone who has elevated Latin music to a new level on the global stage, remains relevant through their artistic and personal contributions, and whose influence has shaped the development of Latin music worldwide. Previous recipients include Andrea Bocelli, Armando Manzanero, Carlos Santana, José José, Maná, Marco Antonio Solís, Ricardo Arjona and Roberto Carlos, among others.
paras.zh: 公告牌终身成就奖旨在表彰一位在职业生涯中取得杰出成就的艺术家——他在全球舞台上将拉丁音乐提升到了一个新的水平，通过他们的艺术和个人贡献保持了影响力，并且他的影响力塑造了全球拉丁音乐的发展。此前的获奖者包括安德里亚·波切利、阿曼多·曼萨内罗、卡洛斯·桑塔纳、何塞·何塞、马纳、马可·安东尼奥·索利斯、里卡多·阿霍纳和罗伯托·卡洛斯等。

paras.en: Castro has solidified his place as one of the defining voices of Latin pop and romantic music. His history on the Billboard charts began in 1992 when “No Podrás” became his first entry on Hot Latin Songs, reaching No. 3. His debut album, Agua Nueva, climbed to No. 2 on Top Latin Pop Albums in January 1993. Since then, he has achieved six No. 1s on Hot Latin Songs, including “Nunca Voy a Olvidarte,” “Amor” and “Azul,” which spent four, eleven and nine weeks at the top, respectively. Years later, Viva El Príncipe, his tribute to legendary Mexican singer José José, spent seven weeks at No. 1 on Top Latin Albums in 2011.
paras.zh: 卡斯特罗巩固了他作为拉丁流行音乐和浪漫音乐的代表人物之一的地位。他在 Billboard 排行榜上的历史始于 1992 年，当时《No Podrás》成为他在热门拉丁歌曲上的第一首歌曲，达到了第 3 名。他的首张专辑《Agua Nueva》于 1993 年 1 月在顶级拉丁流行专辑中攀升至第 2 名。此后，他在热门拉丁歌曲排行榜上获得了六次第一名，其中包括《Nunca Voy a Olvidarte》、《Amor》和《Azul》，这些歌曲花费了 4、11 年的时间和顶部分别为九周。多年后，他向墨西哥传奇歌手何塞·何塞致敬的《Viva El Príncipe》在 2011 年拉丁专辑排行榜上连续七周排名第一。

paras.en: With over 12 million albums sold, Castro continues to connect with audiences through his Nada Solo Éxitos Tour, with performances at major venues such as the Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City and Madison Square Garden in New York.
paras.zh: 专辑销量超过 1200 万张，卡斯特罗继续通过他的 Nada Solo Éxitos Tour 与观众保持联系，并在墨西哥城国家礼堂和纽约麦迪逊广场花园等主要场馆进行演出。

paras.en: The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards brought together the biggest names in Latin music for a night of unforgettable performances, collaborations and special recognitions. In addition to Castro, special honorees this year included Rubén Blades, who received the Billboard Icon Award; Rosalía, who was honored with the Billboard Hall of Fame Award; and Fuerza Regida, who took home the Billboard Vanguard Award.
paras.zh: 2026 年 Billboard 拉丁音乐奖汇聚了拉丁音乐界最知名的人士，度过了一个令人难忘的表演、合作和特别认可之夜。除了卡斯特罗之外，今年的特别获奖者还包括荣获公告牌偶像奖的鲁本·布莱兹 (Rubén Blades)；荣获公告牌名人堂奖的罗莎莉娅；以及荣获公告牌先锋奖的 Fuerza Regida。

articles.title: LISA, Miley, Kacey Musgraves & John Mayer: New Music Friday Guide
articles.author: Lyndsey Havens

paras.en: Billboard’s Friday Music Guide serves as a handy guide to New Music Friday’s most essential releases each week — the key music that everyone will be talking about today, and that will be dominating playlists this weekend and beyond.
paras.zh: Billboard 的周五音乐指南是每周周五新音乐最重要版本的便捷指南 - 今天每个人都会谈论的关键音乐，并且将在本周末及以后的播放列表中占据主导地位。

paras.en: Last week, we featured Olivia Rodrigo feat. Chappell Roan, Tate McRae, Zach Bryan & Angèle.
paras.zh: 上周，我们特别报道了奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的壮举。查普尔·罗恩、泰特·麦克雷、扎克·布莱恩和安吉尔。

paras.en: This week, LISA drops her new EP; Miley features two new songs on the Nobody Wants This season three soundtrack; Kacey Musgraves shares a taste of her just-announced Middle of Nowhere Vol. 2: Tex Mex Tapes; and John Mayer is back with a new single and newly-launched label… plus much more.
paras.zh: 本周，LISA 发布了她的新 EP；麦莉在《Nobody Wants This》第三季配乐中收录了两首新歌；凯西·马斯格雷夫斯 (Kacey Musgraves) 分享了她刚刚发布的《Middle of Nowhere》卷的品味。 2：Tex Mex 磁带；约翰·梅尔 (John Mayer) 带着新单曲和新推出的厂牌回归……还有更多。

paras.en: Check out all of this week’s picks below:
paras.zh: 查看以下本周所有精选内容：

paras.en: Led by the hard-hitting pop-rap single “SaWaDiKa,” released in September, LISA is now sharing her very first solo EP. Focus track “Tarantino” packs just as hard a punch, while “Cobra” is an attitude-packed dance-pop song and album closer “Sweat” is a sultry song that leaves its subject with a simple instruction — “don’t stress me out” — and its listener wanting more. Press Play follows the 2025 release of LISA’S debut solo full-length, Alter Ego, and arrives just in time for the Thai singer’s upcoming Vegas residency that kicks off in November. — LYNDSEY HAVENS
paras.zh: 在 9 月份发行的强劲流行说唱单曲“SaWaDiKa”的带领下，LISA 现在正在分享她的第一张个人 EP。焦点曲目《Tarantino》同样具有强烈的冲击力，而《Cobra》是一首充满态度的舞曲流行歌曲，而专辑结尾的《Sweat》是一首性感的歌曲，它给主题留下了一个简单的指示——“别给我压力”——而听众则想要更多。 Press Play 紧接着 LISA 于 2025 年发行的首张个人长曲《Alter Ego》，正好赶上这位泰国歌手即将于 11 月开始的拉斯维加斯驻场演出。 — 林赛·哈文斯

paras.en: For longtime Miley fans, the release of “Cold Blooded” has been a long time coming. Written in the late 2010s ahead of her EP She Is Coming, the track never saw the light of day — until now. A demo version of the ballad, which showcases Miley’s undeniable vocal control and power over simple piano chords, is featured as a bonus track on the season three soundtrack for Nobody Wants This, out today. Its one of two Miley demos that made it on the album, as a stripped-down version of her Endless Summer Vacation track “You” also features on the soundtrack and in an episode. The soundtrack is out on Atlantic, while all 10 episodes of season three are now streaming on Netflix. — L.H.
paras.zh: 对于麦莉的长期粉丝来说，《冷血》的发行已经等了很长时间了。这首歌写于 2010 年代末，在她的 EP She Is Coming 之前，直到现在才面世。这首民谣的演示版本展示了麦莉不可否认的声音控制力以及对简单钢琴和弦的力量，它是今天发布的《Nobody Wants This》第三季原声带的附加曲目。这是麦莉在专辑中收录的两首小样之一，她的无尽暑假歌曲《You》的精简版也出现在原声带和一集中。该原声带已在 Atlantic 上发行，第三季的全部 10 集现已在 Netflix 上播放。 — L.H.

paras.en: Kacey Musgraves is previewing her upcoming project Middle of Nowhere Vol. 2: Tex Mex Tapes (out Jan. 15 on Lost Highway Records) with the release of new music, including “Weekend In Texas.” “I’ve got the hat and the cattle to back it up / Everything will be great in my favorite state of mind,” she sings. Bright horns, an irresistible groove and Musgraves’ dulcet vocal tones blend luxuriously as she sings of longing for a soul-restoring few days of escape in the Lone Star State. This new release feels both classic and invigorating. — JESSICA NICHOLSON
paras.zh: 凯西·马斯格雷夫斯 (Kacey Musgraves) 正在预览她即将推出的项目《Middle of Nowhere Vol》。 2：Tex Mex Tapes（1 月 15 日在 Lost Highway Records 发行），发行新音乐，包括“Weekend In Texas”。 “我有帽子和牛来支持它/在我最喜欢的心态下一切都会很棒，”她唱道。明亮的号角、令人难以抗拒的律动和马斯格雷夫斯悦耳的音调完美地融合在一起，她唱出了对在孤星州逃亡几天恢复灵魂的渴望。这个新版本感觉既经典又充满活力。 — 杰西卡·尼科尔森

paras.en: “I’m never gonna catch you,” sings Mayer over a soft rock opening riff that recalls Bruce Springsteen’s “I’m On Fire.” The lyric immediately sets the stage for his “Tom and Jerry” metaphor to unfold — likening the famous cat-and-mouse rivalry-fueled friendship to that of a relationship where those involved may just never get right. Mayer explained the song’s inspiration on Instagram, writing in a caption: “‘Tom and Jerry’ was the name I used when saving my first voice memo with this song idea. ‘And if you ever come through, which I doubt you’ll do, I’ll run away with you.’ From that moment on, the adventure began in bringing that feeling to life.” The single arrives on Mayer’s newly-launched Sob Rock Records label in partnership with Mercury. — L.H.
paras.zh: “我永远不会抓住你，”梅耶尔在轻柔的摇滚开场即兴重复中唱道，让人想起布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀的“我着火了”。这句歌词立即为他的“汤姆和杰瑞”隐喻的展开奠定了基础——将著名的猫鼠竞争所引发的友谊比作一种关系，其中所涉及的人可能永远不会和好。梅耶尔在 Instagram 上解释了这首歌的灵感，并在标题中写道：“‘汤姆和杰瑞’是我在用这首歌的想法保存我的第一个语音备忘录时使用的名字。‘如果你能成功，我怀疑你会这么做，我会和你一起逃走。’从那一刻起，冒险就开始了，将这种感觉带入生活。”这首单曲由 Mayer 与 Mercury 合作新推出的 Sob Rock Records 唱片公司发行。 — L.H.

paras.en: As the wait for Fike’s third album, How To Quit Smoking, continues — ahead of its pushed release to Oct. 30 — he shares another taste of what’s to come. “Pangea” sounds like a modern-day recording of an Atmosphere track in the best ways, balancing his melodic rapping with sunny, uptempo production resulting in a breezy song that, at just under two-and-a-half minutes, begs for a repeat. — L.H.
paras.zh: Fike 的第三张专辑《How To Quit Smoking》将于 10 月 30 日发行，等待时间仍在继续，他分享了对即将推出的专辑的另一种品味。 “Pangea”听起来像是一首 Atmosphere 歌曲的现代录音，以最好的方式平衡了他的旋律说唱与阳光明媚、快节奏的制作，从而形成了一首轻快的歌曲，在不到两分半钟的时间里，乞求重复。 — L.H.

paras.en: Norwegian indie-pop singer Girl In Red started teasing a new, pensive project earlier this month when she changed her Instagram handle to @girlinblue and updated her bio to read: “once red, now blue.” Now, just a few weeks later, she has dropped a four-song EP, aptly titled BLUE, exploring the heartbreak that accompanies a breakup. “There’s a hole in the door with your silhouette/ A void in my chest, the longer it’s been, the bigger it gets,” she sings at the start of “Missing Person.” The song quickly becomes an accountability anthem, with Girl In Red acknowledging, “In your absence, I’ve met with my actions…Have you seen this girl? ‘Cause I blew it with her.” Who knows if owning up will help, but at least it can offer some relief. — L.H.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，挪威独立流行歌手“Girl In Red”开始酝酿一个新的项目，当时她将自己的 Instagram 用户名改为@girlinblue，并将个人简介更新为：“曾经是红色，现在是蓝色。”现在，仅仅几周后，她就推出了一张四首歌的 EP，题为《BLUE》，探讨了分手带来的心碎。 “门上有一个洞，有你的剪影/我的胸口有一个空洞，时间越长，它就越大，”她在《失踪的人》的开头唱道。这首歌很快成为一首责任赞歌，红衣女孩承认，“在你不在的情况下，我已经认识到了我的行为……你见过这个女孩吗？因为我把它搞砸了。”谁知道承认是否会有帮助，但至少可以缓解一些压力。 — L.H.

paras.en: After overcoming underdog status to score of the biggest hip-hop hits of 2026 with her New York Knicks-approved “Spend Dat,” Yung Miami has finally unveiled her long-awaited debut solo studio album, Watch Dis. Featuring a wide range of collaborators, including Travis Scott, Summer Walker, Trina, Quavo and more, the 21-track set finds the City Girls alum grounding a revelatory autobiography in the history and culture of her hometown. — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 在凭借纽约尼克斯队认可的《Spend Dat》克服失败地位，成为 2026 年最热门嘻哈热门歌曲后，Yung Miami 终于推出了她期待已久的首张个人录音室专辑《Watch Dis》。这张包含 21 首曲目的专辑由 Travis Scott、Summer Walker、Trina、Quavo 等众多合作者组成，这位 City Girls 校友将一部以家乡历史和文化为基础的启示性自传。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: After linking up with Clipse and Pharrell Williams for the Let God Sort Em Out standout “The Birds Don’t Sing,” John Legend linked up with the Oscar-nominated production powerhouse for Muse, their first full album together after 20 years of friendship. Primarily written and recorded at Williams’ Louis Vuitton HQ studio in Paris, the two superstars spend the 16-track set blending luscious string arrangements with hard-hitting horns and 808s for what Legend calls a “Black James Bond aesthetic.” — K.D.
paras.zh: 在与 Clipse 和 Pharrell Williams 联手制作了《Let God Sort Em Out》中的杰出作品《The Birds Don't Sing》之后，John Legend 又与这位获得奥斯卡提名的制作巨头联手制作了《Muse》，这是他们 20 年后合作的首张完整专辑。这两位超级巨星主要在威廉姆斯位于巴黎的路易威登总部工作室创作和录制，这首包含 16 首曲目的专辑将甜美的弦乐编排与强劲的圆号和 808 融为一体，形成了 Legend 所称的“黑人詹姆斯·邦德美学”。 — K.D.
